DATA_CMM_0228.zht: 變長了，但還是會嘎吱作響。好像比較難拔出來。
DATA_CMM_0228.zhs: 变长了，但还是会嘎吱作响。好像比较难拔出来。

DATA_CMM_0229.ja: A loooong wall. Stray cats use it as a kind of highway at night.
DATA_CMM_0229.en: A loooong wall. Stray cats use it as a kind of highway at night.
DATA_CMM_0229.fr: Loooonnng mur. C'est une autoroute pour les chats de gouttière, gris, la nuit.
DATA_CMM_0229.de: Eine laaaange Mauer. Streunende Katzen nutzen sie nachts als eine Art Autobahn.
DATA_CMM_0229.it: Un muro molto lungo. I gatti lo usano come autostrada la notte.
DATA_CMM_0229.es: Un muro muuuuy largo. Es como una autopista para gatos callejeros.
DATA_CMM_0229.ko: 긴 벽. 고양이의 고속도로로서 애용받는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0229.zht: 超長的牆。好像被當成貓咪的高速公路。
DATA_CMM_0229.zhs: 超长的墙。好像被当成猫咪的高速公路。

DATA_CMM_0230.ja: That sharp, pointy end is just itching to poke some holes in things.
DATA_CMM_0230.en: That sharp, pointy end is just itching to poke some holes in things.
DATA_CMM_0230.fr: Son méchant bout pointu n'a qu'une envie : percer des trous partout.
DATA_CMM_0230.de: Das scharfe, spitze Ende ist wie geschaffen dafür, ein paar Löcher in Dinge zu stechen.
DATA_CMM_0230.it: Un attrezzo da montagna, lo stile ci guadagna.
DATA_CMM_0230.es: Cuidadito con andar haciendo agujeros por ahí sin ton ni son.
DATA_CMM_0230.ko: 끝이 무척 뾰족한 걸 보면 땅을 찍어 팔 의욕이 넘치는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0230.zht: 尖端非常鋒利，幹勁十足的要鑿出洞。
DATA_CMM_0230.zhs: 尖端非常锋利，干劲十足的要凿出洞。

DATA_CMM_0231.ja: Those tiger stripes must be some kind of warning.
DATA_CMM_0231.en: Those tiger stripes must be some kind of warning.
DATA_CMM_0231.fr: Ces bandes tigrées sont sûrement une sorte de signe.
DATA_CMM_0231.de: Diese Tigerstreifen müssen eine Art Warnung sein.
DATA_CMM_0231.it: Quelle strisce devono per forza voler dire qualcosa. Ma cosa?
DATA_CMM_0231.es: Se diría que intenta avisarnos de algo.
DATA_CMM_0231.ko: 호랑이 무늬가 그려져 있으므로 위험하다는 뜻이겠지…
DATA_CMM_0231.zht: 因為畫著老虎的花紋，應該是代表危險的意思吧。
DATA_CMM_0231.zhs: 因为画着老虎的花纹，应该是代表危险的意思吧。

DATA_CMM_0232.ja: Soft and runny, yet tastes like strawberries. It would be nice to have some bread to spread this on.
DATA_CMM_0232.en: Soft and runny, yet tastes like strawberries. It would be nice to have some bread to spread this on.
DATA_CMM_0232.fr: Elle a bien le délicieux goût des framboises. Un peu de pain pour faire une tartine ne serait pas de trop.
DATA_CMM_0232.de: Weich und flüssig, schmeckt aber nach Erdbeeren. Es wäre schön, etwas Brot zu haben, um es damit zu bestreichen.
DATA_CMM_0232.it: Marmellata di fragole. Dolce e deliziosa. A Noi piace contare i semini con la lingua.
DATA_CMM_0232.es: Muy rica, sobre todo si tienes pan donde ponerla.
DATA_CMM_0232.ko: 흐물흐물하지만 딸기 맛. 빵에 바르면 바~로 잘먹겠습니다~다.
DATA_CMM_0232.zht: 黏糊糊的草莓口味。塗在麵包上就能開動。
DATA_CMM_0232.zhs: 粘糊糊的草莓口味。涂在面包上就能开动。

DATA_CMM_0233.ja: A nice, round tree. Someone is obviously taking good care of it... but who?
DATA_CMM_0233.en: A nice, round tree. Someone is obviously taking good care of it... but who?
DATA_CMM_0233.fr: Arbuste sympa et rondelet. Quelqu'un s'en occupe. Mais qui ?
DATA_CMM_0233.de: Ein schöner, runder Baum. Jemand kümmert sich offensichtlich gut um ihn ... aber wer?
DATA_CMM_0233.it: Un bell'albero in buona salute. Qualcuno se ne sta sicuramente prendendo cura... Ma chi?
DATA_CMM_0233.es: Qué bonito arbusto, tan redondito... ¿Quién lo recortará? ¿El barbero?
DATA_CMM_0233.ko: 누군가가 손질한 나무. 깨끗하게 이발하고 둥글둥글하게 변했다.
DATA_CMM_0233.zht: 某人修剪過的樹。被修整得整整齊齊，變成漂亮的圓形。
DATA_CMM_0233.zhs: 某人修剪过的树。被修整得整整齐齐，变成漂亮的圆形。

DATA_CMM_0234.ja: It's called a bed, but flowers don't just sleep here.
DATA_CMM_0234.en: It's called a bed, but flowers don't just sleep here.
DATA_CMM_0234.fr: On appelle cela un parterre parce que les fleurs s'y terrent.
DATA_CMM_0234.de: Beet schreibt man fast wie Bett, aber Pflanzen schlafen hier nicht bloß.
DATA_CMM_0234.it: Aiuola. Troppe vocali, addirittura un polittongo.
DATA_CMM_0234.es: Es como tener una alfombra de flores en medio del jardín.
DATA_CMM_0234.ko: 좀더 이목을 끌고 싶어서 지면에서 점프한 꽃밭. 그 안은 꽃으로 가득하다.
DATA_CMM_0234.zht: 希望能看得更仔細而從地面凸起的花田。裡頭全開滿花朵。
DATA_CMM_0234.zhs: 希望能看得更仔细而从地面凸起的花田。里头全开满花朵。

DATA_CMM_0235.ja: A vital piece of civic decoration. Its lush greenery warms the hearts of anyone who passes by.
DATA_CMM_0235.en: A vital piece of civic decoration. Its lush greenery warms the hearts of anyone who passes by.
DATA_CMM_0235.fr: Élément essentiel des plates-bandes municipales, sa verdure remplit de joie le cœur des passants.
DATA_CMM_0235.de: Ein unverzichtbarer Teil der städtischen Dekoration. Sein üppiges Grün erwärmt die Herzen aller, die vorbeikommen.
DATA_CMM_0235.it: Vegetazione squadrata. Ora abbiamo visto davvero tutto.
DATA_CMM_0235.es: Es bueno poner rincones verdes en la ciudad para limpiar el aire y calmar los ánimos.
DATA_CMM_0235.ko: 녹색으로 마음을 편안하게 해 주는 거리의 소중한 장식품.
DATA_CMM_0235.zht: 用青翠的綠色使心靈平和。街道上重要的裝飾。
DATA_CMM_0235.zhs: 用青翠的绿色使心灵平和。街道上重要的装饰。

DATA_CMM_0236.ja: Sometimes contains a wonderful present. Sometimes contains a fruitcake.
DATA_CMM_0236.en: Sometimes contains a wonderful present. Sometimes contains a fruitcake.
DATA_CMM_0236.fr: Cache parfois un cadeau merveilleux... Ou seulement un gâteau aux fruits.
DATA_CMM_0236.de: Enthält manchmal ein wunderbares Geschenk. Enthält manchmal einen Obstkuchen.
DATA_CMM_0236.es: A veces contiene regalos estupendos y a veces cosas que preferirías no ver.
DATA_CMM_0236.ko: 별 것 아니라며 내밀곤 하지만 때로는 엄청난 물건들이 들어있기도 한 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0236.zht: 嘴上說是不成敬意的小東西，但有時裡面的禮物很厲害。
DATA_CMM_0236.zhs: 嘴上说是不成敬意的小东西，但有时里面的礼物很厉害。

DATA_CMM_0237.ja: Green for now, but when it grows up, it may become a completely different color.
DATA_CMM_0237.en: Green for now, but when it grows up, it may become a completely different color.
DATA_CMM_0237.fr: Vert pour le moment, mais lorsqu'il sera adulte, il pourrait prendre une tout autre couleur.
DATA_CMM_0237.de: Im Moment noch grün, aber wenn er ausgewachsen ist, wird er vielleicht eine ganz andere Farbe haben.
DATA_CMM_0237.it: Per chi ama il verde. Verde inteso come natura, non il colore. Forse anche il colore...
DATA_CMM_0237.es: Ahora mismo está todo verde, pero a ver de qué color se ponen los brotes.
DATA_CMM_0237.ko: 지금은 녹색이지만 성장하면 아름다운 색깔의 꽃을 피운다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0237.zht: 現在是綠色的，但成長之後似乎會冒出有著鮮豔色彩的花朵。
DATA_CMM_0237.zhs: 现在是绿色的，但成长之后似乎会冒出有着鲜艳色彩的花朵。

DATA_CMM_0238.ja: Put a letter in here, and it mysteriously appears at the address written on the envelope.
DATA_CMM_0238.en: Put a letter in here, and it mysteriously appears at the address written on the envelope.
DATA_CMM_0238.fr: Si l'on y glisse une lettre, elle réapparaît quelques jours plus tard à l'adresse indiquée sur l'enveloppe.
DATA_CMM_0238.de: Wenn du hier einen Brief hineinwirfst, erscheint er auf mysteriöse Weise an der Adresse, die auf dem Umschlag steht.
DATA_CMM_0238.it: Le lettere inserite in questa buca si ritrovano magicamente in case di altre persone.
DATA_CMM_0238.es: Si pones una carta aquí, aparecerá misteriosamente en la dirección que has escrito en el sobre.
DATA_CMM_0238.ko: 편지를 이 안에 넣어두면 누군가가 상대방에게 전달해 준다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0238.zht: 把信投入箱子，好像就會有人幫你送達。
DATA_CMM_0238.zhs: 把信投入箱子，好像就会有人帮你送达。

DATA_CMM_0239.ja: A flower you can pick up and take with you. Don't forget to bring some earth along.
DATA_CMM_0239.en: A flower you can pick up and take with you. Don't forget to bring some earth along.
DATA_CMM_0239.fr: Vous pouvez cueillir ces fleurs et les emmener avec vous, mais pensez à emporter aussi de la terre.
DATA_CMM_0239.de: Eine Blume, die du mit nach Hause nehmen kannst. Vergiss nicht, etwas Erde mitzubringen.
DATA_CMM_0239.it: Fiori belli da morire. È solo un modo di dire, ovviamente.
DATA_CMM_0239.es: Unas florecitas estupendas para llevárselas a casa, pero son más felices en la tierra.
DATA_CMM_0239.ko: 여차하면 땅과 함께 옮길 수 있는 꽃. 단, 그렇게 옮길 찬스는 그다지 쉽게 오지 않는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0239.zht: 必要時刻可以連土一起搬運的花朵。但似乎沒什麼需要搬運的機會。
DATA_CMM_0239.zhs: 必要时刻可以连土一起搬运的花朵。但似乎没什么需要搬运的机会。

DATA_CMM_0240.ja: Park your car next to this, and a bigger car will take it someplace else. We are not sure where.
DATA_CMM_0240.en: Park your car next to this, and a bigger car will take it someplace else. We are not sure where.
DATA_CMM_0240.fr: Garez votre véhicule à proximité, et un véhicule plus gros viendra le chercher. Nous ne savons point où il l'emmène.
DATA_CMM_0240.de: Parke dein Auto daneben und ein größeres Auto bringt es woanders hin. Wir sind nicht sicher, wohin.
DATA_CMM_0240.it: Se si parcheggia un'auto qui ne arriverà un'altra più grossa per portarla altrove. Deve far tutto parte di un bellissimo gioco.
DATA_CMM_0240.es: Si aparcas el coche por aquí, se lo llevarán. Luego no te quejes.
DATA_CMM_0240.ko: 여기에 자동차를 놓아두면 큰 자동차가 와서 실어 간다. 어디로 실어 가는지는 모른다.
DATA_CMM_0240.zht: 如果車停在這裡，會有很大的車過來拖走。不曉得車子會被帶到哪裡去。
DATA_CMM_0240.zhs: 如果车停在这里，会有很大的车过来拖走。不晓得车子会被带到哪里去。

DATA_CMM_0241.ja: Brightens up the road when it's dark. Insects seem to love them.
DATA_CMM_0241.en: Brightens up the road when it's dark. Insects seem to love them.
DATA_CMM_0241.fr: Éclaire la route quand il fait noir. Fait danser les insectes.
DATA_CMM_0241.de: Erhellt die Straße, wenn es dunkel ist. Insekten lieben sie anscheinend.
DATA_CMM_0241.it: Punto di ritrovo notturno per insetti.
DATA_CMM_0241.es: Ilumina los caminos de noche y a los insectos les encanta volar a su alrededor.
DATA_CMM_0241.ko: 어두워지면 거리를 밝게 해 준다. 벌레들에게도 인기는 만점이라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0241.zht: 天色一暗下來就會替大家照亮道路。似乎非常受蟲子們喜愛。
DATA_CMM_0241.zhs: 天色一暗下来就会替大家照亮道路。似乎非常受虫子们喜爱。

DATA_CMM_0242.ja: Buildings that suddenly appear and disappear on empty lots. Often spotted near construction sites.
DATA_CMM_0242.en: Buildings that suddenly appear and disappear on empty lots. Often spotted near construction sites.
DATA_CMM_0242.fr: Bâtiments qui vont et viennent sur des terrains vides. On les voit souvent autour des chantiers de construction.
DATA_CMM_0242.de: Gebäude, die plötzlich auf leeren Grundstücken auftauchen und wieder verschwinden. Sie werden oft in der Nähe von Baustellen gesichtet.
DATA_CMM_0242.it: Casa che spunta a piacere quando meno te l'aspetti.
DATA_CMM_0242.es: Es como una casa de bolsillo; cuando quieres irte, la desmontas y te la llevas.
DATA_CMM_0242.ko: 넓은 공터 등에 갑자기 나타났다 갑자기 사라지는 물체. 그 주변에는 100% 공사중.
DATA_CMM_0242.zht: 在寬闊空地等地方突然出現又突然消失的建築。旁邊必定在施工。
DATA_CMM_0242.zhs: 在宽阔空地等地方突然出现又突然消失的建筑。旁边必定在施工。

DATA_CMM_0243.ja: Home sweet home for your car. There's no kitchen or bathroom though.
DATA_CMM_0243.en: Home sweet home for your car. There's no kitchen or bathroom though.
DATA_CMM_0243.fr: Magnifique résidence pour votre voiture, mais sans cuisine ni salle de bains.
DATA_CMM_0243.de: Ein trautes Heim für dein Auto. Allerdings gibt es weder Küche noch Bad.
DATA_CMM_0243.it: Casa dolce casa... Per le auto. Niente bagno né cucina, ma, nonostante ciò, molto confortevole.
DATA_CMM_0243.es: En este sitio duermen los coches, aunque no tienen derecho a desayuno.
DATA_CMM_0243.ko: 자동차의 집. 하지만 부엌과 화장실은 딸려있지 않다.
DATA_CMM_0243.zht: 車子的屋子。但是沒有附設衛浴跟廚房。
DATA_CMM_0243.zhs: 车子的屋子。但是没有附设卫浴跟厨房。

DATA_CMM_0244.ja: A box on a lonely journey. Always being thrown into ships and airplanes.
DATA_CMM_0244.en: A box on a lonely journey. Always being thrown into ships and airplanes.
DATA_CMM_0244.fr: Boîte qui voyage en solitaire. Elle est toujours envoyée par bateau et par avion.
DATA_CMM_0244.de: Eine Kiste auf einer einsamen Reise. Sie wird immer wieder in Schiffe und Flugzeuge geworfen.
DATA_CMM_0244.it: Una cassa che viaggia di continuo. Si sente un po' sola.
DATA_CMM_0244.es: Se pasa la vida en barcos y aviones, pero siempre viaja sola.
DATA_CMM_0244.ko: 배나 비행기로 늘 여행을 하는 고독한 상자.
DATA_CMM_0244.zht: 孤獨的箱子，總是待在船或是飛機上旅行。
DATA_CMM_0244.zhs: 孤独的箱子，总是待在船或是飞机上旅行。

DATA_CMM_0245.ja: Sells all kinds of noise-making devices. Many long-haired people lurk inside.
DATA_CMM_0245.en: Sells all kinds of noise-making devices. Many long-haired people lurk inside.
DATA_CMM_0245.fr: Vend toutes sortes d'instruments bruyants. De nombreuses personnes chevelues rôdent à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_0245.de: Verkauft alle Arten von Geräten, die Lärm machen. Drinnen lauern viele langhaarige Menschen.
DATA_CMM_0245.it: Vende un sacco di strumenti produttori di rumore. Ritrovo per gente con i capelli lunghi.
DATA_CMM_0245.es: Vende aparatos que hacen ruidos a gente que sabe hacerlos sonar bien.
DATA_CMM_0245.ko: 여러 소리를 내는 것을 팔고 있는 듯하다. 머리가 긴 사람들이 잔뜩 있다.
DATA_CMM_0245.zht: 販售著各式各樣能發出樂音的東西。裡面好像有很多長頭髮的人。
DATA_CMM_0245.zhs: 贩售着各式各样能发出乐音的东西。里面好像有很多长头发的人。

DATA_CMM_0246.ja: This is how you know the name of the music store.
DATA_CMM_0246.en: This is how you know the name of the music store.
DATA_CMM_0246.fr: Il vous indique le nom du magasin de musique.
DATA_CMM_0246.de: So erfährt man den Namen des Musikladens.
DATA_CMM_0246.it: Da qui si evince il nome del negozio di musica.
DATA_CMM_0246.es: Sirve para que sepas cómo se llama la tienda de música.
DATA_CMM_0246.ko: 소리를 내는 물건을 파는 가게의 이름이 쓰여있다.
DATA_CMM_0246.zht: 寫著店名，販售會發出樂音的東西。
DATA_CMM_0246.zhs: 写着店名，贩售会发出乐音的东西。

DATA_CMM_0247.ja: A shop filled with all manner of school supplies. Homework answers are not for sale.
DATA_CMM_0247.en: A shop filled with all manner of school supplies. Homework answers are not for sale.
DATA_CMM_0247.fr: On y trouve toutes sortes de fournitures scolaires, mais les réponses aux exercices ne sont pas à vendre.
DATA_CMM_0247.de: Ein Geschäft mit allen Arten von Schulbedarf. Antworten auf Hausaufgaben werden nicht angeboten.
DATA_CMM_0247.it: Vende tutto per la scuola, ma non i compiti già svolti.
DATA_CMM_0247.es: Tiene todo tipo de material escolar, pero no vende las respuestas a los exámenes.
DATA_CMM_0247.ko: 학교에서 사용하는 물건을 잔뜩 팔고 있는 곳. 내일 중간고사 답안지, 완성된 숙제 등은 안 파는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0247.zht: 文具店大量販售著在學校好像會用上的東西。看起來並沒有賣作業的解答。
DATA_CMM_0247.zhs: 文具店大量贩售着在学校好像会用上的东西。看起来并没有卖作业的解答。

DATA_CMM_0248.ja: The stationery store's name is written on it.
DATA_CMM_0248.en: The stationery store's name is written on it.
DATA_CMM_0248.fr: Le nom de la papeterie y figure.
DATA_CMM_0248.de: Auf ihm steht der Name des Schreibwarengeschäfts.
DATA_CMM_0248.it: Si tratta del nome della cartoleria.
DATA_CMM_0248.es: Tiene escrito el nombre del dueño.
DATA_CMM_0248.ko: 주로 학교에서 쓰는 물건을 파는 가게의 이름이 적혀있다.
DATA_CMM_0248.zht: 寫著店名，主要是販售在學校會用上的道具。
DATA_CMM_0248.zhs: 写着店名，主要是贩售在学校会用上的道具。

DATA_CMM_0249.ja: You can call people with this. People can call you here, too, but it's rather rare.
DATA_CMM_0249.en: You can call people with this. People can call you here, too, but it's rather rare.
DATA_CMM_0249.fr: Permet de téléphoner aux gens. On peut également vous appeler, mais c'est plutôt rare.
DATA_CMM_0249.de: Damit kannst du Leute anrufen. Andere Leute können dich hier auch anrufen, aber das ist eher selten.
DATA_CMM_0249.it: Da qui si possono chiamare i propri amici o trasformarsi in supereroi.
DATA_CMM_0249.es: Desde aquí puedes llamar a gente. También te pueden llamar a ti, pero eso ya es más raro.
DATA_CMM_0249.ko: 이쪽에서 거는 일은 있지만, 저쪽에서 걸어오는 일은 일단 없다.
DATA_CMM_0249.zht: 就算這頭可以打電話出去，對方也絕對不會打過來的樣子。
DATA_CMM_0249.zhs: 就算这头可以打电话出去，对方也绝对不会打过来的样子。

DATA_CMM_0250.ja: A very small, but well-appointed apartment, with great views. Close to the bus stop and convenience store.
DATA_CMM_0250.en: A very small, but well-appointed apartment, with great views. Close to the bus stop and convenience store.
DATA_CMM_0250.fr: Appartement très petit mais bien situé, superbe vue. Il n'est pas loin d'un arrêt de bus et d'une épicerie.
DATA_CMM_0250.de: Eine sehr kleine, aber gut ausgestattete Wohnung mit toller Aussicht. In der Nähe der Bushaltestelle und des Lebensmittelladens.
DATA_CMM_0250.it: Un bell'appartamento, bella vista, vicino alla stazione del bus e a un negozio di alimentari. Non gli manca proprio nulla.
DATA_CMM_0250.es: ¡Es pequeñito, pero mira qué vistas y además está tan bien situado...!
DATA_CMM_0250.zht: 充滿戲劇性的建築，有四張半塌塌米大。
DATA_CMM_0250.zhs: 充满戏剧性的建筑，有四张半塌塌米大。

DATA_CMM_0251.ja: A small tree commonly found along the roadside. Many bugs and other gross things live here.
DATA_CMM_0251.en: A small tree commonly found along the roadside. Many bugs and other gross things live here.
DATA_CMM_0251.fr: Petit arbre peuplant le bord des routes. Il sert de maison aux insectes et à d'autres animaux peu recommandables.
DATA_CMM_0251.de: Ein kleiner Baum, der häufig am Straßenrand steht. Hier leben viele Käfer und andere eklige Dinge.
DATA_CMM_0251.it: Albero che orna viali e vie della città. Un albero della giungla metropolitana.
DATA_CMM_0251.es: Estos arbolitos suelen crecer junto a la carretera y sirven de hogar a los bichos, puaj.
DATA_CMM_0251.ko: 도로에 비죽비죽 서 있는 나무. 흙이 적어도 씩씩하게 살아가고 있는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0251.zht: 在路邊一株接著一株生長的樹木。似乎就算土壤很少也精力充沛的生長著。
DATA_CMM_0251.zhs: 在路边一株接着一株生长的树木。似乎就算土壤很少也精力充沛的生长着。

DATA_CMM_0252.ja: The man living here buys lottery tickets at least once a year, but he never wins anything.
DATA_CMM_0252.en: The man living here buys lottery tickets at least once a year, but he never wins anything.
DATA_CMM_0252.fr: L'homme qui habite ici achète des tickets de loto au moins une fois par an et ne gagne jamais rien.
DATA_CMM_0252.de: Der Mann, der hier wohnt, kauft mindestens einmal im Jahr Lottoscheine, aber er gewinnt nie etwas.
DATA_CMM_0252.it: Ci abita un appassionato di lotto e lotterie che non ha mai vinto nulla in vita propria.
DATA_CMM_0252.es: El dueño de esta casa compra mucha lotería, pero nunca le toca ni el reintegro.
DATA_CMM_0252.ko: 매년 복권을 사고 있으나 한 번도 당첨된 적이 없다.
DATA_CMM_0252.zht: 每年都會買大樂透，卻從來沒中過獎。
DATA_CMM_0252.zhs: 每年都会买大乐透，却从来没中过奖。

DATA_CMM_0253.ja: This is what you run into when you're walking down the street and looking at something else.
DATA_CMM_0253.en: This is what you run into when you're walking down the street and looking at something else.
DATA_CMM_0253.fr: Vous vous y cognez lorsque vous marchez dans la rue en rêvant à autre chose.
DATA_CMM_0253.de: Hieran stößt man sich, wenn man die Straße runterläuft und auf etwas anderes achtet.
DATA_CMM_0253.it: Bisogna fare attenzione a non sbatterci contro quando si cammina distratti.
DATA_CMM_0253.es: Es el tipo de cosa con la que tropiezas cuando te giras a mirar por la calle.
DATA_CMM_0253.ko: 딴 곳을 보며 걸으면 부딪히게 되는 봉.
DATA_CMM_0253.zht: 走路東張西望會迎面撞上的桿子。
DATA_CMM_0253.zhs: 走路东张西望会迎面撞上的杆子。

DATA_CMM_0254.ja: This family is considering moving overseas soon.
DATA_CMM_0254.en: This family is considering moving overseas soon.
DATA_CMM_0254.fr: Cette famille compte partir à l'étranger bientôt.
DATA_CMM_0254.de: Diese Familie überlegt, bald nach Übersee zu ziehen.
DATA_CMM_0254.it: La famiglia che ci abita purtroppo non è legata da parentela con nessun personaggio famoso.
DATA_CMM_0254.es: Esta familia está pensando en mudarse al otro lado del mundo.
DATA_CMM_0254.ko: 언젠가는 해변으로 이사해서 살겠다는 생각을 버리지 않고 있다.
DATA_CMM_0254.zht: 正在考慮要不要全家移民國外。
DATA_CMM_0254.zhs: 正在考虑要不要全家移民国外。

DATA_CMM_0255.ja: Sparrows make pit stops at the top. Dogs make pit stops of their own at the bottom.
DATA_CMM_0255.en: Sparrows make pit stops at the top. Dogs make pit stops of their own at the bottom.
DATA_CMM_0255.fr: Le sommet de cet objet est le territoire des moineaux. Les chiens marquent leur territoire au pied de celui-ci.
DATA_CMM_0255.de: Spatzen machen oben einen Boxenstopp. Hunde machen ihre eigenen Boxenstopps am Boden.
DATA_CMM_0255.it: I passeri fanno lunghe pause sulla cima di queste strutture. I cani fanno lunghe pause ai piedi di queste strutture. Ma per ragioni diverse.
DATA_CMM_0255.es: Los pájaros se posan arriba y los perros hacen una parada técnica abajo.
DATA_CMM_0255.ko: 위에는 참새가 머물고, 아래에선 강아지가 쉬야를 하는 동물들의 휴식처.
DATA_CMM_0255.zht: 小動物們的休息區。上層會有麻雀停留，下層會有小狗小便。
DATA_CMM_0255.zhs: 小动物们的休息区。上层会有麻雀停留，下层会有小狗小便。

DATA_CMM_0259.ja: A bric-a-brac shop owned by a weird old guy. A bit of an odd selection, but perhaps treasure lurks inside.
DATA_CMM_0259.en: A bric-a-brac shop owned by a weird old guy. A bit of an odd selection, but perhaps treasure lurks inside.
DATA_CMM_0259.fr: Ce magasin est tenu par un vieux monsieur bizarre et c'est un vrai fourbi, mais peut-être y trouverez-vous des trésors.
DATA_CMM_0259.de: Ein Trödelladen, der einem seltsamen alten Mann gehört. Eine etwas merkwürdige Auswahl, aber vielleicht lauert dort ein Schatz.
DATA_CMM_0259.it: Un negozio di chincaglieria di proprietà di uno strano vecchietto. Secondo Noi ricco di segreti e tesori.
DATA_CMM_0259.es: Esta tienda vende adornos y cachivaches muy raros, pero a lo mejor hay algún tesoro.
DATA_CMM_0259.ko: 주인이 취미로 연 가게. 상품 구성은 항상 한편으로 치우쳐 있으나 가끔씩 엄청난 보물을 팔 때도 있는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0259.zht: 店主個人興趣開的雜貨店。商品很冷門，但有時也會賣很厲害的寶物。
DATA_CMM_0259.zhs: 店主个人兴趣开的杂货店。商品很冷门，但有时也会卖很厉害的宝物。

DATA_CMM_0260.ja: Were it not for this sign, We would have no idea what the store's name was.
DATA_CMM_0260.en: Were it not for this sign, We would have no idea what the store's name was.
DATA_CMM_0260.fr: Si cette enseigne n'était pas là, nul ne saurait à quel magasin il a affaire.
DATA_CMM_0260.de: Ohne dieses Schild hätten wir keine Ahnung, wie der Laden heißt.
DATA_CMM_0260.it: Pensate, senza questa insegna non sapremmo il nome del negozio.
DATA_CMM_0260.es: Si no fuera por el rótulo, no sabríamos cómo se llama la tienda.
DATA_CMM_0260.ko: 가게 이름 이외에는 아무것도 모른다. 눈에 띄면 띌수록 그 이름은 뇌리에 새겨진다.
DATA_CMM_0260.zht: 除了商店的名字一概不知。放得越久名字越能被記住。
DATA_CMM_0260.zhs: 除了商店的名字一概不知。放得越久名字越能被记住。

DATA_CMM_0261.ja: A tree found lining the side of tropical roadways. Often seen in not-so-tropical areas nowadays.
DATA_CMM_0261.en: A tree found lining the side of tropical roadways. Often seen in not-so-tropical areas nowadays.
DATA_CMM_0261.fr: Cet arbre pousse le long des routes sillonnant les tropiques. De nos jours, on le plante aussi dans les zones moins tropicales.
DATA_CMM_0261.de: Ein Baum, der an tropischen Straßenrändern wächst. Heutzutage auch oft in nicht ganz so tropischen Gebieten zu sehen.
DATA_CMM_0261.it: Pianta tropicale che spesso si trova in luoghi poco tropicali.
DATA_CMM_0261.es: Estos árboles provienen de climas tropicales, pero ahora se ven en todas partes.
DATA_CMM_0261.ko: 원래는 남쪽 섬 길가에 서있는 나무. 요즘에는 남쪽 나라가 아니더라도 여기저기 서 있는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0261.zht: 原本是生長在南國小島路邊的樹。最近也會長在非南方國家的樣子。
DATA_CMM_0261.zhs: 原本是生长在南国小岛路边的树。最近也会长在非南方国家的样子。

DATA_CMM_0262.ja: A place to become one with nature, but it's hard to get TV reception this far from the city.
DATA_CMM_0262.en: A place to become one with nature, but it's hard to get TV reception this far from the city.
DATA_CMM_0262.fr: Cet endroit permet de communier avec la nature, mais il est difficile de capter les chaînes de télévision si loin de la ville.
DATA_CMM_0262.de: Ein Ort, an dem man mit der Natur eins wird. Allerdings ist es schwierig, so weit von der Stadt entfernt TV-Programme zu empfangen.
DATA_CMM_0262.it: Sarebbe un posto ottimo per viverci se non ci fossero terribili problemi di ricezione per la TV.
DATA_CMM_0262.es: Ideal para vivir en armonía con la naturaleza, pero que sepas que aquí no hay tele.
DATA_CMM_0262.ko: 자연과 하나가 될 수 있는 멋진 집. 단, 보고 싶은 프로가 있어도 전파가 잡히지 않는 경우가 많다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0262.zht: 跟自然合為一體的漂亮屋子。但即使有想看的節目，也往往沒有播放。
DATA_CMM_0262.zhs: 跟自然合为一体的漂亮屋子。但即使有想看的节目，也往往没有播放。

DATA_CMM_0263.ja: You can pack all sorts of food in here. Big eaters love them.
DATA_CMM_0263.en: You can pack all sorts of food in here. Big eaters love them.
DATA_CMM_0263.fr: Il peut contenir de nombreux aliments. Les gros mangeurs l'adorent.
DATA_CMM_0263.de: Hier kann man alle Arten von Lebensmitteln hineinpacken. Große Esser lieben sie.
DATA_CMM_0263.it: Una ciotola molto molto capiente, amata dai golosi.
DATA_CMM_0263.es: Sirve para poner cosas de comer dentro; cuanto más grande, mejor.
DATA_CMM_0263.ko: 먹을 것이 잔뜩 들어가므로 먹보에게 딱이다.
DATA_CMM_0263.zht: 可以裝非常多食物，適合貪吃鬼。
DATA_CMM_0263.zhs: 可以装非常多食物，适合贪吃鬼。

DATA_CMM_0264.ja: Everyone who comes here dreams of what they'll do once they hit the jackpot.
DATA_CMM_0264.en: Everyone who comes here dreams of what they'll do once they hit the jackpot.
DATA_CMM_0264.fr: Tous ceux qui viennent ici rêvent de ce qu'ils feront s'ils décrochent la timbale.
DATA_CMM_0264.de: Jeder, der hierher kommt, träumt davon, was er macht, wenn er den Jackpot geknackt hat.
DATA_CMM_0264.it: Tutti entrano con un sogno ed escono con una speranza.
DATA_CMM_0264.es: Todos los clientes sueñan con lo que harán cuando les toque el premio gordo.
DATA_CMM_0264.ko: 당첨되면 어떡하지…라는 것이 여기 오는 사람들의 입버릇이다.
DATA_CMM_0264.zht: 來這裡的人口頭禪是：「中獎的話該怎麼辦？」
DATA_CMM_0264.zhs: 来这里的人口头禅是：「中奖的话该怎么办？」

DATA_CMM_0265.ja: Even if you buy all of the tickets, you won't necessarily win. We suppose you can only pray that won't happen.
DATA_CMM_0265.en: Even if you buy all of the tickets, you won't necessarily win. We suppose you can only pray that won't happen.
DATA_CMM_0265.fr: Même si vous achetez tous les tickets, vous ne gagnerez peut-être pas. Votre seul recours est alors la prière, Nous semble-t-il.
DATA_CMM_0265.de: Selbst wenn du alle Lose kaufst, wirst du nicht unbedingt gewinnen. Du kannst wohl nur beten, dass das nicht passiert.
DATA_CMM_0265.it: Perché qualcuno non compra TUTTI i biglietti? In questo modo sarebbe sicuro di vincere, no?
DATA_CMM_0265.es: Aunque compres todos los boletos de la tienda, puede que siga sin salir el tuyo.
DATA_CMM_0265.ko: 몽땅 사도 안 맞는 경우가 있다고 한다. 일단 구입한 후에는 기도하는 수밖에 방법이 없다.
DATA_CMM_0265.zht: 有時全買下來也不會中獎。不小心買了的話也只能祈禱會中獎了。
DATA_CMM_0265.zhs: 有时全买下来也不会中奖。不小心买了的话也只能祈祷会中奖了。

DATA_CMM_0266.ja: Occasionally changes without you even noticing. Always very annoying when that happens.
DATA_CMM_0266.en: Occasionally changes without you even noticing. Always very annoying when that happens.
DATA_CMM_0266.fr: Change parfois sans que vous ne vous en aperceviez. C'est toujours très frustrant.
DATA_CMM_0266.de: Ändert sich gelegentlich, ohne dass man es merkt. Immer ziemlich ärgerlich, wenn das passiert.
DATA_CMM_0266.it: Passano le stagioni e cambiano le locandine. Ci deve essere una sorta di relazione fra le due cose.
DATA_CMM_0266.es: Cambia cada poco tiempo, así nunca te aburres al mirarla.
DATA_CMM_0266.ko: 어느 사이엔가 그려진 그림이 바뀌어 있는 성질 급한 판때기. 자세히 보기 전에 그림이 바뀌어 있으면 다소 분하다.
DATA_CMM_0266.zht: 急躁的板子，才剛注意到，上面的圖就變了。在看清楚圖之前就改變的話會有點懊惱。
DATA_CMM_0266.zhs: 急躁的板子，才刚注意到，上面的图就变了。在看清楚图之前就改变的话会有点懊恼。

DATA_CMM_0267.ja: We have yet to hear of any quails in the area.
DATA_CMM_0267.en: We have yet to hear of any quails in the area.
DATA_CMM_0267.fr: Nous n'avons toujours pas entendu de cailles dans cette zone.
DATA_CMM_0267.de: Von Wachteln haben wir in dieser Gegend noch nichts gehört.
DATA_CMM_0267.it: Un cartello che indica dove trovare il fiume delle quaglie. Si chiama così ma non ci sono molte quaglie in zona.
DATA_CMM_0267.es: No sabemos por qué se llama así, si en esta zona no hay codornices.
DATA_CMM_0267.zht: 不論初級或五級，好像沒有比一級更厲害的河川了。
DATA_CMM_0267.zhs: 不论初级或五级，好像没有比一级更厉害的河川了。

DATA_CMM_0268.ja: One side is sharp, but the other is not. However, either side is fairly painful.
DATA_CMM_0268.en: One side is sharp, but the other is not. However, either side is fairly painful.
DATA_CMM_0268.fr: Un côté est aiguisé, mais pas l'autre. Dans tous les cas, il n'est pas bon de recevoir un coup.
DATA_CMM_0268.de: Eine Seite ist scharf, die andere nicht. Allerdings sind beide Seiten ziemlich schmerzhaft.
DATA_CMM_0268.it: Ha un lato affilato e l'altro no. Ad ogni modo sono entrambi dolorosi.
DATA_CMM_0268.es: Lo mejor es quitarse de en medio cuando sacan una de estas.
DATA_CMM_0268.ko: 날이 잘 드는 곳과 전혀 안 드는 곳이 있는 것 같다. 날이 안 드는 곳으로 맞아도 무지 아프다.
DATA_CMM_0268.zht: 似乎有鋒利無比的刀刃也有較鈍不銳利的部位。被不銳利的部位打也是會痛的。
DATA_CMM_0268.zhs: 似乎有锋利无比的刀刃也有较钝不锐利的部位。被不锐利的部位打也是会痛的。

DATA_CMM_0269.ja: Sit here to get out of the rain while you wait. Long waits tend to result in stress.
DATA_CMM_0269.en: Sit here to get out of the rain while you wait. Long waits tend to result in stress.
DATA_CMM_0269.fr: Asseyez-vous ici en attendant que la pluie cesse. Si vous attendez longtemps, le stress s'en mêlera.
DATA_CMM_0269.de: Setz dich hier hin, um nicht im Regen zu stehen, während du wartest. Lange Wartezeiten führen oft zu Stress.
DATA_CMM_0269.it: Un posto per lunghe, frustranti attese.
DATA_CMM_0269.es: El que espera, desespera, ya lo dice el refrán. Pero al menos no te mojas si llueve.
DATA_CMM_0269.ko: 비에 젖지 않으므로 오래 기다려도 안심이다. 하지만 너무 오래 기다리면 상당히 신경질난다.
DATA_CMM_0269.zht: 因為不會淋到雨，所以能放心在此長時間等待。不過等太久的話會讓人焦急。
DATA_CMM_0269.zhs: 因为不会淋到雨，所以能放心在此长时间等待。不过等太久的话会让人焦急。

DATA_CMM_0270.ja: A tube filled with the energy to make other things move. Some last longer than others.
DATA_CMM_0270.en: A tube filled with the energy to make other things move. Some last longer than others.
DATA_CMM_0270.fr: Tube contenant l'énergie de déplacer des objets. De durée variable.
DATA_CMM_0270.de: Eine Röhre, die mit der Energie gefüllt ist, die andere Dinge in Bewegung setzt. Manche halten länger als andere.
DATA_CMM_0270.it: Un tubetto ripieno di energia da usare per varie diavolerie.
DATA_CMM_0270.es: Hay algunas que duran menos y otras duran y duran más.
DATA_CMM_0270.ko: 여러 가지 기계를 움직이는 에너지가 들어있는 통. 상당히 오래 견디는 종류도 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0270.zht: 存放能源的長筒，可以讓各種機械運轉。有些乾電池用起來特別持久。
DATA_CMM_0270.zhs: 存放能源的长筒，可以让各种机械运转。有些干电池用起来特别持久。

DATA_CMM_0271.ja: A house for scurrying insects. Once they check in, they never seem to check out.
DATA_CMM_0271.en: A house for scurrying insects. Once they check in, they never seem to check out.
DATA_CMM_0271.fr: Hôtel pour insectes grouillants. Une fois installés, ils ne partent jamais.
DATA_CMM_0271.de: Ein Haus für wuselnde Insekten. Wenn sie einmal eingezogen sind, reisen sie offenbar nie wieder ab.
DATA_CMM_0271.it: Gli scarafaggi sembrano amare questo posto, vengono qui in vacanza e non tornano più...
DATA_CMM_0271.es: A los bichos les gusta tanto este sitio que han tomado residencia permanente.
DATA_CMM_0271.ko: 바스락 대며 움직이는 검은 벌레를 위한 집. 한번 집에 돌아오면 두 번 다시 외출을 하지 않는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0271.zht: 專門的屋子，提供給動起來沙沙響的黑色蟲子。回到家後就不會再出門了的樣子。
DATA_CMM_0271.zhs: 专门的屋子，提供给动起来沙沙响的黑色虫子。回到家后就不会再出门了的样子。

DATA_CMM_0272.ja: A house for sleeping outdoors. Looks like a pyramid, but beware! The person inside is still alive.
DATA_CMM_0272.en: A house for sleeping outdoors. Looks like a pyramid, but beware! The person inside is still alive.
DATA_CMM_0272.fr: Maison pour dormir dehors. On dirait une pyramide, mais attention, ceux qui y sommeillent ne sont pas des momies.
DATA_CMM_0272.de: Ein Haus zum Schlafen im Freien. Sieht aus wie eine Pyramide, aber Vorsicht! Die Person darin ist noch am Leben.
DATA_CMM_0272.it: Una casa per dormire all'aperto. Attenzione: nonostante sembri una piramide, il suo inquilino è ancora vivo.
DATA_CMM_0272.es: Sirve para dormir en el campo, pero si no quieres viajar, puedes plantarla en el jardín.
DATA_CMM_0272.ko: 일부러 밖에서 자기 위한 집. 피라미드 같이 보이지만 그 안의 사람은 살아있다.
DATA_CMM_0272.zht: 專門建成的屋子，提供給特意在野外睡覺的人。看起來像是金字塔，住在裡面的人卻活得好好的。
DATA_CMM_0272.zhs: 专门建成的屋子，提供给特意在野外睡觉的人。看起来像是金字塔，住在里面的人却活得好好的。

DATA_CMM_0273.ja: A large falling stone. Grows larger and larger as it rolls.
DATA_CMM_0273.en: A large falling stone. Grows larger and larger as it rolls.
DATA_CMM_0273.fr: Gros rocher tombant. Il devient de plus en plus gros en tombant.
DATA_CMM_0273.de: Ein großer fallender Stein. Je weiter er rollt, desto größer wird er.
DATA_CMM_0273.it: Un'enorme roccia che cade; diventa sempre più grande mentre rotola.
DATA_CMM_0273.es: ¡No se te ocurra hacer una carrera para ver quién llega antes abajo!
DATA_CMM_0273.ko: 어디선가 굴러들어 오는 커다란 돌. 처음 구르기 시작할 때는 작아도 구르면서 점점 커지는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0273.zht: 不知道從哪裡滾來的大石頭。剛開始滾時似乎還是小石頭，越滾逐漸變得越大。
DATA_CMM_0273.zhs: 不知道从哪里滚来的大石头。刚开始滚时似乎还是小石头，越滚逐渐变得越大。

DATA_CMM_0274.ja: You can't have summer without these. We always feel empty after setting them off for some reason.
DATA_CMM_0274.en: You can't have summer without these. We always feel empty after setting them off for some reason.
DATA_CMM_0274.fr: Sans eux, l'été ne serait pas l'été. Curieusement, Nous Nous sentons toujours vide après les avoir lancés.
DATA_CMM_0274.de: Ohne kann man Silvester nicht genießen. Aus irgendeinem Grund fühlen wir uns immer müde, nachdem wir es abgeschossen haben.
DATA_CMM_0274.it: Non è estate senza questi. Per qualche motivo, Ci sentiamo sempre vuoti dopo averli accesi.
DATA_CMM_0274.es: No hay festival que se precie sin un buen espectáculo pirotécnico.
DATA_CMM_0274.ko: 여름의 풍류이다. 모두에게 인기가 있지만 다 끝난 후엔 좀 허전한 느낌이 든다.
DATA_CMM_0274.zht: 夏季的季節風情詩。很受歡迎，只是放完後似乎會有些寂寞。
DATA_CMM_0274.zhs: 夏季的季节风情诗。很受欢迎，只是放完后似乎会有些寂寞。

DATA_CMM_0275.ja: You only see this around the new year in Japan. The bamboo part is more decorative than the pine, really.
DATA_CMM_0275.en: You only see this around the new year in Japan. The bamboo part is more decorative than the pine, really.
DATA_CMM_0275.fr: Elle ne se montre qu'autour du nouvel an au Japon. En fait, la partie en bambou est plus jolie que celle en pin.
DATA_CMM_0275.de: Man sieht sie in Japan nur um das Neujahr herum. Der Teil aus Bambus ist dekorativer als die Kiefer.
DATA_CMM_0275.it: Decorazione tradizionale giapponese benaugurante per il nuovo anno.
DATA_CMM_0275.es: Se usan como decoración de Año Nuevo en Japón. La verdad es que el bambú decora más.
DATA_CMM_0275.ko: 1년을 시작할 때만 볼 수 있는 것. 나름대로 눈에 띄는 성격이다.
DATA_CMM_0275.zht: 新年才看得到。雖然叫門松，但竹子比較顯眼。
DATA_CMM_0275.zhs: 新年才看得到。虽然叫门松，但竹子比较显眼。

DATA_CMM_0276.ja: Birds and small animals call this home. It seems like a nice enough place to live.
DATA_CMM_0276.en: Birds and small animals call this home. It seems like a nice enough place to live.
DATA_CMM_0276.fr: Les oiseaux et les petits animaux y ont élu domicile. Ça a l'air plutôt confortable.
DATA_CMM_0276.de: Vögel und kleine Tiere sind hier zu Hause. Scheint ein netter Ort zum Leben zu sein.
DATA_CMM_0276.it: Casa per piccoli animali, una specie di condominio molto rustico.
DATA_CMM_0276.es: Aquí viven pájaros y otras bestezuelas. Parece un hogar agradable.
DATA_CMM_0276.ko: 새나 작은 동물들이 사용하는 집. 살기엔 쾌적한 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0276.zht: 小鳥和小動物的屋子。感覺住起來很舒服。
DATA_CMM_0276.zhs: 小鸟和小动物的屋子。感觉住起来很舒服。

DATA_CMM_0277.ja: What is this tree? We're stumped.
DATA_CMM_0277.en: What is this tree? We're stumped.
DATA_CMM_0277.fr: Quel est cet arbre ? Nous sommes sciés.
DATA_CMM_0277.de: Was ist das für ein Baum? Wir sind wohl auf dem Holzweg.
DATA_CMM_0277.it: Che albero è? Ormai qui abbiamo messo radici.
DATA_CMM_0277.es: ¿Qué árbol es este? No seas tocón.
DATA_CMM_0277.ko: 이 나무는 왠지 매우 신경 쓰이는 나무.
DATA_CMM_0277.zht: 不知道為什麼，這棵樹讓人非常在意。
DATA_CMM_0277.zhs: 不知道为什么，这棵树让人非常在意。

DATA_CMM_0278.ja: Used to stop the flowers and plants inside from escaping.
DATA_CMM_0278.en: Used to stop the flowers and plants inside from escaping.
DATA_CMM_0278.fr: Empêche les fleurs et les plantes qu'elle entoure de s'échapper.
DATA_CMM_0278.de: Soll verhindern, dass die Blumen und Pflanzen im Inneren entkommen.
DATA_CMM_0278.it: Serve per evitare che le piante e i fiori evadano dal giardino.
DATA_CMM_0278.es: Será que tienen miedo de que se escapen las flores.
DATA_CMM_0278.ko: 어지럽혀지지 않게 하기 위해, 이것으로 주변을 둘러놓는 것 같다. 멋대로 들어가는 건 옳지 않다.
DATA_CMM_0278.zht: 似乎是不想花園被破壞才會用圍籬圍住。擅自闖入不太好。
DATA_CMM_0278.zhs: 似乎是不想花园被破坏才会用围篱围住。擅自闯入不太好。

DATA_CMM_0279.ja: A place where you're allowed to park your car. The spaces are a little narrow, though.
DATA_CMM_0279.en: A place where you're allowed to park your car. The spaces are a little narrow, though.
DATA_CMM_0279.fr: Endroit où vous pouvez garer votre voiture, si elle aime les espaces confinés.
DATA_CMM_0279.de: Ein Ort, an dem man sein Auto parken darf. Die Plätze sind allerdings ein bisschen eng.
DATA_CMM_0279.it: Abbiamo sentito dire che non si trovano più posti come questo. Eppure eccolo qui!
DATA_CMM_0279.es: Acuérdate de dónde aparcas tu coche para no andar dando vueltas luego.
DATA_CMM_0279.ko: 차를 세울 수 있게 준비해 준 장소. 하지만 세우는 장소가 좀 좁다.
DATA_CMM_0279.zht: 讓人停車的地方。但停車空間有點窄。
DATA_CMM_0279.zhs: 让人停车的地方。但停车空间有点窄。

DATA_CMM_0280.ja: These games are a pain. We know what to do, but Our fingers aren't fast enough...
DATA_CMM_0280.en: These games are a pain. We know what to do, but Our fingers aren't fast enough...
DATA_CMM_0280.fr: Ces jeux sont énervants. Nous avons beau savoir que faire, Nos royaux doigts ne sont pas assez rapides.
DATA_CMM_0280.de: Diese Spiele sind eine Qual. Wir wissen, was zu tun ist, aber unsere Finger sind nicht schnell genug ...
DATA_CMM_0280.it: Un puzzle game. Questi giochi Ci angustiano. Sappiamo cosa fare ma le Nostre dita non sono abbastanza rapide per farlo.
DATA_CMM_0280.es: Qué rollo; tenemos los dedos más lentos que el cerebro.
DATA_CMM_0280.ko: 답을 알고 있어도 손가락을 움직여야 하는 까다로운 게임.
DATA_CMM_0280.zht: 就算知道解答也不得不動手拼的辛苦遊戲。
DATA_CMM_0280.zhs: 就算知道解答也不得不动手拼的辛苦游戏。

DATA_CMM_0281.ja: Ideally, the number on this sign should be small.
DATA_CMM_0281.en: Ideally, the number on this sign should be small.
DATA_CMM_0281.fr: Dans l'idéal, le numéro sur ce panneau doit être petit.
DATA_CMM_0281.de: Die Zahl auf diesem Schild ist idealerweise klein.
DATA_CMM_0281.it: In un mondo perfetto non esisterebbero.
DATA_CMM_0281.es: Lo ideal sería que la cifra fuera 0.
DATA_CMM_0281.zht: 這個數字少一點似乎會比較平靜。
DATA_CMM_0281.zhs: 这个数字少一点似乎会比较平静。

DATA_CMM_0285.ja: Floats lazily on top of lakes. Frogs are known to enjoy this.
DATA_CMM_0285.en: Floats lazily on top of lakes. Frogs are known to enjoy this.
DATA_CMM_0285.fr: Se prélasse en flottant dans les mares. Les grenouilles aiment ça.
DATA_CMM_0285.de: Treibt faul auf der Oberfläche von Seen. Frösche sind bekannt dafür, dass sie sie lieben.
DATA_CMM_0285.it: Galleggia pigramente nelle acque placide dei laghetti. Le rane amano riposarvici le stanche membra.
DATA_CMM_0285.es: Flota en los estanques para que las ranas puedan tomar el sol.
DATA_CMM_0285.ko: 물 위에 둥둥 떠있다. 그 줄기에는 구멍 투성이의 채소가 달려있는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_0285.zht: 漂浮在水面。底部似乎連接著長滿洞洞的蔬菜。
DATA_CMM_0285.zhs: 漂浮在水面。底部似乎连接着长满洞洞的蔬菜。

DATA_CMM_0286.ja: It appears that only rich frogs can get on this.
DATA_CMM_0286.en: It appears that only rich frogs can get on this.
DATA_CMM_0286.fr: Il semble que seules les grenouilles les plus riches puissent s'y reposer.
DATA_CMM_0286.de: Anscheinend schaffen es nur reiche Frösche darauf.
DATA_CMM_0286.es: Solárium de lujo para ranas millonarias.
DATA_CMM_0286.ko: 물 위에 떠있는 이파리 중 큰 녀석. 절대 부자 개구리의 집이 아니다.
DATA_CMM_0286.zht: 漂浮在水面的巨大葉子。不代表就是有錢青蛙的家。
DATA_CMM_0286.zhs: 漂浮在水面的巨大叶子。不代表就是有钱青蛙的家。

DATA_CMM_0287.ja: Floats lazily on top of lakes. Princely amphibians sit on these.
DATA_CMM_0287.en: Floats lazily on top of lakes. Princely amphibians sit on these.
DATA_CMM_0287.fr: Se prélasse en flottant dans les mares. Elle fait office de trône pour les grenouilles de sang bleu.
DATA_CMM_0287.de: Sie schwimmen auf Seen träge vor sich hin. Auf ihnen sitzen prinzenhafte Amphibien.
DATA_CMM_0287.it: Fiore di loto, simbolo del Buddismo, immaginiamo ci vivano le rane di nobili origini.
DATA_CMM_0287.es: Otra maravilla flotante para anfibios con ganas de coger bronce.
DATA_CMM_0287.ko: 물 위에 둥둥 떠있는 이파리. 이 위에서 노래를 부르는 개구리가 있는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0287.zht: 漂浮在水面的葉子。好像有青蛙在上頭唱歌。
DATA_CMM_0287.zhs: 漂浮在水面的叶子。好像有青蛙在上头唱歌。

DATA_CMM_0288.ja: A trendy fish that has found its own style.
DATA_CMM_0288.en: A trendy fish that has found its own style.
DATA_CMM_0288.fr: Poisson très à la mode qui a lancé son propre style.
DATA_CMM_0288.de: Ein trendiger Fisch, der seinen eigenen Stil gefunden hat.
DATA_CMM_0288.it: Un pesce con un certo stile.
DATA_CMM_0288.es: Este pescado marca estilo a lo largo y ancho del río.
DATA_CMM_0288.ko: 자기 나름대로의 패션을 확립한 멋쟁이 물고기
DATA_CMM_0288.zht: 時髦的魚，找到了屬於自己的時尚。
DATA_CMM_0288.zhs: 时髦的鱼，找到了属于自己的时尚。

DATA_CMM_0289.ja: Protects the peace in his neighborhood. Polices it, if you will.
DATA_CMM_0289.en: Protects the peace in his neighborhood. Polices it, if you will.
DATA_CMM_0289.fr: Protège la paix du quartier, en le rendant plus "policé".
DATA_CMM_0289.de: Bewahrt den Frieden in seiner Nachbarschaft. Wie die Polizei das so macht.
DATA_CMM_0289.it: L'estremo difensore della legge nel quartiere.
DATA_CMM_0289.es: Se ocupa de atrapar a los facinerosos y otras gentes de mal vivir.
DATA_CMM_0289.ko: 거리의 안전을 지키는 사람. 매번 마을과 거리를 빙글빙글 돌고 있다.
DATA_CMM_0289.zht: 保護城鎮安全的人。似乎如名稱一般，機警戒備城鎮安全，明察犯罪事件。
DATA_CMM_0289.zhs: 保护城镇安全的人。似乎如名称一般，机警戒备城镇安全，明察犯罪事件。

DATA_CMM_0290.ja: A box that suddenly locks tightly when you put money inside. Good for storing important stuff.
DATA_CMM_0290.en: A box that suddenly locks tightly when you put money inside. Good for storing important stuff.
DATA_CMM_0290.fr: Caisson qui se verrouille complètement lorsque l'on y met de l'argent, parce qu'il est très radin.
DATA_CMM_0290.de: Eine Kiste, die plötzlich fest verschlossen ist, wenn man Geld hineinwirft. Gut für die Aufbewahrung wichtiger Dinge.
DATA_CMM_0290.it: Armadietto che si chiude a pagamento. A Noi non convince del tutto... Abbiamo sempre paura che non si apra più.
DATA_CMM_0290.es: El sitio ideal para guardar cosas de gran valor.
DATA_CMM_0290.ko: 돈을 넣으면 갑자기 열기 힘들어지는 상자. 소중한 물건을 집어넣으면 좋을 듯싶다.
DATA_CMM_0290.zht: 一投錢就變得難以開啟的箱子。重要的東西保管起來比較好。
DATA_CMM_0290.zhs: 一投钱就变得难以开启的箱子。重要的东西保管起来比较好。

DATA_CMM_0291.ja: A small tree or plant grown inside a tiny box. Elderly people treasure them.
DATA_CMM_0291.en: A small tree or plant grown inside a tiny box. Elderly people treasure them.
DATA_CMM_0291.fr: Petit arbre ou plante qui a grandi dans un pot minuscule. Ce sont les préférés des personnes âgées.
DATA_CMM_0291.de: Ein kleiner Baum oder eine Pflanze, die in einem winzigen Kästchen wächst. Ältere Menschen schätzen sie.
DATA_CMM_0291.it: Un piccolo albero in un piccolo vaso cresciuto per sembrare un grande albero in un bosco. C'è della poesia in tutto ciò.
DATA_CMM_0291.es: Criar estos árboles en miniatura es todo un arte.
DATA_CMM_0291.ko: 조그만 용기 안에서 키워지는 조그만 나무나 풀. 할아버지의 보물
DATA_CMM_0291.zht: 小小的容器中種植著嬌小的草木。是老爺爺的寶貝。
DATA_CMM_0291.zhs: 小小的容器中种植着娇小的草木。是老爷爷的宝贝。

DATA_CMM_0292.ja: Many a student's dreams have come true under this sign.
DATA_CMM_0292.en: Many a student's dreams have come true under this sign.
DATA_CMM_0292.fr: Combien de rêveries estudiantines y sont-elles devenues réalité ?
DATA_CMM_0292.de: Die Träume vieler Studenten sind unter diesem Schild wahr geworden.
DATA_CMM_0292.es: ¡Ah, las fiestas de verano! ¡El baile bajo las estrellas y los farolillos...!
DATA_CMM_0292.zht: 躍躍欲試的祭典招牌，雖然是在學校裡。
DATA_CMM_0292.zhs: 跃跃欲试的祭典招牌，虽然是在学校里。

DATA_CMM_0293.ja: A store that sells fried balls with bits of octopus inside. They burn your mouth if you eat them too quickly.
DATA_CMM_0293.en: A store that sells fried balls with bits of octopus inside. They burn your mouth if you eat them too quickly.
DATA_CMM_0293.fr: Magasin où l'on trouve des boules de pieuvre frites. Si vous aimez vous brûler le palais, mangez-les très vite.
DATA_CMM_0293.de: Ein Laden, der frittierte Bällchen verkauft, die mit Tintenfischstücken gefüllt sind. Sie verbrennen einem den Mund, wenn man sie zu schnell isst.
DATA_CMM_0293.it: Chiosco che vende takoyaki, palline fritte al ripieno di polipo.
DATA_CMM_0293.es: Esta tienda vende delicias de pulpo. Has de ser paciente, porque están fritas y queman.
DATA_CMM_0293.ko: 볼 안에 문어가 들어 있는 음식을 팔고 있다. 급하게 입에 넣으면 화상을 입는다.
DATA_CMM_0293.zht: 販賣著在球裡放進章魚的食物。立刻放進嘴裡吃的話似乎會燙傷。
DATA_CMM_0293.zhs: 贩卖着在球里放进章鱼的食物。立刻放进嘴里吃的话似乎会烫伤。

DATA_CMM_0294.ja: Your current location. Sometimes a lot harder to find than you'd expect.
DATA_CMM_0294.en: Your current location. Sometimes a lot harder to find than you'd expect.
DATA_CMM_0294.fr: C'est là que vous vous trouvez actuellement. On est parfois beaucoup plus perdu qu'on ne le croit.
DATA_CMM_0294.de: Dein aktueller Standort. Manchmal viel schwieriger zu finden, als man denkt.
DATA_CMM_0294.it: Indicazione che i più ritengono consolatoria.
DATA_CMM_0294.es: Para que sepas dónde estás, aunque sea más fácil decirlo que hacerlo.
DATA_CMM_0294.ko: 지금 있는 곳. 이것을 찾는 것이 나름대로 꽤 힘들 때가 있다.
DATA_CMM_0294.zht: 現在位置。要找到它似乎會很費勁。
DATA_CMM_0294.zhs: 现在位置。要找到它似乎会很费劲。

DATA_CMM_0295.ja: A fancy radio that has one tape player for each speaker... We think.
DATA_CMM_0295.en: A fancy radio that has one tape player for each speaker... We think.
DATA_CMM_0295.fr: Superbe radiocassette avec un lecteur pour chaque haut-parleur. C'est là Notre auguste déduction.
DATA_CMM_0295.de: Ein schickes Radio, das einen Kassettenspieler für jeden Lautsprecher hat ... Glauben wir zumindest.
DATA_CMM_0295.it: Sembra che abbia una cassa per ogni cassetta.
DATA_CMM_0295.es: Para que pongas tu propia música si te cansas de escuchar la radio.
DATA_CMM_0295.ko: 왼쪽 테이프는 왼쪽 스피커, 오른쪽 테이프는 오른쪽 스피커에서 들려온다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0295.zht: 左邊的音響播放左邊的錄音帶，右邊的音響是播放右邊的錄音帶的樣子。
DATA_CMM_0295.zhs: 左边的音响播放左边的录音带，右边的音响是播放右边的录音带的样子。

DATA_CMM_0296.ja: Important messages hang under this balloon, drifting gently in the wind.
DATA_CMM_0296.en: Important messages hang under this balloon, drifting gently in the wind.
DATA_CMM_0296.fr: Ce ballon transporte aux quatre vents des messages on ne peut plus importants.
DATA_CMM_0296.de: Unter diesem Ballon hängen wichtige Botschaften, die sanft im Wind schweben.
DATA_CMM_0296.es: Estos globos gigantes mecen la publicidad al viento...
DATA_CMM_0296.ko: 풍선 아래에 중요한 알림을 내걸고 하늘에 떠있다.
DATA_CMM_0296.zht: 飄在空中的氣球，底下懸掛著重要消息。
DATA_CMM_0296.zhs: 飘在空中的气球，底下悬挂着重要消息。

DATA_CMM_0297.ja: Good at pumping water, it seems. If you're lucky, you may tap into a hot spring.
DATA_CMM_0297.en: Good at pumping water, it seems. If you're lucky, you may tap into a hot spring.
DATA_CMM_0297.fr: Cet objet sait très bien pomper l'eau. Avec un peu de chance, vous pourriez découvrir un geyser.
DATA_CMM_0297.de: Sie kann anscheinend gut Wasser pumpen. Wenn du Glück hast, triffst du vielleicht auf eine heiße Quelle.
DATA_CMM_0297.it: Ottima per pompare acqua, la leggenda narra che se si è abbastanza fortunati può persino fuoriuscirne aranciata.
DATA_CMM_0297.es: Sirve para sacar agua; no hemos oído de nadie que haya encontrado petróleo.
DATA_CMM_0297.ko: 물을 빨아들이고 내뿜는 것이 장기인 듯하다. 뜨거운 물도 나온다.
DATA_CMM_0297.zht: 擅長從地底汲水到地面吐出。偶爾會汲取到熱水的樣子。
DATA_CMM_0297.zhs: 擅长从地底汲水到地面吐出。偶尔会汲取到热水的样子。

DATA_CMM_0298.ja: Festivals in Japan aren't really festivals unless someone is carting one of these around.
DATA_CMM_0298.en: Festivals in Japan aren't really festivals unless someone is carting one of these around.
DATA_CMM_0298.fr: Les festivals japonais ne sont pas vraiment des festivals si personne ne pousse l'un de ces autels sur une charrette.
DATA_CMM_0298.de: Festivals in Japan sind nicht wirklich Festivals, wenn nicht jemand so ein Ding herumschleppt.
DATA_CMM_0298.it: Tempietto tradizionale giapponese, viene trasportato durante le feste locali.
DATA_CMM_0298.es: Los festivales de Japón no son festivos si el omikoshi no sale en procesión.
DATA_CMM_0298.zht: 也有兒童神轎、女性神轎等，稱呼神轎的方式似乎會因抬轎的人而改變。
DATA_CMM_0298.zhs: 也有儿童神轿、女性神轿等，称呼神轿的方式似乎会因抬轿的人而改变。

DATA_CMM_0299.ja: A person on top, a fish down below. Occasionally falls in love with regular human beings.
DATA_CMM_0299.en: A person on top, a fish down below. Occasionally falls in love with regular human beings.
DATA_CMM_0299.fr: Femme-poisson... Elle s'éprend parfois d'hommes qui sont hommes jusqu'au bout des ongles, ce qui lui attire beaucoup d'ennuis.
DATA_CMM_0299.de: Oben ein Mensch, unten ein Fisch. Gelegentlich verliebt sie sich in normale Menschen.
DATA_CMM_0299.it: Mezza donna e mezzo pesce, spesso si innamora di uomini interi ma non ne capiamo il perché.
DATA_CMM_0299.es: Mitad mujer, mitad pez, pero tiene la manía de enamorarse de hombres con piernas.
DATA_CMM_0299.ko: 위는 사람, 밑은 생선으로 된 생물이다. 인간과 사랑에 빠지는 경우가 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_0299.zht: 上半身是人類，下半身是魚的生物。似乎也會和人類墜入情網。
DATA_CMM_0299.zhs: 上半身是人类，下半身是鱼的生物。似乎也会和人类坠入情网。

DATA_CMM_0300.ja: In high demand during the summer. People's eyes spin from watching it.
DATA_CMM_0300.en: In high demand during the summer. People's eyes spin from watching it.
DATA_CMM_0300.fr: Très demandés l'été. Si on les regarde intensément, ils peuvent avoir un effet hypnotisant.
DATA_CMM_0300.de: Im Sommer sehr gefragt. Den Leuten wird schwindlig, wenn sie ihr zusehen.
DATA_CMM_0300.it: Letale per le zanzare, non sappiamo se sia perché le tramortisce o perché le ipnotizza.
DATA_CMM_0300.es: Para librarse de invitados indeseables en las cenas en el jardín.
DATA_CMM_0300.ko: 여름이 되면 사방팔방에서 찾는 인기인. 그래서 뱅글뱅글 돌고 있군.
DATA_CMM_0300.zht: 似乎一到夏天變得炙手可熱。所以也忙得暈頭轉向。
DATA_CMM_0300.zhs: 似乎一到夏天变得炙手可热。所以也忙得晕头转向。

DATA_CMM_0301.ja: A bloodsucking insect. Your skin gets all red and itchy if one of these bites you.
DATA_CMM_0301.en: A bloodsucking insect. Your skin gets all red and itchy if one of these bites you.
DATA_CMM_0301.fr: Insecte vampire. La peau devient toute rouge là où l'un de ces monstres vous a piqué.
DATA_CMM_0301.de: Ein blutsaugendes Insekt. Deine Haut wird ganz rot und juckt, wenn du von einem solchen Insekt gestochen wirst.
DATA_CMM_0301.it: Una cosa che non capiamo delle zanzare è perché provochino prurito. Starebbero molto più simpatiche se succhiassero gocce di sangue senza dare fastidio.
DATA_CMM_0301.es: Te chupan la sangre y encima te dejan una picadura. Desde luego...
DATA_CMM_0301.ko: 피를 빠는 벌레. 물린 곳은 찹쌀떡처럼 부풀어올라 가렵다.
DATA_CMM_0301.zht: 吸血的蟲子。被咬的地方會腫得像麻糬，還很癢。
DATA_CMM_0301.zhs: 吸血的虫子。被咬的地方会肿得像麻糬，还很痒。

DATA_CMM_0302.ja: Lie back and relax on this big chair. Do not use it as a driver's seat. You may fall asleep.
DATA_CMM_0302.en: Lie back and relax on this big chair. Do not use it as a driver's seat. You may fall asleep.
DATA_CMM_0302.fr: Installez-vous confortablement dans ce siège, mais ne l'utilisez pas pour conduire, vous pourriez vous endormir.
DATA_CMM_0302.de: Lehn dich zurück und entspann dich auf diesem großen Stuhl. Benutze ihn nicht als Fahrersitz. Du könntest einschlafen.
DATA_CMM_0302.it: Poltrona dove ci si può comodamente rilassare. Rischio pisolino assicurato.
DATA_CMM_0302.es: Para tumbarse a leer o echarse siestas interminables.
DATA_CMM_0302.ko: 뒤로 젖히고 기댈 수 있다. 금방 졸려오기 때문에 운전석으로는 적합하지 않은 듯.
DATA_CMM_0302.zht: 往後靠就能懶洋洋的放鬆。會變得想睡覺，所以無法當成駕駛座。
DATA_CMM_0302.zhs: 往后靠就能懒洋洋的放松。会变得想睡觉，所以无法当成驾驶座。

DATA_CMM_0303.ja: A thrilling game where you dodge enemy bullets. Hopefully they won't hit anything off-screen...
DATA_CMM_0303.en: A thrilling game where you dodge enemy bullets. Hopefully they won't hit anything off-screen...
DATA_CMM_0303.fr: Un jeu prenant, dans lequel vous évitez les balles ennemies. Espérons qu'elles ne sortent pas de l'écran...
DATA_CMM_0303.de: Ein spannendes Spiel, bei dem du feindlichen Geschossen ausweichen musst. Hoffentlich treffen sie nichts außerhalb des Bildschirms ...
DATA_CMM_0303.it: Un gioco d'azione, speriamo che i proiettili non escano dallo schermo!
DATA_CMM_0303.es: Un juego lleno de emoción sin peligro real de daño físico, salvo en los dedos.
DATA_CMM_0303.ko: 적의 총알을 요리저리 피해나가는 스릴만점의 게임. 빗나간 총알의 행방이 나름대로 걱정된다.
DATA_CMM_0303.zht: 要穿過敵人子彈的驚險遊戲。射偏子彈的去向令人不安。
DATA_CMM_0303.zhs: 要穿过敌人子弹的惊险游戏。射偏子弹的去向令人不安。

DATA_CMM_0304.ja: Walking in these makes a very nice sound. They look very painful to wear though...
DATA_CMM_0304.en: Walking in these makes a very nice sound. They look very painful to wear though...
DATA_CMM_0304.fr: Si vous marchez avec ces sandales, vous ferez de la musique. Mais elles n'ont pas l'air très confortables...
DATA_CMM_0304.de: Beim Laufen in diesen Schuhen hört man ein sehr schönes Geräusch. Es sieht allerdings sehr schmerzhaft aus, sie zu tragen ...
DATA_CMM_0304.es: Hacen un ruido agradable al andar, pero parecen dolorosas de llevar...
DATA_CMM_0304.ko: 내일 날씨나 길을 헤매었을 때 점을 보는 도구로도 사용된다.
DATA_CMM_0304.zht: 據說能充當擲筊，預測隔天天氣的神奇鞋子。
DATA_CMM_0304.zhs: 据说能充当掷筊，预测隔天天气的神奇鞋子。

DATA_CMM_0305.ja: This smooth, shiny shoe keeps water out. It keeps water in, too!
DATA_CMM_0305.en: This smooth, shiny shoe keeps water out. It keeps water in, too!
DATA_CMM_0305.fr: Cette chaussure à la structure unie et brillante garde l'eau à l'extérieur... comme à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_0305.de: Dieser glatte, glänzende Schuh lässt das Wasser draußen. Und auch drinnen!
DATA_CMM_0305.it: Stivali che tengono fuori l'acqua. Oppure la possono anche tenere dentro.
DATA_CMM_0305.es: Para no mojarse los pies aunque caiga un diluvio.
DATA_CMM_0305.ko: 물에 젖는 것을 방지하는 맨들맨들한 신발. 안에 물이 들어간 경우에도 그 물을 꼼짝달싹 못하게 가둬버리는 대단한 물건.
DATA_CMM_0305.zht: 防水的光滑鞋子。性能優良，連進到鞋子裡的水也會被關住。
DATA_CMM_0305.zhs: 防水的光滑鞋子。性能优良，连进到鞋子里的水也会被关住。

DATA_CMM_0306.ja: For children, and therefore cute and tiny. With this, rainy days are fun days!
DATA_CMM_0306.en: For children, and therefore cute and tiny. With this, rainy days are fun days!
DATA_CMM_0306.fr: Elle est adaptée aux enfants : petite et mignonne. Grâce à elle, les jours pluvieux sont des jours heureux.
DATA_CMM_0306.de: Für Kinder und daher niedlich und klein. Hiermit werden Regentage zu Spaßtagen!
DATA_CMM_0306.it: Certi bambini attendono i giorni di pioggia per poterci giocare.
DATA_CMM_0306.es: Versión para niños pequeñita y mona. Los días de lluvia son días de fiesta.
DATA_CMM_0306.ko: 아이들용이라 좀더 귀엽다. 이것만 있으면 비오는 날이 매우 기다려진다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0306.zht: 小孩穿的雨鞋，有點可愛。有了這雙鞋會讓人期待下雨。
DATA_CMM_0306.zhs: 小孩穿的雨鞋，有点可爱。有了这双鞋会让人期待下雨。

DATA_CMM_0307.ja: A car that enjoys stuffing garbage into its maw. Not a finicky eater, thankfully.
DATA_CMM_0307.en: A car that enjoys stuffing garbage into its maw. Not a finicky eater, thankfully.
DATA_CMM_0307.fr: Ce véhicule n'aime rien tant que dévorer des ordures. Heureusement, il n'est pas très difficile.
DATA_CMM_0307.de: Ein Auto, das gerne Müll in sein Maul stopft. Zum Glück ist es kein wählerischer Esser.
DATA_CMM_0307.it: Un camion a cui piace riempirsi la bocca di spazzatura. Non molto schizzinoso fortunatamente.
DATA_CMM_0307.es: Se traga todo tipo de porquerías. Es muy de agradecer, pero huele tan mal...
DATA_CMM_0307.ko: 쓰레기를 입 안에 가득 넣고 다니는 차. 편식을 안 하는 것으로 알려졌다.
DATA_CMM_0307.zht: 讓人類把垃圾丟進嘴巴的車子。它不挑食，可以放心地丟。
DATA_CMM_0307.zhs: 让人类把垃圾丢进嘴巴的车子。它不挑食，可以放心地丢。

DATA_CMM_0308.ja: A high, windowless wall. Whoever put this up must really have something to hide.
DATA_CMM_0308.en: A high, windowless wall. Whoever put this up must really have something to hide.
DATA_CMM_0308.fr: Mur haut et sans fenêtres. Celui qui l'a construit là devait avoir beaucoup de choses à cacher.
DATA_CMM_0308.de: Eine hohe, fensterlose Wand. Wer auch immer sie errichtet hat, muss wirklich etwas zu verbergen haben.
DATA_CMM_0308.it: Sembra che vogliano nascondervi dietro qualcosa.
DATA_CMM_0308.es: Para que ningún viandante despistado se caiga en el agujero de los cimientos.
DATA_CMM_0308.ko: 창문이 없는 높은 벽. 정말 남에게 보이기 싫은 무언가가 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_0308.zht: 沒有窗戶的高牆。裡面可能有不想被人看到的東西。
DATA_CMM_0308.zhs: 没有窗户的高墙。里面可能有不想被人看到的东西。

DATA_CMM_0309.ja: A car for carrying heavy objects around. You can often hear country music coming from inside.
DATA_CMM_0309.en: A car for carrying heavy objects around. You can often hear country music coming from inside.
DATA_CMM_0309.fr: Souvent utilisé pour le transport d'objets lourds, ce véhicule swingue souvent aux mélodieux accords de country.
DATA_CMM_0309.de: Ein Auto, um schwere Gegenstände zu transportieren. Man hört oft Country-Musik aus dem Innenraum.
DATA_CMM_0309.it: Un veicolo per i trasporti pesanti.
DATA_CMM_0309.es: Este vehículo transporta cargas pesadas y pega unos bocinazos tremendos.
DATA_CMM_0309.ko: 무거운 것을 싣고 달리는 자동차. 가까이 가면 트로트가 들려오는 경우가 많다.
DATA_CMM_0309.zht: 載運沉重貨物的車子。接近它時常常能聽見演歌。
DATA_CMM_0309.zhs: 载运沉重货物的车子。接近它时常常能听见演歌。

DATA_CMM_0310.ja: A loooong vehicle that runs a set route. Often runs late.
DATA_CMM_0310.en: A loooong vehicle that runs a set route. Often runs late.
DATA_CMM_0310.fr: Très, très long véhicule qui effectue un itinéraire invariable. Il est souvent en retard.
DATA_CMM_0310.de: Ein überlanges Fahrzeug, das eine bestimmte Route fährt. Kommt oft zu spät.
DATA_CMM_0310.it: Un veicolo pubblico che fa sempre la stessa strada e in ritardo.
DATA_CMM_0310.es: Vehículo alargado para transporte de pasajeros. Tiene la costumbre de llegar tarde.
DATA_CMM_0310.ko: 기다란 탈것. 거리를 달리는 루트는 정해져 있으나, 멈췄다가 달렸다가 대단히 바쁜 녀석이다.
DATA_CMM_0310.zht: 很長的交通工具。在街道行駛的路線是固定的，但走走停停看起來很忙。
DATA_CMM_0310.zhs: 很长的交通工具。在街道行驶的路线是固定的，但走走停停看起来很忙。

DATA_CMM_0311.ja: They put up this pole and string so that the fish wouldn't fly away.
DATA_CMM_0311.en: They put up this pole and string so that the fish wouldn't fly away.
DATA_CMM_0311.fr: Le mat et la ficelle ne sont là que pour empêcher le poisson de prendre le large.
DATA_CMM_0311.de: Diese Stange und die Schnur wurden aufgehängt, damit der Fisch nicht wegfliegen konnte.
DATA_CMM_0311.it: Il palo è stato alzato per non far volar via il pesce.
DATA_CMM_0311.es: Estas tienen forma de pez; parece que están volando...
DATA_CMM_0311.ko: 하늘을 나는 생선이 도망 못 가도록 줄로 매어놓기 위한 봉.
DATA_CMM_0311.zht: 為了不讓魚從空中逃走，要用繩子綁在這根棒子上。
DATA_CMM_0311.zhs: 为了不让鱼从空中逃走，要用绳子绑在这根棒子上。

DATA_CMM_0312.ja: The biggest, most reliable carp... as long as there's a good wind, that is.
DATA_CMM_0312.en: The biggest, most reliable carp... as long as there's a good wind, that is.
DATA_CMM_0312.fr: La carpe la plus grande et la plus fiable, pourvu qu'elle soit dans le vent...
DATA_CMM_0312.de: Der größte und zuverlässigste Karpfen ... vorausgesetzt, es weht ein guter Wind.
DATA_CMM_0312.es: La banderola de pez más grande; luce mejor cuando hay buen viento.
DATA_CMM_0312.ko: 가장 믿음직한 잉어. 하지만 바람이 없을 때는 굉장히 무기력하다.
DATA_CMM_0312.zht: 最可靠的鯉魚。不過要是沒有風，黑鯉魚旗看起來會非常累。
DATA_CMM_0312.zhs: 最可靠的鲤鱼。不过要是没有风，黑鲤鱼旗看起来会非常累。

DATA_CMM_0313.ja: Magoi's first right-hand man. Swims happily in the air.
DATA_CMM_0313.en: Magoi's first right-hand man. Swims happily in the air.
DATA_CMM_0313.fr: Le premier adjoint de Magoi. Il flotte joyeusement dans l'air.
DATA_CMM_0313.de: Die erste rechte Hand von Magoi. Schwimmt fröhlich durch die Luft.
DATA_CMM_0313.it: Il braccio... Il pesce destro di Magoi.
DATA_CMM_0313.es: Este pez rojo siempre se agita en el viento junto a Magoi; son inseparables.
DATA_CMM_0313.zht: 嘍囉1號。看起來游得很有意思。
DATA_CMM_0313.zhs: 小弟1号。看起来游得很有意思。

DATA_CMM_0314.ja: Magoi's second right-hand man. Still a child, it seems.
DATA_CMM_0314.en: Magoi's second right-hand man. Still a child, it seems.
DATA_CMM_0314.fr: Le deuxième adjoint de Magoi. Il a encore l'air d'un enfant.
DATA_CMM_0314.de: Die zweite rechte Hand von Magoi. Scheint noch ein Kind zu sein.
DATA_CMM_0314.it: Un altro amico di Magoi, il più giovane.
DATA_CMM_0314.es: Esta banderola siempre acompaña a las anteriores; son un grupo muy unido.

DATA_CMM_0315.ja: Swims along with the carp streamers. We are fairly sure this is not a fish.
DATA_CMM_0315.en: Swims along with the carp streamers. We are fairly sure this is not a fish.
DATA_CMM_0315.fr: Accompagne les évolutions aériennes des carpes. Nous sommes pourtant certain qu'il n'appartient pas à la gent des poissons volants.
DATA_CMM_0315.de: Schwimmt mit den Karpfenfahnen mit. Wir sind ziemlich sicher, dass das kein Fisch ist.
DATA_CMM_0315.it: Nuota con Magoi e amici, ma siamo praticamente sicuri che non sia un pesce.
DATA_CMM_0315.es: Este árbol azotado por el viento también es una estrella de las banderolas.
DATA_CMM_0315.ko: 잉어 깃발과 함께 떠있다. 아무리 봐도 물고기로는 보이지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_0315.zht: 跟鯉魚旗們一同游泳。不過怎麼看都長得不像魚。
DATA_CMM_0315.zhs: 跟鲤鱼旗们一同游泳。不过怎么看都长得不像鱼。

DATA_CMM_0316.ja: Obviously very happy. She must have gotten a piece of corn out from her teeth.
DATA_CMM_0316.en: Obviously very happy. She must have gotten a piece of corn out from her teeth.
DATA_CMM_0316.fr: Évidemment très joyeux. Il a dû trouver un reste de repas entre deux dents.
DATA_CMM_0316.de: Offensichtlich sehr glücklich. Sie hat es wohl geschafft, ein Stück Mais zwischen ihren Zähnen zu entfernen.
DATA_CMM_0316.it: Molto allegra. Deve essersi tolta qualcosa dai denti.
DATA_CMM_0316.es: La alegría personificada, siempre parece que acaba de recibir buenas noticias.
DATA_CMM_0316.ko: 상당히 기뻐하고 있다. 이빨에 낀 김치를 빼냈기 때문인가~?
DATA_CMM_0316.zht: 笑得非常開心。她剃掉卡牙縫的蔬菜了嗎？
DATA_CMM_0316.zhs: 笑得非常开心。她剃掉卡牙缝的蔬菜了吗？

DATA_CMM_0317.ja: People put their butts on this. Every bottom is like a new chapter in its life story.
DATA_CMM_0317.en: People put their butts on this. Every bottom is like a new chapter in its life story.
DATA_CMM_0317.fr: Les gens y posent leur derrière. Chaque nouvel occupant écrit une page de sa longue histoire.
DATA_CMM_0317.de: Die Leute setzen ihren Hintern darauf. Jedes Hinterteil ist wie ein neues Kapitel in seiner Lebensgeschichte.
DATA_CMM_0317.it: C'è chi la preferisce ad altre panche.
DATA_CMM_0317.es: Sirve para sentarse; cada trasero deja su huella...
DATA_CMM_0317.ko: 여러 사람이 엉덩이를 올려놓는 것 같다. 엉덩이의 수만큼의 드라마가 펼쳐졌던 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0317.zht: 很多人會坐在上面。有多少人坐就有多少故事。
DATA_CMM_0317.zhs: 很多人会坐在上面。有多少人坐就有多少故事。

DATA_CMM_0318.ja: A round toy you go inside and spin around in. Not very fun unless you have at least two people.
DATA_CMM_0318.en: A round toy you go inside and spin around in. Not very fun unless you have at least two people.
DATA_CMM_0318.fr: Jouet dans lequel on rentre avant de le faire tourner. Il n'est pas très marrant, à moins d'être deux.
DATA_CMM_0318.de: Ein rundes Spielzeug, in das man hineingeht und in dem man sich drehen kann. Macht nicht viel Spaß, wenn man nicht mindestens zu zweit ist.
DATA_CMM_0318.es: Si te metes dentro darás vueltas y más vueltas, pero es más divertido si sois dos.
DATA_CMM_0318.ko: 안에 갇히는 것뿐만이 아니라 빙글빙글 돌리기까지 하는 놀이기구. 둘 이상 놀지 않으면 별 재미가 없다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0318.zht: 人關在裡頭轉圈圈的球型遊樂設施。至少要兩個人一起玩才有趣。
DATA_CMM_0318.zhs: 人关在里头转圈圈的球型游乐设施。至少要两个人一起玩才有趣。

DATA_CMM_0319.ja: A toy that goes up and down. Not meant to measure weight, but it often turns out that way.
DATA_CMM_0319.en: A toy that goes up and down. Not meant to measure weight, but it often turns out that way.
DATA_CMM_0319.fr: Ce jeu balance les enfants de bas en haut. Il n'a pas été conçu pour mesurer le poids, mais il sert souvent de cette manière.
DATA_CMM_0319.de: Ein Spielzeug, das hoch und runter geht. Es ist nicht dazu gedacht, das Gewicht zu messen, aber es macht das häufig trotzdem.
DATA_CMM_0319.it: Sembra una bilancia, ma in realtà è un gioco.
DATA_CMM_0319.es: Si uno de los dos pesa mucho más que el otro, jugar aquí no molará nada.
DATA_CMM_0319.ko: 무게를 재는 것이 목적은 아닌 것 같다. 끼익 철커덕 하며 노는 도구.
DATA_CMM_0319.zht: 看來不是量體重的。一上一下翹來翹去的遊樂設施。
DATA_CMM_0319.zhs: 看来不是量体重的。一上一下翘来翘去的游乐设施。

DATA_CMM_0320.ja: A well-ventilated structure made of iron bars. The upper levels are the most popular.
DATA_CMM_0320.en: A well-ventilated structure made of iron bars. The upper levels are the most popular.
DATA_CMM_0320.fr: Cette structure est faite de barres de métal ; les niveaux les plus hauts ont la cote.
DATA_CMM_0320.de: Eine gut belüftete Struktur aus Eisenstangen. Die oberen Etagen sind am beliebtesten.
DATA_CMM_0320.it: Non è un castello vero, è un gioco per bambini.
DATA_CMM_0320.es: Los niños suelen pelearse por estar arriba... ¿Será por las vistas?
DATA_CMM_0320.ko: 뼈로만 만들어져 바람이 잘 통하는 건축물. 2층이나 3층보다 이곳 꼭대기의 인기가 훨씬 좋다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0320.zht: 這個建築只有骨架，非常通風。比起二樓或三樓，頂樓最受歡迎的樣子。
DATA_CMM_0320.zhs: 这个建筑只有骨架，非常通风。比起二楼或三楼，顶楼最受欢迎的样子。

DATA_CMM_0321.ja: Provides a brief moment of fun in exchange for several seconds of thankless toil.
DATA_CMM_0321.en: Provides a brief moment of fun in exchange for several seconds of thankless toil.
DATA_CMM_0321.fr: Offre un moment de glissage inoubliable récompensant plusieurs secondes de terribles efforts.
DATA_CMM_0321.de: Bringt einen kurzen Moment Spaß im Austausch für etliche Sekunden undankbarer Plackerei.
DATA_CMM_0321.it: Non siamo sicuri valga la pena faticare per salire quando la discesa è così breve.
DATA_CMM_0321.es: Una vez nunca es suficiente; siempre acabas volviendo a subir.
DATA_CMM_0321.ko: 고생하여 올라간 후, 일순간의 쾌감을 만끽하는 곳.
DATA_CMM_0321.zht: 為了一瞬間的快感而費勁爬上高處的東西。
DATA_CMM_0321.zhs: 为了一瞬间的快感而费劲爬上高处的东西。

DATA_CMM_0322.ja: Families gather around this warm table in winter. Cats like it too, so watch your step.
DATA_CMM_0322.en: Families gather around this warm table in winter. Cats like it too, so watch your step.
DATA_CMM_0322.fr: Les familles se réunissent autour de cette table chauffante en hiver. Les chats aussi, alors attention où vous mettez les pieds.
DATA_CMM_0322.de: Im Winter versammeln sich die Familien um diesen warmen Tisch. Auch Katzen mögen ihn, also pass auf, wo du hintrittst.
DATA_CMM_0322.it: Le famiglie si siedono in questo tavolo riscaldante durante l'inverno. Piace anche ai gatti, quindi fateli spazio.
DATA_CMM_0322.es: Es como una mesa camilla con brasero y todo, pero cuadrada. Le gusta incluso al gato.
DATA_CMM_0322.ko: 추울 때 모두가 모여드는 휴식처. 고양이도 들어오므로 밟지 않도록 주의가 필요하다.
DATA_CMM_0322.zht: 冬天時大家會聚在這裡休息。小心別踩到跟著鑽進來的貓咪。
DATA_CMM_0322.zhs: 冬天时大家会聚在这里休息。小心别踩到跟着钻进来的猫咪。

DATA_CMM_0323.ja: Packed full of unnecessary items. Entire islands have been made from this stuff.
DATA_CMM_0323.en: Packed full of unnecessary items. Entire islands have been made from this stuff.
DATA_CMM_0323.fr: Regorge d'objets inutiles. On les rassemble pour en faire des îles.
DATA_CMM_0323.de: Vollgepackt mit nutzlosen Dingen. Aus diesem Zeug wurden schon ganze Inseln gemacht.
DATA_CMM_0323.it: Cose che la gente non vuole più. Quanta tristezza nell'immondizia. Quanta amarezza nella vita.
DATA_CMM_0323.es: O sea, todas las cosas que no quieres. Suele oler bastante mal.
DATA_CMM_0323.ko: 필요없는 것들이 가득하다. 이것으로 구성된 섬이 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_0323.zht: 聚集很多不需要的東西。似乎有島嶼是用資源回收做出來的。
DATA_CMM_0323.zhs: 聚集很多不需要的东西。似乎有岛屿是用资源回收做出来的。

DATA_CMM_0324.ja: A board used to ride on waves. Apparently it's more fashionable to stand up on it than to lie stomach down.
DATA_CMM_0324.en: A board used to ride on waves. Apparently it's more fashionable to stand up on it than to lie stomach down.
DATA_CMM_0324.fr: Planche utilisée pour prendre les vagues. Il semble plus cool de s'y tenir debout, en équilibre, que sur le ventre.
DATA_CMM_0324.de: Ein Brett, mit dem man auf den Wellen reitet. Anscheinend ist es modischer, darauf zu stehen, als sich auf den Bauch zu legen.
DATA_CMM_0324.it: Tavola non per mangiare ma per cavalcare le onde, ma non a cavalcioni.
DATA_CMM_0324.es: Sirve para navegar sobre las olas; no la uses para planchar la ropa.
DATA_CMM_0324.ko: 파도를 타기 위한 널판지인 듯. 시대의 파도도 탈 수 있는지는 불명.
DATA_CMM_0324.zht: 似乎是能衝浪的板子。不知道能不能衝時代的浪潮。
DATA_CMM_0324.zhs: 似乎是能冲浪的板子。不知道能不能冲时代的浪潮。

DATA_CMM_0325.ja: Put this under your bottom before you sit down. People also throw these after a really good sumo match.
DATA_CMM_0325.en: Put this under your bottom before you sit down. People also throw these after a really good sumo match.
DATA_CMM_0325.fr: Mettez-le sous vos fesses avant de vous asseoir. Il est souvent d'usage de se les jeter à la figure après un super match de sumo.
DATA_CMM_0325.de: Leg das unter deinen Hintern, bevor du dich hinsetzt. Viele werfen sie auch nach einem richtig guten Sumokampf.
DATA_CMM_0325.it: Cuscino giapponese, una delizia per il fondoschiena.
DATA_CMM_0325.es: Para sentarse cómodamente y para taparse la cara cuando miras una peli de miedo.
DATA_CMM_0325.ko: 앉을 때 엉덩이 밑에 까는 물건. 씨름선수들에게 집어 던질 때도 있다.
DATA_CMM_0325.zht: 坐著時墊在屁股下的東西。有時似乎也會拋坐墊給相撲力士。
DATA_CMM_0325.zhs: 坐着时垫在屁股下的东西。有时似乎也会抛坐垫给相扑力士。

DATA_CMM_0326.ja: Cook fish with this, and you'll attract a hungry crowd in a hurry.
DATA_CMM_0326.en: Cook fish with this, and you'll attract a hungry crowd in a hurry.
DATA_CMM_0326.fr: Cuisinez un peu de poisson avec, et vous attirerez une foule affamée en un clin d'œil.
DATA_CMM_0326.de: Wenn du hiermit Fisch zubereitest, lockst du in kürzester Zeit eine hungrige Menge an.
DATA_CMM_0326.it: L'argilla è ottima per certe pietanze.
DATA_CMM_0326.es: En cuanto metas el pescado, vendrán los vecinos a ver si les invitas.
DATA_CMM_0326.ko: 이것을 이용하여 생선을 구우면 냄새에 이끌려 몰려드는 사람이 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_0326.zht: 用陶土炭火爐烤魚的話，似乎會有人尋著魚香味而來。
DATA_CMM_0326.zhs: 用陶土炭火炉烤鱼的话，似乎会有人寻着鱼香味而来。

DATA_CMM_0327.ja: This one is for adults. It can carry a lot of weight, making it invaluable for shopping trips.
DATA_CMM_0327.en: This one is for adults. It can carry a lot of weight, making it invaluable for shopping trips.
DATA_CMM_0327.fr: Celui-ci est pour les adultes. Il peut transporter beaucoup de poids, et est donc indispensable pour aller faire les courses.
DATA_CMM_0327.de: Dieses Modell ist für Erwachsene gedacht. Es kann ein hohes Gewicht tragen und ist daher unbezahlbar für Einkaufstouren.
DATA_CMM_0327.it: Per adulti, utilissimo per fare la spesa e per gareggiare con gli amici in tutta sicurezza.
DATA_CMM_0327.es: Solo para adultos; como puede cargar mucho peso, es ideal para la compra.
DATA_CMM_0327.ko: 어른용 세발 자전거. 짐을 잔뜩 실을 수 있기 때문에 쇼핑에 자주 이용한다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0327.zht: 成人用的三輪車。因為能載很多行李，是購物時的重要工具。
DATA_CMM_0327.zhs: 成人用的三轮车。因为能载很多行李，是购物时的重要工具。

DATA_CMM_0328.ja: Pedal this vehicle to go forward. Difficult to use if your legs are too long.
DATA_CMM_0328.en: Pedal this vehicle to go forward. Difficult to use if your legs are too long.
DATA_CMM_0328.fr: Pédalez pour avancer. Si vos jambes sont trop longues, vous aurez l'air bête.
DATA_CMM_0328.de: Tritt in die Pedale dieses Fahrzeugs, um vorwärts zu fahren. Schwierig zu benutzen, wenn deine Beine zu lang sind.
DATA_CMM_0328.it: Più si cresce e più è difficile usarlo. Ha anche la retromarcia.
DATA_CMM_0328.es: Pedalea con fuerza y llegarás lejos.
DATA_CMM_0328.ko: 발로 끼익끼익 페달을 돌리면 앞으로 가는 자전거. 다리가 길면 못 탄다.
DATA_CMM_0328.zht: 用腳吱吱嘎嘎踩踏前進的交通工具。腳長的話似乎很難騎乘。
DATA_CMM_0328.zhs: 用脚吱吱嘎嘎踩踏前进的交通工具。脚长的话似乎很难骑乘。

DATA_CMM_0329.ja: A bag made out of paper. The bottom will fall out if you put in too many things, so be careful.
DATA_CMM_0329.en: A bag made out of paper. The bottom will fall out if you put in too many things, so be careful.
DATA_CMM_0329.fr: Sac de papier ! Attention à ne pas trop le charger, ou il se fâchera et explosera.
DATA_CMM_0329.de: Eine Tüte aus Papier. Der Boden fällt heraus, wenn man zu viele Dinge hineinpackt, also Vorsicht.
DATA_CMM_0329.it: Abbiamo sempre paura che si rompa, ma è più resistente di quello che sembra.
DATA_CMM_0329.es: Si pones demasiadas cosas dentro, se romperá el fondo y se caerá todo.
DATA_CMM_0329.ko: 종이로 만들어진 봉투 같다. 물건을 너무 많이 넣으면 밑이 터져버리므로 주의.
DATA_CMM_0329.zht: 好像是紙做的袋子。小心放太多東西，底部會破掉。
DATA_CMM_0329.zhs: 好像是纸做的袋子。小心放太多东西，底部会破掉。

DATA_CMM_0330.ja: Used to heat up rooms. Occasionally enclosed in a protective cage.
DATA_CMM_0330.en: Used to heat up rooms. Occasionally enclosed in a protective cage.
DATA_CMM_0330.fr: Utilisé pour chauffer les maisons. Parfois emprisonné dans une cage.
DATA_CMM_0330.de: Zum Beheizen von Räumen. Ist manchmal von einem Schutzkäfig umschlossen.
DATA_CMM_0330.it: Molto utile per le serate invernali e per case fredde.
DATA_CMM_0330.es: Calienta bien, pero el combustible sale carísimo.
DATA_CMM_0330.ko: 방을 데우는 도구. 가끔 우리 안에 갇히는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_0330.zht: 溫暖房間的道具。似乎有時候會被困在溫暖的房裡。
DATA_CMM_0330.zhs: 温暖房间的道具。似乎有时候会被困在温暖的房里。

DATA_CMM_0331.ja: A large stone. We're not exactly sure what it's for.
DATA_CMM_0331.en: A large stone. We're not exactly sure what it's for.
DATA_CMM_0331.fr: Gros rocher. Nous ne savons pas exactement à quoi il sert.
DATA_CMM_0331.de: Ein großer Stein. Wir sind nicht genau sicher, für was der gut ist.
DATA_CMM_0331.it: Una grande pietra. Non chiedeteci di cosa si tratti.
DATA_CMM_0331.es: No sabemos exactamente para qué sirve, pero luce bien.
DATA_CMM_0331.ko: 커다란 돌. 누름돌은 아니라지만 뭐 비슷한 놈이겠지.
DATA_CMM_0331.zht: 巨大的石頭。不是壓醃菜用的，但好像是類似的東西。
DATA_CMM_0331.zhs: 巨大的石头。不是压腌菜用的，但好像是类似的东西。

DATA_CMM_0332.ja: Lots of handles make this wheel easy to turn.
DATA_CMM_0332.en: Lots of handles make this wheel easy to turn.
DATA_CMM_0332.fr: Grâce à ses nombreuses poignées, ce volant est facile à tourner.
DATA_CMM_0332.de: Dank der vielen Griffe lässt sich dieses Rad leicht drehen.
DATA_CMM_0332.it: Un volante con moltissime maniglie, probabilmente si può guidare in sei.
DATA_CMM_0332.es: Tiene un montón de mangos para que sea fácil de girar.
DATA_CMM_0332.ko: 어쨌든 돌리기 쉽게 잡을 곳이 잔뜩 달려있다.
DATA_CMM_0332.zht: 為了好旋轉，上面裝了非常多握把。
DATA_CMM_0332.zhs: 为了好旋转，上面装了非常多握把。

DATA_CMM_0333.ja: Used to water flowers, amongst other things. If you have some soap, you can even wash your hands.
DATA_CMM_0333.en: Used to water flowers, amongst other things. If you have some soap, you can even wash your hands.
DATA_CMM_0333.fr: Utilisé pour arroser les fleurs, entre autres. Si vous avez du savon, vous pourrez même vous laver les mains.
DATA_CMM_0333.de: Dient unter anderem zum Gießen von Blumen. Wenn du etwas Seife hast, kannst du dir sogar die Hände waschen.
DATA_CMM_0333.it: Puoi utilizzarlo per dar da bere ai fiori, tra le tante cose. Se hai una del sapone, ti ci puoi persino lavare le mani.
DATA_CMM_0333.es: Ideal para no tener que salir al pozo con un cubo cada vez que quieres agua.
DATA_CMM_0333.ko: 꽃에 물을 줄 때 사용하는 등 매우 편리하다. 비누가 있으면 손도 깨끗하게 씻을 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_0333.zht: 要澆花的時候相當方便。有肥皂的話，還能洗手。
DATA_CMM_0333.zhs: 要浇花的时候相当方便。有肥皂的话，还能洗手。

DATA_CMM_0334.ja: A great person who sat cross-legged for a long time.
DATA_CMM_0334.en: A great person who sat cross-legged for a long time.
DATA_CMM_0334.fr: Grande personne qui s'est longtemps assise en tailleur.
DATA_CMM_0334.de: Eine große Persönlichkeit, die lange im Schneidersitz gesessen hat.
DATA_CMM_0334.it: Una grande persona che è rimasta seduta a gambe incrociate per molto tempo.
DATA_CMM_0334.es: Una gran persona que pasó demasiado tiempo con las piernas cruzadas.
DATA_CMM_0334.ko: 좌선 자세로 오랜 시간 앉아 있던 대단한 사람이다.

DATA_CMM_0335.ja: Look at this to get an idea of the planet's shape. It feels smooth, but the real thing is much rougher.
DATA_CMM_0335.en: Look at this to get an idea of the planet's shape. It feels smooth, but the real thing is much rougher.
DATA_CMM_0335.fr: Regardez-le pour avoir une idée de la forme de la planète. Il est peut-être lisse, mais la réalité est bien plus rugueuse...
DATA_CMM_0335.de: Wirf einen Blick hierauf, um eine Vorstellung von der Form des Planeten zu bekommen. Fühlt sich glatt an, ist aber in Wirklichkeit viel unebener.
DATA_CMM_0335.it: Si usa per avere un'idea della forma della Terra. Quella vera è molto più ruvida, però.
DATA_CMM_0335.es: Para que te hagas una idea de cómo es el planeta, pero en pequeñito.
DATA_CMM_0335.ko: 이 별의 모양새를 대충 알 수 있는 물건. 만져보면 매끈매끈하지만 오리지널은 상당히 울퉁불퉁하다.
DATA_CMM_0335.zht: 看了就知道地球大概的形狀。模型摸起來很光滑，實際上卻是凹凹凸凸。
DATA_CMM_0335.zhs: 看了就知道地球大概的形状。模型摸起来很光滑，实际上却是凹凹凸凸。

DATA_CMM_0336.ja: People used to walk the streets at night carrying these. Some deep-sea fish still use them today.
DATA_CMM_0336.en: People used to walk the streets at night carrying these. Some deep-sea fish still use them today.
DATA_CMM_0336.fr: Autrefois, les gens parcouraient les rues la nuit en portant ces objets. Il paraît que des poissons d'eau profonde les utilisent encore.
DATA_CMM_0336.de: Früher liefen die Menschen nachts mit ihnen durch die Straßen. Einige Tiefseefische benutzen sie noch heute.
DATA_CMM_0336.it: Nel passato venivano usate dai viandanti. Non sappiamo a chi sia venuta l'idea di fare delle lanterne con la carta...
DATA_CMM_0336.es: Antes la gente los llevaba cuando paseaba de noche. Los peces abisales, también.
DATA_CMM_0336.ko: 옛날에 어두운 곳을 지날 때 사용한 것 같다. 지금도 이것을 머리에 달고 다니는 물고기가 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0336.zht: 很久以前走在黑暗中使用的東西。現在還是有些魚會頂在頭上。
DATA_CMM_0336.zhs: 很久以前走在黑暗中使用的东西。现在还是有些鱼会顶在头上。

DATA_CMM_0337.ja: A tool for getting a clear look at the stars. Don't forget to close one eye before using it.
DATA_CMM_0337.en: A tool for getting a clear look at the stars. Don't forget to close one eye before using it.
DATA_CMM_0337.fr: Instrument permettant de regarder les étoiles de près. N'oubliez pas de faire un clin d'œil avant de regarder à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_0337.de: Ein Werkzeug für einen klaren Blick auf die Sterne. Vergiss nicht, ein Auge zu schließen, bevor du es benutzt.
DATA_CMM_0337.it: Attenzione: chiudere l'occhio che non si appoggia al telescopio, non l'inverso.
DATA_CMM_0337.es: Sirve para mirar las estrellas; no te olvides de cerrar el otro ojo.
DATA_CMM_0337.ko: 별이 잘 보이는 도구. 두 눈으로 보려면 잘 안 보인다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0337.zht: 能清晰看見星星的道具。兩眼同時看的話似乎會不清楚。
DATA_CMM_0337.zhs: 能清晰看见星星的道具。两眼同时看的话似乎会不清楚。

DATA_CMM_0338.ja: Easy to break down when it's time to move. Good for outdoorsy types.
DATA_CMM_0338.en: Easy to break down when it's time to move. Good for outdoorsy types.
DATA_CMM_0338.fr: Facile à démonter quand sonne l'heure de déménager. Convient très bien à ceux qui aiment vivre dehors.
DATA_CMM_0338.de: Leicht zerlegbar, wenn es Zeit für einen Umzug ist. Gut für Outdoor-Typen.
DATA_CMM_0338.it: Troppo fragile per i Nostri reali gusti.
DATA_CMM_0338.es: Para jugar a los indios aunque sea en el jardín.
DATA_CMM_0338.ko: 이동할 때 편리한 접이식 건물. 아웃도어파에게는 좋은 물건일지도…
DATA_CMM_0338.zht: 方便移動的組合式建築。在戶外活動時使用也許不錯。
DATA_CMM_0338.zhs: 方便移动的组合式建筑。在户外活动时使用也许不错。

DATA_CMM_0339.ja: A shiny gold object. Having lots of these lined up on the shelf makes people feel content.
DATA_CMM_0339.en: A shiny gold object. Having lots of these lined up on the shelf makes people feel content.
DATA_CMM_0339.fr: Objet doré et brillant. Les gens sont généralement fiers d'en aligner beaucoup sur leurs étagères.
DATA_CMM_0339.de: Ein glänzendes Goldobjekt. Wer viele davon im Regal stehen hat, ist zufrieden.
DATA_CMM_0339.it: In genere chi ne ha un sacco ama vantarsene con gli amici.
DATA_CMM_0339.es: Un objeto dorado y brillante. La gente se enorgullece si tiene muchos de estos en el salón.
DATA_CMM_0339.ko: 번쩍번쩍한 장식물. 이것이 선반에 잔뜩 놓여져 있으면 기분이 좋다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0339.zht: 亮晶晶的耀眼擺飾。在層架上排列很多獎盃的話似乎會很開心。
DATA_CMM_0339.zhs: 亮晶晶的耀眼摆饰。在层架上排列很多奖杯的话似乎会很开心。

DATA_CMM_0340.ja: Great for cooking beef, pork, chicken, crab, fish, and anything else you can eat.
DATA_CMM_0340.en: Great for cooking beef, pork, chicken, crab, fish, and anything else you can eat.
DATA_CMM_0340.fr: Super pour cuisiner du bœuf, du porc, du poulet, du crabe, du poisson... En fait, tout ce que vous voulez manger !
DATA_CMM_0340.de: Hervorragend geeignet für die Zubereitung von Rind-, Schweine-, Hühner-, Krabben- und Fischgerichten sowie für alles andere, was man essen kann.
DATA_CMM_0340.it: Ottima per cucinare manzo, pollo, pesce, verdure, crostacei... Insomma: tutto.
DATA_CMM_0340.es: Ideal para cocinar ternera, cerdo, pollo, pescado y todo lo que se te ocurra.
DATA_CMM_0340.ko: 뭐든지 팍 삶아 버리는 신기한 냄비. 화가 나면 폭발해 버리는 위험한 녀석도 가끔 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_0340.zht: 如果叫牛豬雞蟹牡蠣鯛魚河豚火鍋的話太長了。所以裡面有很多食材時，都叫相撲鍋吧。
DATA_CMM_0340.zhs: 如果叫牛猪鸡蟹牡蛎鲷鱼河豚火锅的话太长了。所以里面有很多食材时，都叫相扑锅吧。

DATA_CMM_0341.ja: A pot used for boiling slices of meat. Apparently the part in the center is nothing too important.
DATA_CMM_0341.en: A pot used for boiling slices of meat. Apparently the part in the center is nothing too important.
DATA_CMM_0341.fr: Ustensile servant à faire bouillir des tranches de viande. La partie centrale ne semble pas très importante.
DATA_CMM_0341.de: Ein Topf, der zum Kochen von Fleischscheiben verwendet wird. Der Teil in der Mitte scheint nicht allzu wichtig zu sein.
DATA_CMM_0341.it: Usata per intingervi fettine di carne da cucinare e mangiare al momento.
DATA_CMM_0341.es: Sirve para hervir tiras de carne, que salen ricas, ricas.
DATA_CMM_0341.ko: 고기를 뜨거운 물에 씻어 먹기 위한 냄비. 가운데 장식물은 특별히 신경쓰지 않아도 된다.
DATA_CMM_0341.zht: 盛滿熱湯的鍋子，可以川燙肉片來吃。別太介意鍋子中間隆起。
DATA_CMM_0341.zhs: 盛满热汤的锅子，可以川烫肉片来吃。别太介意锅子中间隆起。

DATA_CMM_0342.ja: A bike used for delivering pizzas. Fairly normal specs, considering its need for speed.
DATA_CMM_0342.en: A bike used for delivering pizzas. Fairly normal specs, considering its need for speed.
DATA_CMM_0342.fr: Cette mobylette est utilisée pour livrer des pizzas. Elle a été dopée pour aller plus vite.
DATA_CMM_0342.de: Ein Fahrrad zum Ausliefern von Pizza. Recht gewöhnliches Modell, wenn man bedenkt, wie schnell es sein muss.
DATA_CMM_0342.it: Una moto usata per consegnare le pizze.
DATA_CMM_0342.es: Es el que usan para repartir pizzas, pero no es que sea más veloz que los demás.
DATA_CMM_0342.ko: 피자를 배달하는 오토바이. 빨리 배달해야 하지만 성능은 고만고만하다.
DATA_CMM_0342.zht: 送披薩的機車。明明必須盡快趁熱送達，車子性能卻很普通。
DATA_CMM_0342.zhs: 送披萨的机车。明明必须尽快趁热送达，车子性能却很普通。

DATA_CMM_0343.ja: A bike used for deliveries. Looks different from the pizza bike, but both are basically the same thing.
DATA_CMM_0343.en: A bike used for deliveries. Looks different from the pizza bike, but both are basically the same thing.
DATA_CMM_0343.fr: Mobylette utilisée pour livrer des repas. Elle a l'air différente de sa collègue pizzaïolo, mais c'est une illusion.
DATA_CMM_0343.de: Ein Fahrrad für Lieferungen. Sieht anders aus als das Pizza-Fahrrad, aber beide sind im Grunde gleich.
DATA_CMM_0343.it: Una moto usata per consegnare del cibo dai ristoranti che fanno servizio a domicilio.
DATA_CMM_0343.es: Sirve para entregar comida a domicilio. Es distinto, pero en el fondo es igual.
