DATA_CMM_1364.fr: Une chouette petite boutique ouverte à toute heure du jour et de la nuit. Les vendeurs ne dorment donc jamais ?
DATA_CMM_1364.de: Ein nützlicher Laden, der rund um die Uhr geöffnet ist. Wir fragen uns, wann der Angestellte schlafen geht.
DATA_CMM_1364.it: Un negozio molto utile aperto a tutte le ore. Chissà come fa il commesso a non dormire mai.
DATA_CMM_1364.es: Muy práctica para los clientes, pero no sabemos cuándo duerme el dueño.
DATA_CMM_1364.ko: 하루 종일 열려있는 편리한 가게. 점원들은 언제 잠을 자는지 신기하기만 하다.
DATA_CMM_1364.zht: 營業一整天的便利商店。不知道店員都什麼時候睡覺。
DATA_CMM_1364.zhs: 营业一整天的便利商店。不知道店员都什么时候睡觉。

DATA_CMM_1365.ja: This looks like a flower, but it's actually a giant pile of small bugs.
DATA_CMM_1365.en: This looks like a flower, but it's actually a giant pile of small bugs.
DATA_CMM_1365.fr: On dirait une fleur, mais en fait c'est un énorme tas de toutes petites bêtes.
DATA_CMM_1365.de: Sieht aus wie eine Blume, ist aber eigentlich ein riesiger Haufen kleiner Käfer.
DATA_CMM_1365.it: Sembra un fiore ma in realtà è una figura composta da tantissime creaturine.
DATA_CMM_1365.es: Parece una flor, pero rasca bastante y en realidad no huele a nada.
DATA_CMM_1365.ko: 꽃처럼 보이지만 사실은 작은 벌레들이 모여서 만들어진 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1365.zht: 看起來很像花，但據說是小蟲聚集形成的。
DATA_CMM_1365.zhs: 看起来很像花，但据说是小虫聚集形成的。

DATA_CMM_1366.ja: There are some vacation spots made entirely of these.
DATA_CMM_1366.en: There are some vacation spots made entirely of these.
DATA_CMM_1366.fr: Certaines destinations touristiques sont composées presque uniquement de ces animaux.
DATA_CMM_1366.de: Es gibt Urlaubsorte, die nur hieraus bestehen.
DATA_CMM_1366.it: Ci sono delle isole che sono fatte solamente di corallo.
DATA_CMM_1366.es: El turismo en masa lo está destruyendo; mejor míralo en documentales.
DATA_CMM_1366.ko: 이것이 잔뜩 모여있는 관광지가 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1366.zht: 好像有個觀光地就是因為許多這個聚集才形成的。
DATA_CMM_1366.zhs: 好像有个观光地就是因为许多这个聚集才形成的。

DATA_CMM_1367.ja: This piece is very popular. It's always surrounded by fish.
DATA_CMM_1367.en: This piece is very popular. It's always surrounded by fish.
DATA_CMM_1367.fr: Les poissons adorent celui-ci, ils se bousculent pour l'admirer.
DATA_CMM_1367.de: Dieses Stück ist sehr beliebt. Es ist immer von Fischen umgeben.
DATA_CMM_1367.it: Molto amato dai pesci che lo circondano di continuo.
DATA_CMM_1367.es: Debe de ser el más simpático del fondo marino; siempre está rodeado de peces.
DATA_CMM_1367.ko: 주변에 물고기나 벌레들이 잔뜩 모여드는 바다의 인기인.
DATA_CMM_1367.zht: 周遭有豐富的魚、蟲類聚集，是海裡的大熱門。
DATA_CMM_1367.zhs: 周遭有丰富的鱼、虫类聚集，是海里的大热门。

DATA_CMM_1368.ja: Whether on land or in the ocean, this has the power to endlessly fascinate people.
DATA_CMM_1368.en: Whether on land or in the ocean, this has the power to endlessly fascinate people.
DATA_CMM_1368.fr: Qu'il soit sur la terre ferme ou sous l'eau, il fascine les gens.
DATA_CMM_1368.de: Ob an Land oder im Meer, das hier hat die Kraft, die Menschen unendlich zu faszinieren.
DATA_CMM_1368.it: Ha il potere di affascinare la gente.
DATA_CMM_1368.es: Se usa como adorno en la superficie, pero es mucho más bonito bajo el mar.
DATA_CMM_1368.ko: 바닷속에서나 육지에서나 사람을 매료시키는 매력의 소유자.
DATA_CMM_1368.zht: 據說不論在海底還是陸地上都有令人醉心的魅力。
DATA_CMM_1368.zhs: 据说不论在海底还是陆地上都有令人醉心的魅力。

DATA_CMM_1369.ja: This is the same color as the ocean, so it could be hard to spot.
DATA_CMM_1369.en: This is the same color as the ocean, so it could be hard to spot.
DATA_CMM_1369.fr: Celui-ci est de la même couleur que l'océan : il est bien camouflé !
DATA_CMM_1369.de: Sie hat die gleiche Farbe wie der Ozean und könnte daher schwer zu erkennen sein.
DATA_CMM_1369.it: Ha lo stesso colore dell'oceano, diventa quindi difficile da trovare.
DATA_CMM_1369.es: Este es del color del agua; será para pasar desapercibido.
DATA_CMM_1369.ko: 바닷속에서는 바닷물과 색이 비슷해서 구분하기 힘들지도 모르겠다.
DATA_CMM_1369.zht: 在海裡顏色跟環境一致，也許不容易發現。
DATA_CMM_1369.zhs: 在海里颜色跟环境一致，也许不容易发现。

DATA_CMM_1370.ja: This isn't any fun by itself. You need a giant spinning wheel, too.
DATA_CMM_1370.en: This isn't any fun by itself. You need a giant spinning wheel, too.
DATA_CMM_1370.fr: Toute seule, elle ne sert à rien. Ajoutez-y une grosse roue qui tourne, c'est autre chose !
DATA_CMM_1370.de: Das allein macht noch keinen Spaß. Man braucht dazu noch ein riesiges, sich drehendes Rad.
DATA_CMM_1370.it: Non è divertente da sola, ci vuole anche la ruota!
DATA_CMM_1370.es: Esto no tiene nada de divertido por sí solo; falta la rueda enorme que gira.
DATA_CMM_1370.ko: 이것만으로는 아무것도 즐길 수 없다. 빙글빙글 도는 거대한 고리가 필요하다.
DATA_CMM_1370.zht: 光有這個一點都不有趣，還需要有轉個不停的巨大轉輪。
DATA_CMM_1370.zhs: 光有这个一点都不有趣，还需要有转个不停的巨大转轮。

DATA_CMM_1371.ja: We don't know what this factory builds, but apparently it's something important.
DATA_CMM_1371.en: We don't know what this factory builds, but apparently it's something important.
DATA_CMM_1371.fr: Aucune idée de ce que produit cette usine ; ce doit être quelque chose d'important !
DATA_CMM_1371.de: Wir wissen nicht, was in dieser Fabrik hergestellt wird, aber es scheint etwas Wichtiges zu sein.
DATA_CMM_1371.it: Non sappiamo cosa stiano producendo ma siamo sicuri si tratti di qualcosa di importante.
DATA_CMM_1371.es: No sabemos qué fabrica, pero debe de ser algo sumamente importante.
DATA_CMM_1371.ko: 무엇을 만드는지는 전혀 모르겠지만 어쨌든 중요한 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_1371.zht: 完全不知道這是在製造什麼，不過總之是重要的東西。
DATA_CMM_1371.zhs: 完全不知道这是在制造什么，不过总之是重要的东西。

DATA_CMM_1372.ja: It's not good to breathe the smoke that comes out of the tubes on some of these.
DATA_CMM_1372.en: It's not good to breathe the smoke that comes out of the tubes on some of these.
DATA_CMM_1372.fr: Il est recommandé de ne pas trop inhaler la fumée qui sort de ses cheminées !
DATA_CMM_1372.de: Es ist nicht gut, den Rauch einzuatmen, der bei manchen von ihnen aus den Rohren kommt.
DATA_CMM_1372.it: Non fa bene alla salute respirare i fumi che fuoriescono da questi impianti.
DATA_CMM_1372.es: No es nada sano respirar los humos que salen de ahí; esperemos que dentro tengan buenos ambientadores.
DATA_CMM_1372.ko: 통에서 연기를 뭉개뭉개 내뿜고 있다. 그 중에는 들이마시면 안 되는 연기를 내뿜는 것도 있다.
DATA_CMM_1372.zht: 長筒狀的東西冒出滾滾濃煙，好像有些地方排出的煙是不能吸的。
DATA_CMM_1372.zhs: 长筒状的东西冒出滚滚浓烟，好像有些地方排出的烟是不能吸的。

DATA_CMM_1373.ja: A revolving floor. Cars can spin on it, so be careful!
DATA_CMM_1373.en: A revolving floor. Cars can spin on it, so be careful!
DATA_CMM_1373.fr: Un sol en rotation ! Attention aux voitures tournantes.
DATA_CMM_1373.de: Ein rotierender Boden. Autos können sich auf ihm drehen, also sei vorsichtig!
DATA_CMM_1373.it: Un pavimento rotante per auto. Forse una giostra?
DATA_CMM_1373.es: Esperemos que no gire tan rápido que el coche salga disparado...
DATA_CMM_1373.ko: 빙글빙글 도는 마루. 이런 도로만 있으면 자동차는 계속 돌기만 하므로 매우 낭패.
DATA_CMM_1373.zht: 會旋轉的地板。有這種地板，汽車就會轉來轉去，真麻煩。
DATA_CMM_1373.zhs: 会旋转的地板。有这种地板，汽车就会转来转去，真麻烦。

DATA_CMM_1374.ja: Put these on your feet to go gliding on the snow. Not very convenient unless you're going downhill.
DATA_CMM_1374.en: Put these on your feet to go gliding on the snow. Not very convenient unless you're going downhill.
DATA_CMM_1374.fr: On les met sur ses pieds pour glisser dans la neige. À la remontée, ce n'est pas très pratique.
DATA_CMM_1374.de: Steck dir das hier an die Füße, um auf dem Schnee zu gleiten. Nicht sehr praktisch, es sei denn, es geht bergab.
DATA_CMM_1374.it: Basta indossarli per galleggiare sulla neve. Utili soprattutto in discesa.
DATA_CMM_1374.es: Sirve para desplazarse por la nieve, pero no es muy práctico si vas cuesta arriba.
DATA_CMM_1374.ko: 발에 붙이고 눈 위를 미끄러지는 도구. 내리막 이외에선 꽤 불편하다.
DATA_CMM_1374.zht: 裝在腳上後，能在雪面上咻咻滑行的工具。除了下坡以外還挺不方便的。
DATA_CMM_1374.zhs: 装在脚上后，能在雪面上咻咻滑行的工具。除了下坡以外还挺不方便的。

DATA_CMM_1375.ja: With these on, you'll become pigeon-toed.
DATA_CMM_1375.en: With these on, you'll become pigeon-toed.
DATA_CMM_1375.fr: Jaune comme le soleil mais il ne fait pas fondre la neige !
DATA_CMM_1375.de: Mit denen laufen sogar Männer über den großen Onkel.
DATA_CMM_1375.es: Lo difícil es conseguir que no se enreden.
DATA_CMM_1375.zht: 裝上這個，好像自然會變內八。
DATA_CMM_1375.zhs: 装上这个，好像自然会变内八。

DATA_CMM_1376.ja: Sometimes you see these going downhill all by themselves.
DATA_CMM_1376.en: Sometimes you see these going downhill all by themselves.
DATA_CMM_1376.fr: De temps en temps on en voit un qui descend la piste tout schuss...
DATA_CMM_1376.de: Manchmal sieht man, wie sie ganz von selbst bergab rutschen.
DATA_CMM_1376.it: A volte scendono da soli dalle montagne.
DATA_CMM_1376.es: A veces ellos solitos deciden que quieren bajar la pendiente.
DATA_CMM_1376.ko: 가끔씩 이것만 미끌어져 올 때도 있다.
DATA_CMM_1376.zht: 有時候會只看到這個滑過來。
DATA_CMM_1376.zhs: 有时候会只看到这个滑过来。

DATA_CMM_1377.ja: These poles hold you up while you're skiing. They look thin and unreliable, but they're actually pretty strong.
DATA_CMM_1377.en: These poles hold you up while you're skiing. They look thin and unreliable, but they're actually pretty strong.
DATA_CMM_1377.fr: Ces petits bâtons vous aident à vous tenir droit dans vos bottes... de ski. Ils ont l'air fragiles, mais ne vous fiez pas aux apparences.
DATA_CMM_1377.de: Diese Stöcke halten dich beim Skifahren aufrecht. Sie sehen dünn und unzuverlässig aus, aber sind eigentlich ziemlich stark.
DATA_CMM_1377.it: Sembra piccola e poco affidabile, in realtà è molto robusta.
DATA_CMM_1377.es: Aunque parezcan muy endebles, resultan una gran ayuda para no caer de los esquís.
DATA_CMM_1377.ko: 스키를 탈 때, 몸을 지탱해 주는 막대. 얇아서 다소 불안하지만 의외로 튼튼하다.
DATA_CMM_1377.zht: 滑雪時拿來輔助支撐的棒子。雖然棒子很細好像不太可靠，但其實很堅固。
DATA_CMM_1377.zhs: 滑雪时拿来辅助支撑的棒子。虽然棒子很细好像不太可靠，但其实很坚固。

DATA_CMM_1378.ja: You can't even walk right with this attached to your feet. It may be just one board, but it's still tough to ride.
DATA_CMM_1378.en: You can't even walk right with this attached to your feet. It may be just one board, but it's still tough to ride.
DATA_CMM_1378.fr: Pas la peine d'essayer de marcher avec ça, vous n'aurez pas l'air cool. Contentez-vous de glisser sans tomber !
DATA_CMM_1378.de: Mit diesem Brett an den Füßen kann man nicht einmal richtig laufen. Es ist zwar nur ein Brett, aber es ist trotzdem schwer zu beherrschen.
DATA_CMM_1378.it: Con questo non si riesce nemmeno a camminare, eppure sembra molto divertente.
DATA_CMM_1378.es: Con esto en los pies no se puede ni andar, pero parece fabuloso para bajar la montaña.
DATA_CMM_1378.ko: 이것을 신으면 제대로 걷지도 못한다. 하나만 있다고 쉽게 배우는 건 아닌 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_1378.zht: 穿著這個完全沒辦法走路，雖然只有一塊板子，但實際上可不簡單。
DATA_CMM_1378.zhs: 穿着这个完全没办法走路，虽然只有一块板子，但实际上可不简单。

DATA_CMM_1379.ja: Good for vegetarians who want to try sushi.
DATA_CMM_1379.en: Good for vegetarians who want to try sushi.
DATA_CMM_1379.fr: Un bon truc pour les végétariens qui veulent s'initier aux sushis !
DATA_CMM_1379.de: Gut für Vegetarier, die Sushi probieren möchten.
DATA_CMM_1379.it: Per i vegetariani che vogliono assaggiare il sushi.
DATA_CMM_1379.es: No es tan refrescante como un gazpacho, pero tiene su aquel.

DATA_CMM_1380.ja: A food made of tuna and rice rolled up into a cylinder.
DATA_CMM_1380.en: A food made of tuna and rice rolled up into a cylinder.
DATA_CMM_1380.fr: Du thon et du riz enroulés pour former un cylindre.
DATA_CMM_1380.de: Eine Speise aus Thunfisch und Reis, die zu einem Zylinder aufgerollt sind.
DATA_CMM_1380.it: Cibo fatto di tonno, riso e alghe.
DATA_CMM_1380.es: Se diría que el atún se ha hecho un lío. Ja, ja.
DATA_CMM_1380.ko: 참치를 밥으로 말고, 그 주변을 김으로 다시 만 음식.
DATA_CMM_1380.zht: 用米包住鮪魚，外面再包上一層海苔的食物。不知道鐵火是指什麼火。
DATA_CMM_1380.zhs: 用米包住鲔鱼，外面再包上一层海苔的食物。不知道铁火是指什么火。

DATA_CMM_1381.ja: A food made of tasty little red balls. You can eat the black part with it, too.
DATA_CMM_1381.en: A food made of tasty little red balls. You can eat the black part with it, too.
DATA_CMM_1381.fr: Des petites boules rouges délicieuses. On peut manger le noir, aussi.
DATA_CMM_1381.de: Ein Essen aus leckeren kleinen roten Kugeln. Man kann den schwarzen Teil auch mitessen.
DATA_CMM_1381.it: Ripieno di gustose palline di colore rosso, la foglia nera intorno è altrettanto edibile.
DATA_CMM_1381.es: Las huevas de salmón son como cerecitas saladas, con la ventaja de no tener hueso.
DATA_CMM_1381.ko: 붉은 알갱이가 톡톡 터지는 맛있는 음식. 검은 부분도 함께 먹는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1381.zht: 紅色會爆漿的部分很美味的食物。黑色的部分好像也能一起吃。
DATA_CMM_1381.zhs: 红色会爆浆的部分很美味的食物。黑色的部分好像也能一起吃。

DATA_CMM_1382.ja: A sturdy rock katamari. Nothing but rocks... We are bored by its lack of variety, very bored.
DATA_CMM_1382.en: A sturdy rock katamari. Nothing but rocks... We are bored by its lack of variety, very bored.
DATA_CMM_1382.fr: Un robuste katamari en pierre. Rien que des cailloux. Cela Nous déçoit et Nous ennuie.
DATA_CMM_1382.de: Ein robuster Stein-Katamari. Nichts als Steine ... Der Mangel an Abwechslung langweilt uns. Sehr.
DATA_CMM_1382.it: Un robusto katamari di roccia. Nient'altro che rocce... Che noia!
DATA_CMM_1382.es: Un katamari de piedras duras. Piedras. Nos aburre mucho ver tanta piedra.
DATA_CMM_1382.ko: 단단한 돌덩이의 집합체. 돌 말고 딴 걸로도 뭉쳐놓으면 좋으련만…
DATA_CMM_1382.zht: 堅硬石頭聚集形成的。多加上其他東西成形不好嗎。
DATA_CMM_1382.zhs: 坚硬石头聚集形成的。多加上其他东西成形不好吗。

DATA_CMM_1384.ja: They say an enormous caterpillar is born on this island every hundred years.
DATA_CMM_1384.en: They say an enormous caterpillar is born on this island every hundred years.
DATA_CMM_1384.fr: La légende veut qu'une chenille géante naisse sur cette île tous les cent ans.
DATA_CMM_1384.de: Es heißt, dass auf dieser Insel alle hundert Jahre eine riesige Raupe geboren wird.
DATA_CMM_1384.it: Dicono che vi nasca un bruco enorme una volta ogni cent'anni.
DATA_CMM_1384.es: Por alguna razón, la leyenda cuenta que cada 100 años nace un ciempiés enorme en esta isla.
DATA_CMM_1384.ko: 100년에 한 번 거대한 애벌레가 태어나는 것으로 유명한 섬.
DATA_CMM_1384.zht: 據說一百年會誕生一隻巨大青蟲的島。
DATA_CMM_1384.zhs: 据说一百年会诞生一只巨大青虫的岛。

DATA_CMM_1385.ja: A plain old island. You can dig all you want, but you won't find anything.
DATA_CMM_1385.en: A plain old island. You can dig all you want, but you won't find anything.
DATA_CMM_1385.fr: Un île sans aucun intérêt, elle ne cache même pas de trésor. Pourquoi ce nom ronflant ?
DATA_CMM_1385.de: Eine einfache alte Insel. Du kannst graben, so viel du willst, aber du wirst nichts finden.
DATA_CMM_1385.it: Una vecchia isola spoglia, non ha più nemmeno un tesoro sepolto.
DATA_CMM_1385.es: Muchos han llegado esperanzados con su mapa y su pala, pero nadie ha encontrado aún el tesoro.
DATA_CMM_1385.ko: 아무리 파내려가도 흙밖에 나오지 않는 평범한 섬.
DATA_CMM_1385.zht: 翻土也只會出現土的普通島嶼。
DATA_CMM_1385.zhs: 翻土也只会出现土的普通岛屿。

DATA_CMM_1386.ja: An island that shines faintly at night. Nobody knows why.
DATA_CMM_1386.en: An island that shines faintly at night. Nobody knows why.
DATA_CMM_1386.fr: Une île qui brille légèrement dans la nuit. Un mystère encore irrésolu.
DATA_CMM_1386.de: Eine Insel, die nachts schwach leuchtet. Niemand weiß, warum.
DATA_CMM_1386.it: Un'isola che risplende delicatamente di notte. Nessuno sa perché.
DATA_CMM_1386.es: Esta isla refulge en la noche, y nadie ha sabido nunca por qué.
DATA_CMM_1386.ko: 밤이 되면 어렴풋이 빛나기 시작하는 섬. 어떻게 빛을 내는지는 모른다.
DATA_CMM_1386.zht: 一到夜晚就會發出微弱光芒的島。不知道是什麼原理。
DATA_CMM_1386.zhs: 一到夜晚就会发出微弱光芒的岛。不知道是什么原理。

DATA_CMM_1387.ja: Salmon stop by this island while spawning. They don't actually spawn here, however.
DATA_CMM_1387.en: Salmon stop by this island while spawning. They don't actually spawn here, however.
DATA_CMM_1387.fr: Les saumons font une pause près de cette île au moment du frai. Ne les effrayez pas !
DATA_CMM_1387.de: Lachse machen hier halt, wenn sie auf dem Weg zu ihrem Laichplatz sind. Hier laichen sie aber nicht.
DATA_CMM_1387.it: I salmoni, durante la stagione degli amori, si fermano qui per un po'. In vacanza.
DATA_CMM_1387.es: Los salmones descansan un poco aquí antes de seguir su ruta del desove.
DATA_CMM_1387.ko: 연어가 산란하기 전에 잠시 들리는 섬. 잠시 들리기만 할 뿐, 알을 낳아주지는 않는다.
DATA_CMM_1387.zht: 鮭魚產卵的途中會短暫停留的島。牠們都只短暫停留，不在這裡產卵。
DATA_CMM_1387.zhs: 鲑鱼产卵的途中会短暂停留的岛。它们都只短暂停留，不在这里产卵。

DATA_CMM_1388.ja: An island created when a meteor fell to earth ages ago. Would you call that lucky or unlucky?
DATA_CMM_1388.en: An island created when a meteor fell to earth ages ago. Would you call that lucky or unlucky?
DATA_CMM_1388.fr: Une île apparue lorsqu'un météorite est tombé là il y a fort longtemps. Un bien ou un mal pour la planète ?
DATA_CMM_1388.de: Eine Insel, die entstand, als vor langer Zeit ein Meteor auf die Erde fiel. Würdest du das als Glück oder Unglück bezeichnen?
DATA_CMM_1388.it: Un'isola creata da un meteorite che è caduto sulla Terra ere fa.
DATA_CMM_1388.es: Esta isla fue creada por la caída de un meteorito. ¿Crees que fue una suerte o no?
DATA_CMM_1388.ko: 아주 먼 옛날, 운석이 떨어져서 생겨난 섬. 행운인지 불행인지…
DATA_CMM_1388.zht: 從前隕石墜落時出現的島，不知道算是幸還是不幸。
DATA_CMM_1388.zhs: 从前陨石坠落时出现的岛，不知道算是幸还是不幸。

DATA_CMM_1389.ja: A miraculous island that has never been stepped on by giant superheroes, no matter how nearby they were fighting.
DATA_CMM_1389.en: A miraculous island that has never been stepped on by giant superheroes, no matter how nearby they were fighting.
DATA_CMM_1389.fr: Une île miraculeuse, où aucun promoteur n'a jamais mis les pieds ! Certains s'en sont pourtant approchés de près.
DATA_CMM_1389.de: Eine wundersame Insel, die noch nie von riesigen Superhelden betreten wurde, egal wie nahe sie der Insel im Kampf kamen.
DATA_CMM_1389.it: Un'isola miracolosa sulla quale non ha posato piede mai nessun supereroe gigante, nonostante stessero combattendo nelle vicinanze.
DATA_CMM_1389.es: En esta isla nunca se ha detenido ningún superhéroe ni monstruo, y eso sí que es raro.
DATA_CMM_1389.ko: 아무리 가까운 곳에서 치열한 격전이 벌어져도, 한 번도 짓밟힌 적이 없는 기적의 섬.
DATA_CMM_1389.zht: 不論英雄在多近的距離戰鬥，也絕對不會被摧毀的奇蹟之島。
DATA_CMM_1389.zhs: 不论英雄在多近的距离战斗，也绝对不会被摧毁的奇迹之岛。

DATA_CMM_1390.ja: They say this island is home to fairies. We'd love to battle them sometime.
DATA_CMM_1390.en: They say this island is home to fairies. We'd love to battle them sometime.
DATA_CMM_1390.fr: On dit que des fées habitent cette île. Nous aimerions beaucoup Nous mesurer à elles.
DATA_CMM_1390.de: Es heißt, auf dieser Insel leben Feen. Wir würden gerne einmal gegen sie kämpfen.
DATA_CMM_1390.it: Dicono che quest'isola sia la casa delle fate. Ci piacerebbe infinitamente combattere con loro un giorno.
DATA_CMM_1390.es: Dicen que aquí viven unas hadas, pero nos parece un reclamo publicitario más.
DATA_CMM_1390.ko: 요정들이 산다고 전해지는 섬. 꼭 한번 승부해 보고 싶다.
DATA_CMM_1390.zht: 聽說是妖精們居住的島嶼。希望務必和他們分個高下。
DATA_CMM_1390.zhs: 听说是妖精们居住的岛屿。希望务必和他们分个高下。

DATA_CMM_1391.ja: If you pile food onto this, there's no way anyone could completely finish it in one go.
DATA_CMM_1391.en: If you pile food onto this, there's no way anyone could completely finish it in one go.
DATA_CMM_1391.fr: Il serait utopique d'essayer de vider une assiette comme celle-ci !
DATA_CMM_1391.de: Wenn man das Essen hier drauf stapelt, kann das alles niemals jemand in einem Mal aufessen.
DATA_CMM_1391.it: Se si riempie completamente di cibo la porzione sarà troppo abbondante per una persona sola.
DATA_CMM_1391.es: Por mucha hambre que tengas, no conseguirás acabarte el plato entero. Es enorme.
DATA_CMM_1391.ko: 어떤 음식이든 여기에 담으면 분명 다 먹기 전에 질려버릴 것이다.
DATA_CMM_1391.zht: 要是在這上頭堆滿某樣食物，一定會在吃完前就先吃膩。
DATA_CMM_1391.zhs: 要是在这上头堆满某样食物，一定会在吃完前就先吃腻。

DATA_CMM_1392.ja: Harder to use as it gets shorter. We wish there was a way to extract the lead so We could use it all up.
DATA_CMM_1392.en: Harder to use as it gets shorter. We wish there was a way to extract the lead so We could use it all up.
DATA_CMM_1392.fr: Il reste toujours un bout de mine à la fin. Nous aimerions pouvoir l'utiliser lui aussi.
DATA_CMM_1392.de: Je kürzer es wird, desto schwieriger wird die Nutzung. Wir wünschten, man könnte das Blei herausziehen, damit wir es ganz aufbrauchen können.
DATA_CMM_1392.it: Diventa più difficile da usare quando si accorcia.
DATA_CMM_1392.es: ¿Alguien ha conseguido gastar un lápiz hasta el final? Aquí tienen la costumbre de perderse...
DATA_CMM_1392.ko: 짧아지면 사용하기 불편하다. 심 부분만 꺼내서 마지막까지 쓸 수 있으면 좋을 텐데…
DATA_CMM_1392.zht: 變短後就很難用。要是能取出筆芯的部分，寫到全部用完就好了。
DATA_CMM_1392.zhs: 变短后就很难用。要是能取出笔芯的部分，写到全部用完就好了。

DATA_CMM_1393.ja: There's an eraser on the end, and if you sharpen it, it becomes a pencil. Try to treat it nicer than that, though.
DATA_CMM_1393.en: There's an eraser on the end, and if you sharpen it, it becomes a pencil. Try to treat it nicer than that, though.
DATA_CMM_1393.fr: Une mine à un bout, une gomme à l'autre. Si vous taillez la gomme, vous aurez un crayon à deux bouts. Ce serait dommage...
DATA_CMM_1393.de: Am Ende ist ein Radierer und wenn man ihn anspitzt, wird er zu einem Bleistift. Du solltest ihn allerdings etwas netter behandeln.
DATA_CMM_1393.it: Se ci si scrive si consuma, se si cancella si consuma. Un destino segnato il suo.
DATA_CMM_1393.es: Ten cuidado, no te vayas a liar con para qué sirve cada extremo.
DATA_CMM_1393.ko: 엉덩이에 지우개가 달려있긴 하지만 너무 문지르면 연필심이 튀어 나오므로 소중히 다뤄야 한다.
DATA_CMM_1393.zht: 尾巴上附有橡皮擦，但是磨光後會出現鉛筆的部分，所以最好珍惜著用。
DATA_CMM_1393.zhs: 尾巴上附有橡皮擦，但是磨光后会出现铅笔的部分，所以最好珍惜着用。

DATA_CMM_1394.ja: A pencil with a picture of outer space on it. However, it's mostly used on Earth, really.
DATA_CMM_1394.en: A pencil with a picture of outer space on it. However, it's mostly used on Earth, really.
DATA_CMM_1394.fr: Sur ce crayon il y a une photo de l'Univers ! On l'utilise principalement sur Terre, néanmoins.
DATA_CMM_1394.de: Ein Bleistift mit einem Bild des Weltraums darauf. Allerdings wird er hauptsächlich auf der Erde benutzt.
DATA_CMM_1394.it: Una matita decorata con il firmamento. Comunque viene usata sulla Terra.
DATA_CMM_1394.es: Por mucho que tenga un dibujo del espacio exterior, solo se utiliza en la Tierra.
DATA_CMM_1394.ko: 우주의 상황이 그려진 연필. 실제로는 지구에서 사용되는 경우가 대부분.
DATA_CMM_1394.zht: 畫著宇宙樣貌的鉛筆，不過其實大多只在地球上使用。
DATA_CMM_1394.zhs: 画着宇宙样貌的铅笔，不过其实大多只在地球上使用。

DATA_CMM_1395.ja: Home to a seafaring man and his family. Tonight's dinner is grilled mackerel and fried mackerel.
DATA_CMM_1395.en: Home to a seafaring man and his family. Tonight's dinner is grilled mackerel and fried mackerel.
DATA_CMM_1395.fr: La maison d'un marin et de sa famille. Au menu ce soir : maquereau grillé puis maquereau frit !
DATA_CMM_1395.de: Heimat eines Seefahrers und seiner Familie. Heute Abend gibt es gegrillte Makrele und gebratene Makrele.
DATA_CMM_1395.it: Famiglia di pescatori, stasera a cena merluzzo ai ferri e merluzzo fritto.
DATA_CMM_1395.es: Aquí vive un marinero y su familia; hoy cenan sopa de sardineta, sardineta asada y flan de sardineta.
DATA_CMM_1395.ko: 바다 사나이와 가족들이 사는 집. 오늘 저녁은 고등어 자반구이와 고등어 된장조림.
DATA_CMM_1395.zht: 漁夫和漁夫家人生活的家。今晚來點鹽烤鯖魚和味噌燉鯖魚。
DATA_CMM_1395.zhs: 渔夫和渔夫家人生活的家。今晚来点盐烤鲭鱼和味噌炖鲭鱼。

DATA_CMM_1396.ja: The daughter in this family is at the age where she's a bit sensitive to the smell of fish.
DATA_CMM_1396.en: The daughter in this family is at the age where she's a bit sensitive to the smell of fish.
DATA_CMM_1396.fr: La fille de cette famille est à cet âge un peu difficile où l'odeur du poisson empoisonne.
DATA_CMM_1396.de: Die Tochter dieser Familie ist in einem Alter, in dem sie etwas empfindlich auf den Geruch von Fisch reagiert.
DATA_CMM_1396.it: La figlia si trova in quella particolare età in cui le dà fastidio l'odore del pesce.
DATA_CMM_1396.es: A la hija mayor le molesta el olor a pescado que llega de casa de los vecinos.
DATA_CMM_1396.ko: 여기 딸내미는 생선 비린내가 밸까 걱정하는 한창 나이 때다.
DATA_CMM_1396.zht: 這家的女兒正值有些在意魚腥味的敏感年紀。
DATA_CMM_1396.zhs: 这家的女儿正值有些在意鱼腥味的敏感年纪。

DATA_CMM_1397.ja: The whole family wants to have meat for dinner, but nobody is brave enough to actually say so.
DATA_CMM_1397.en: The whole family wants to have meat for dinner, but nobody is brave enough to actually say so.
DATA_CMM_1397.fr: Toute la famille meurt d'envie de manger enfin un peu de viande, mais personne n'ose le dire.
DATA_CMM_1397.de: Die ganze Familie möchte Fleisch zum Abendessen, aber niemand traut sich, es zu sagen.
DATA_CMM_1397.it: Tutta la famiglia vorrebbe della carne per cena, ma nessuno trova il coraggio di dirlo.
DATA_CMM_1397.es: El padre es marinero; a la familia le encantaría cenar carne, pero no se atreven a decírselo.
DATA_CMM_1397.ko: 가끔은 고기도 먹고 싶은데 누구 하나 말을 꺼내는 이는 없다.
DATA_CMM_1397.zht: 雖然偶爾也想吃點肉，但是沒有人敢說。
DATA_CMM_1397.zhs: 虽然偶尔也想吃点肉，但是没有人敢说。

DATA_CMM_1398.ja: No matter how heavy the crane gets, this always supports it. We sense love blooming.
DATA_CMM_1398.en: No matter how heavy the crane gets, this always supports it. We sense love blooming.
DATA_CMM_1398.fr: Peu importe le poids de la grue, l'échafaudage la soutient toujours impassiblement. Si c'est pas de l'amour, ça !
DATA_CMM_1398.de: Egal, wie schwer der Kran wird, das hier stützt ihn immer. Wir spüren die blühende Liebe.
DATA_CMM_1398.it: Non importa quanto pesante possa diventare la gru. Il ponteggio la sostiene sempre.
DATA_CMM_1398.es: Por pesada que se ponga la grúa, siempre está ahí. Esto es el inicio de una bonita amistad.
DATA_CMM_1398.ko: 아무리 괴로워도 묵묵히 지탱해 준다. 왠지 사랑의 예감이…
DATA_CMM_1398.zht: 好像不管多艱辛都願意支持著我們。天啊，要戀愛了。
DATA_CMM_1398.zhs: 好像不管多艰辛都愿意支持着我们。天啊，要恋爱了。

DATA_CMM_1399.ja: A place to gather and feed fish. You can't really call them pets.
DATA_CMM_1399.en: A place to gather and feed fish. You can't really call them pets.
DATA_CMM_1399.fr: Un endroit où on rassemble les poissons pour les nourrir. Ils ont beau engraisser, ils restent assez ingrats...
DATA_CMM_1399.de: Ein Ort zum Sammeln und Füttern von Fischen. Man kann sie nicht wirklich als Haustiere bezeichnen.
DATA_CMM_1399.it: Un posto per raggruppare i pesci. Non è che così diventino animali domestici però.
DATA_CMM_1399.es: Mejor que no puedas sacarlos a pasear ni enseñarles truquitos, así no te encariñarás con ellos.
DATA_CMM_1399.ko: 물고기를 모아서 먹이를 주는 곳. 침대가 안 보이는 것으로 봐선 자는 곳은 아닌 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1399.zht: 吸引魚群靠近撒餌的地方。不過看起來不像是在養寵物。
DATA_CMM_1399.zhs: 吸引鱼群靠近撒饵的地方。不过看起来不像是在养宠物。

DATA_CMM_1400.ja: He's apparently sending commands to the driver in the little car.
DATA_CMM_1400.en: He's apparently sending commands to the driver in the little car.
DATA_CMM_1400.fr: On dirait qu'il donne des instructions au conducteur de la petite voiture.
DATA_CMM_1400.de: Er sendet offenbar Befehle an den Fahrer des kleinen Wagens.
DATA_CMM_1400.it: A quanto pare invia ordini al piccolo pilota nella macchinina.
DATA_CMM_1400.es: Dirige su cochecito desde la distancia. ¿Será telepatía?
DATA_CMM_1400.ko: 작은 자동차 운전자에게 지시를 보내고 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1400.zht: 感覺像是在對小玩具車的駕駛員下指令。
DATA_CMM_1400.zhs: 感觉像是在对小玩具车的驾驶员下指令。

DATA_CMM_1401.ja: Stubborn person feared by all children in the neighborhood.
DATA_CMM_1401.en: Stubborn person feared by all children in the neighborhood.
DATA_CMM_1401.fr: Tous les enfants du quartier ont peur de cette tête de mule.
DATA_CMM_1401.de: Störrische Person, die alle Kinder in der Nachbarschaft fürchten.
DATA_CMM_1401.it: Persona testarda temuta da tutti i bambini del vicinato.
DATA_CMM_1401.es: Todos los niños del vecindario le tienen miedo.
DATA_CMM_1401.ko: 이빨을 분리, 합체할 수 있는 부류의 인간. 머리카락을 분리, 합체할 수 있는 타입도 있는 듯…
DATA_CMM_1401.zht: 鄰居小孩會害怕的頑固老頭。
DATA_CMM_1401.zhs: 邻居小孩会害怕的顽固老头。

DATA_CMM_1402.ja: He often claims that his wife fell head over heels for him at first sight.
DATA_CMM_1402.en: He often claims that his wife fell head over heels for him at first sight.
DATA_CMM_1402.fr: Il raconte souvent comment sa femme a eu pour lui le coup de foudre absolu.
DATA_CMM_1402.de: Er behauptet oft, seine Frau habe sich auf den ersten Blick in ihn verliebt.
DATA_CMM_1402.it: Si vanta spesso che la trisnonna perse la testa per lui al primo sguardo.
DATA_CMM_1402.es: Insiste en que en sus tiempos era todo un galán, pero nadie acaba de creerlo...
DATA_CMM_1402.zht: 口頭禪是「是老伴先愛上我的」。
DATA_CMM_1402.zhs: 口头禅是「是老伴先爱上我的」。

DATA_CMM_1403.ja: You often hear her say "This summer, I swear...!" around this season.
DATA_CMM_1403.en: You often hear her say "This summer, I swear...!" around this season.
DATA_CMM_1403.fr: Sa phrase préférée : "Je jure que cet été... !"
DATA_CMM_1403.de: Um diese Jahreszeit herum hört man sie oft sagen: „Diesen Sommer schwöre ich ...".
DATA_CMM_1403.it: Come ogni estate, nutre grandi speranze.
DATA_CMM_1403.es: Por esta época suele andar murmurando: "Este año, sí...".
DATA_CMM_1403.ko: 이 계절이 되면 입버릇처럼「올 여름에야말로!!」라는 대사를 내뱉는다.
DATA_CMM_1403.zht: 一到這個季節就會常把「今年夏天我一定要……」掛在嘴邊。
DATA_CMM_1403.zhs: 一到这个季节就会常把「今年夏天我一定要……」挂在嘴边。

DATA_CMM_1404.ja: She gets asked this a lot because she's tall, but she's no good at either volleyball or basketball.
DATA_CMM_1404.en: She gets asked this a lot because she's tall, but she's no good at either volleyball or basketball.
DATA_CMM_1404.fr: Non, non et non, elle n'est pas douée pour le volley, ni pour le basket. Même si c'est une grande perche ! Arrêtez de le lui demander !
DATA_CMM_1404.de: Sie wird das oft gefragt, weil sie groß ist, aber sie ist weder im Volleyball noch im Basketball gut.
DATA_CMM_1404.it: Vista l'altezza le chiedono spesso se è brava a pallavolo o a basket.
DATA_CMM_1404.es: A pesar de su estatura, ni el baloncesto ni el voley-playa son lo suyo.
DATA_CMM_1404.ko: 키가 커서 자주 그런 소리를 듣지만, 발레나 농구는 잘 못한다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1404.zht: 很不擅長打排球或籃球，卻因為長得高常常被問。
DATA_CMM_1404.zhs: 很不擅长打排球或篮球，却因为长得高常常被问。

DATA_CMM_1405.ja: They say every day is a battle for him, but We have yet to see him fighting anyone.
DATA_CMM_1405.en: They say every day is a battle for him, but We have yet to see him fighting anyone.
DATA_CMM_1405.fr: On entend parfois que sa vie est un conflit perpétuel. Nous ne l'avons encore jamais vu se battre.
DATA_CMM_1405.de: Es heißt, jeder Tag sei ein Kampf für ihn, aber wir haben ihn noch nie gegen jemanden kämpfen sehen.
DATA_CMM_1405.it: Dice che ogni giorno è una lotta per lui ma nessuno l'ha mai visto lottare.
DATA_CMM_1405.es: Dice que cada día es una lucha, pero nunca se le ha visto pelear con nadie.
DATA_CMM_1405.ko: 싸우는 가장이라고들 하지만, 싸우는 모습은 한 번도 본 적이 없다.
DATA_CMM_1405.zht: 雖然常被稱作是「奮鬥老爸」，不過從沒看過他戰鬥的樣子。
DATA_CMM_1405.zhs: 虽然常被称作是「奋斗老爸」，不过从没看过他战斗的样子。

DATA_CMM_1406.ja: Knows all the best restaurants. Very good at karaoke.
DATA_CMM_1406.en: Knows all the best restaurants. Very good at karaoke.
DATA_CMM_1406.fr: Il s'y connaît en restaurant et c'est un pro du karaoké.
DATA_CMM_1406.de: Kennt die besten Restaurants. Sehr gut im Karaoke.
DATA_CMM_1406.it: Conosce i ristoranti migliori. Eccelle nel karaoke.
DATA_CMM_1406.es: Conoce los mejores locales y es un as del karaoke.
DATA_CMM_1406.ko: 땀을 폭포수처럼 흘리고 있다. 역시 땀만으론 살이 빠지지 않는 듯…
DATA_CMM_1406.zht: 知道很多美味店家。也很會唱卡拉OK。
DATA_CMM_1406.zhs: 知道很多美味店家。也很会唱卡拉OK。

DATA_CMM_1407.ja: His daughter recently got a boyfriend, and now he's tense all day, every day.
DATA_CMM_1407.en: His daughter recently got a boyfriend, and now he's tense all day, every day.
DATA_CMM_1407.fr: Depuis que sa fille s'est trouvée un copain, il est très stressé.
DATA_CMM_1407.de: Seine Tochter hat seit Kurzem einen Freund und jetzt ist er den ganzen Tag angespannt, jeden Tag.
DATA_CMM_1407.it: Sua figlia ha appena trovato un fidanzato e lui è tesissimo e preoccupato.
DATA_CMM_1407.es: Es tan tímido que le da vergüenza saludar incluso a sus hijos.
DATA_CMM_1407.ko: 최근에 딸에게 애인이 생겼기에 초초한 나날을 보내고 있다.
DATA_CMM_1407.zht: 好像最近知道女兒有男朋友，於是每日坐立難安。
DATA_CMM_1407.zhs: 好像最近知道女儿有男朋友，于是每日坐立难安。

DATA_CMM_1408.ja: A very sensible young man who doesn't drink or smoke. Good for him.
DATA_CMM_1408.en: A very sensible young man who doesn't drink or smoke. Good for him.
DATA_CMM_1408.fr: Un jeune homme bien comme il faut qui ne fume pas et ne boit pas. C'est bien.
DATA_CMM_1408.de: Ein sehr vernünftiger junger Mann, der weder trinkt noch raucht. Gut für ihn.
DATA_CMM_1408.it: Un giovanotto giudizioso, che non beve e non fuma.
DATA_CMM_1408.es: No sale ni comete excesos y ahorra todos los meses. Bravo por él.
DATA_CMM_1408.ko: 술, 담배를 하지 않는 성실한 인간.

DATA_CMM_1409.ja: Loves to gossip anytime, anyplace. When she laughs, babies start screaming.
DATA_CMM_1409.en: Loves to gossip anytime, anyplace. When she laughs, babies start screaming.
DATA_CMM_1409.fr: Ne rate jamais un petit commérage. Quand elle rit, les bébés du quartier se mettent tous à hurler.
DATA_CMM_1409.de: Sie liebt es, jederzeit und überall zu tratschen. Wenn sie lacht, fangen die Babys an zu schreien.
DATA_CMM_1409.it: Ama i pettegolezzi e chiacchierare comunque e dovunque. Quando ride fa piangere i bambini.
DATA_CMM_1409.es: Cuando se ríe, los bebés empiezan a llorar.
DATA_CMM_1409.ko: 인간 중에서 최강의 생물. 남자, 여자와는 다른 제 3의 성별이라 한다.
DATA_CMM_1409.zht: 就算不用在井邊洗衣了，也免不了要話家常幾句。在人類中堪稱最強的類型。
DATA_CMM_1409.zhs: 就算不用在井边洗衣了，也免不了要话家常几句。在人类中堪称最强的类型。

DATA_CMM_1410.ja: Confident she's number one at clipping coupons and doing the bargain-sale dash.
DATA_CMM_1410.en: Confident she's number one at clipping coupons and doing the bargain-sale dash.
DATA_CMM_1410.fr: A la fois fée du logis et redoutable en affaires lorsqu'elle flaire un bon coup.
DATA_CMM_1410.de: Sie hält sich für die Nummer eins beim Ausschneiden von Coupons und bei der Schnäppchenjagd.
DATA_CMM_1410.it: Sicura di sé e delle sue qualità di scattista nella corsa ai saldi.
DATA_CMM_1410.es: Se entretiene recortando cupones de descuento. Bueno, hay gente para todo.
DATA_CMM_1410.ko: 전단지 체크와 세일 대시는 누구에게도 지지 않을 자신이 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1410.zht: 在查閱傳單和衝刺限時優惠方面，有自信不會輸給任何人。
DATA_CMM_1410.zhs: 在查阅传单和冲刺限时优惠方面，有自信不会输给任何人。

DATA_CMM_1411.ja: She can't help but say "Thank you. Three million yen is your change."
DATA_CMM_1411.en: She can't help but say "Thank you. Three million yen is your change."
DATA_CMM_1411.fr: "Un, deux, et trois qui font dix" ; c'est presque un réflexe, pour elle.
DATA_CMM_1411.de: Sie kann nicht anders als zu sagen: „Danke. Ihr Wechselgeld sind drei Millionen Yen."
DATA_CMM_1411.it: Non può fare a meno di dire "Grazie, ecco il vostro resto: tre milioni di yen".
DATA_CMM_1411.es: Siempre se equivoca con el cambio, pero ¡es tan simpática!
DATA_CMM_1411.zht: 會開玩笑地說「找您300萬日圓」。
DATA_CMM_1411.zhs: 会开玩笑地说「找您300万日圆」。

DATA_CMM_1412.ja: He's always worried about sales revenue and closing time.
DATA_CMM_1412.en: He's always worried about sales revenue and closing time.
DATA_CMM_1412.fr: Son souci principal : faire du chiffre et fermer à l'heure.
DATA_CMM_1412.de: Er macht sich immer Sorgen um den Umsatz und den Ladenschluss.
DATA_CMM_1412.it: Vive nella preoccupazione delle vendite e degli orari di chiusura.
DATA_CMM_1412.es: Pese a sus esfuerzos, no ha conseguido que los dependientes bailen por la tienda.
DATA_CMM_1412.ko: 숫자와 시간에 항상 신경을 쓰고 있다.
DATA_CMM_1412.zht: 總是很在意數字和時間。
DATA_CMM_1412.zhs: 总是很在意数字和时间。

DATA_CMM_1413.ja: He's often heard saying "I just work here."
DATA_CMM_1413.en: He's often heard saying "I just work here."
DATA_CMM_1413.fr: Il dit souvent aux clients mécontents : "Vous savez, moi je ne suis qu'un employé" !
DATA_CMM_1413.de: Man hört ihn oft sagen: „Ich arbeite hier nur".
DATA_CMM_1413.it: Dice spesso "Ehi, io qui ci lavoro solamente!".
DATA_CMM_1413.es: Cuando encuentra un cliente pelma, le dice que él solo es un mandado.
DATA_CMM_1413.zht: 口頭禪是「我也只是個領死薪水的」。
DATA_CMM_1413.zhs: 口头禅是「我也只是个领死薪水的」。

DATA_CMM_1414.ja: One of the cheapest dishes on the sushi bar's menu.
DATA_CMM_1414.en: One of the cheapest dishes on the sushi bar's menu.
DATA_CMM_1414.fr: Un des plats les moins chers de la carte du bar à sushis.
DATA_CMM_1414.de: Eines der günstigsten Gerichte auf der Speisekarte der Sushi-Bar.
DATA_CMM_1414.it: Uno dei sushi più a buon mercato.
DATA_CMM_1414.es: Es uno de los más baratos, pero claro, no es el más rico.
DATA_CMM_1414.ko: 빛깔생선이라고 하지만, 아무리 봐도 보석은 아닌 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1414.zht: 又稱「發光魚類」，但似乎不是寶石。
DATA_CMM_1414.zhs: 又称「发光鱼类」，但似乎不是宝石。

DATA_CMM_1415.ja: No matter whether he wins or loses the match, he always thinks he's number one.
DATA_CMM_1415.en: No matter whether he wins or loses the match, he always thinks he's number one.
DATA_CMM_1415.fr: Qu'il gagne ou qu'il perde, dans sa tête il est toujours numéro un.
DATA_CMM_1415.de: Egal, ob er das Spiel gewinnt oder verliert, er hält sich immer für die Nummer eins.
DATA_CMM_1415.it: Non importa se vince o perde, pensa sempre di essere il numero uno.
DATA_CMM_1415.es: Tanto si gana como si pierde, él se siente todo un campeón.
DATA_CMM_1415.ko: 시합에 이기든 지든, 언제나 자신이 최고라고 생각하는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1415.zht: 不論比賽是勝是敗，總是認為自己最厲害。
DATA_CMM_1415.zhs: 不论比赛是胜是败，总是认为自己最厉害。

DATA_CMM_1416.ja: A famously brutal, vicious wrestler. Remarkably calm in the dressing room, however.
DATA_CMM_1416.en: A famously brutal, vicious wrestler. Remarkably calm in the dressing room, however.
DATA_CMM_1416.fr: Connu pour sa brutalité et ses coups vicieux. Il est toujours étrangement calme de retour au vestiaire...
DATA_CMM_1416.de: Ein für seine Brutalität und Bösartigkeit berühmter Wrestler. In der Umkleidekabine ist er jedoch bemerkenswert ruhig.
DATA_CMM_1416.it: Famoso per la sua crudeltà e brutalità. Negli spogliatoi invece è famoso per la sua calma e gentilezza.
DATA_CMM_1416.es: Es tan famoso que lleva la máscara para que no lo reconozcan los fans.
DATA_CMM_1416.ko: 흉악 난폭하기로 소문난 레슬러. 대기실에서는 의외로 조용하다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1416.zht: 凶神惡煞般的有名摔角手。聽說在休息室裡意外地沒幹勁。
DATA_CMM_1416.zhs: 凶神恶煞般的有名摔角手。听说在休息室里意外地没干劲。

DATA_CMM_1417.ja: These guys say they are just "big boned," but most people just call them fat.
DATA_CMM_1417.en: These guys say they are just "big boned," but most people just call them fat.
DATA_CMM_1417.fr: Ils auraient pu être poètes, mais ont préféré au son du luth le son de la lutte.
DATA_CMM_1417.de: Diese Typen sagen, sie hätten nur „schwere Knochen" und dass ihre Arbeit ein „Knochenjob" ist.
DATA_CMM_1417.it: I lottatori di sumo sono davvero robusti e potenti.
DATA_CMM_1417.es: Dicen que tienen los huesos grandes, pero también es verdad que comen mucho, mucho.
DATA_CMM_1417.ko: 동료와 어울려 으스대고 있지만, 불량배는 아닌 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1417.zht: 跟同伴一起廝混叛逆，但好像不是不良少年。
DATA_CMM_1417.zhs: 跟同伴一起厮混叛逆，但好像不是不良少年。

DATA_CMM_1418.ja: Good at throwing people around. He can't throw your katamari though, so don't worry.
DATA_CMM_1418.en: Good at throwing people around. He can't throw your katamari though, so don't worry.
DATA_CMM_1418.fr: Très doué pour balancer les gens dans tous les sens. Il ne pourra pas le faire avec votre katamari, ne vous inquiétez pas.
DATA_CMM_1418.de: Er kann gut Leute durch die Gegend schleudern. Deinen Katamari kann er aber nicht werfen, also keine Sorge.
DATA_CMM_1418.it: Bravissimo a lanciare la gente. Non può lanciare katamari, quindi non c'è da preoccuparsi.
DATA_CMM_1418.es: Puede lanzar a la gente por los aires, pero no te preocupes, que con tu katamari no podrá.
DATA_CMM_1418.ko: 인간을 던지는 것이 특기. 덩어리는 던지지 못하므로 안심.
DATA_CMM_1418.zht: 擅長把人摔出去。縮成一團就可以放心不會被摔了。
DATA_CMM_1418.zhs: 擅长把人摔出去。缩成一团就可以放心不会被摔了。

DATA_CMM_1419.ja: Guys who likes spinning around and around. Watch you don't get dizzy staring at them.
DATA_CMM_1419.en: Guys who likes spinning around and around. Watch you don't get dizzy staring at them.
DATA_CMM_1419.fr: De drôles de gens qui prennent plaisir à tourner en tous sens. Ne les regardez pas trop, vous pourriez en être tout retourné.
DATA_CMM_1419.de: Kerle, die sich gerne im Kreis drehen. Pass auf, dass dir beim Zuschauen nicht schwindelig wird.
DATA_CMM_1419.it: Dei tizi che amano girare. Guardarli troppo può essere ipnotizzante.
DATA_CMM_1419.es: Les encanta rodar y rodar. No vayas a marearte mirándolos.
DATA_CMM_1419.ko: 빙글빙글 도는 것을 좋아하는 사람. 보고 있으면 눈이 돌아가므로 주의.
DATA_CMM_1419.zht: 喜歡一直旋轉的人。小心一直盯著看會頭昏眼花喔。
DATA_CMM_1419.zhs: 喜欢一直旋转的人。小心一直盯着看会头昏眼花喔。

DATA_CMM_1420.ja: Brother-in-law to the red and yellow ones.
DATA_CMM_1420.en: Brother-in-law to the red and yellow ones.
DATA_CMM_1420.fr: Le beau-frère des jumbomen rouge et jaune.
DATA_CMM_1420.it: Cognato di quello rosso e di quello giallo.
DATA_CMM_1420.es: Es cuñado del que va de rojo.
DATA_CMM_1420.zht: 紅色跟黃色是異母兄弟。
DATA_CMM_1420.zhs: 红色跟黄色是异母兄弟。

DATA_CMM_1421.ja: A monster who's at his best underground, but is honest enough to come up to the surface to fight.
DATA_CMM_1421.en: A monster who's at his best underground, but is honest enough to come up to the surface to fight.
DATA_CMM_1421.fr: Il est à son affaire sous terre, mais ce monstre a l'honnêteté de sortir de son trou pour se battre.
DATA_CMM_1421.de: Ein Monster, das im Untergrund am besten ist. Es ist aber ehrlich genug, um an der Oberfläche zu kämpfen.
DATA_CMM_1421.it: Un mostro che è potentissimo sotto terra, ma è talmente onesto che esce a combattere in superficie.
DATA_CMM_1421.es: Este monstruo se maneja mejor en el subsuelo, pero al menos sale a la superficie a dar la cara para luchar.
DATA_CMM_1421.ko: 땅 속이 홈그라운드인 주제에 일부러 땅 위로 올라와 싸우는 대단한 괴수.
DATA_CMM_1421.zht: 明明比較擅長在地底，卻特地跑到地面上戰鬥，是講武德的怪獸。
DATA_CMM_1421.zhs: 明明比较擅长在地底，却特地跑到地面上战斗，是讲武德的怪兽。

DATA_CMM_1422.ja: Didn't play many sports back in school. Loves drinking milk.
DATA_CMM_1422.en: Didn't play many sports back in school. Loves drinking milk.
DATA_CMM_1422.fr: Ne le répétez pas, mais il porte des chaussures plateforme !
DATA_CMM_1422.de: Hat in der Schule nicht viel Sport getrieben. Trinkt gerne Milch.
DATA_CMM_1422.it: Non praticava molti sport a scuola. Adora bere latte.
DATA_CMM_1422.es: No se dedicaba a practicar muchos deportes en la escuela. Le encanta beber leche.
DATA_CMM_1422.ko: 시크릿 슈즈라는 구두를 신고 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1422.zht: 聽說他學生時代沒特別做什麼運動。最喜歡喝牛奶。
DATA_CMM_1422.zhs: 听说他学生时代没特别做什么运动。最喜欢喝牛奶。

DATA_CMM_1423.ja: An animal whose body is made of cloth. Don't tell anyone, but there are people inside.
DATA_CMM_1423.en: An animal whose body is made of cloth. Don't tell anyone, but there are people inside.
DATA_CMM_1423.fr: Un animal dont le corps est fait de tissu. Ce sont tous les gens qu'il a mangés qui le font bouger.
DATA_CMM_1423.de: Ein Tier, dessen Körper aus Stoff gemacht ist. Sag es niemandem, aber da sind Menschen drin.
DATA_CMM_1423.it: Un animale il cui corpo è fatto di stoffa. Dovrebbe essere un segreto... ci sono delle persone all'interno.
DATA_CMM_1423.es: El cuerpo está hecho de tela. No se lo cuentes a nadie, pero dentro hay gente.
DATA_CMM_1423.ko: 몸체가 보자기로 되어 있는 동물. 여기서만 하는 말이지만, 안에는 사람이 들어가 있다.
DATA_CMM_1423.zht: 身體是用包袱布做的動物。偷偷告訴你，裡面有人類喔。
DATA_CMM_1423.zhs: 身体是用包袱布做的动物。偷偷告诉你，里面有人类喔。

DATA_CMM_1424.ja: Apparently it's easy once you get the hang of it. Falling off hurts.
DATA_CMM_1424.en: Apparently it's easy once you get the hang of it. Falling off hurts.
DATA_CMM_1424.fr: Il paraît que c'est facile de les monter une fois qu'on les a domptées. Les chutes restent douloureuses.
DATA_CMM_1424.de: Angeblich ist es einfach, wenn man den Dreh raus hat. Hinfallen tut weh.
DATA_CMM_1424.it: A quanto pare è abbastanza semplice una volta appresi i fondamentali. Cadere fa male.
DATA_CMM_1424.es: Parece que es fácil una vez le coges el truquillo, pero las caídas duelen mucho.
DATA_CMM_1424.ko: 말이라곤 하지만 다리는 두개밖에 없다. 넘어지면 무지 아프다.
DATA_CMM_1424.zht: 踩著兩根細細的棒子走路。萬一摔下來會很痛。
DATA_CMM_1424.zhs: 踩着两根细细的棒子走路。万一摔下来会很痛。

DATA_CMM_1425.ja: A squirmy creature. It has eight legs, so it ought to be able to walk better.
DATA_CMM_1425.en: A squirmy creature. It has eight legs, so it ought to be able to walk better.
DATA_CMM_1425.fr: Un animal pas très adroit, qui titube en marchant ; on s'attendrait pourtant au contraire, avec toutes ces jambes !
DATA_CMM_1425.de: Ein ekliges Wesen. Mit acht Beinen sollte man eigentlich besser laufen können.
DATA_CMM_1425.it: Una strana creatura, con otto gambe. Ci saremmo aspettati che sapesse camminare meglio.
DATA_CMM_1425.es: A pesar de tener 8 patas, por tierra se desplaza fatal.
DATA_CMM_1425.ko: 흐물흐물한 생물. 다리가 8개나 있는 주제에 좀 제대로 걷지…
DATA_CMM_1425.zht: 軟趴趴的生物。明明有8隻腳，希望牠能好好走路啊。
DATA_CMM_1425.zhs: 软趴趴的生物。明明有8只脚，希望它能好好走路啊。

DATA_CMM_1426.ja: It gets called slow a lot on land, so it's decided to do its stuff in the ocean instead.
DATA_CMM_1426.en: It gets called slow a lot on land, so it's decided to do its stuff in the ocean instead.
DATA_CMM_1426.fr: Elle a honte de sa démarche sur terre, alors elle a préféré élire domicile sous l'eau.
DATA_CMM_1426.de: An Land wird sie oft als langsam bezeichnet, also hat sie beschlossen, ihre Arbeit im Meer zu erledigen.
DATA_CMM_1426.it: Sulla terraferma gli davano del tardone, dunque si è trasferito in mare.
DATA_CMM_1426.es: El caparazón da mucho calor, por eso se pasa la vida en el agua.
DATA_CMM_1426.ko: 육지에선 느림보라 놀림받기 때문에 바다에서 활약하기로 맘을 정했다.
DATA_CMM_1426.zht: 似乎是因為在陸地上被人說行動緩慢，所以下定決心在海中大展身手。
DATA_CMM_1426.zhs: 似乎是因为在陆地上被人说行动缓慢，所以下定决心在海中大展身手。

DATA_CMM_1427.ja: A man with tasteful facial hair. His exact profession is unclear.
DATA_CMM_1427.en: A man with tasteful facial hair. His exact profession is unclear.
DATA_CMM_1427.fr: Homme cultivant sa moustache et son bon goût avec amour.
DATA_CMM_1427.de: Ein Mann mit geschmackvoller Gesichtsbehaarung. Sein genauer Beruf ist unklar.
DATA_CMM_1427.it: Un tizio dalla barba alla moda e dalla professione un poco oscura.
DATA_CMM_1427.es: Da gusto mirarlo, pero nadie sabe exactamente a qué se dedica.
DATA_CMM_1427.ko: 수염이 매력적인 아저씨. 평소에 무슨 일을 하는지는 불명.
DATA_CMM_1427.zht: 鬍子很有個性的叔叔。不知道他平常都在做什麼。
DATA_CMM_1427.zhs: 胡子很有个性的叔叔。不知道他平常都在做什么。

DATA_CMM_1428.ja: It apparently takes him four hours to do his hair.
DATA_CMM_1428.en: It apparently takes him four hours to do his hair.
DATA_CMM_1428.fr: C'est toujours un cauchemar pour lui de se raser...
DATA_CMM_1428.de: Er braucht offenbar vier Stunden, um sich die Haare zu machen.
DATA_CMM_1428.it: Sembra che ci metta quattro ore a pettinarsi.
DATA_CMM_1428.es: Y si no se ve en el espejo, ¿no se corta al afeitarse...?
DATA_CMM_1428.zht: 據說他的髮型要花4小時整理。
DATA_CMM_1428.zhs: 据说他的发型要花4小时整理。

DATA_CMM_1429.ja: When you become an entertainment superstar, you get to fish for these.
DATA_CMM_1429.en: When you become an entertainment superstar, you get to fish for these.
DATA_CMM_1429.fr: Poisson beaucoup pêché par les superstars en vadrouille sur leur yacht.
DATA_CMM_1429.de: Wenn man ein Superstar-Entertainer wird, kann man die hier angeln.
DATA_CMM_1429.it: Il suo nemico è il pesce scudo.
DATA_CMM_1429.es: Pese a los rumores, no se ha demostrado que se dediquen a la esgrima en sus ratos libres.
DATA_CMM_1429.ko: 일류 스타가 되면 이런 물고기를 낚을 수 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1429.zht: 當上超知名藝人的話，好像就能去釣這種魚。
DATA_CMM_1429.zhs: 当上超知名艺人的话，好像就能去钓这种鱼。

DATA_CMM_1430.ja: Making calamari out of this could have very dangerous results.
DATA_CMM_1430.en: Making calamari out of this could have very dangerous results.
DATA_CMM_1430.fr: C'est une entreprise titanesque que de vouloir cuisiner un calmar de cette taille...
DATA_CMM_1430.de: Die Herstellung von Calamares aus denen hier könnte sehr gefährliche Folgen haben.
DATA_CMM_1430.it: Una frittura di pesce colossale, se solo lo si catturasse.
DATA_CMM_1430.es: Quizás sea mejor que te pases a las patatas bravas.
DATA_CMM_1430.ko: 이것으로 오징어 소면을 만들면 엄청난 일이 벌어질 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1430.zht: 要是拿來做墨魚素麵應該很不得了。
DATA_CMM_1430.zhs: 要是拿来做墨鱼素面应该很不得了。

DATA_CMM_1431.ja: This looks exceptionally big, but there are even bigger ones deep in the ocean.
DATA_CMM_1431.en: This looks exceptionally big, but there are even bigger ones deep in the ocean.
DATA_CMM_1431.fr: Elle a l'air énorme, mais elle est minuscule, comparée à ses sœurs qui hantent les fonds marins.
DATA_CMM_1431.de: Der sieht außergewöhnlich groß aus, aber tief im Ozean gibt es noch größere Exemplare.
DATA_CMM_1431.it: Questo sembra gigantesco, ma ce ne sono di più grandi nell'oceano.
DATA_CMM_1431.es: ¿Te parece inmenso? Pues dicen que su abuelo es todavía más grande.
DATA_CMM_1431.ko: 이것도 보통 몸집은 아니나, 바닷속에는 더욱 더 큰 놈들이 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1431.zht: 這樣就已經大得嚇人了，但是聽說海裡還有更巨大的。
DATA_CMM_1431.zhs: 这样就已经大得吓人了，但是听说海里还有更巨大的。

DATA_CMM_1432.ja: A merman. His below-average looks make people wish they saw a mermaid instead.
DATA_CMM_1432.en: A merman. His below-average looks make people wish they saw a mermaid instead.
DATA_CMM_1432.fr: Homme-poisson. Comme il n'est pas très joli, il souffre beaucoup de décevoir ceux qui préféreraient voir des sirènes.
DATA_CMM_1432.de: Ein Meermann. Sein mäßiges Aussehen lässt die Leute wünschen, sie hätten stattdessen eine Meerjungfrau vor sich.
DATA_CMM_1432.it: Una sirena maschio. È così brutto che in genere la gente preferisce vedere le sirene donna.
DATA_CMM_1432.es: Sin la melena ondeando en el agua pierde bastante. Preferimos las sirenas.
DATA_CMM_1432.ko: 남자 인형. 바라보는 이를 안타깝게 만드는 것이 특기인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1432.zht: 男性人魚。特技是讓看到他的人變得患得患失。
DATA_CMM_1432.zhs: 男性人鱼。特技是让看到他的人变得患得患失。

DATA_CMM_1433.ja: Insects live in here. You could almost say they have a village down there.
DATA_CMM_1433.en: Insects live in here. You could almost say they have a village down there.
DATA_CMM_1433.fr: C'est une maison pour les insectes. On pourrait même dire qu'ils y vivent en communauté.
DATA_CMM_1433.de: Hier drin leben Insekten. Man könnte fast sagen, sie haben ein Dorf da unten.
DATA_CMM_1433.it: Qui ci vivono degli insetti, formano una specie di villaggio.
DATA_CMM_1433.es: Aquí viven insectos; si miras bien, verás las casitas y las calles.
DATA_CMM_1433.ko: 풀이 고개를 치켜들고 있어서 벌레들이 숨을 수 있다. 벌레들의 파라다이스.
DATA_CMM_1433.zht: 雜草叢生，躲著許多蟲子。有草有蟲，所以才叫「草蟲」吧。
DATA_CMM_1433.zhs: 杂草丛生，躲着许多虫子。有草有虫，所以才叫「草虫」吧。

DATA_CMM_1434.ja: You can hide all sorts of things in this tall grass.
DATA_CMM_1434.en: You can hide all sorts of things in this tall grass.
DATA_CMM_1434.fr: On peut cacher toutes sortes de secrets dans ces herbes.
DATA_CMM_1434.de: In diesem hohen Gras kann man alles Mögliche verstecken.
DATA_CMM_1434.it: Si può nascondere qualunque cosa qui.
DATA_CMM_1434.es: Puedes esconderte aquí, pero si la hierba te hace cosquillas y te ríes, te pillarán.
DATA_CMM_1434.ko: 키가 크기 때문에 여러 가지를 숨겨놓을 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_1434.zht: 草長得很高，可以藏各種東西。
DATA_CMM_1434.zhs: 草长得很高，可以藏各种东西。

DATA_CMM_1435.ja: Search for your missing baseball in here, and you might find something mysterious instead.
DATA_CMM_1435.en: Search for your missing baseball in here, and you might find something mysterious instead.
DATA_CMM_1435.fr: Vous y cherchez en vain la balle que vous avez perdue. Vous ramènerez sans doute quelque trésor en lot de consolation.
DATA_CMM_1435.de: Wenn du hier nach deinem fehlenden Baseball suchst, findest du vielleicht etwas Geheimnisvolles.
DATA_CMM_1435.it: Alcuni bambini alla ricerca dei loro palloni hanno trovato dei tesori nascosti qui.
DATA_CMM_1435.es: Si esto fuera una película, estarías buscando tu pelota y encontrarías algo espantoso. Andate con ojo.
DATA_CMM_1435.ko: 이 안에서 야구공을 찾고 있으면 무언가 신기한 물건을 발견하는 경우가 왕왕 있다.
DATA_CMM_1435.zht: 要是在這裡找棒球，好像會找到什麼神奇的東西。
DATA_CMM_1435.zhs: 要是在这里找棒球，好像会找到什么神奇的东西。

DATA_CMM_1436.ja: Something might be lurking inside here. Unless it isn't.
DATA_CMM_1436.en: Something might be lurking inside here. Unless it isn't.
DATA_CMM_1436.fr: Un horrible monstre se cache peut-être à l'intérieur... Ou peut-être pas.
DATA_CMM_1436.de: Irgendetwas könnte hier drin lauern. Oder auch nicht.
DATA_CMM_1436.it: Qualcosa di orribile potrebbe essere in agguato qui dentro. Ma forse no.
DATA_CMM_1436.es: Puede que haya algo acechando dentro. Pero puede que no.
DATA_CMM_1436.zht: 感覺好像有什麼東西躲在裡面，又好像沒有。
DATA_CMM_1436.zhs: 感觉好像有什么东西躲在里面，又好像没有。

DATA_CMM_1437.ja: People put inside this fence occasionally start fighting feverishly. That's why it's so sturdy.
DATA_CMM_1437.en: People put inside this fence occasionally start fighting feverishly. That's why it's so sturdy.
DATA_CMM_1437.fr: Les gens entourés par cette barrière se battent parfois frénétiquement. C'est pourquoi elle est si solide.
DATA_CMM_1437.de: Leute, die von diesem Zaun eingeschlossen werden, fangen manchmal an, fieberhaft zu kämpfen. Deshalb ist er auch so stabil.
DATA_CMM_1437.it: A volte la gente che entra qui combatte con ferocia. Per questo è così resistente.
DATA_CMM_1437.es: Si pones a dos luchadores en su perímetro, se lanzarán el uno contra el otro.
DATA_CMM_1437.ko: 여기에 둘러싸이면 뜨거운 사나이들의 배틀이 전개되는 경우도 있다. 그래서 꽤 단단하다.
DATA_CMM_1437.zht: 聽說男人們被這個包圍時，就可能展開熱血的戰鬥，所以挺堅固的。
DATA_CMM_1437.zhs: 听说男人们被这个包围时，就可能展开热血的战斗，所以挺坚固的。

DATA_CMM_1438.ja: A piece of décor too big to be useful. You can't throw it away, though, since there are people inside.
DATA_CMM_1438.en: A piece of décor too big to be useful. You can't throw it away, though, since there are people inside.
DATA_CMM_1438.fr: Elément de décoration plutôt encombrant. Hélas, impossible de s'en débarrasser, des gens vivent à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_1438.de: Ein Dekoartikel, der zu groß ist, um nützlich zu sein. Man kann ihn aber nicht wegwerfen, weil Menschen drin sind.
DATA_CMM_1438.it: Un oggetto artistico troppo grande per essere utile. C'è dentro della gente e quindi non può essere buttato via.
DATA_CMM_1438.es: La verdad es que resulta aparatoso para ponerlo como decoración...
DATA_CMM_1438.ko: 너무 커서 민폐를 끼치는 장식품. 그러나 안에는 사람이 들어있으므로 버려선 안된다.
DATA_CMM_1438.zht: 大到礙事的擺設。可是裡面有人，所以不能丟。
DATA_CMM_1438.zhs: 大到碍事的摆设。可是里面有人，所以不能丢。

DATA_CMM_1439.ja: This trails the path of an airplane in flight. It disappears quickly, so it's okay if it's messy.
DATA_CMM_1439.en: This trails the path of an airplane in flight. It disappears quickly, so it's okay if it's messy.
DATA_CMM_1439.fr: Sillage nuageux d'un avion. On est toujours triste de voir qu'il s'efface vite.
DATA_CMM_1439.de: Das hier folgt der Flugbahn eines Flugzeugs. Es verschwindet schnell, also ist es okay, wenn es chaotisch ist.
DATA_CMM_1439.it: Scia che viene lasciata dagli aerei. Sparisce in fretta, non rovina quindi il cielo.
DATA_CMM_1439.es: Si se cruzan varios, el cielo se parece a un tablero o algo así.
DATA_CMM_1439.ko: 비행기가 날아간 후에 생긴다고 한다. 금방 사라지므로 망가뜨려도 혼나지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_1439.zht: 聽說是飛機飛過去造成的雲。馬上就會消失，所以就算亂放也不會被罵。
DATA_CMM_1439.zhs: 听说是飞机飞过去造成的云。马上就会消失，所以就算乱放也不会被骂。

DATA_CMM_1440.ja: This makes your flight path obvious, so it may be best not to use an airplane when you're fleeing somewhere.
DATA_CMM_1440.en: This makes your flight path obvious, so it may be best not to use an airplane when you're fleeing somewhere.
DATA_CMM_1440.fr: Marque clairement où l'avion est passé il y a cinq minutes... Mieux vaut éviter ce moyen de transport si vous êtes recherché !
DATA_CMM_1440.de: Hierdurch wird deine Flugroute offensichtlich, sodass es vielleicht besser ist, kein Flugzeug zu benutzen, wenn du auf der Flucht bist.
DATA_CMM_1440.it: Svela a tutti dove è andato l'aereo.
DATA_CMM_1440.es: Si consiguieran que fuese azul, el avión podría volar de incógnito donde fuese.
DATA_CMM_1440.ko: 날아간 흔적이 이렇게 들통나므로, 도망갈 땐 가능하면 비행기는 안 타는 게 좋을 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_1440.zht: 飛過會留下痕跡，所以逃亡時不要搭飛機比較好。
DATA_CMM_1440.zhs: 飞过会留下痕迹，所以逃亡时不要搭飞机比较好。

DATA_CMM_1441.ja: An annoying phenomenon that brings rain with it. Kids who want to play outside hate this.
DATA_CMM_1441.en: An annoying phenomenon that brings rain with it. Kids who want to play outside hate this.
DATA_CMM_1441.fr: Signe précurseur de la colère des cieux. Ceux qui veulent jouer dehors deviennent ombrageux en le voyant à l'horizon.
DATA_CMM_1441.de: Ein lästiges Phänomen, das Regen mit sich bringt. Kinder, die draußen spielen wollen, hassen das.
DATA_CMM_1441.it: Un fenomeno fastidioso che porta la pioggia. I bambini che amano giocare all'aperto lo odiano.
DATA_CMM_1441.es: Este molesto fenómeno suele ocurrir al principio de las vacaciones, por causas desconocidas.
DATA_CMM_1441.ko: 비를 데려오는 골치아픈 녀석. 밖에서 놀고 싶어하는 아이에겐 굉장히 미움받는다.
DATA_CMM_1441.zht: 會帶來雨水的麻煩傢伙。想要外出玩耍的孩子好像很討厭它。
DATA_CMM_1441.zhs: 会带来雨水的麻烦家伙。想要外出玩耍的孩子好像很讨厌它。

DATA_CMM_1442.ja: A tantalizing fence built to draw people's attention. Pretty dangerous when you're driving.
DATA_CMM_1442.en: A tantalizing fence built to draw people's attention. Pretty dangerous when you're driving.
DATA_CMM_1442.fr: Barrière tape-à-l'œil construite pour attirer l'attention des gens. Ne la regardez pas en conduisant !
DATA_CMM_1442.de: Ein verlockender Zaun, der die Aufmerksamkeit der Leute auf sich ziehen soll. Ziemlich gefährlich, wenn man Auto fährt.
DATA_CMM_1442.it: Una ringhiera costruita con l'intento di attirare l'attenzione.
DATA_CMM_1442.es: Tuvieron que quitarla porque los conductores se distraían mirándola.
DATA_CMM_1442.ko: 운전 중 한눈 파는 것은 위험한데도, 한눈 팔게 만드는 마성의 울타리.
DATA_CMM_1442.zht: 魔幻般的柵欄。開車時不該東張西望的，它卻企圖引人東張西望。
DATA_CMM_1442.zhs: 魔幻般的栅栏。开车时不该东张西望的，它却企图引人东张西望。

DATA_CMM_1443.ja: No matter how long the fence may be, when you see this, that's the end.
DATA_CMM_1443.en: No matter how long the fence may be, when you see this, that's the end.
DATA_CMM_1443.fr: C'est un peu la racine d'une barrière...
DATA_CMM_1443.de: Egal wie lang der Zaun auch sein mag, wenn du das siehst, ist er vorbei.
DATA_CMM_1443.it: Non importa quanto lunga sia la ringhiera, quando c'è questo, vuol dire che è finita.
DATA_CMM_1443.es: Por larga que sea la valla, cuando ves esto es que ya se ha acabado.
DATA_CMM_1443.ko: 아무리 긴 울타리라도 이녀석이 보이면 거기서 끝이다.
DATA_CMM_1443.zht: 不論多麼長的柵欄，到這裡就等於到盡頭。
DATA_CMM_1443.zhs: 不论多么长的栅栏，到这里就等于到尽头。

DATA_CMM_1444.ja: Don't look down on this for being a pre-fab. It's the management center for the entire zoo.
DATA_CMM_1444.en: Don't look down on this for being a pre-fab. It's the management center for the entire zoo.
DATA_CMM_1444.fr: Ce bâtiment est hideux. C'est la cage dans laquelle s'enferme la direction du zoo chaque jour.
DATA_CMM_1444.de: Schau nicht auf dieses Gebäude herab, weil es ein Fertighaus ist. Es ist das Verwaltungszentrum des gesamten Zoos.
DATA_CMM_1444.it: Anche se è solo un prefabbricato, dentro ci lavora il guardiano di tutto lo zoo.
DATA_CMM_1444.es: Parece una chapuza, pero en alguna parte hay que poner la cafetera y el teléfono.
DATA_CMM_1444.ko: 조립식 주택이라고 깔보면 안 된다. 이래 봬도 동물원 전체를 관리하는 관리 센터이다.
DATA_CMM_1444.zht: 不能因為是組合屋就小看它。這裡可是掌管整座動物園的管理中心。
DATA_CMM_1444.zhs: 不能因为是组合屋就小看它。这里可是掌管整座动物园的管理中心。

DATA_CMM_1445.ja: Men are asked to take one step forward.
DATA_CMM_1445.en: Men are asked to take one step forward.
DATA_CMM_1445.de: Männer werden gebeten, einen Schritt nach vorne zu machen.
DATA_CMM_1445.it: Gli uomini dovrebbero alzare sempre l'asse per brevi soste.
DATA_CMM_1445.es: Aunque se forman muchas colas delante, nunca regalan nada.
DATA_CMM_1445.ko: 남자들은 한발 더 앞으로 다가가야 한다고…
DATA_CMM_1445.zht: 聽說男生得更往前一步才行。
DATA_CMM_1445.zhs: 听说男生得更往前一步才行。

DATA_CMM_1446.ja: Standing here is like going on an exciting expedition for just a few dollars.
DATA_CMM_1446.en: Standing here is like going on an exciting expedition for just a few dollars.
DATA_CMM_1446.fr: Offrez-vous un voyage au bout de la ville pour quelques sous, en attendant sous cet abri.
DATA_CMM_1446.de: Hier zu stehen ist wie eine aufregende Entdeckungsreise für nur ein paar $.
DATA_CMM_1446.it: Con pochi soldi si può fare un viaggio emozionante.
DATA_CMM_1446.es: Turismo urbano: coge el primer autobús que llegue y vive la aventura.
DATA_CMM_1446.ko: 스릴만점의 탐험을 100엔으로 즐길 수 있는 듯한데, 아무래도 그런 분위기로 보이진 않는다.
DATA_CMM_1446.zht: 聽說站這裡，就能用100日圓體驗一場有趣的探險，但完全看不出來。
DATA_CMM_1446.zhs: 听说站这里，就能用100日圆体验一场有趣的探险，但完全看不出来。

DATA_CMM_1447.ja: Three small faces. They get along well enough, but they apparently have different tastes in cosmetics.
DATA_CMM_1447.en: Three small faces. They get along well enough, but they apparently have different tastes in cosmetics.
DATA_CMM_1447.fr: Un poteau avec plein de visages. Ils tiennent des réunions pour savoir quoi regarder.
DATA_CMM_1447.de: Viele kleine Gesichter. Sie kommen gut miteinander aus, aber haben offenbar einen unterschiedlichen Kosmetikgeschmack.
DATA_CMM_1447.it: Gruppo di piccole facce. Vanno molto d'accordo, ma hanno gusti diversi in quanto a cosmetici.
DATA_CMM_1447.es: Estas caras se llevan muy bien, lo que es una suerte porque no se pueden separar...
DATA_CMM_1447.ko: 개성파 트리오. 기본적으론 사이가 좋지만 화장하는 취미는 서로 안 맞는다.
DATA_CMM_1447.zht: 笑臉三人組。基本上感情是不錯，但是化妝的風格好像不合。
DATA_CMM_1447.zhs: 笑脸三人组。基本上感情是不错，但是化妆的风格好像不合。

DATA_CMM_1448.ja: A delicious meat patty, but it seems they forgot to bring the buns.
DATA_CMM_1448.en: A delicious meat patty, but it seems they forgot to bring the buns.
DATA_CMM_1448.fr: Délicieux assemblage de viande, mais on a dû oublier le pain...
DATA_CMM_1448.de: Ein leckerer Fleischfladen, aber anscheinend hat man das Brötchen vergessen.
DATA_CMM_1448.it: Deliziose polpette di carne, ma a quanto pare hanno dimenticato il panino!
DATA_CMM_1448.es: Muy jugosa, pero le falta chicha sin el panecillo.
DATA_CMM_1448.ko: 고기를 치댄 뒤 둥글게 만든 음식. 굽는 도중에 가져오는 건 무슨 경우야~?
DATA_CMM_1448.zht: 把肉捏成圓餅的食物。竟然烤到一半就上桌了，這是在搞什麼！？
DATA_CMM_1448.zhs: 把肉捏成圆饼的食物。竟然烤到一半就上桌了，这是在搞什么！？

DATA_CMM_1449.ja: Eat this, and bubbles blow out of your mouth. It's extremely dangerous if you swallow it.
DATA_CMM_1449.en: Eat this, and bubbles blow out of your mouth. It's extremely dangerous if you swallow it.
DATA_CMM_1449.fr: Mâchonnez cet étrange objet pour faire des bulles avec la bouche. C'est très dangereux de l'avaler.
DATA_CMM_1449.de: Wenn du das isst, kommen Blasen aus deinem Mund. Es ist extrem gefährlich, wenn du es verschluckst.
DATA_CMM_1449.it: Basta masticarla e soffiare per creare delle bolle. Non va inghiottita.
DATA_CMM_1449.es: Cuidado con hacer globos demasiado grandes, a ver si vas a salir volando.
DATA_CMM_1449.ko: 이것을 먹으면 풍선이 부풀어지므로 삼키면 위험하다.
DATA_CMM_1449.zht: 吃這個就能吹起氣球，所以要是不小心吞下就糟了。
DATA_CMM_1449.zhs: 吃这个就能吹起气球，所以要是不小心吞下就糟了。

DATA_CMM_1450.ja: Lots of people live here in the afternoon, but they all go away at night. There must be a ghost.
DATA_CMM_1450.en: Lots of people live here in the afternoon, but they all go away at night. There must be a ghost.
DATA_CMM_1450.fr: Beaucoup de gens vivent là pendant l'après-midi, mais ils s'en vont la nuit. Il doit y avoir un fantôme.
DATA_CMM_1450.de: Nachmittags leben hier viele Menschen, aber nachts gehen sie alle weg. Es gibt wohl einen Geist.
DATA_CMM_1450.it: Pieno di vita di giorno, quasi vuoto la notte. Deve esserci un fantasma che fa scappare tutti quanti.
DATA_CMM_1450.es: Hay mucha gente durante el día, pero nadie se queda a pasar la noche. Será que hay fantasmas.
DATA_CMM_1450.ko: 낮에는 많은 사람들이 살고 있지만, 밤이 되면 모두 어딘가로 사라진다. 무서운 귀신이라도 나오나 보다.
DATA_CMM_1450.zht: 白天很多人，但一到晚上大家就不見了。可能是晚上有鬼吧？
DATA_CMM_1450.zhs: 白天很多人，但一到晚上大家就不见了。可能是晚上有鬼吧？

DATA_CMM_1451.ja: They say the seats by the window aren't any good... even though you can see outside and all.
DATA_CMM_1451.en: They say the seats by the window aren't any good... even though you can see outside and all.
DATA_CMM_1451.fr: Les places à côté de la fenêtre ne sont pas très courues. Mais pourtant, on voit l'extérieur...
DATA_CMM_1451.de: Es heißt, die Plätze am Fenster seien nicht gut ... obwohl man nach draußen sehen kann.
DATA_CMM_1451.it: Dicono che i posti vicino alla finestra non siano un granché nonostante il panorama.
DATA_CMM_1451.es: ¿Por qué se tenía que estropear el ascensor justo el día que tienes que subir al piso 32?
DATA_CMM_1451.ko: 창쪽 좌석은 그다지 좋은 곳이 아닌가 보다. 밖이 다 보여서 멋지기만 하구만…
DATA_CMM_1451.zht: 據說窗邊不是個好位子。但可以看到窗外景色明明就不錯。
DATA_CMM_1451.zhs: 据说窗边不是个好位子。但可以看到窗外景色明明就不错。

DATA_CMM_1452.ja: Clothing can often be seen hung outside to dry. Perhaps some people live here.
DATA_CMM_1452.en: Clothing can often be seen hung outside to dry. Perhaps some people live here.
DATA_CMM_1452.fr: On y voit souvent des vêtements perchés aux fenêtres. Des gens habitent peut-être dedans.
DATA_CMM_1452.de: Oft sieht man Kleidung zum Trocknen draußen hängen. Vielleicht leben hier ein paar Menschen.
DATA_CMM_1452.it: Spesso si vedono dei panni stesi fuori ad asciugare, probabilmente, dunque, ci vive qualcuno.
DATA_CMM_1452.es: Se suele ver colada tendida a secar; eso va a ser que vive gente dentro.
DATA_CMM_1452.ko: 옥상에 뭔가를 널어놓는 경우가 가끔 있다. 여기서 사는 사람이 있는지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_1452.zht: 有時候屋頂會曬些東西。也許是有人住吧。
DATA_CMM_1452.zhs: 有时候屋顶会晒些东西。也许是有人住吧。

DATA_CMM_1453.ja: The big boss is somewhere in here, but you won't get any praise for finding him.
DATA_CMM_1453.en: The big boss is somewhere in here, but you won't get any praise for finding him.
DATA_CMM_1453.fr: Le grand patron est quelque part à l'intérieur. Et après ?
DATA_CMM_1453.de: Der große Boss ist irgendwo hier drin, aber du wirst nicht gelobt, wenn du ihn findest.
DATA_CMM_1453.it: Il gran capo vive qui da qualche parte, ma nessuno verrà elogiato per averlo trovato.
DATA_CMM_1453.es: El jefe siempre está aquí, pero ni siquiera su secretaria sabe dónde.
DATA_CMM_1453.ko: 가장 높은 사람이 여기 어딘가에 있는 듯하지만, 찾아낸다고 칭찬받는 것은 아니다.
DATA_CMM_1453.zht: 地位最高的人就住在這裡面的某個地方，不過就算找到了也沒有任何獎勵。
DATA_CMM_1453.zhs: 地位最高的人就住在这里面的某个地方，不过就算找到了也没有任何奖励。

DATA_CMM_1454.ja: We can't tell from the outside, but there may be buildings out there that are longer underground.
DATA_CMM_1454.en: We can't tell from the outside, but there may be buildings out there that are longer underground.
DATA_CMM_1454.fr: Nous Nous demandons si certains bâtiments ne sont pas comme les icebergs, avec une partie émergée minuscule.
DATA_CMM_1454.de: Wir können es von außen nicht erkennen, aber vielleicht gibt es dort draußen Gebäude, die unter der Erde länger sind.
DATA_CMM_1454.it: Difficile a dirsi dall'esterno, ma probabilmente ci sono dei palazzi che vanno più in profondità.
DATA_CMM_1454.es: Parece bajito, pero dicen que tiene 10 sótanos. Sería que tenían los planos al revés.
DATA_CMM_1454.ko: 밖에서 보면 모르겠지만, 땅속 깊이 파묻힌 빌딩이 존재할지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_1454.zht: 從外頭是看不出來，不過也許這棟大樓地面下的部分更長。
DATA_CMM_1454.zhs: 从外头是看不出来，不过也许这栋大楼地面下的部分更长。

DATA_CMM_1455.ja: A green balloon. It was probably greener before it was inflated.
DATA_CMM_1455.en: A green balloon. It was probably greener before it was inflated.
DATA_CMM_1455.fr: Un ballon vert. Il était sans doute d'un vert plus vif avant de prendre de l'embonpoint.
DATA_CMM_1455.de: Ein grüner Luftballon. Er war wahrscheinlich noch grüner, bevor er aufgeblasen wurde.
DATA_CMM_1455.it: Un palloncino verde. Era più scuro prima di essere gonfiato.
DATA_CMM_1455.es: Por mucho que lo dejes madurar al sol, no se volverá rojo.
DATA_CMM_1455.ko: 녹색 풍선. 빵빵하게 부풀기 전에는 더욱 진한 녹색이었다.

DATA_CMM_1456.ja: Get a lot of these, and it seems you can float into the air.
DATA_CMM_1456.en: Get a lot of these, and it seems you can float into the air.
DATA_CMM_1456.fr: Si l'on en achète beaucoup, on dit qu'on peut léviter...
DATA_CMM_1456.de: Wenn man viele davon hat, scheint es, als könne man in der Luft schweben.
DATA_CMM_1456.es: Si te atas los suficientes a los brazos, a lo mejor puedes irte volando.
DATA_CMM_1456.ko: 이것이 잔뜩 모이면 하늘을 나는 것도 가능하다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1456.zht: 聽說蒐集很多這種氣球就能飄到空中。
DATA_CMM_1456.zhs: 听说搜集很多这种气球就能飘到空中。

DATA_CMM_1457.ja: Even after the flavor's gone, the gum's still there. How economical!
DATA_CMM_1457.en: Even after the flavor's gone, the gum's still there. How economical!
DATA_CMM_1457.fr:
Même quand le goût n'est plus là, le chewing-gum demeure.
Très économique !
DATA_CMM_1457.de: Selbst wenn der Geschmack weg ist, ist der Kaugummi noch da. Wie ergiebig!
DATA_CMM_1457.it: La gomma rimane anche se il sapore se n'è andato. Questo sì che è economico.
DATA_CMM_1457.es: Aunque esté sin sabor, no te ves capaz de dejar de mascar.
DATA_CMM_1457.ko: 맛은 사라져도 씹을 게 남아있는 신기한 과자.
DATA_CMM_1457.zht: 就算沒味道也不會消失的超划算食物。
DATA_CMM_1457.zhs: 就算没味道也不会消失的超划算食物。

DATA_CMM_1459.ja: Fall down in this and you'll make a you-shaped hole. It's fun!
DATA_CMM_1459.en: Fall down in this and you'll make a you-shaped hole. It's fun!
DATA_CMM_1459.fr: Jetez-vous dedans et faites-vous tirer le portrait gratuitement !
DATA_CMM_1459.de: Wenn du hineinfällst, entsteht ein Loch in deiner Form. Spaßig!
DATA_CMM_1459.it: Basta caderci dentro per fare un buco a forma di se stessi.
DATA_CMM_1459.es: Da hasta pena pisarla, pero más pena sería mirarla desde dentro de la casa.
DATA_CMM_1459.ko: 여기에 넘어지면 자기 모양과 똑같은 자국이 남아서 재미있다.
DATA_CMM_1459.zht: 撲倒在這上頭就會出現跟自己一樣形狀的洞，真好玩。
DATA_CMM_1459.zhs: 扑倒在这上头就会出现跟自己一样形状的洞，真好玩。

DATA_CMM_1460.ja: Snow that solidified into a katamari. Children always tramp all over this when they walk.
DATA_CMM_1460.en: Snow that solidified into a katamari. Children always tramp all over this when they walk.
DATA_CMM_1460.fr: Neige qui s'est solidifiée en un katamari. Les enfants adorent l'écraser en passant à côté.
DATA_CMM_1460.de: Schnee, der zu einem Katamari erstarrt ist. Kinder trampeln immer darauf herum, wenn sie laufen.
DATA_CMM_1460.it: Neve solidificata in una specie di katamari. I bambini amano calpestarla.
DATA_CMM_1460.es: La nieve se ha convertido en un katamari; puedes usarlo para hacer prácticas.
DATA_CMM_1460.ko: 눈이 얼어붙어 덩어리가 된 눈. 아이들은 반드시 발로 밟는다.
DATA_CMM_1460.zht: 雪凝結成塊形成的。小朋友一定會踩著這個走。
DATA_CMM_1460.zhs: 雪凝结成块形成的。小朋友一定会踩着这个走。

DATA_CMM_1461.ja: No matter how large a katamari the little pieces of snow make, it's just called snow.
DATA_CMM_1461.en: No matter how large a katamari the little pieces of snow make, it's just called snow.
DATA_CMM_1461.fr: Peu importe la taille du katamari que forment les petits morceaux de neige, ce sera toujours de la neige.
DATA_CMM_1461.de: Egal, wie groß der Katamari ist, den die kleinen Schneestückchen bilden, er heißt einfach Schnee.
DATA_CMM_1461.it: Non importa quanto sia grande il katamari che i vari fiocchi riescono a fare, si chiama sempre neve.
DATA_CMM_1461.es: Está bien querer hacer una bola más grande que tú, pero ¿seguro que es sensato?
DATA_CMM_1461.ko: 작은 눈이 이렇게 크게 뭉쳤다 하더라도, 그 이름은 역시 눈에 불과함.
DATA_CMM_1461.zht: 就算凝結成這麼大塊也還是叫「雪」。
DATA_CMM_1461.zhs: 就算凝结成这么大块也还是叫「雪」。

DATA_CMM_1462.ja: Even when it's this big, it'll all melt away someday. It's a little painful to think about.
DATA_CMM_1462.en: Even when it's this big, it'll all melt away someday. It's a little painful to think about.
DATA_CMM_1462.fr: Elle est impressionnante, comme ça, mais elle fondra un jour, c'est dans l'ordre des choses.
DATA_CMM_1462.de: Selbst wenn er so groß ist, wird er eines Tages dahinschmelzen. Der Gedanke daran ist ein bisschen schmerzhaft.
DATA_CMM_1462.it: Anche quando è così tanta... prima o poi si scioglierà. La vita è fugacità.
DATA_CMM_1462.es: Es una lástima que no vaya a sobrevivir hasta el verano...
DATA_CMM_1462.ko: 이렇게 커다래도 결국 녹아없어지면 약간 센치해지는 허무한 물체이다.
DATA_CMM_1462.zht: 這麼巨大，卻也總有一天會融化消失，是種有點令人哀傷的物體。
DATA_CMM_1462.zhs: 这么巨大，却也总有一天会融化消失，是种有点令人哀伤的物体。

DATA_CMM_1463.ja: Snow on Christmas Day apparently leads to romantic love.
DATA_CMM_1463.en: Snow on Christmas Day apparently leads to romantic love.
DATA_CMM_1463.fr: La neige à Noël est si romantique...
DATA_CMM_1463.de: Schnee am Weihnachtstag führt offenbar zu romantischer Liebe.
DATA_CMM_1463.it: A quanto pare la neve a Natale è molto apprezzata dalle persone romantiche.
DATA_CMM_1463.es: Esconder piedras dentro de las bolas de nieve no está nada bien, que lo sepas.
DATA_CMM_1463.ko: 크리스마스 밤에 눈이 내리면 로맨틱한 사랑이 싹튼다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1463.zht: 聽說聖誕節時下雪的話，就會有浪漫的愛情故事誕生。
DATA_CMM_1463.zhs: 听说圣诞节时下雪的话，就会有浪漫的爱情故事诞生。

DATA_CMM_1464.ja: The foundation is available only in winter. We have yet to see a year-round version.
DATA_CMM_1464.en: The foundation is available only in winter. We have yet to see a year-round version.
DATA_CMM_1464.fr: Elle n'est disponible que pendant l'hiver. A quand les neiges éternelles ?
DATA_CMM_1464.de: Das Fundament ist nur im Winter erhältlich. Eine Ganzjahresversion haben wir noch nicht gesehen.
DATA_CMM_1464.it: Una casa prettamente invernale, non abbiamo mai visto la sua controparte estiva.
DATA_CMM_1464.es: Alojamiento solo disponible en invierno; enfermos febriles abstenerse.
DATA_CMM_1464.ko: 겨울 한정 토대. 다른 계절엔 본 적이 없다.
DATA_CMM_1464.zht: 冬天才看得到的雪屋基座。沒見過能存在一整年的。
DATA_CMM_1464.zhs: 冬天才看得到的雪屋基座。没见过能存在一整年的。

DATA_CMM_1468.ja: Has a much higher rank than the garden-variety R's you see every day.
DATA_CMM_1468.en: Has a much higher rank than the garden-variety R's you see every day.
DATA_CMM_1468.fr: Beaucoup plus noble que les versions qui circulent partout aujourd'hui.
DATA_CMM_1468.de: Hat einen viel höheren Rang als die alltäglichen „R", die man ständig sieht.
DATA_CMM_1468.it: Non c'è da scherzare con questi.
DATA_CMM_1468.es: ¿Eso quiere decir que la han cacheado antes de dejarla entrar?
DATA_CMM_1468.ko: 근방의 R과는 그 격이 다르다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1468.zht: 聽說比到處看得到的R厲害。
DATA_CMM_1468.zhs: 听说比到处看得到的R厉害。

DATA_CMM_1469.ja: They aren't worried much about the time it took for the goods to get here.
DATA_CMM_1469.en: They aren't worried much about the time it took for the goods to get here.
DATA_CMM_1469.fr: Personne ne s'effraie du temps que les marchandises ont mis pour arriver ici...
DATA_CMM_1469.de: Wie lange die Waren bis zur Anlieferung gebraucht haben, ist ihnen eigentlich relativ egal.
DATA_CMM_1469.it: A quanto pare il tempo che le merci ci hanno messo ad arrivare non conta.
DATA_CMM_1469.es: No parece preocuparles demasiado el tiempo que tardan en llegar los productos.
DATA_CMM_1469.ko: 얼마나 많은 시간을 거쳐 여기까지 왔는지는 그다지 신경쓰지 않는 눈치이다.
DATA_CMM_1469.zht: 他們好像不介意送到這裡花了多久時間。
DATA_CMM_1469.zhs: 他们好像不介意送到这里花了多久时间。

DATA_CMM_1470.ja: A house often seen in rural towns. The people inside live a relaxed lifestyle.
DATA_CMM_1470.en: A house often seen in rural towns. The people inside live a relaxed lifestyle.
DATA_CMM_1470.fr: Maison des villes rurales. Les gens à l'intérieur mènent une vie relax.
DATA_CMM_1470.de: Ein Haus, das man oft in ländlichen Städten sieht. Die Menschen darin pflegen einen entspannten Lebensstil.
DATA_CMM_1470.it: Un tipo di casa vista solo in campagna. La vita è sana, ma meno rilassata di quel che si pensi.
DATA_CMM_1470.es: Aunque se lleve un ritmo de vida muy tranquilo, a veces se producen rebeliones.
DATA_CMM_1470.ko: 시골 거리에서 자주 볼 수 있는 집. 슬로우한 생활을 영위하는 사람들이 살고 있다.
DATA_CMM_1470.zht: 鄉下常見的屋子。裡面住著正在過慢生活的人。
DATA_CMM_1470.zhs: 乡下常见的屋子。里面住着正在过慢生活的人。

DATA_CMM_1471.ja: There are holes in it, so it's only good for carrying large objects.
DATA_CMM_1471.en: There are holes in it, so it's only good for carrying large objects.
DATA_CMM_1471.fr: Elle est trouée, alors ne transportez pas de petits objets avec !
DATA_CMM_1471.de: Sie ist durchlöchert und eignet sich daher nur für den Transport großer Gegenstände.
DATA_CMM_1471.it: Ci sono dei buchi, quindi va bene solo per portare oggetti grandi.
DATA_CMM_1471.es: Tiene agujeros, así que no guardes nada que sea muy secreto.
DATA_CMM_1471.ko: 구멍이 나 있으므로 큰 것만 실어 나를 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_1471.zht: 上面有很多洞，只能裝比洞還大的東西。
DATA_CMM_1471.zhs: 上面有很多洞，只能装比洞还大的东西。

DATA_CMM_1472.ja: A solid, sturdy box, but it's too low to be used as a desk or chair.
DATA_CMM_1472.en: A solid, sturdy box, but it's too low to be used as a desk or chair.
DATA_CMM_1472.fr: Une cagette solide, hélas trop petite pour faire une chaise.
DATA_CMM_1472.de: Eine solide, robuste Box, aber zu niedrig, um als Schreibtisch oder Stuhl verwendet zu werden.
DATA_CMM_1472.it: Una scatola robusta, ma troppo bassa per fare da sedia o tavolo.
DATA_CMM_1472.es: Es muy sólida, pero demasiado baja para hacer de mesa o de silla.
DATA_CMM_1472.ko: 딱딱하고 튼튼하지만 키가 작아서 책상으로도 의자로도 사용할 수 없다.
DATA_CMM_1472.zht: 雖然比較硬又比較堅固，但高度不高，可以當成椅子或桌子。
DATA_CMM_1472.zhs: 虽然比较硬又比较坚固，但高度不高，可以当成椅子或桌子。

DATA_CMM_1473.es: Se pronuncia "na", como su nombre indica.

DATA_CMM_1474.ja: A letter that represents many different emotions depending on how you pronounce it.
DATA_CMM_1474.en: A letter that represents many different emotions depending on how you pronounce it.
DATA_CMM_1474.fr: Selon la façon de la prononcer, cette lettre peut faire changer d'humeur.
DATA_CMM_1474.de: Ein Buchstabe, der für viele verschiedene Gefühle steht, je nachdem, wie man ihn ausspricht.
DATA_CMM_1474.it: Una lettera che può veicolare molte emozioni diverse a seconda di come la pronunci.
DATA_CMM_1474.es: Una letra puede representar muchas emociones dependiendo de la pronunciación.
DATA_CMM_1474.zht: 轉折的尖角似乎被磨圓了。
DATA_CMM_1474.zhs: 转折的尖角似乎被磨圆了。

DATA_CMM_1475.es: O sea, medio coco. Ja, ja.

DATA_CMM_1476.ja: He's apparently good at making stars, but We can't tell for sure because he's so small.
DATA_CMM_1476.en: He's apparently good at making stars, but We can't tell for sure because he's so small.
DATA_CMM_1476.fr: Il est assez doué pour faire des planètes, mais Nous ne savons pas pourquoi il est si petit. C'est l'un de nos grands soucis.
DATA_CMM_1476.de: Er ist offenbar gut darin, Planeten herzustellen, aber ganz sicher sind wir nicht, weil er so klein ist.
DATA_CMM_1476.it: A quanto pare è bravo a fare corpi celesti, ma non siamo in grado di dirlo perché sono troppo piccole.
DATA_CMM_1476.es: A pesar de su pequeño tamaño, tiene una altura moral considerable.
DATA_CMM_1476.ko: 별을 만드는 것이 특기라곤 하지만 너무 작아서 잘 안 보인다.
DATA_CMM_1476.zht: 雖然很擅長製造星球，但太小了看不清楚。
DATA_CMM_1476.zhs: 虽然很擅长制造星球，但太小了看不清楚。

DATA_CMM_1477.ja: A slightly sunburnt cousin who enjoys going out stark naked.
DATA_CMM_1477.en: A slightly sunburnt cousin who enjoys going out stark naked.
DATA_CMM_1477.fr: Cousin légèrement bronzé qui aime bien se promener nu.
DATA_CMM_1477.de: Ein leicht sonnenverbrannter Cousin, der gerne splitternackt unterwegs ist.
DATA_CMM_1477.it: Un cugino pieno di scottature. Adora uscire completamente nudo.
DATA_CMM_1477.es: El otro día se quemó en la playa; lo sabemos porque le gusta andar desnudo.
DATA_CMM_1477.ko: 약간 검게 그을린 사촌. 항상 발가벗은 채로 외출하고 돌아 다닌다.
DATA_CMM_1477.zht: 曬得有點黑的親戚。好像平常都脫光光出門。
DATA_CMM_1477.zhs: 晒得有点黑的亲戚。好像平常都脱光光出门。

DATA_CMM_1478.ja: A cousin who eats too much. Although he wasn't even dieting, he says he gained it all back.
DATA_CMM_1478.en: A cousin who eats too much. Although he wasn't even dieting, he says he gained it all back.
DATA_CMM_1478.fr: Il mange trop. Il ne faisait pas de régime, mais il se plaint d'avoir tout repris.
DATA_CMM_1478.de: Ein Cousin, der zu viel isst. Er war nicht mal auf Diät und sagt, dass er alles wieder zugenommen hat.
DATA_CMM_1478.it: Un cugino che mangia un po' troppo. Ignora l'esistenza delle diete.
DATA_CMM_1478.es: Engorda con solo pensar en comida; el pobre tiene un problema.
DATA_CMM_1478.ko: 먹보 사촌. 다이어트를 한 것도 아닌데 왠지 요요현상이 일어난다고…
DATA_CMM_1478.zht: 吃太多的親戚。明明沒在減肥卻復胖了。
DATA_CMM_1478.zhs: 吃太多的亲戚。明明没在减肥却复胖了。

DATA_CMM_1479.ja: A cousin who switched butts to a spikier model. It hasn't been generating much buzz.
DATA_CMM_1479.en: A cousin who switched butts to a spikier model. It hasn't been generating much buzz.
DATA_CMM_1479.fr: En optant pour un modèle plus pointu, Ace n'a impressionné personne.
DATA_CMM_1479.de: Ein Cousin, der seinen Po gegen einen stacheligeren getauscht hat. Viel Erfolg hatte er damit nicht.
DATA_CMM_1479.it: Un cugino che ha cambiato il sedere con un modello appuntito. Non ha fatto scalpore.
DATA_CMM_1479.es: Ha cambiado de imagen hace poco, pero aparte de eso, no ha hecho nada más.
DATA_CMM_1479.ko: 삼각 엉덩이로 모델 체인지를 한 사촌. 그러나 그다지 화제의 중심이 된 적은 없다.
DATA_CMM_1479.zht: 把自己頭左右兩邊改得尖尖的親戚。但大家已經看習慣了。
DATA_CMM_1479.zhs: 把自己头左右两边改得尖尖的亲戚。但大家已经看习惯了。

DATA_CMM_1480.ja: A cousin who looks a lot like the Prince from certain angles. Apparently, he was once so surprised that his face jumped out of his body.
DATA_CMM_1480.en: A cousin who looks a lot like the Prince from certain angles. Apparently, he was once so surprised that his face jumped out of his body.
DATA_CMM_1480.fr: Ce cousin-là ressemble étrangement au Prince, vu sous certains angles. Une fois, il a été tellement surpris que son visage s'est séparé de son corps.
DATA_CMM_1480.de: Ein Cousin, der aus manchen Blickwinkeln dem Prinzen sehr ähnelt. Einmal war er so überrascht, dass ihm das Gesicht aus dem Körper gesprungen ist.
DATA_CMM_1480.it: Un cugino che assomiglia moltissimo al Principe, almeno da certi punti di vista. A quanto pare un giorno ne fu così sorpreso che la faccia gli è saltata via.
DATA_CMM_1480.es: Según cómo lo mires, se parece un poco al Príncipe, aunque la Reina diga que no.
DATA_CMM_1480.ko: 왕자와 닮은 사촌. 얼굴을 내밀수록 깜짝 놀라는 경우가 허다하다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1480.zht: 跟王子長得很像的親戚。聽說曾經嚇到臉都要飛出來了。
DATA_CMM_1480.zhs: 跟王子长得很像的亲戚。听说曾经吓到脸都要飞出来了。

DATA_CMM_1481.ja: It's been a while since this cousin stood on her own two feet. She's gotten taller since last time, so she doesn't need to float anymore.
DATA_CMM_1481.en: It's been a while since this cousin stood on her own two feet. She's gotten taller since last time, so she doesn't need to float anymore.
DATA_CMM_1481.fr: Ça fait un moment que ce cousin ne s'était plus tenu debout. Il a grandi depuis la dernière fois, alors il n'a plus besoin de flotter.
DATA_CMM_1481.de: Es ist eine Weile her, dass dieser Cousin auf eigenen Beinen gestanden hat. Seit dem letzten Mal ist er gewachsen und muss nicht mehr schweben.
DATA_CMM_1481.it: Era da tanto che non stava con i piedi per terra. Questo cugino è cresciuto e ha smesso di fluttuare.
DATA_CMM_1481.es: Este primo no deja de crecer; no gana para pantalones.
DATA_CMM_1481.ko: 오랜만에 등장한 사촌. 예전보다 키가 컸지만 공중에 떠 있어서야 무슨 의미가 있겠나.
DATA_CMM_1481.zht: 終於把腳露出來的親戚。好像是之前長高，所以不必再用飄的了。
