DATA_CMM_1913.it: Questo cartello dice "Natura". Ovviamente si tratta di un falso visto che questo cartello è di chiara origine artificiale.
DATA_CMM_1913.es: Si supieras japonés, lo escribirías así.
DATA_CMM_1913.ko: 아무리봐도 인공물인데, 천연이라고 빡빡 우기는 곤란한 녀석.
DATA_CMM_1913.zht: 不管怎麼看都是人造，還謊稱是「自然」，真令人頭痛。
DATA_CMM_1913.zhs: 不管怎么看都是人造，还谎称是「自然」，真令人头痛。

DATA_CMM_1914.ja: This sign reads "Memorial." Apparently this is asking readers not to let go of their memories.
DATA_CMM_1914.en: This sign reads "Memorial." Apparently this is asking readers not to let go of their memories.
DATA_CMM_1914.fr: Il semble se rappeler au souvenir des gens qui le lisent.
DATA_CMM_1914.de: Auf diesem Schild steht „Denkmal". Offenbar werden Lesende damit aufgefordert, an ihren Erinnerungen festzuhalten.
DATA_CMM_1914.it: "Memorial". A quanto pare motiva i lettori a non perdere le proprie memorie.
DATA_CMM_1914.es: Otro rótulo para que sepas dónde vas, si es que sabes leer japonés.
DATA_CMM_1914.ko: 추억을 잊지 말라고 뭔가에 열심히 호소하고 있다.
DATA_CMM_1914.zht: 為了不忘記回憶而刻意強調什麼的感覺。
DATA_CMM_1914.zhs: 为了不忘记回忆而刻意强调什么的感觉。

DATA_CMM_1915.ko: 아무리 기다려도 움직이지 않는 것으로 봐선 고장나 있는 건지도 모르겠다.
DATA_CMM_1915.zht: 不管等多久它都不會動。大概是壞掉了吧。
DATA_CMM_1915.zhs: 不管等多久它都不会动。大概是坏掉了吧。

DATA_CMM_1916.ja: This sign means "thing." Put this and the previous kanji together to make the word for "animal."
DATA_CMM_1916.en: This sign means "thing." Put this and the previous kanji together to make the word for "animal."
DATA_CMM_1916.fr: Il signifie "chose". Marié avec le caractère précédent, il devient "animal".
DATA_CMM_1916.it: Questo kanji da solo significa "cosa", assieme al primo diventa "cosa che si muove" e quindi "animali".
DATA_CMM_1916.es: Este kanji significa "cosa". Si lo pones junto al anterior, significa "animal".
DATA_CMM_1916.ko: 물건이라고는 하나 어떤 물건인지는 알려주지 않는다. 나쁜 놈은 아닌 것 같은데…
DATA_CMM_1916.zht: 說是「物」也沒說是什麼物品。但至少感覺不是可惡的「惡」。
DATA_CMM_1916.zhs: 说是「物」也没说是什么物品。但至少感觉不是可恶的「恶」。

DATA_CMM_1917.ja: This sign means "park." So, there you have it! All the kanji together mean "Zoo." We think it would be easier to just write "Zoo."
DATA_CMM_1917.en: This sign means "park." So, there you have it! All the kanji together mean "Zoo." We think it would be easier to just write "Zoo."
DATA_CMM_1917.fr: Signifie "parc". C'est magique ! Les trois caractères ensemble donnent "zoo". Mais Nous pensons qu'il serait plus court d'écrire "zoo".
DATA_CMM_1917.de: Dieses Zeichen steht auch für „O". Alle drei ergeben „Zoo". Warum hat man dafür nicht einfach ein Schild genommen?
DATA_CMM_1917.it: Questo significa parco. Insomma "ZOO". Era più facile scriverlo così.
DATA_CMM_1917.es: Este kanji significa "parque". ¡Ya lo tienes! Todos estos kanji juntos significan "zoo".
DATA_CMM_1917.ko: 사람이 많은 곳에 자주 보이는 글자다.
DATA_CMM_1917.zht: 感覺是用在喧鬧的地方的文字。
DATA_CMM_1917.zhs: 感觉是用在喧闹的地方的文字。

DATA_CMM_1918.ja: A crane made out of pretty paper. Nobody seems to point out that it has no legs.
DATA_CMM_1918.en: A crane made out of pretty paper. Nobody seems to point out that it has no legs.
DATA_CMM_1918.fr: Belle grue de papier. On dirait que personne ne s'inquiète de savoir où sont ses pattes.
DATA_CMM_1918.de: Ein Kranich aus hübschem Papier. Es scheint niemanden zu stören, dass er keine Beine hat.
DATA_CMM_1918.it: Una gru fatta con della buona carta. Nessuno, per educazione, fa notare che le mancano le gambe.
DATA_CMM_1918.es: Es tan bonita que nadie se da cuenta de que no tiene patas.
DATA_CMM_1918.ko: 예쁜 종이로 만든 학. 다리가 없는 것은 누구도 언급하려 하지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_1918.zht: 漂亮的紙做成的鶴。都沒有人想問為什麼沒有腳。
DATA_CMM_1918.zhs: 漂亮的纸做成的鹤。都没有人想问为什么没有脚。

DATA_CMM_1919.ja: A cute paper crane. You can puff out its stomach and spread its wings, if you like.
DATA_CMM_1919.en: A cute paper crane. You can puff out its stomach and spread its wings, if you like.
DATA_CMM_1919.fr: Jolie grue en papier. Soufflez-lui dans l'estomac et ses ailes se déploieront.
DATA_CMM_1919.de: Ein niedlicher Papierkranich. Man kann seinen Bauch aufplustern und seine Flügel ausbreiten, wenn man mag.
DATA_CMM_1919.it: Una gru molto carina, le ali si muovono e le si gonfia il petto.
DATA_CMM_1919.es: Puedes moverle las alas con las manos, pero no volará.
DATA_CMM_1919.ko: 귀여운 종이 학. 배부분을 부풀리거나, 날개를 펴거나 하며 노는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_1919.zht: 惹人憐愛，紙製成的鶴。好像能讓它的肚子鼓起來，或是展翅遊玩。
DATA_CMM_1919.zhs: 惹人怜爱，纸制成的鹤。好像能让它的肚子鼓起来，或是展翅游玩。

DATA_CMM_1920.ja: Even if you pluck a real crane, it won't look like this. It's best not to try it.
DATA_CMM_1920.en: Even if you pluck a real crane, it won't look like this. It's best not to try it.
DATA_CMM_1920.fr: Même si vous plumez une vraie grue, elle ne lui ressemblera pas. Nous vous déconseillons d'essayer.
DATA_CMM_1920.de: Selbst wenn man einen echten Kranich rupft, sieht er nicht so aus. Am besten versucht man es erst gar nicht.
DATA_CMM_1920.it: Non si è mai vista una gru verde, la cosa risulta poco realistica.
DATA_CMM_1920.es: Más que pajarita de papel, debería llamarse lorito de papel.
DATA_CMM_1920.ko: 학의 털을 몽땅 뽑아도 이런 색깔은 안 나오므로 괜히 시험해보려 하지 말자.
DATA_CMM_1920.zht: 把鶴的羽毛拔下來也不會變紙鶴，還是別這麼做吧。
DATA_CMM_1920.zhs: 把鹤的羽毛拔下来也不会变纸鹤，还是别这么做吧。

DATA_CMM_1921.ja: Apparently dislikes other cranes made out of gold and silver paper.
DATA_CMM_1921.en: Apparently dislikes other cranes made out of gold and silver paper.
DATA_CMM_1921.fr: Elle est jalouse des grues faites de papier doré et argenté.
DATA_CMM_1921.de: Anscheinend mag er andere Kraniche aus Gold- und Silberpapier nicht.
DATA_CMM_1921.it: A quanto pare si crede la gru più bella.
DATA_CMM_1921.es: Se dice que tiene celos de las pajaritas de papel dorado.
DATA_CMM_1921.ko: 금이나 은으로 치장한 학에게 라이벌 의식을 느끼는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1921.zht: 它好像把金紙鶴和銀紙鶴當成競爭對手。
DATA_CMM_1921.zhs: 它好像把金纸鹤和银纸鹤当成竞争对手。

DATA_CMM_1922.ja: This guy's pretty spiky. Getting pecked with its beak must hurt a lot.
DATA_CMM_1922.en: This guy's pretty spiky. Getting pecked with its beak must hurt a lot.
DATA_CMM_1922.fr: Elle est très pointue. Mieux vaut éviter de recevoir un coup de bec.
DATA_CMM_1922.de: Ziemlich stacheliges Kerlchen. Muss echt wehtun, wenn er mit seinem Schnabel pickt.
DATA_CMM_1922.it: Ha il becco acuminato, potrebbe fare dei danni.
DATA_CMM_1922.es: Ese pico es muy puntiagudo; seguro que hace daño, aunque sea de papel.
DATA_CMM_1922.ko: 굉장히 삐쭉하다. 이 부리에 쪼이면 굉장히 아플 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_1922.zht: 非常尖銳。要是被它的鳥嘴啄到一定很痛。
DATA_CMM_1922.zhs: 非常尖锐。要是被它的鸟嘴啄到一定很痛。

DATA_CMM_1923.ja: He thinks he's unique, but there are dozens more just like him.
DATA_CMM_1923.en: He thinks he's unique, but there are dozens more just like him.
DATA_CMM_1923.fr: Elle se croit unique, mais elle n'est pas crue. Ses frères et sœurs sont nombreux.
DATA_CMM_1923.de: Glaubt, er sei einzigartig, aber es gibt noch Dutzende, die genauso wie er sind.
DATA_CMM_1923.it: Pensa di essere un pezzo unico ma si sbaglia di grosso.
DATA_CMM_1923.es: Se cree única, pero hay varias docenas iguales que ella.
DATA_CMM_1923.ko: 천 마리 학 중 한마리가 되는 건 개성이 없다고 생각하여, 거부하려 하고 있다.
DATA_CMM_1923.zht: 它好像覺得被做成千紙鶴太沒有個人特色，所以不太願意。
DATA_CMM_1923.zhs: 它好像觉得被做成千纸鹤太没有个人特色，所以不太愿意。

DATA_CMM_1924.ja: You don't know which side will be the head until just before it's complete. How very exciting.
DATA_CMM_1924.en: You don't know which side will be the head until just before it's complete. How very exciting.
DATA_CMM_1924.fr: Difficile de savoir où sera sa tête avant qu'elle soit finie. C'est très amusant.
DATA_CMM_1924.de: Man weiß erst kurz vor Vollendung, welche Seite der Kopf sein wird. Wirklich sehr aufregend.
DATA_CMM_1924.it: Non si sa da quale lato sia la testa fino a quando non è terminata. È una cosa che personalmente troviamo elettrizzante.
DATA_CMM_1924.es: Hasta que no la terminas, no sabes de qué lado estará la cabeza. Qué emocionante.
DATA_CMM_1924.ko: 누가 가장 위에 군림하게 될지는 완성 직전까지 모르기 때문에, 두근두근 거리고 있다.
DATA_CMM_1924.zht: 不到完成前最後一刻不曉得哪一邊才是頭部，所以令人雀躍。
DATA_CMM_1924.zhs: 不到完成前最后一刻不晓得哪一边才是头部，所以令人雀跃。

DATA_CMM_1925.ja: A string made of lots of cranes. They must have run out of energy after the 50th one.
DATA_CMM_1925.en: A string made of lots of cranes. They must have run out of energy after the 50th one.
DATA_CMM_1925.fr: Guirlande faite de nombreuses grues. A la cinquantième, l'artisan en a eu assez.
DATA_CMM_1925.de: Eine Kette aus vielen Kraninchen. Nach dem 50. muss irgendwie die Luft raus gewesen sein.
DATA_CMM_1925.es: El plan era hacer 5.000, pero es que es muy cansado.
DATA_CMM_1925.ko: 여러 종이학을 실로 꿰어 모은 것. 아무래도 50마리에서 힘이 빠진 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_1925.zht: 用線串起許多紙鶴而成。似乎到第50隻就累垮了。
DATA_CMM_1925.zhs: 用线串起许多纸鹤而成。似乎到第50只就累垮了。

DATA_CMM_1926.ja: A brand new character who's made out of paper. It's hard to feel affection for it as it has no face.
DATA_CMM_1926.en: A brand new character who's made out of paper. It's hard to feel affection for it as it has no face.
DATA_CMM_1926.fr: Un nouveau personnage fait de papier. Difficile de l'aimer parce qu'on ne voit pas son visage.
DATA_CMM_1926.de: Eine brandneue Figur aus Papier. Es fällt schwer, sie lieb zu gewinnen, da sie kein Gesicht hat.
DATA_CMM_1926.it: Un nuovo personaggio con poca personalità, le sue emozioni non traspaiono molto visto che non ha il viso.
DATA_CMM_1926.es: Como no tiene cara, resulta difícil tomarle cariño.
DATA_CMM_1926.ko: 종이로 접은 사람. 하지만 얼굴이 없어서 애착이 안 생기는 것이 옥의 티.
DATA_CMM_1926.zht: 紙做的全新角色。唯一美中不足的是因為沒有臉所以不討喜。
DATA_CMM_1926.zhs: 纸做的全新角色。唯一美中不足的是因为没有脸所以不讨喜。

DATA_CMM_1927.ja: Origami shaped like a samurai's hat. Put it on, and you'll feel much braver than before.
DATA_CMM_1927.en: Origami shaped like a samurai's hat. Put it on, and you'll feel much braver than before.
DATA_CMM_1927.fr: Pièce d'armure de samouraï en papier. Elle vous donne du courage.
DATA_CMM_1927.de: Origami in Form eines Samurai-Helms. Setzt man ihn auf, fühlt man sich gleich viel mutiger.
DATA_CMM_1927.it: Un origami a forma di elmo di samurai, basta indossarlo per sentirsi più spavaldi.
DATA_CMM_1927.es: Si te lo pones, seguro que te invade un ardor guerrero. No te lo pongas.
DATA_CMM_1927.ko: 종이로 만든 사무라이의 모자. 이걸 쓰면 왠지 용기가 솟아난다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1927.zht: 紙摺的武士帽子。戴著好像就能鼓起勇氣。
DATA_CMM_1927.zhs: 纸折的武士帽子。戴着好像就能鼓起勇气。

DATA_CMM_1928.ja: An airplane made out of paper. People often mess around with the wings too much and render it earthbound.
DATA_CMM_1928.en: An airplane made out of paper. People often mess around with the wings too much and render it earthbound.
DATA_CMM_1928.fr: Aéronef de papier. À force de toucher ses ailes, les gens l'abîment et le clouent au sol.
DATA_CMM_1928.de: Ein Flugzeug aus Papier. Die Leute spielen oft zu viel mit seinen Flügeln herum und sorgen so dafür, dass es nicht mehr fliegt.
DATA_CMM_1928.it: Un aereo fatto di carta. Pare che ognuno abbia la propria opinione su come debbano essere le ali e quante volte debbano essere piegate.
DATA_CMM_1928.es: No toquetees demasiado las alas o no conseguirás que vuele.
DATA_CMM_1928.ko: 종이로 만든 비행기. 날개를 접는 등, 개성이 지나치게 뚜렷하면 오히려 잘 안 나는 경우가 대부분이다.
DATA_CMM_1928.zht: 紙做的飛機。聽說炫耀自己的美學多摺翅膀等，到最後往往反而飛不了。
DATA_CMM_1928.zhs: 纸做的飞机。听说炫耀自己的美学多折翅膀等，到最后往往反而飞不了。

DATA_CMM_1929.ja: A flower with an eternally fiery color. Pinning one to your breast is considered snobby.
DATA_CMM_1929.en: A flower with an eternally fiery color. Pinning one to your breast is considered snobby.
DATA_CMM_1929.fr: Fleur qui va droit au cœur des femmes. N'en portez pas à la boutonnière, vous aurez l'air snob.
DATA_CMM_1929.de: Eine Blume mit ewig feuriger Farbe. Sich so eine an die Brust zu heften, gilt als versnobt.
DATA_CMM_1929.it: Un fiore dal colore focoso ed eterno.
DATA_CMM_1929.es: La reina de las flores, aunque no puede compararse a la Reina del Cosmos Todo.
DATA_CMM_1929.ko: 언제까지나 변함없는 정열의 색을 상징하는 꽃. 가슴에 끼우는 것은 재수없다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1929.zht: 帶著永恆不變的熱情顏色的花朵。插在胸口就太做作了。
DATA_CMM_1929.zhs: 带着永恒不变的热情颜色的花朵。插在胸口就太做作了。

DATA_CMM_1930.ja: Someone must have cared about this one a lot more than the others.
DATA_CMM_1930.en: Someone must have cared about this one a lot more than the others.
DATA_CMM_1930.fr: Son créateur a dû l'aimer beaucoup pour lui consacrer autant de temps.
DATA_CMM_1930.de: Jemand muss sich um dieses Kunstwerk sehr viel mehr gekümmert haben als um die anderen.
DATA_CMM_1930.it: Qualcuno deve essersi messo proprio d'impegno.
DATA_CMM_1930.es: Esta ha debido de comer mucho más que las otras.
DATA_CMM_1930.ko: 평범한 녀석들보다 더욱 뜨거운 정열로 뭉친 녀석이겠지.
DATA_CMM_1930.zht: 大概比一般紙鶴更滿懷熱情吧。
DATA_CMM_1930.zhs: 大概比一般纸鹤更满怀热情吧。

DATA_CMM_1931.ja: After the TV's installed, people often put weird objects in whatever space is left.
DATA_CMM_1931.en: After the TV's installed, people often put weird objects in whatever space is left.
DATA_CMM_1931.fr: Après y avoir installé sa télé, on l'entoure souvent d'un assemblage d'objets hétéroclites.
DATA_CMM_1931.de: Nachdem darauf ein Fernseher abgestellt wurde, stellen die Leute oft noch seltsame andere Gegenstände dazu.
DATA_CMM_1931.it: Un supporto per la TV che spesso viene riempito di cianfrusaglie.
DATA_CMM_1931.es: Para que el televisor pueda vivir su vida sin sobresaltos.
DATA_CMM_1931.ko: 텔레비전을 올리고 남은 공간에는 미묘한 장식물들이 올려지는 경우가 허다하다.
DATA_CMM_1931.zht: 放完電視後剩下的空間好像大多會放些奇妙的擺設。
DATA_CMM_1931.zhs: 放完电视后剩下的空间好像大多会放些奇妙的摆设。

DATA_CMM_1932.ja: Udon noodles with fried tofu on top. The name means "fox noodles," but it's not actually made with fox meat.
DATA_CMM_1932.en: Udon noodles with fried tofu on top. The name means "fox noodles," but it's not actually made with fox meat.
DATA_CMM_1932.fr: Nouilles udon et tofu frit. "Kitsune" signifie "renard" en japonais... Pas de panique, vous ne mangez pas de goupil.
DATA_CMM_1932.de: Udon mit frittiertem Tofu. Der Name bedeutet „Fuchsnudeln", aber eigentlich werden sie gar nicht mit Fuchsfleisch zubereitet.
DATA_CMM_1932.it: I noodle della volpe, così vengono chiamati in Giappone i noodle con tofu fritto. Non c'è carne di volpe.
DATA_CMM_1932.es: Fideos con tofu frito encima. El nombre significa "zorro", pero el plato es vegetariano.
DATA_CMM_1932.ko: 튀김이 들어간 우동. 지역에 따라 국물맛과 색깔이 달라지는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_1932.zht: 加了炸豆皮的烏龍麵。據說狐狸喜歡吃炸豆皮。
DATA_CMM_1932.zhs: 加了炸豆皮的乌龙面。据说狐狸喜欢吃炸豆皮。

DATA_CMM_1933.ja: Don't peel the plastic off the surface unless you want to get into an argument.
DATA_CMM_1933.en: Don't peel the plastic off the surface unless you want to get into an argument.
DATA_CMM_1933.fr: Prenez-en soin, ou vous n'aurez plus le droit de regarder les matchs de foot.
DATA_CMM_1933.de: Man sollte die Schutzfolie nicht von der Oberfläche abziehen, außer wenn man Streit sucht.
DATA_CMM_1933.it: La plastica serve per proteggere il telecomando dall'usura del tempo.
DATA_CMM_1933.es: No quites la funda de plástico o habrá guerra en casa.
DATA_CMM_1933.ko: 표면에 씌워진 비닐을 멋대로 뜯어내면 싸움이 일어나므로 주의할 것.
DATA_CMM_1933.zht: 聽說隨便撕掉表面附的塑膠片會吵架，所以務必小心。
DATA_CMM_1933.zhs: 听说随便撕掉表面附的塑胶片会吵架，所以务必小心。

DATA_CMM_1934.ja: Apparently Mom overturned this table the other day.
DATA_CMM_1934.en: Apparently Mom overturned this table the other day.
DATA_CMM_1934.fr: Maman aurait retourné cette table l'autre jour.
DATA_CMM_1934.de: Anscheinend hat Mama diesen Tisch neulich umgestoßen.
DATA_CMM_1934.it: A quanto pare la mamma ha ribaltato questo tavolo giusto l'altro giorno.
DATA_CMM_1934.es: Parece ser que mamá la volcó el otro día.
DATA_CMM_1934.zht: 以前好像被媽媽掀翻過。
DATA_CMM_1934.zhs: 以前好像被妈妈掀翻过。

DATA_CMM_1935.ja: It would be much more convenient to sharpen both sides of this pencil, but apparently people don't often do that.
DATA_CMM_1935.en: It would be much more convenient to sharpen both sides of this pencil, but apparently people don't often do that.
DATA_CMM_1935.fr: Il serait beaucoup plus pratique de tailler les deux côtés de ce crayon, mais personne ne le fait...
DATA_CMM_1935.de: Es wäre viel einfacher, beide Seiten des Bleistifts anzuspitzen, aber anscheinend macht das niemand.
DATA_CMM_1935.it: Perché nessuno mai tempera entrambi i lati della matita?
DATA_CMM_1935.es: Sería más práctico afilarlo por los dos extremos, pero la gente no lo hace.
DATA_CMM_1935.ko: 양쪽 다 깎아서 사용하면 매우 편리할 텐데도 그렇게 쓰는 사람은 드문 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_1935.zht: 兩邊都削尖明明比較方便，但好像不常見。
DATA_CMM_1935.zhs: 两边都削尖明明比较方便，但好像不常见。

DATA_CMM_1936.ja: A bunch of string wrapped around a piece of paper. Whoever wrapped this must be very disciplined.
DATA_CMM_1936.en: A bunch of string wrapped around a piece of paper. Whoever wrapped this must be very disciplined.
DATA_CMM_1936.fr: Bout de fil entourant un morceau de papier. L'auteur de cette œuvre d'art doit être très discipliné.
DATA_CMM_1936.de: Ein Bündel Schnur, das um ein Stück Papier gewickelt ist. Wer das gemacht hat, muss sehr diszipliniert sein.
DATA_CMM_1936.it: Chiunque l'abbia arrotolato in questo modo deve avere molta molta pazienza.
DATA_CMM_1936.es: Quienquiera que enrolló el hilo debía de ser alguien muy disciplinado.
DATA_CMM_1936.ko: 종이에 말려진 실뭉치. 굉장히 깨끗하게 말려 있으므로 이걸 만 사람은 분명 꼼꼼할 것이다.
DATA_CMM_1936.zht: 捲在紙上的一束線。因為捲得很漂亮，所以捲的人一定很一絲不苟。
DATA_CMM_1936.zhs: 卷在纸上的一束线。因为卷得很漂亮，所以卷的人一定很一丝不苟。

DATA_CMM_1937.ja: String is wrapped around and around this thing. That slit the string goes into is a superb idea.
DATA_CMM_1937.en: String is wrapped around and around this thing. That slit the string goes into is a superb idea.
DATA_CMM_1937.fr: Le fil tourne autour jusqu'à avoir le tournis. Cette fente est très pratique pour l'embobiner.
DATA_CMM_1937.de: Schnur ist um dieses Ding gewickelt. Der Schlitz, durch den die Schnur geht, ist eine tolle Idee.
DATA_CMM_1937.it: Ha un qualcosa di affascinante che non sappiamo mettere a fuoco.
DATA_CMM_1937.es: Este es el único método sensato de guardar el hilo. ¿Te imaginas si viniera en una pelota enmarañada?
DATA_CMM_1937.ko: 실이 둘둘 말려있다. 겨울밤, 부부가 사이좋게 이것을 말고 있는 광경은 이제 추억에 불과한가~?
DATA_CMM_1937.zht: 上頭捲著一圈圈的線。把線頭固定在小缺口上真是妙招。
DATA_CMM_1937.zhs: 上头卷着一圈圈的线。把线头固定在小缺口上真是妙招。

DATA_CMM_1938.ja: A string wrapped around a cylindrical object. Drop this on the floor, and the string will unravel.
DATA_CMM_1938.en: A string wrapped around a cylindrical object. Drop this on the floor, and the string will unravel.
DATA_CMM_1938.fr: Fil entourant un objet cylindrique. Si vous le faites tomber, la ficelle se déroulera.
DATA_CMM_1938.de: Eine Schnur, die um einen zylindrischen Gegenstand gewickelt ist. Lässt man ihn auf den Boden fallen, löst sich die Schnur ab.
DATA_CMM_1938.it: Una corda sottilissima arrotolata attorno a un corpo cilindrico.
DATA_CMM_1938.es: A los gatos les gusta mucho jugar con hilo, pero si desenrollas un carrete entero la abuela se disgustará.
DATA_CMM_1938.ko: 원추형 물체에 말아놓은 실. 바닥에 떨어뜨려 실이 도르르 풀리며 굴러가면 무척 우울해진다.
DATA_CMM_1938.zht: 捲在圓柱狀東西上的線。掉在地上的話，線就會滾滾滾，不斷鬆脫，太令人憂鬱了。
DATA_CMM_1938.zhs: 卷在圆柱状东西上的线。掉在地上的话，线就会滚滚滚，不断松脱，太令人忧郁了。

DATA_CMM_1939.ja: The hole in the middle makes this very handy. To put it bluntly, it's something like a roll of toilet paper.
DATA_CMM_1939.en: The hole in the middle makes this very handy. To put it bluntly, it's something like a roll of toilet paper.
DATA_CMM_1939.fr: Nous trouvons le trou au milieu très utile. L'objet évoque un rouleau de papier toilette.
DATA_CMM_1939.de: Das Loch in der Mitte macht ihn sehr praktisch. Kurz gesagt ist er wie eine Art Toilettenpapierrolle.
DATA_CMM_1939.it: Il buco nel mezzo lo rende molto comodo. Per dirla tutta: è simile a un rotolo di carta igienica.
DATA_CMM_1939.es: Perdón por el comentario, pero parece un rollo de papel higiénico en miniatura.
DATA_CMM_1939.ko: 가운데 구멍이 뚫려 있어서 사용하기 편하다. 쉽게 말해 화장지 같은 원리라고 할 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_1939.zht: 中間有開洞方便使用。簡單地說就是像廁所滾筒衛生紙一樣的感覺。
DATA_CMM_1939.zhs: 中间有开洞方便使用。简单地说就是像厕所滚筒卫生纸一样的感觉。

DATA_CMM_1940.ja: The best at rolling around. The bouncing ones must be really important.
DATA_CMM_1940.en: The best at rolling around. The bouncing ones must be really important.
DATA_CMM_1940.fr: Très douée pour rouler sur le sol. Celles qui rebondissent se sont fait rouler.
DATA_CMM_1940.de: Nichts rollt besser. Die hüpfenden müssen wirklich wichtig sein.
DATA_CMM_1940.it: La palla migliore da rotolare in giro.
DATA_CMM_1940.es: Otro juguete favorito de los gatos y otras bestias.
DATA_CMM_1940.ko: 굴러가는 것이 특기이다. 이걸 뛰어넘는 사람은 대단한 사람이다.
DATA_CMM_1940.zht: 最厲害的特技就是滾來滾去。會彈起來的是箇中高手吧。
DATA_CMM_1940.zhs: 最厉害的特技就是滚来滚去。会弹起来的是个中高手吧。

DATA_CMM_1941.ja: Our eyes got tired trying to find where the sharp point ends.
DATA_CMM_1941.en: Our eyes got tired trying to find where the sharp point ends.
DATA_CMM_1941.fr: Nos yeux pleurent à force de chercher où finit le bout pointu.
DATA_CMM_1941.de: Unsere Augen schliefen ein, als wir versuchten, das Ende der scharfen Spitze zu erkennen.
DATA_CMM_1941.it: Abbiamo passato interi minuti a cercare di capire dove finisse esattamente la punta.
DATA_CMM_1941.es: Se nos cansó la vista intentando ver dónde acaba la parte puntiaguda.
DATA_CMM_1941.ko: 튀어나온 모서리 중 가장 높은 곳을 찾으려 했더니 눈이 너무 아프다.
DATA_CMM_1941.zht: 想找出尖角的最尖端的話，眼都要花了。
DATA_CMM_1941.zhs: 想找出尖角的最尖端的话，眼都要花了。

DATA_CMM_1942.ja: It may project, but it doesn't stick out, so you don't have to worry about it.
DATA_CMM_1942.en: It may project, but it doesn't stick out, so you don't have to worry about it.
DATA_CMM_1942.fr: Il se projette, mais géométriquement, alors ne vous inquiétez pas.
DATA_CMM_1942.de: Hierfür wäre eine Leinwand sehr nützlich.
DATA_CMM_1942.it: Si proietta ma non significa che sporge, quindi niente paura.
DATA_CMM_1942.es: Aunque impresione, en realidad no tiene vida propia. Pobre.
DATA_CMM_1942.ko: 튀어나와 있지만 그렇다고 딱히 항의하는 건 아니니 신경쓰지 말자.
DATA_CMM_1942.zht: 雖然是突起，卻不需要頂著東西，所以不需要木頭。
DATA_CMM_1942.zhs: 虽然是突起，却不需要顶着东西，所以不需要木头。

DATA_CMM_1943.ja: Really wants to be called Big 'n Wide someday.
DATA_CMM_1943.en: Really wants to be called Big 'n Wide someday.
DATA_CMM_1943.fr: Son désir le plus cher : prendre un peu de poids.
DATA_CMM_1943.de: Möchte eines Tages „Groß & Breit" genannt werden.
DATA_CMM_1943.it: Ambisce a farsi chiamare "Il ciccio". Forse, un giorno, ce la farà.
DATA_CMM_1943.es: Le gustaría ganar algo de volumen, pero no tiene tiempo de ir al gimnasio.
DATA_CMM_1943.zht: 好像希望能變成又粗又大。
DATA_CMM_1943.zhs: 好像希望能变成又粗又大。

DATA_CMM_1944.ja: A dangerous object that often chases after people in narrow caves.
DATA_CMM_1944.en: A dangerous object that often chases after people in narrow caves.
DATA_CMM_1944.fr: Objet très facétieux, qu'on voit souvent poursuivre les héros dans les grottes.
DATA_CMM_1944.de: Ein gefährliches Objekt, das in engen Höhlen oft hinter Menschen herläuft.
DATA_CMM_1944.it: Un oggetto pericoloso che spesso insegue la gente che si avventura in strette caverne.
DATA_CMM_1944.es: Este peligroso objeto suele perseguir a la gente por túneles estrechos.
DATA_CMM_1944.ko: 자주 동굴 같은데서 주위를 꽉 메우며 사람에게 굴러오는 위험한 물체.
DATA_CMM_1944.zht: 經常在狹窄洞窟裡朝人滾過來的危險物體。
DATA_CMM_1944.zhs: 经常在狭窄洞窟里朝人滚过来的危险物体。

DATA_CMM_1945.ja: It may be huge, but We still can't tell where exactly the sharp point ends.
DATA_CMM_1945.en: It may be huge, but We still can't tell where exactly the sharp point ends.
DATA_CMM_1945.fr: Il est énorme, mais Nous ne voyons toujours pas où se termine son bout pointu.
DATA_CMM_1945.de: Ist zwar riesig, aber wir wissen immer noch nicht, wo genau die scharfe Spitze endet.
DATA_CMM_1945.es: Es enorme, pero seguimos sin saber exactamente dónde acaba la punta.
DATA_CMM_1945.ko: 크기가 변했어도 역시 모서리 중 최고의 모서리는 구분하기 힘들다.
DATA_CMM_1945.zht: 就算變大了，尖角的最尖端還是看不太清楚。
DATA_CMM_1945.zhs: 就算变大了，尖角的最尖端还是看不太清楚。

DATA_CMM_1946.ja: Everyone was trying to drag it down, so it became angry and got even bigger.
DATA_CMM_1946.en: Everyone was trying to drag it down, so it became angry and got even bigger.
DATA_CMM_1946.fr: Tout le monde essayait de l'attraper, alors il s'est énervé et a grandi.
DATA_CMM_1946.de: Alle haben versucht, sie herunterzuziehen, was sie wütend gemacht und weiter angeheizt hat.
DATA_CMM_1946.it: Tutti cercavano di trascinarlo a terra, ma lui, per ripicca, è diventato persino più grande.
DATA_CMM_1946.es: Intentaron acabar con él, pero se enfadó y se hizo aún más grande.
DATA_CMM_1946.ko: 모두 발을 빼려고 해서 오히려 더 넓어진 버린 비운의 사나이.
DATA_CMM_1946.zht: 因為大家都畏畏縮縮地，所以它一氣之下就變得太大了。
DATA_CMM_1946.zhs: 因为大家都畏畏缩缩地，所以它一气之下就变得太大了。

DATA_CMM_1947.ja: Even at this size, it's still a little saddened by how long and thin it is.
DATA_CMM_1947.en: Even at this size, it's still a little saddened by how long and thin it is.
DATA_CMM_1947.fr: Même s'il est assez bien charpenté, cet objet est tout de même triste d'être long et fin.
DATA_CMM_1947.de: Selbst bei dieser Größe ist es immer noch ein wenig traurig, wie kurz  und dünn es ist.
DATA_CMM_1947.it: Anche se è diventato grande, è un po' triste perché è lungo e sottile
DATA_CMM_1947.es: Lamenta su gran estatura; nadie está contento con lo que tiene...
DATA_CMM_1947.ko: 크게 변했어도 길고 얇은 느낌인 것이 약간 씁쓸하다.
DATA_CMM_1947.zht: 就算變大了還是細長型，有些哀傷。
DATA_CMM_1947.zhs: 就算变大了还是细长型，有些哀伤。

DATA_CMM_1948.ja: A helpful car that goes wherever you tell it to, but you'll need to reward it for its trouble.
DATA_CMM_1948.en: A helpful car that goes wherever you tell it to, but you'll need to reward it for its trouble.
DATA_CMM_1948.fr: Véhicule très gentil qui vous emmène là où vous voulez. Prévoyez quand même une petite récompense...
DATA_CMM_1948.de: Ein hilfsbereites Auto, das überall hinfährt, wo man es hinschickt, aber man muss es für seine Mühen auch belohnen.
DATA_CMM_1948.it: Un'auto gentile che porta la gente dove vuole ma, alla fine del viaggio, va ricompensata.
DATA_CMM_1948.es: Este coche te lleva donde tú quieras, siempre que tengas el dinero para pagar.
DATA_CMM_1948.ko: 가고 싶은 곳을 말하면 거기까지 데려다 주는 친절한 자동차. 단지 나름대로 대가가 필요하다.
DATA_CMM_1948.zht: 能載人到想去的地方的好心車子。但是需要不少報酬。
DATA_CMM_1948.zhs: 能载人到想去的地方的好心车子。但是需要不少报酬。

DATA_CMM_1949.ja: A very tall bus that has a famous city in its name. It still works in other cities, though.
DATA_CMM_1949.en: A very tall bus that has a famous city in its name. It still works in other cities, though.
DATA_CMM_1949.fr: Très grand bus qui porte le nom d'une très grande ville, mais que l'on rencontre un peu partout.
DATA_CMM_1949.de: Ein sehr großer Bus, der eine berühmte Stadt im Namen trägt. Er fährt aber auch in anderen Städten.
DATA_CMM_1949.it: Un autobus a due piani, molto famosi sono quelli di Londra, la città degli autobus a due piani.
DATA_CMM_1949.es: Aunque los hay en otros sitios, estos autobuses de dos pisos siempre nos recordarán a Londres.
DATA_CMM_1949.ko: 굉장히 키가 큰 버스. 달리는 거리의 이름이 쓰여져 있으나, 다른 거리에서도 활약 중이라 한다.
DATA_CMM_1949.zht: 長得很高的巴士。名稱裡包含它行駛的城鎮名，不過也常活躍穿梭在其他城鎮。
DATA_CMM_1949.zhs: 长得很高的巴士。名称里包含它行驶的城镇名，不过也常活跃穿梭在其他城镇。

DATA_CMM_1950.ja: This car is very fast, but it has one weakness... you can't bring a friend along.
DATA_CMM_1950.en: This car is very fast, but it has one weakness... you can't bring a friend along.
DATA_CMM_1950.fr: Cette voiture est très rapide, mais elle n'a qu'un maître et vos amis devront rester au garage.
DATA_CMM_1950.de: Dieses Auto ist sehr schnell, aber es hat eine Schwäche ... man kann keinen Freund mitnehmen.
DATA_CMM_1950.it: Un'auto molto veloce ma che ha poco spazio per il bagaglio.
DATA_CMM_1950.es: Sí, es muy rápido, pero solo tiene una plaza. ¿Con quién vas a hablar?
DATA_CMM_1950.ko: 굉장히 빠르지만 친구를 옆에 못 태우는 것이 옥의 티.
DATA_CMM_1950.zht: 速度非常快，唯一美中不足的就是沒辦法載朋友。
DATA_CMM_1950.zhs: 速度非常快，唯一美中不足的就是没办法载朋友。

DATA_CMM_1951.ja: Little boys yearn for these. If you clean your plate, you might grow up to be the one to drive it someday.
DATA_CMM_1951.en: Little boys yearn for these. If you clean your plate, you might grow up to be the one to drive it someday.
DATA_CMM_1951.fr: Les petits garçons aimeraient tous en avoir une. S'ils mangent bien leur soupe, ils seront peut-être exaucés.
DATA_CMM_1951.de: Kleine Jungs sehnen sich nach so einem. Wenn man immer brav aufisst, fährt man eines Tages vielleicht einen.
DATA_CMM_1951.it: I bambini la adorano, ma per potere guidare quest'auto bisogna sempre fare i compiti e mangiare tutti gli spinaci. O almeno è questo quello che dicono le madri ai figli.
DATA_CMM_1951.es: Si te comes toda la verdura, a lo mejor llegarás a conducir uno de estos.
DATA_CMM_1951.ko: 남자들의 동경의 대상. 편식하지 말고 잘 먹으면 될 수 있을지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_1951.zht: 男孩子的夢想。不挑食多吃點的話也許能當上選手。
DATA_CMM_1951.zhs: 男孩子的梦想。不挑食多吃点的话也许能当上选手。

DATA_CMM_1952.ja: This car apparently can't run unless you frequently change its tires. That must be why you don't see them in town.
DATA_CMM_1952.en: This car apparently can't run unless you frequently change its tires. That must be why you don't see them in town.
DATA_CMM_1952.fr: Elle refuse de travailler si vous ne changez pas ses pneus fréquemment. En plus, elle n'aime pas sortir de son circuit.
DATA_CMM_1952.de: Dieses Auto kann anscheinend nicht fahren, wenn man nicht regelmäßig die Reifen wechselt. Deswegen sieht man es bestimmt nie in der Stadt.
DATA_CMM_1952.it: Quest'auto vuole sempre essere alla moda e per questo si cambia di continuo gli pneumatici.
DATA_CMM_1952.es: Aunque corre mucho, hay que cambiar las ruedas a menudo y eso hace perder tiempo.
DATA_CMM_1952.ko: 자주 타이어를 갈아주지 않으면 달릴 수 없는 것 같다. 그래서 거리에선 안 보이는 거군.
DATA_CMM_1952.zht: 好像得經常更換輪胎才能跑。就是因為這樣才沒在街上看過吧。
DATA_CMM_1952.zhs: 好像得经常更换轮胎才能跑。就是因为这样才没在街上看过吧。

DATA_CMM_1953.ja: This can conquer any road, but it's no more effective than usual on regular streets.
DATA_CMM_1953.en: This can conquer any road, but it's no more effective than usual on regular streets.
DATA_CMM_1953.fr: Il peut rouler sa bosse sur n'importe quelle bosse. En ville, il s'ennuie car il aimerait voir plus de dos d'âne...
DATA_CMM_1953.de: Damit bezwingt man jede Straße, aber auf normalen Straßen fährt er auch nicht effektiver.
DATA_CMM_1953.it: Non c'è strada che non possa conquistare, ma sulle strade normali non ha alcun vantaggio.
DATA_CMM_1953.es: Se atreve con cualquier carretera, pero en ciudad no es particularmente práctico.
DATA_CMM_1953.ko: 그 어떤 길도 거침없이 질주한다. 그러나 일반 도로에서는 그다지 효과가 없다.
DATA_CMM_1953.zht: 不論什麼道路都輕輕鬆鬆的樣子。不過在一般道路好像沒什麼用。
DATA_CMM_1953.zhs: 不论什么道路都轻轻松松的样子。不过在一般道路好像没什么用。

DATA_CMM_1954.ja: A car you can pack all sorts of stuff in. Children and animals occasionally go inside and have big adventures.
DATA_CMM_1954.en: A car you can pack all sorts of stuff in. Children and animals occasionally go inside and have big adventures.
DATA_CMM_1954.fr: Vous pouvez y ranger toutes sortes de choses. Les animaux y font parfois de longs voyages.
DATA_CMM_1954.de: Man kann hier alles Mögliche hineinpacken. Gelegentlich erleben Kinder und Tiere große Abenteuer drin.
DATA_CMM_1954.it: Una vettura che può contenere ogni sorta di oggetti. Mi ricordo che una volta ne abbiamo vista una vuota.
DATA_CMM_1954.es: Contiene todo tipo de cosas. A veces se cuela un niño con su perro y tienen aventuras.
DATA_CMM_1954.ko: 짐이 잔뜩 들어가는 자동차. 가끔씩 아이나 동물들이 이것을 타고 모험을 떠나는 경우도 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1954.zht: 裝著很多東西的車。聽說有時候會有小孩子或動物搭著這種車去冒險。
DATA_CMM_1954.zhs: 装着很多东西的车。听说有时候会有小孩子或动物搭着这种车去冒险。

DATA_CMM_1955.ja: A horse pulls this for you, making things super easy. Hang a carrot in front to speed it up.
DATA_CMM_1955.en: A horse pulls this for you, making things super easy. Hang a carrot in front to speed it up.
DATA_CMM_1955.fr: Attelez-y un cheval pour qu'il avance à votre place. Vous pouvez utiliser une carotte pour le motiver.
DATA_CMM_1955.de: Ein Pferd zieht sie für einen, was alles einfacher macht. Hängt man vorne eine Möhre dran, geht's noch schneller.
DATA_CMM_1955.it: Come un risciò trainato da un uomo, con un cavallo al posto dell'uomo.
DATA_CMM_1955.es: Es muy cómodo; el caballo hace todo el trabajo y tú solo tienes que sostener la zanahoria.
DATA_CMM_1955.ko: 말이 끌어주는 편안한 탈것. 앞에 당근을 달아주면 더욱 스피드 업하는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_1955.zht: 輕鬆讓馬拉著走的搭乘工具。前面吊著胡蘿蔔好像就能加速。
DATA_CMM_1955.zhs: 轻松让马拉着走的搭乘工具。前面吊着胡萝卜好像就能加速。

DATA_CMM_1956.ja: You can ride inside the pumpkin. The horses must have eaten all the pumpkin guts earlier.
DATA_CMM_1956.en: You can ride inside the pumpkin. The horses must have eaten all the pumpkin guts earlier.
DATA_CMM_1956.fr: Vous prenez place à l'intérieur de la citrouille. Les chevaux ont dû manger tout l'intérieur pour vous faire de la place.
DATA_CMM_1956.de: Man kann im Kürbis mitfahren. Die Pferde müssen ihn zuvor vollständig leer gefressen haben.
DATA_CMM_1956.it: Si può entrare nella zucca. Forse da qui deriva l'espressione "mettitelo bene nella zucca".
DATA_CMM_1956.es: No sabemos cómo habrán hecho para vaciar tan descomunal cucurbitácea.
DATA_CMM_1956.ko: 호박에 탈 수 있는 신기한 탈것. 안쪽은 말이 파먹어 버렸나~?
DATA_CMM_1956.zht: 能夠坐在南瓜裡面。裡面的果肉是被馬吃掉了吧。
DATA_CMM_1956.zhs: 能够坐在南瓜里面。里面的果肉是被马吃掉了吧。

DATA_CMM_1957.ja: A car pulled by a person. It's slow-but-maneuverable, making it good for short jaunts.
DATA_CMM_1957.en: A car pulled by a person. It's slow-but-maneuverable, making it good for short jaunts.
DATA_CMM_1957.fr: Véhicule tiré par un piéton. Il est lent, mais très manœuvrable, donc très efficace dans les embouteillages.
DATA_CMM_1957.de: Ein Gefährt, das von einer Person gezogen wird. Es ist langsam, aber wendig und eignet sich daher gut für kurze Strecken.
DATA_CMM_1957.it: Come una carrozza trainata da cavalli, con un uomo al posto dei cavalli.
DATA_CMM_1957.es: Es un asiento del que tira una persona. Son los taxis más comunes de Asia.
DATA_CMM_1957.ko: 인간이 끌어 달리는 자동차. 스피드는 없지만 세심한 운전이 가능하므로, 가까운 외출에는 적격일지도~?
DATA_CMM_1957.zht: 由人類拉著跑的車子。雖然速度不快，但轉彎靈活，很適合稍微外出時搭乘。
DATA_CMM_1957.zhs: 由人类拉着跑的车子。虽然速度不快，但转弯灵活，很适合稍微外出时搭乘。

DATA_CMM_1959.ja: People who don't want their face to be seen wear this. Take it off before going in a store, or people will be angry.
DATA_CMM_1959.en: People who don't want their face to be seen wear this. Take it off before going in a store, or people will be angry.
DATA_CMM_1959.fr: Apprécié des gens qui n'aiment pas qu'on voie leur visage. Enlevez-le avant d'entrer dans un magasin, ce n'est pas poli.
DATA_CMM_1959.de: Leute, die nicht wollen, dass man ihr Gesicht erkennt, tragen so einen. Man nimmt ihn besser ab, bevor man in ein Geschäft geht, sonst gibt's Ärger.
DATA_CMM_1959.it: Indossato da chi vuole nascondere il proprio volto ma, allo stesso tempo, non vuole passare inosservato.
DATA_CMM_1959.es: Quítatelo antes de entrar en una tienda o la gente se pondrá nerviosa.
DATA_CMM_1959.ko: 얼굴을 보이고 싶지 않은 사람이 쓰는 것 같다. 가게에 들어갈 때 안 벗으면 무척 혼난다.
DATA_CMM_1959.zht: 聽說是不想露臉的人戴的。進到店裡不脫下的話會遭痛罵。
DATA_CMM_1959.zhs: 听说是不想露脸的人戴的。进到店里不脱下的话会遭痛骂。

DATA_CMM_1960.ja: You can open and close the bit in front, ensuring you'll never get bored of it.
DATA_CMM_1960.en: You can open and close the bit in front, ensuring you'll never get bored of it.
DATA_CMM_1960.fr: Vous pouvez ouvrir et fermer la visière, c'est un passe-temps très prenant.
DATA_CMM_1960.de: Man kann das Visier vorne öffnen und schließen, sodass einem nie langweilig wird.
DATA_CMM_1960.it: Si può aprire e chiudere sul davanti, così da non risultare mai noioso.
DATA_CMM_1960.es: Puedes llevar la visera subida, pero recomendamos bajarla si no quieres merendar mosquitos.
DATA_CMM_1960.ko: 앞부분을 열거나 닫거나 하는 것만으로 질리지 않고 계속 사용할 수 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1960.zht: 前面的部分可以隨意開關，讓人玩不膩。
DATA_CMM_1960.zhs: 前面的部分可以随意开关，让人玩不腻。

DATA_CMM_1961.ja: You can judge its abilities by whether or not it stops at the designated mark on the platform.
DATA_CMM_1961.en: You can judge its abilities by whether or not it stops at the designated mark on the platform.
DATA_CMM_1961.fr: Faites des tests de précision en regardant s'il s'arrête ou non devant la marque du quai.
DATA_CMM_1961.de: Ob er funktioniert, erkennt man daran, ob er an der vorgesehenen Markierung an der Plattform anhält oder nicht.
DATA_CMM_1961.it: Deve essere difficile per un treno non partire mai prima né dopo l'ora stabilita. Talmente difficile che non lo fanno mai.
DATA_CMM_1961.es: Nos preguntamos si pierden puntos por no detenerse justo en la línea marcada en el andén.
DATA_CMM_1961.ko: 마크 부분을 보면 확실히 제동이 가능한지의 성능을 알 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_1961.zht: 能不能準確停在標示的地方就可以看出性能如何。
DATA_CMM_1961.zhs: 能不能准确停在标示的地方就可以看出性能如何。

DATA_CMM_1962.ja: A car meant for police officers to ride in. Its colors are garish, but somehow it's still really good at hiding.
DATA_CMM_1962.en: A car meant for police officers to ride in. Its colors are garish, but somehow it's still really good at hiding.
DATA_CMM_1962.fr: Elle est très voyante, mais on l'utilise quand même pour espionner les gangsters.
DATA_CMM_1962.de: Ein Auto, mit dem Polizisten herumfahren. Seine Farben wirken grell, aber irgendwie kann es sich trotzdem gut verstecken.
DATA_CMM_1962.it: Un'auto creata perché venga usata dalla polizia. Ha colori accessi, ma riesce comunque a nascondersi bene.
DATA_CMM_1962.es: No son precisamente discretos, pero con suerte los malhechores no los ven venir.
DATA_CMM_1962.ko: 경찰관이 타는 자동차. 굉장히 눈에 띄는 색깔인데도 어째서인지 숨기의 명수라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1962.zht: 給警察坐的車。顏色明明很醒目，卻莫名擅長躲藏。
DATA_CMM_1962.zhs: 给警察坐的车。颜色明明很醒目，却莫名擅长躲藏。

DATA_CMM_1963.ja: A heroic car that's off in a flash whenever there's a fire. It puts out flames with the water from its hose.
DATA_CMM_1963.en: A heroic car that's off in a flash whenever there's a fire. It puts out flames with the water from its hose.
DATA_CMM_1963.fr: Son travail consiste à sortir toutes sirènes hurlantes dès qu'il y a un feu. Il attaque les flammes en crachant de l'eau.
DATA_CMM_1963.de: Ein heldenhaftes Fahrzeug, das blitzschnell losfährt, wenn es brennt. Es löscht Flammen mit Wasser aus seinem Schlauch.
DATA_CMM_1963.it: Un'auto per gente che corre ovunque ci sia un grosso fuoco; devono essere appassionati di barbecue.
DATA_CMM_1963.es: Esto sí que es un vehículo heroico, escupiendo toda esa agua para apagar fuegos...
DATA_CMM_1963.ko: 화재가 발생하면 최고 지위를 가진다. 호스에서 물을 뿜어 불을 끄는 히어로 같은 자동차.
DATA_CMM_1963.zht: 發生火災它就會飛快趕到。能夠從軟管噴出水滅火，是英雄般的車子。
DATA_CMM_1963.zhs: 发生火灾它就会飞快赶到。能够从软管喷出水灭火，是英雄般的车子。

DATA_CMM_1964.ja: This flies gently through the sky. Poking it with a needle will lead to big trouble.
DATA_CMM_1964.en: This flies gently through the sky. Poking it with a needle will lead to big trouble.
DATA_CMM_1964.fr: Vole gracieusement dans le ciel. Ne le percez pas avec une aiguille, vous seriez mal inspiré.
DATA_CMM_1964.de: Fliegt sanft durch die Lüfte. Vorsicht mit Nadeln!
DATA_CMM_1964.es: Andar jugando con agujas en su interior no es buena idea.
DATA_CMM_1964.ko: 하늘을 느긋히 비행하는 탈것. 바늘로 찌르면 큰일 난다.
DATA_CMM_1964.zht: 悠閒地飛在空中的交通工具。要是用針戳應該會出大事。
DATA_CMM_1964.zhs: 悠闲地飞在空中的交通工具。要是用针戳应该会出大事。

DATA_CMM_1965.ja: This car mostly creates video that's used on TV. Apparently it sometimes sends signals to space, too.
DATA_CMM_1965.en: This car mostly creates video that's used on TV. Apparently it sometimes sends signals to space, too.
DATA_CMM_1965.fr: Étrange insecte roulant plein d'antennes, qui fabrique des films qui passent à la télé.
DATA_CMM_1965.de: Dieses Fahrzeug erstellt hauptsächlich Videos, die im Fernsehen laufen. Anscheinend sendet es manchmal auch Signale in den Weltraum.
DATA_CMM_1965.it: Un'auto che produce video usati per la TV. Se abbiamo ben capito gira per le strade e spara i programmi nelle antenne.
DATA_CMM_1965.es: Si está aparcada frente a tu casa de noche, ten cuidado con las llamadas que haces.
DATA_CMM_1965.ko: 주로 TV에서 사용하는 영상을 만들고 있다. 가끔씩 우주와의 교신도 하고 있는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_1965.zht: 主要在製作電視上播的影片。聽說有時也會跟宇宙通訊。
DATA_CMM_1965.zhs: 主要在制作电视上播的影片。听说有时也会跟宇宙通讯。

DATA_CMM_1966.ja: A car that can't stop telling people its name. It didn't even bother asking Our name.
DATA_CMM_1966.en: A car that can't stop telling people its name. It didn't even bother asking Our name.
DATA_CMM_1966.fr: Voiture qui adore crier son nom aux gens. Elle ne Nous a même pas demandé le Nôtre. Quelle impudence !
DATA_CMM_1966.de: Ein Auto, das nicht aufhört, den Leuten seinen Namen mitzuteilen. Es hat sich nicht mal die Mühe gemacht, nach unserem Namen zu fragen.
DATA_CMM_1966.it: Un'auto che continua a ripetere un nome. Che ossessione.
DATA_CMM_1966.es: Este coche se pasa el tiempo gritando su nombre pero nunca pregunta el nuestro.
DATA_CMM_1966.ko: 자기 소개에 정신이 없는 자동차. 상대방 이름은 들으려고도 하지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_1966.zht: 一直自我介紹的煩人車子。都不會想問其他人的名字。
DATA_CMM_1966.zhs: 一直自我介绍的烦人车子。都不会想问其他人的名字。

DATA_CMM_1967.ja: A flute used in music. You sometimes see spit come out from the bottom, which is kind of gross.
DATA_CMM_1967.en: A flute used in music. You sometimes see spit come out from the bottom, which is kind of gross.
DATA_CMM_1967.fr: Flûte qui fait de la musique. Quand de la salive en sort, c'est que le musicien n'est pas doué.
DATA_CMM_1967.de: Eine Flöte, die beim Musizieren verwendet wird. Manchmal läuft Spucke am unteren Ende raus, was ziemlich eklig ist.
DATA_CMM_1967.it: Se lo si usa troppo si ha la flautolenza.
DATA_CMM_1967.es: Esta flauta suena muy bien, pero a veces salta saliva, lo que resulta asqueroso.
DATA_CMM_1967.ko: 음악에서 사용하는 피리. 밑에서 침이 흘러나와 좀 더럽다.
DATA_CMM_1967.zht: 音樂課用的笛子。會從下面滴出口水，有點髒。
DATA_CMM_1967.zhs: 音乐课用的笛子。会从下面滴出口水，有点脏。

DATA_CMM_1968.ja:
The larger drum in the set. Move your
feet and practice your rhythm.
DATA_CMM_1968.en:
The larger drum in the set. Move your
feet and practice your rhythm.
DATA_CMM_1968.fr:
Le plus gros fût de la batterie.
Les élèves qui tapent du pied pendant
les cours rêvent sûrement de lui.
DATA_CMM_1968.de:
Die größere Trommel im Schlagzeug.
Wer im Unterricht mit den Füßen wippt,
übt bestimmt dafür.
DATA_CMM_1968.it: La grancassa. Muovi i piedi e pratica il tuo ritmo!
DATA_CMM_1968.es: Es el hermano mayor; la gente que golpea con los pies en clase debe de estar practicando.
DATA_CMM_1968.ko: 드럼 세트 중 큰 북. 수업 중에 다리를 덜덜 떠는 것은 아마도 이 북 연습을 위한 것이리라.
DATA_CMM_1968.zht: 鼓組中最大的鼓。有人會踏腳練習打節奏。
DATA_CMM_1968.zhs: 鼓组中最大的鼓。有人会踏脚练习打节奏。

DATA_CMM_1969.ja: The smaller drum in the set. It looks terribly lonely when it's all by itself.
DATA_CMM_1969.en: The smaller drum in the set. It looks terribly lonely when it's all by itself.
DATA_CMM_1969.fr: Le plus petit tambour de la batterie. Il n'aime pas qu'on le voie tout seul.
DATA_CMM_1969.de: Die kleinere Trommel im Schlagzeug. Sie sieht furchtbar einsam aus, wenn sie ganz allein steht.
DATA_CMM_1969.it: Fa un po' pena quando è lì tutto da solo con la sua aria un po' così.
DATA_CMM_1969.es: Este hermanito pequeño parece muy desvalido cuando está solo.
DATA_CMM_1969.ko: 드럼 세트 중 작은 북. 이것 하나만 놓고 보면 왠지 쓸쓸하게 느껴진다.
DATA_CMM_1969.zht: 鼓組中最小的鼓。只有一個看起來會有點淒涼。
DATA_CMM_1969.zhs: 鼓组中最小的鼓。只有一个看起来会有点凄凉。

DATA_CMM_1970.ja: The cymbal in the drum set. It would probably go really far if you threw it.
DATA_CMM_1970.en: The cymbal in the drum set. It would probably go really far if you threw it.
DATA_CMM_1970.fr: La cymbale de la batterie. Ne la frappez pas trop fort, elle résonne.
DATA_CMM_1970.de: Das Becken im Schlagzeug. Es würde wahrscheinlich sehr weit fliegen, wenn man es wirft.
DATA_CMM_1970.it: Parte della batteria, quasi indispensabili nella musica moderna.
DATA_CMM_1970.es: Una de las estrellas del conjunto, pero no se lo tiene creído.
DATA_CMM_1970.ko: 드럼 세트의 심벌즈. 던지면 분명 멀리 날아갈 것이다.
DATA_CMM_1970.zht: 鼓組中的銅鈸。丟出去的話應該可以飛很遠。
DATA_CMM_1970.zhs: 鼓组中的铜钹。丢出去的话应该可以飞很远。

DATA_CMM_1971.ja: An instrument that makes sounds when you blow into it. You need to shape your lips just right to get a good sound.
DATA_CMM_1971.en: An instrument that makes sounds when you blow into it. You need to shape your lips just right to get a good sound.
DATA_CMM_1971.fr: Elle parle lorsque vous soufflez dans son oreille. Il faut bien parler en serrant les lèvres.
DATA_CMM_1971.de: Ein Instrument, das Töne erzeugt, wenn man reinbläst. Man muss seine Lippen dabei richtig formen, um einen guten Klang zu erzeugen.
DATA_CMM_1971.it: Per suonare questo strumento bisogna fare delle pernacchie.
DATA_CMM_1971.es: El secreto está en colocar bien los labios, más que en soplar hasta ponerte azul.
DATA_CMM_1971.ko: 숨을 내뿜으면 소리가 나는 악기. 입술 모양이 좋은 소리를 내는 원동력이라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1971.zht: 吹氣就會發出聲響的樂器。據說嘴型是聲音漂不漂亮的關鍵。
DATA_CMM_1971.zhs: 吹气就会发出声响的乐器。据说嘴型是声音漂不漂亮的关键。

DATA_CMM_1972.ja: Put this in your mouth and breathe in and out to make sounds. It would be easier if all you had to do was exhale.
DATA_CMM_1972.en: Put this in your mouth and breathe in and out to make sounds. It would be easier if all you had to do was exhale.
DATA_CMM_1972.fr: Il est très pratique. Mettez-le contre votre bouche et respirez : vous pouvez en jouer sans vous arrêter.
DATA_CMM_1972.de: Man hält sie an den Mund und atmet ein und aus, um Töne zu erzeugen. Es wäre einfacher, wenn man nur ausatmen müsste.
DATA_CMM_1972.es: Sería más fácil si solo hubiera que soplar, pero hay que inhalar también.
DATA_CMM_1972.ko: 입에 물고 숨을 들이쉬었다 내쉬었다 하면 소리가 난다. 전부 불기만 하면 좀더 쉽게 익힐 텐데…
DATA_CMM_1972.zht: 叼著吸氣吐氣之間就會發出聲響。要是一次吹全部就簡單多了。
DATA_CMM_1972.zhs: 叼着吸气吐气之间就会发出声响。要是一次吹全部就简单多了。

DATA_CMM_1973.ja: A Chinese-style instrument. We guess it's used while eating ramen, or when kung-fu fighting.
DATA_CMM_1973.en: A Chinese-style instrument. We guess it's used while eating ramen, or when kung-fu fighting.
DATA_CMM_1973.fr: Instrument chinois. Nous supposons qu'on l'utilise en mangeant des ramen ou pendant les combats de kung-fu.
DATA_CMM_1973.de: Ein Instrument im chinesischen Stil. Wir vermuten, dass er beim Ramen-Essen oder beim Kung-Fu-Kämpfen zum Einsatz kommt.
DATA_CMM_1973.it: Uno strumento dal forte retrogusto orientale.
DATA_CMM_1973.es: En las películas, el héroe siempre se pone detrás para huir de las balas del malo.
DATA_CMM_1973.ko: 중국풍 악기. 라면을 먹을 때나, 쿵후 대련을 시작할 때 자주 울린다.
DATA_CMM_1973.zht: 中華風樂器。應該是在吃拉麵或是功夫比武等時機會用上吧？
DATA_CMM_1973.zhs: 中华风乐器。应该是在吃拉面或是功夫比武等时机会用上吧？

DATA_CMM_1974.ja: A very large bell. Japanese people ring this 108 times to bring in the new year, so don't just go ringing it.
DATA_CMM_1974.en: A very large bell. Japanese people ring this 108 times to bring in the new year, so don't just go ringing it.
DATA_CMM_1974.fr: Très grande cloche. Les Japonais la frappent 108 fois pour faire venir la nouvelle année, ne la faites pas sonner en vain.
DATA_CMM_1974.de: Eine sehr große Glocke. Japaner läuten sie 108 Mal, um das neue Jahr einzuläuten, also läutet man sie besser nicht einfach so.
DATA_CMM_1974.it: Una campana molto grande che in Giappone viene suonata 108 volte all'inizio del nuovo anno.
DATA_CMM_1974.es: En Japón la tañen 108 veces para dar la bienvenida al año nuevo. Luego hay que descansar hasta el año siguiente.
DATA_CMM_1974.ko: 굉장히 큰 종. 108번 울리면 1년이 지난다고 하므로, 함부로 울리면 큰일이 일어난다.
DATA_CMM_1974.zht: 非常巨大的鐘。據說敲108次就會過新年了，所以不能隨便亂敲。
DATA_CMM_1974.zhs: 非常巨大的钟。据说敲108次就会过新年了，所以不能随便乱敲。

DATA_CMM_1975.ja: Honey in a tube. You can squeeze it right into your mouth. How convenient!
DATA_CMM_1975.en: Honey in a tube. You can squeeze it right into your mouth. How convenient!
DATA_CMM_1975.fr: Du miel en tube que vous pouvez mettre directement dans votre bouche. Très utile.
DATA_CMM_1975.de: Honig in einer Tube. So kann man ihn direkt in den Mund drücken. Wie praktisch!
DATA_CMM_1975.it: Miele in tubetto, ora non ci sono più limiti.
DATA_CMM_1975.es: Es tan deliciosa que entendemos por qué los osos se arriesgan a meter la nariz en las colmenas.
DATA_CMM_1975.ko: 튜브에 들어있는 벌꿀. 통을 눌러서 입 안에 직접 넣을 수 있기 때문에 편리하다.
DATA_CMM_1975.zht: 放在罐子裡的蜂蜜。可以直接就口食用，非常方便。
DATA_CMM_1975.zhs: 放在罐子里的蜂蜜。可以直接就口食用，非常方便。

DATA_CMM_1976.ja: A very hard and sweet food, often used in Japanese denture ads.
DATA_CMM_1976.en: A very hard and sweet food, often used in Japanese denture ads.
DATA_CMM_1976.fr: Comme elle est aussi dure que sucrée, on la voit souvent dans les publicités de dentifrices.
DATA_CMM_1976.de: Ein sehr harter und süßer Snack, der oft in japanischer Zahnprothesenwerbung gezeigt wird.
DATA_CMM_1976.it: Molto duro e dolce, un po' come Noi.
DATA_CMM_1976.es: Es tan dulce y tan dura que aparece en los anuncios de dentaduras postizas en Japón.
DATA_CMM_1976.ko: 의외로 단단한 과자. 틀니 선전에 자주 등장한다.
DATA_CMM_1976.zht: 意外堅硬的點心。經常出現在假牙廣告裡。
DATA_CMM_1976.zhs: 意外坚硬的点心。经常出现在假牙广告里。

DATA_CMM_1977.ja: A thing you put under your head when sleeping. Some people take these with them when they travel.
DATA_CMM_1977.en: A thing you put under your head when sleeping. Some people take these with them when they travel.
DATA_CMM_1977.fr: Vous le mettez sous votre tête pour dormir. Certains l'emmènent en voyage avec eux.
DATA_CMM_1977.de: Legt man beim Schlafen unter den Kopf. Manche Leute nehmen sie mit auf Reisen.
DATA_CMM_1977.it: Un ripiano dove appoggiare la testa mentre si dorme.
DATA_CMM_1977.es: Es mejor que te la pongas bajo la cabeza; si te la pones en la cara, no podrás respirar.
DATA_CMM_1977.ko: 잠을 잘 때 머리에 베는 것. 타올을 마는 것이 일반적인 사용법인가~?
DATA_CMM_1977.zht: 睡覺時墊在腦袋下方的東西。捲毛巾來睡是常見的使用方式吧？
DATA_CMM_1977.zhs: 睡觉时垫在脑袋下方的东西。卷毛巾来睡是常见的使用方式吧？

DATA_CMM_1978.ja: This always gets heavier when coming back from a trip.
DATA_CMM_1978.en: This always gets heavier when coming back from a trip.
DATA_CMM_1978.fr: Elle est toujours plus lourde lorsque l'on rentre de voyage.
DATA_CMM_1978.de: Ist immer schwerer, wenn man von einer Reise zurückkommt.
DATA_CMM_1978.it: Una valigia che tende a diventare più pesante quando si ritorna da un viaggio.
DATA_CMM_1978.es: Siempre acaba pesando más de lo que creíamos, sobre todo a la vuelta.
DATA_CMM_1978.ko: 와이프에게 걸리면 곤란한 라이터가 들어있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_1978.zht: 旅行包好像裝著打火機，被太太看到就不妙了。
DATA_CMM_1978.zhs: 旅行包好像装着打火机，被太太看到就不妙了。

DATA_CMM_1979.ja: Very heavy clothing. You probably move a lot more nimbly once you take this off.
DATA_CMM_1979.en: Very heavy clothing. You probably move a lot more nimbly once you take this off.
DATA_CMM_1979.fr: Vêtement très lourd. On doit se sentir tout léger quand on l'enlève.
DATA_CMM_1979.de: Sehr schwere Kleidung. Wahrscheinlich ist man wesentlich wendiger, wenn man sie auszieht.
DATA_CMM_1979.it: Un vestito per proteggere, un vestito per lottare la lotta della vita.
DATA_CMM_1979.es: Quizás se extinguieron porque no podían moverse con todo ese peso encima...
DATA_CMM_1979.ko: 굉장히 무거운 옷. 벗고 싶을 때는 굉장히 빨리 벗을 수 있을지도 모르겠다.
DATA_CMM_1979.zht: 非常沉重的衣服。脫掉衣服的時候說不定會變得很敏捷。
DATA_CMM_1979.zhs: 非常沉重的衣服。脱掉衣服的时候说不定会变得很敏捷。

DATA_CMM_1980.ja: We're floored by the bold brushstrokes and delicate use of color.
DATA_CMM_1980.en: We're floored by the bold brushstrokes and delicate use of color.
DATA_CMM_1980.fr: Nous sommes impressionné par l'audace des coups de pinceau.
DATA_CMM_1980.de: Wir sind begeistert von den kühnen Pinselstrichen und dem zarten Einsatz von Farbe.
DATA_CMM_1980.it: Un quadro impressionante più che impressionista.
DATA_CMM_1980.es: Nos fascina el uso del color y la fuerza del trazo.
DATA_CMM_1980.zht: 豪放的筆觸跟細膩的上色令人愛不釋手。
DATA_CMM_1980.zhs: 豪放的笔触跟细腻的上色令人爱不释手。

DATA_CMM_1981.ja: A clock with a hanging thing that goes back and forth. We start nodding off whenever we check the time. How inconvenient.
DATA_CMM_1981.en: A clock with a hanging thing that goes back and forth. We start nodding off whenever we check the time. How inconvenient.
DATA_CMM_1981.fr: Horloge à balancier. Son mouvement régulier Nous endort quand Nous voulons voir l'heure.
DATA_CMM_1981.de: Eine Uhr, an der etwas herunterhängt, das sich hin- und herbewegt. Immer wenn wir auf die Zeit gucken, schlafen wir ein. Echt nervig.
DATA_CMM_1981.it: Un orologio con un sistema meccanico troppo ingombrante per essere utile.
DATA_CMM_1981.es: Si te empeñas en menear la cabeza a su ritmo, acabarás con dolor de cuello.
DATA_CMM_1981.ko: 흔들흔들거리는 추가 달려있는 시계. 시간을 보려다가 최면에 걸려버리는 경우도 있다고…
DATA_CMM_1981.zht: 時鐘懸掛著左右晃盪的東西。每次看時間都昏昏欲睡，所以不太方便。
DATA_CMM_1981.zhs: 时钟悬挂着左右晃荡的东西。每次看时间都昏昏欲睡，所以不太方便。

DATA_CMM_1982.ja: A clock you put on your arm. The band gets all sweaty in summer, which isn't a good feeling.
DATA_CMM_1982.en: A clock you put on your arm. The band gets all sweaty in summer, which isn't a good feeling.
DATA_CMM_1982.fr: Horloge que l'on porte au poignet. Le bracelet est tout mouillé en été, c'est dégoûtant.
DATA_CMM_1982.de: Eine Uhr, die man am Arm trägt. Das Band ist im Sommer immer ganz verschwitzt, was sich nicht besonders gut anfühlt.
DATA_CMM_1982.it: Un orologio piccolo da mettere al polso. Probabilmente è collegato in qualche modo con il Grande Orologio della Vita.
DATA_CMM_1982.es: Es práctico, pero la correa molesta mucho en verano y siempre acaba en el bolsillo...
DATA_CMM_1982.ko: 팔에 차는 시계. 여름이 되면 줄 부분에 땀이 차서 기분이 나쁘다.
DATA_CMM_1982.zht: 戴在手腕上的時鐘。一到夏天，戴錶帶的部位會稍微出汗，有點噁心。
DATA_CMM_1982.zhs: 戴在手腕上的时钟。一到夏天，戴表带的部位会稍微出汗，有点恶心。

DATA_CMM_1984.ja: A miraculous machine that turns any food into juice. You can't tell what's inside once it's done, which is awfully exciting.
DATA_CMM_1984.en: A miraculous machine that turns any food into juice. You can't tell what's inside once it's done, which is awfully exciting.
DATA_CMM_1984.fr: Machine miraculeuse qui transforme les aliments en jus. On ne sait plus ce qu'il y a à l'intérieur après, c'est amusant.
DATA_CMM_1984.de: Eine wundersame Maschine, die jedes Lebensmittel in Saft verwandelt. Man kann nicht sagen, was drin ist, wenn es fertig ist. Sehr aufregend.
DATA_CMM_1984.it: Una macchina meravigliosa che tramuta ogni cibo in un succo. È difficile capire da quali ingredienti sia composto il liquido, il che rende il tutto molto interessante.
DATA_CMM_1984.es: Esta máquina maravillosa transforma todo en zumo. Ten cuidado con lo que pones dentro.
DATA_CMM_1984.ko: 음식이 주스가 되어 버리는 미러클한 기계. 무엇이 들어있는지 구분이 안 가므로 꽤나 익사이팅.
DATA_CMM_1984.zht: 可以把食物變成果汁的奇蹟機器。因為會變得搞不清楚放了什麼進去，相當緊張刺激。
DATA_CMM_1984.zhs: 可以把食物变成果汁的奇迹机器。因为会变得搞不清楚放了什么进去，相当紧张刺激。

DATA_CMM_1985.ja: People jump over these when they're around, even though it would be far easier just to avoid them.
DATA_CMM_1985.en: People jump over these when they're around, even though it would be far easier just to avoid them.
DATA_CMM_1985.fr: On saute par-dessus pour s'amuser, mais il serait plus intelligent de la contourner.
DATA_CMM_1985.de: Die Leute springen über sie drüber, wenn sie eine sehen, obwohl es viel einfacher wäre, sie einfach zu ignorieren.
DATA_CMM_1985.it: La gente lo salta, quando invece sarebbe più facile evitarlo.
DATA_CMM_1985.es: ¿Por qué se empeña la gente en saltarlas con lo fácil que es rodearlas?
DATA_CMM_1985.ko: 이것이 보이면 모두 뛰어넘으려 한다. 굳이 안 뛰어넘고 피해가면 될 텐데…
DATA_CMM_1985.zht: 大家遇到跨欄都會跳過去。其實不必特地跳過去，繞開跑也行的。
DATA_CMM_1985.zhs: 大家遇到跨栏都会跳过去。其实不必特地跳过去，绕开跑也行的。

DATA_CMM_1986.ja: One of a bunch of kites strung together. Hopefully there aren't any trees nearby.
DATA_CMM_1986.en: One of a bunch of kites strung together. Hopefully there aren't any trees nearby.
DATA_CMM_1986.fr: Cerf-volant fêtard qui aime voler en troupeau et qui n'aime pas beaucoup les orages.
DATA_CMM_1986.de: Ein Haufen miteinander verbundener Drachen. Hoffentlich sind keine Bäume in der Nähe.
DATA_CMM_1986.it: Un aquilone. Speriamo non ci siano alberi nelle vicinanze...
DATA_CMM_1986.es: Esperemos que no haya árboles cerca...
DATA_CMM_1986.ko: 대보름에는 이것을 띄운 후 실을 끊어 나쁜 것을 내보내고 복을 맞아들인다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_1986.zht: 很多風箏串在一起。幸好不是蜜蜂的蜂針。
DATA_CMM_1986.zhs: 很多风筝串在一起。幸好不是蜜蜂的蜂针。

DATA_CMM_1987.ja: This speedy kite used to be quite popular. You could probably use these to scare off sparrows.
DATA_CMM_1987.en: This speedy kite used to be quite popular. You could probably use these to scare off sparrows.
DATA_CMM_1987.fr: Il est très rapide, ce qui a fait sa popularité. Il serait sans doute possible de l'utiliser pour effrayer les moineaux.
DATA_CMM_1987.de: Dieser schnelle Drachen war früher sehr beliebt. Wahrscheinlich wurden damit Spatzen verscheucht.
DATA_CMM_1987.it: Questo aquilone era piuttosto famoso un tempo. Potresti provare a utilizzarlo per spaventare dei passeri.
DATA_CMM_1987.es: Da gusto verlas volar, pero es cansado andar corriendo con ellas.
DATA_CMM_1987.ko: 옛날에 유행하던 스피드를 내는 연. 참새를 위협할 때도 사용된다.
DATA_CMM_1987.zht: 速度快的風箏，以前流行過。似乎也可以用來嚇唬麻雀。
DATA_CMM_1987.zhs: 速度快的风筝，以前流行过。似乎也可以用来吓唬麻雀。

DATA_CMM_1988.ja: A special machine that can take a dark room and turn it into outer space.
DATA_CMM_1988.en: A special machine that can take a dark room and turn it into outer space.
DATA_CMM_1988.fr: Machine extraordinaire, capable de transformer une pièce noire en ciel étoilé.
DATA_CMM_1988.de: Eine spezielle Maschine, die einen dunklen Raum in den Weltraum verwandelt.
DATA_CMM_1988.it: Una macchina che trasforma una stanza buia nel cielo stellato.
DATA_CMM_1988.es: Es mágico: puede transformar una bóveda oscura en un cielo estrellado con un clic.
DATA_CMM_1988.ko: 이것을 어두운 방에서 사용하면, 그곳이 순식간에 우주로 변하고 마는 스페셜 머신.
DATA_CMM_1988.zht: 不可思議的機器，在漆黑房間使用的話，房間就會變成宇宙。
DATA_CMM_1988.zhs: 不可思议的机器，在漆黑房间使用的话，房间就会变成宇宙。

DATA_CMM_1989.ja: A well-used item that helps humans build their bodies. It's very heavy, so dropping it on your foot would be a tragedy.
DATA_CMM_1989.en: A well-used item that helps humans build their bodies. It's very heavy, so dropping it on your foot would be a tragedy.
DATA_CMM_1989.fr: Très utilisé par les hommes pour se muscler. Ce n'est pas une très bonne idée de se le faire tomber sur le pied.
DATA_CMM_1989.de: Menschen nutzen sie oft, um ihre Körper zu formen. Weil sie sehr schwer ist, lässt man sie besser nicht auf die Füße fallen.
DATA_CMM_1989.it: Un attrezzo usato per mantenersi in forma o per deformarsi in maniera muscolosa.
DATA_CMM_1989.es: Como su nombre indica, pesan mucho: que no se te caigan en el pie.
DATA_CMM_1989.ko: 몸을 단련하는 인간의 애용품. 굉장히 무겁기 때문에 발 위에 떨어뜨리면 비참한 상황이 벌어진다.
DATA_CMM_1989.zht: 人類鍛鍊體魄時喜愛的商品。非常重，所以砸到腳後果不堪設想。
DATA_CMM_1989.zhs: 人类锻炼体魄时喜爱的商品。非常重，所以砸到脚后果不堪设想。

DATA_CMM_1990.ja: A beam made of iron. Someone really strong must use this.
DATA_CMM_1990.en: A beam made of iron. Someone really strong must use this.
DATA_CMM_1990.fr: Poutre en métal. Il faut être très fort pour la soulever.
DATA_CMM_1990.de: Ein Balken aus Eisen. Muss von jemandem benutzt werden, der sehr stark ist.
DATA_CMM_1990.it: Simile alla sua cugina in legno, ma servono più spinaci per modellarla.
DATA_CMM_1990.es: Seguro que el operario es un fortachón de miedo.
DATA_CMM_1990.ko: 철로 만든 막대기. 몸을 꽤나 단련한 사람이 사용하는 물건이다.
DATA_CMM_1990.zht: 鋼做成的棒子。是體魄經過相當程度鍛鍊的人在使用吧？
DATA_CMM_1990.zhs: 钢做成的棒子。是体魄经过相当程度锻炼的人在使用吧？

DATA_CMM_1991.ja: Operate the crane in this machine to grab items. We wish the crane would help Us out a bit more.
DATA_CMM_1991.en: Operate the crane in this machine to grab items. We wish the crane would help Us out a bit more.
DATA_CMM_1991.fr: Utilisez la grue pour attraper et soulever des objets. Nous aimerions qu'elle Nous aide un peu.
DATA_CMM_1991.de: Man steuert den Kran in dieser Maschine, um nach Gegenständen zu greifen. Wir würden uns wünschen, dass der Kran etwas nützlicher wäre.
DATA_CMM_1991.it: Si può usare la gru per recuperare degli oggetti. Purtroppo la gru non coopera molto.
DATA_CMM_1991.es: Por poco que pese el oso de peluche que quieres sacar, siempre se acaba cayendo.
DATA_CMM_1991.ko: 크레인을 조종해서 물건을 집는 기계. 크레인이 좀더 분발해줬으면 싶다.
DATA_CMM_1991.zht: 操作吊鉤取物的機械。現在正好是希望吊鉤能更賣力工作的時候。
DATA_CMM_1991.zhs: 操作吊钩取物的机械。现在正好是希望吊钩能更卖力工作的时候。

DATA_CMM_1992.ja: Good for smoothing down your head. Fashion leaders wouldn't be caught dead without this.
DATA_CMM_1992.en: Good for smoothing down your head. Fashion leaders wouldn't be caught dead without this.
DATA_CMM_1992.fr: Très bien pour aplatir vos épis. Les gens à la mode en ont toujours un avec eux.
DATA_CMM_1992.de: Gut zum Glätten von Haaren. Modedesigner würden sich ohne das Ding nicht blicken lassen.
DATA_CMM_1992.it: Ottimo per dare un certo ordine alle capigliature.
DATA_CMM_1992.es: Sirve para poner el pelo en orden. Su hábitat natural es el bolsillo trasero del pantalón.
DATA_CMM_1992.ko: 머리를 고정하는데에 적격이다. 패션 리더의 필수 아이템.
DATA_CMM_1992.zht: 最適合用來梳理頭髮。時尚教主的必備道具。
DATA_CMM_1992.zhs: 最适合用来梳理头发。时尚教主的必备道具。

DATA_CMM_1993.ja: A computer screen. People stare at these all day in offices. They must be pretty interesting.
DATA_CMM_1993.en: A computer screen. People stare at these all day in offices. They must be pretty interesting.
DATA_CMM_1993.fr: Écran d'ordinateur. Dans les bureaux, les gens les regardent toute la journée. Ils doivent être très intéressants.
DATA_CMM_1993.de: Ein Computerbildschirm. In Büros starren die Leute den ganzen Tag auf solche. Müssen ziemlich interessant sein.
DATA_CMM_1993.it: Uno schermo per computer. Deve mostrare cose molto interessanti visto che la gente lo fissa di continuo.
DATA_CMM_1993.es: Debe de ser interesante, porque la gente que trabaja en oficinas se pasa el día mirándolo.
DATA_CMM_1993.ko: 컴퓨터의 화면. 얼마나 재미있으면 회사원들이 하루 종일 이것만 들여다 보고 있을까.
DATA_CMM_1993.zht: 電腦的畫面。公司職員白天都在盯著看，大概是相當有意思吧？
DATA_CMM_1993.zhs: 电脑的画面。公司职员白天都在盯着看，大概是相当有意思吧？

DATA_CMM_1994.ja: People in offices tappity-tap on this. The faster they are, the more bloodshot their eyes become.
DATA_CMM_1994.en: People in offices tappity-tap on this. The faster they are, the more bloodshot their eyes become.
DATA_CMM_1994.fr: Les gens dans les bureaux les tapent toute la journée. Ils ne doivent pas les aimer beaucoup.
DATA_CMM_1994.de: Leute in Büros tippen darauf herum. Je schneller sie sind, desto blutunterlaufener sehen ihre Augen aus.
DATA_CMM_1994.it: Produce un bellissimo suono simile al tip tap.
DATA_CMM_1994.es: Hay quien se pone tapones en los oídos porque se irrita con el clic-clic-clic.
DATA_CMM_1994.ko: 회사원이 타닥타닥 두드리는 것. 스피드가 빠른 인간일수록 눈에 핏줄이 서 있다.
DATA_CMM_1994.zht: 公司職員會喀擦喀擦地敲擊鍵盤。打字越快的人眼睛會越紅。
DATA_CMM_1994.zhs: 公司职员会喀擦喀擦地敲击键盘。打字越快的人眼睛会越红。

DATA_CMM_1995.ja: Apparently all the really difficult things are being thought out inside of this machine. We wish the poor thoughts would come out once in a while.
DATA_CMM_1995.en: Apparently all the really difficult things are being thought out inside of this machine. We wish the poor thoughts would come out once in a while.
DATA_CMM_1995.fr: Apparemment, tous les problèmes très difficiles entrent là-dedans pour y être résolus. Pourquoi n'ont-ils jamais le droit d'en sortir ?
DATA_CMM_1995.de: Anscheinend werden alle wirklich schwierigen Dinge von dieser Maschine erdacht. Wir wünschten, die armen Gedanken dürften ab und zu mal raus.
DATA_CMM_1995.it: Una macchina le cui dinamiche magiche Ci sono oscure.
DATA_CMM_1995.es: Es un aparato muy práctico cuando funciona, pero lleva a la desesperación cuando se rebela.
DATA_CMM_1995.ko: 어려운 것은 몽땅 이 안에서 생각해 준다고 한다. 안에만 있지 말고 가끔은 외출도 하면 좋을 텐데…
DATA_CMM_1995.zht: 似乎困難的事都在電腦裡盤算。要是別整天蹲在家裡，會出門就好了。
DATA_CMM_1995.zhs: 似乎困难的事都在电脑里盘算。要是别整天蹲在家里，会出门就好了。

DATA_CMM_1996.ja: Colorful dumplings. They're different colors, but actually taste the same.
DATA_CMM_1996.en: Colorful dumplings. They're different colors, but actually taste the same.
DATA_CMM_1996.fr: Des boulettes pleines de couleurs. Leur gamme chromatique varie, mais pas leur goût.
DATA_CMM_1996.de: Bunte Teigtaschen. Obwohl sie verschiedenfarbig sind, schmecken sie eigentlich alle gleich.
DATA_CMM_1996.it: Dei ravioli variegati nei colori ma identici nel gusto.
DATA_CMM_1996.es: Bolitas de masita dulces. Aunque tengan distintos colores, todas saben igual.
DATA_CMM_1996.ko: 컬러풀한 경단. 색깔만 다르지 맛은 똑같다.
DATA_CMM_1996.zht: 色彩繽紛的糰子。顏色雖然不同味道都一樣。
DATA_CMM_1996.zhs: 色彩缤纷的团子。颜色虽然不同味道都一样。

DATA_CMM_1997.ja: A creamy food made from hot cheese and white sauce. You'll burn your tongue if you aren't careful.
DATA_CMM_1997.en: A creamy food made from hot cheese and white sauce. You'll burn your tongue if you aren't careful.
DATA_CMM_1997.fr: Un aliment crémeux contenant du fromage et de la sauce blanche. C'est très chaud, avis aux gourmands.
DATA_CMM_1997.de: Eine cremige Speise aus heißem Käse und weißer Soße. Wenn man nicht aufpasst, verbrennt man sich die Zunge.
DATA_CMM_1997.it: Una crema di besciamella e formaggio caldi.
DATA_CMM_1997.es: Salsa cremosa, queso fundido y un toque dorado. Pero ten cuidado de no chamuscarlo.
DATA_CMM_1997.ko: 뜨거운 치즈와 화이트 소스가 끈적끈적 녹아 내리는 음식. 조심하지 않으면 화상을 입는다.
DATA_CMM_1997.zht: 融入了熱呼呼的起司跟白醬的料理。不小心就會燙傷。
DATA_CMM_1997.zhs: 融入了热呼呼的起司跟白酱的料理。不小心就会烫伤。

DATA_CMM_1998.ja: A block-like thing with a daruma drawn on it. Never moves, even when the blocks under it are knocked off.
DATA_CMM_1998.en: A block-like thing with a daruma drawn on it. Never moves, even when the blocks under it are knocked off.
DATA_CMM_1998.fr: On dirait un bloc, mais une tête est gravée dessus. Il reste de marbre, même quand les blocs en dessous tombent.
DATA_CMM_1998.de: Ein blockartiges Ding, auf das ein Daruma gezeichnet ist. Bewegt sich nie, auch wenn man die Blöcke darunter herausschlägt.
DATA_CMM_1998.it: Un blocco con disegnato un daruma, inamovibile anche quando il resto viene spazzato via.
DATA_CMM_1998.es: Muñequito daruma desmontable. No cambia de cara aunque le quites el cuerpo.
DATA_CMM_1998.ko: 오뚝이가 그려진 쌓기의 일종. 아래에 쌓여진 쌓기는 두드려 맞아도, 이놈만은 맞지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_1998.zht: 像積木的東西，畫著不倒翁的圖案。就算下面堆疊的積木挨打了，也只有這傢伙不會被打。
DATA_CMM_1998.zhs: 像积木的东西，画着不倒翁的图案。就算下面堆迭的积木挨打了，也只有这家伙不会被打。

DATA_CMM_1999.ja: Apparently lives for the thrill of getting sent flying by a hammer.
DATA_CMM_1999.en: Apparently lives for the thrill of getting sent flying by a hammer.
DATA_CMM_1999.fr: Il ne vit que pour le bonheur d'être heurté par un marteau.
DATA_CMM_1999.de: Lebt anscheinend für den Nervenkitzel, von einem Hammer durch die Luft geschleudert zu werden.
DATA_CMM_1999.it: Vive in attesa di essere colpito da un martello.
DATA_CMM_1999.es: Al parecer, el juego consiste en derribar las partes del cuerpo.
DATA_CMM_1999.ko: 맞아 날아가는 스릴감이 의외로 짜릿한 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_1999.zht: 瞬間化為烏有的刺激感出奇地令人無法抗拒。
DATA_CMM_1999.zhs: 瞬间化为乌有的刺激感出奇地令人无法抗拒。

DATA_CMM_2000.ja: Tries its very best to stay put.
DATA_CMM_2000.en: Tries its very best to stay put.
DATA_CMM_2000.fr: Il fait de son mieux pour ne pas bouger.
DATA_CMM_2000.de: Gibt sein Bestes, um an Ort und Stelle zu bleiben.
DATA_CMM_2000.it: Ce la mette tutta per non muoversi.
DATA_CMM_2000.es: Intenta mantenerse firme con todas sus fuerzas.

DATA_CMM_2001.ja: Its mind and body are a mess from all the punishment it receives.
DATA_CMM_2001.en: Its mind and body are a mess from all the punishment it receives.
DATA_CMM_2001.fr: Son esprit et sa tête sont secoués à cause de tous les coups qu'il reçoit.
DATA_CMM_2001.de: Sein Geist und sein Körper sind ganz geschunden von den ganzen Strafen, die er bekommt.
DATA_CMM_2001.it: Non è mai in ottima forma.
DATA_CMM_2001.es: Ya no sabe dónde tiene la cabeza a causa de los golpes que recibe.
DATA_CMM_2001.ko: 언제나 두드려 맞아서 몸도 마음도 엉망이다.
DATA_CMM_2001.zht: 總是挨揍，身心都殘破不堪。
DATA_CMM_2001.zhs: 总是挨揍，身心都残破不堪。

DATA_CMM_2002.ja: Not only does this have to support everyone's weight, people are always hitting it with hammers. It must feel very put upon.
DATA_CMM_2002.en: Not only does this have to support everyone's weight, people are always hitting it with hammers. It must feel very put upon.
DATA_CMM_2002.fr: Il doit soutenir tout le reste du corps et les gens le frappent à coup de marteau. Nous sommes certain qu'il accuse le coup.
DATA_CMM_2002.de: Muss nicht nur das Gewicht aller tragen, sondern wird von Leuten auch ständig mit dem Hammer geschlagen. Muss ganz schön viel aushalten.
DATA_CMM_2002.it: Non solo deve reggere tutto il resto del corpo ma la gente lo colpisce costantemente con dei martelli. Sta pensando al licenziamento.
DATA_CMM_2002.es: No solo tiene que soportar todo el peso, sino que todo el mundo lo ataca con martillos. Pobre.
DATA_CMM_2002.ko: 모두를 떠받들어 가뜩이나 무거운데 얻어맞기까지 해서 정말 우울하다.
DATA_CMM_2002.zht: 支撐著大家，負擔沉重的同時還會被槌子毆打，真是禍不單行。
DATA_CMM_2002.zhs: 支撑着大家，负担沉重的同时还会被槌子殴打，真是祸不单行。

DATA_CMM_2003.ja: A small bottle filled with salty powder used for cooking. Often becomes lumpy and refuses to leave the bottle.
DATA_CMM_2003.en: A small bottle filled with salty powder used for cooking. Often becomes lumpy and refuses to leave the bottle.
DATA_CMM_2003.fr: Petite bouteille pleine d'une poudre salée utilisée en cuisine. Souvent, elle coagule et refuse de sortir de la bouteille.
DATA_CMM_2003.de: Eine kleine Flasche, die mit salzigem Pulver gefüllt ist, das zum Kochen benutzt wird. Klumpt oft und weigert sich dann, das Fläschchen zu verlassen.
DATA_CMM_2003.it: Una bottiglietta piena di sale, indispensabile in cucina e nella Vita, arma molto efficace contro gli spiriti maligni.
DATA_CMM_2003.es: A veces se apelmaza y se niega a abandonar el salero; será porque está a gusto.
DATA_CMM_2003.ko: 짠 분말이 들어있는 병. 후라이팬에 구운 쌀알을 넣어두면 습기가 차지 않는다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2003.zht: 小瓶子，裝著做料理的鹹味粉。在瓶中放入用平底鍋煎過的米粒，就能放心鹽巴不會受潮了。
DATA_CMM_2003.zhs: 小瓶子，装着做料理的咸味粉。在瓶中放入用平底锅煎过的米粒，就能放心盐巴不会受潮了。

DATA_CMM_2004.ja: A bottle filled with powder used to play tricks on people. Apparently also used for cooking.
DATA_CMM_2004.en: A bottle filled with powder used to play tricks on people. Apparently also used for cooking.
DATA_CMM_2004.fr: Bouteille pleine de poudre que les blagueurs aiment beaucoup. Elle serait également utilisée pour cuisiner.
DATA_CMM_2004.de: Mit dem Pulver darin spielt man anderen gerne Streiche. Kann man anscheinend auch zum Kochen benutzen.
DATA_CMM_2004.it: Una bottiglietta piena di una polvere nera usata per fare degli scherzi e, qualche volta, in cucina.
DATA_CMM_2004.es: Además de para hacer estornudar a la gente, parece ser que se usa para cocinar.
DATA_CMM_2004.ko: 남에게 장난을 치기 좋은 가루가 들어있다. 요리에 사용하는 경우도 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2004.zht: 裝有可以捉弄人的粉末。做菜時好像也會使用。
DATA_CMM_2004.zhs: 装有可以捉弄人的粉末。做菜时好像也会使用。

DATA_CMM_2005.ja: A bottle filled with sweet powder. So popular with bugs, if you leave it around they line up to eat it.
DATA_CMM_2005.en: A bottle filled with sweet powder. So popular with bugs, if you leave it around they line up to eat it.
DATA_CMM_2005.fr: Pot plein de poudre sucrée. Les insectes l'aiment tellement qu'ils font la queue pour en manger.
DATA_CMM_2005.de: Eine mit süßem Pulver gefüllte Dose. Liegt er herum, ist er so beliebt bei Insekten, dass sie Schlange stehen, um ihn zu fressen.
DATA_CMM_2005.it: Una polvere dolce, molto amata dagli insetti e dai bambini. Faranno entrambi di tutto per ottenerne un po'.
DATA_CMM_2005.es: Otro clásico de las bromas pesadas por su parecido con la sal...
DATA_CMM_2005.ko: 내버려두면 벌레가 줄을 지어 먹으러 올 정도로 맛있고 달콤한 가루가 들어있는 병.
DATA_CMM_2005.zht: 瓶子裝著甜甜的粉末，好吃到放置不管就會有蟲子列隊來吃。
DATA_CMM_2005.zhs: 瓶子装着甜甜的粉末，好吃到放置不管就会有虫子列队来吃。

DATA_CMM_2006.ja: A bottle filled with a salty black liquid. The tip is very narrow because drinking too much is bad for your health.
DATA_CMM_2006.en: A bottle filled with a salty black liquid. The tip is very narrow because drinking too much is bad for your health.
DATA_CMM_2006.fr: Plein d'un liquide noir et salé. Son goulot est très étroit parce qu'il est très radin.
DATA_CMM_2006.de: Eine mit einer salzigen schwarzen Flüssigkeit gefüllte Flasche. Ihre Öffnung ist sehr klein, denn viel davon zu trinken ist schlecht für die Gesundheit.
DATA_CMM_2006.it: Una bottiglia con un beccuccio per centellinare la salsa di soia.
DATA_CMM_2006.es: Tiene el cuello estrecho porque tomar demasiada salsa es malo para la salud.
DATA_CMM_2006.ko: 검고 짠 액체가 들어있는 병. 입구가 좁은 것은 벌컥벌컥 들이키면 몸에 해롭기 때문일 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2006.zht: 瓶子裝有又黑又鹹的液體。瓶口狹窄似乎是因為喝太多會對身體不好。
DATA_CMM_2006.zhs: 瓶子装有又黑又咸的液体。瓶口狭窄似乎是因为喝太多会对身体不好。

DATA_CMM_2007.ja: A clip that keeps freshly-washed clothing from flying away. You could also use this underwater, We suppose.
DATA_CMM_2007.en: A clip that keeps freshly-washed clothing from flying away. You could also use this underwater, We suppose.
DATA_CMM_2007.fr: Pince qui garde les vêtements mis à sécher pour qu'ils ne prennent pas la poudre d'escampette.
DATA_CMM_2007.de: Eine Klammer, die verhindert, dass frisch gewaschene Kleidung wegfliegt. Könnte man auch unter Wasser verwenden, vermuten wir.
DATA_CMM_2007.it: Un oggetto che impedisce ai vestiti stesi di volare via.
DATA_CMM_2007.es: Sirve para que la ropa no salga volando cuando se tiende a secar. Qué represora.
DATA_CMM_2007.ko: 세탁한 옷이 날아가지 않도록 고정하는 도구. 물에 잠수할 때도 사용할 수는 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2007.zht: 夾住東西的道具，防止洗好的衣服飛走。潛水的時候也能使用吧？
DATA_CMM_2007.zhs: 夹住东西的道具，防止洗好的衣服飞走。潜水的时候也能使用吧？

DATA_CMM_2008.ja: The "ding" means that whatever's inside is heated up.
DATA_CMM_2008.en: The "ding" means that whatever's inside is heated up.
DATA_CMM_2008.fr: Quand il fait "ding", c'est qu'il a fini de travailler.
DATA_CMM_2008.de: Wenn sie „ding" macht, heißt das, dass ihr Inhalt erhitzt ist.
DATA_CMM_2008.it: Quando si sente un "ding" vuol dire che la cena è pronta.
DATA_CMM_2008.es: El "ping" que hace te anuncia que la comida está lista.
DATA_CMM_2008.zht: 叮──一響，就是某種東西已經熱好的證據。
DATA_CMM_2008.zhs: 叮──一响，就是某种东西已经热好的证据。

DATA_CMM_2009.ja: A food that shoots out from under the soil. It gets hard and inedible when it becomes an adult.
DATA_CMM_2009.en: A food that shoots out from under the soil. It gets hard and inedible when it becomes an adult.
DATA_CMM_2009.fr: Aliment qui pousse à une vitesse phénoménale et qu'il faut cueillir tout petit.
DATA_CMM_2009.de: Ein Nahrungsmittel, das aus der Erde hervorsprießt. Wird allerdings hart und ungenießbar, wenn sie groß ist.
DATA_CMM_2009.it: Cibo orientale che va mangiato prima che diventi una pianta non commestibile.
DATA_CMM_2009.es: Cuando crece y se pone más duro solo es apto para pandas.
DATA_CMM_2009.ko: 땅 속에서 꼬물꼬물 자라난 먹을 것. 어른이 되면 딱딱해서 먹을 수 없다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2009.zht: 一種食物，會從土裡接二連三地長出來。長大之後好像會變得很硬而無法食用。
DATA_CMM_2009.zhs: 一种食物，会从土里接二连三地长出来。长大之后好像会变得很硬而无法食用。

DATA_CMM_2010.ja: A princess came out of one of these in a Japanese fairy tale, but you probably won't find another one in here.
DATA_CMM_2010.en: A princess came out of one of these in a Japanese fairy tale, but you probably won't find another one in here.
DATA_CMM_2010.fr: Une légende japonaise raconte qu'une princesse en sortit. Elle est déjà partie, alors ne la cherchez pas dans votre assiette.
DATA_CMM_2010.de: In einem japanischen Märchen entschlüpfte eine Prinzessin aus einem solchen, aber in dem verbirgt sich wahrscheinlich nicht noch eine.
DATA_CMM_2010.it: Secondo una leggenda giapponese da una canna come queste è nata una principessa. Non crediamo ci siano molte possibilità che ne nascano altre.
DATA_CMM_2010.es: Un cuento japonés dice que una princesa nació de un brote de bambú, pero no hemos encontrado ninguna en el plato.
DATA_CMM_2010.ko: 공주님이 들어있으면 당첨이다. 과거를 통틀어 지금까지 딱 한 번 당첨이 있었다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2010.zht: 出現公主就算是中獎了吧？從以前到現在好像只中獎過一次。
DATA_CMM_2010.zhs: 出现公主就算是中奖了吧？从以前到现在好像只中奖过一次。

DATA_CMM_2011.ja: Rowing a boat with this is very tiring. Best used as a fan.
DATA_CMM_2011.en: Rowing a boat with this is very tiring. Best used as a fan.
DATA_CMM_2011.fr: Les deux faces de cette raquette sont de différentes couleurs et textures. Une pour le ping, l'autre pour le pong.
DATA_CMM_2011.de: Mit dem ein Boot zu steuern ist ziemlich anstrengend. Am besten noch als Fächer zu gebrauchen.
DATA_CMM_2011.it: Utile in molte occasioni. Scomoda per remare ma ottima come ventaglio.
DATA_CMM_2011.es: Usarla como remo resulta muy cansado; mejor aprovéchala como abanico.
DATA_CMM_2011.ko: 온천에 가면 반드시 해야 한다고 한다. 여행갈 때는 가지고 가는 편이 좋다.
DATA_CMM_2011.zht: 似乎提到溫泉就必須打桌球。要旅行的話最好帶著出門。

DATA_CMM_2016.en: A cute little blooming cactus. It still has spikes, though.

DATA_CMM_2017.en: A plant meant for viewing. It's so uptight about its figure that it only drinks a very small amount of water.

DATA_CMM_2017.zhs: 据说是观赏用植物。不太喝水，是对自己很严苛的家伙。

DATA_CMM_2018.ja: Milk in a conveniently sized pack. Goes well with cookies and chocolates.
DATA_CMM_2018.en: Milk in a conveniently sized pack. Goes well with cookies and chocolates.

DATA_CMM_2019.ja: A very creamy liquid. Running a slice of bread along the bottom of the bowl is the best way to eat it all up.
DATA_CMM_2019.en: A very creamy liquid. Running a slice of bread along the bottom of the bowl is the best way to eat it all up.

DATA_CMM_2020.en: A machine that puts out a cool wind. We can't help but bring Our face up to it and make funny voices.

DATA_CMM_2021.en: A star that fell into the ocean. It was probably too small to become even stardust.

DATA_CMM_2030.en: This pen lets you write things which can't be easily erased. When you want a star's autograph, bring this.

DATA_CMM_2031.en: A figure dug out of the earth. Apparently, that surprised look dates from before it was dug up.
