DATA_CMM_2033.it: Un raro insetto che si dà fuoco al sedere di notte, o qualcosa del genere.
DATA_CMM_2033.es: Deben de llevar una pila pequeñita para brillar de ese modo en la noche.
DATA_CMM_2033.ko: 신기하게도 빛나는 벌레. 안에 들어가는 전지는 매우 작을 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2033.zht: 會發光的罕見蟲子。感覺裝在裡面的電池很小顆。
DATA_CMM_2033.zhs: 会发光的罕见虫子。感觉装在里面的电池很小颗。

DATA_CMM_2034.ja: A bouquet of roses. Not used often, but used when it counts.
DATA_CMM_2034.en: A bouquet of roses. Not used often, but used when it counts.
DATA_CMM_2034.fr: Cet objet n'est pas souvent utilisé. Pourtant, il fait toujours plaisir.
DATA_CMM_2034.de: Ein Blumenstrauß aus Rosen. Wird nicht oft verschenkt, aber immer, wenn's wichtig ist.
DATA_CMM_2034.es: Un ramo de flores dice más que varias horas de serenata.
DATA_CMM_2034.ko: 장미 꽃다발. 절호의 타이밍에서 사용해야 효력을 발휘한다.
DATA_CMM_2034.zht: 玫瑰花束。在關鍵時刻使用的道具。
DATA_CMM_2034.zhs: 玫瑰花束。在关键时刻使用的道具。

DATA_CMM_2035.ja: The ice cream isn't always as big as the picture in the banner, so be careful.
DATA_CMM_2035.en: The ice cream isn't always as big as the picture in the banner, so be careful.
DATA_CMM_2035.fr: Méfiez-vous : la glace n'est pas toujours aussi grosse que l'image de l'enseigne.
DATA_CMM_2035.de: Das Eis ist nicht immer so groß wie im Bild auf dem Banner, also nicht wundern.
DATA_CMM_2035.it: Attenzione, non sempre il gelato è grande come la figura.
DATA_CMM_2035.es: Los helados de verdad no suelen ser tan grandes como los del rótulo; no te engañes.
DATA_CMM_2035.ko: 여기에 그려진 모양과 다른 경우도 있기 때문에 주의가 필요하다.
DATA_CMM_2035.zht: 要注意霜淇淋可能會跟畫在旗子上的形狀有些許不同。
DATA_CMM_2035.zhs: 要注意霜淇淋可能会跟画在旗子上的形状有些许不同。

DATA_CMM_2036.ja: Apparently, they sell souvenirs that prove you've been here. Even if you eat them later.
DATA_CMM_2036.en: Apparently, they sell souvenirs that prove you've been here. Even if you eat them later.
DATA_CMM_2036.fr: On vend des souvenirs qui prouvent que vous êtes bien venu ici. Précieux alibis...
DATA_CMM_2036.de: Offenbar werden dort Souvenirs verkauft, die beweisen, dass man dort gewesen ist. Auch wenn man sie später isst.
DATA_CMM_2036.it: Il negozio vende oggetti che servono per dimostrare di essere effettivamente stati dove si è detto. Si chiamano souvenir.
DATA_CMM_2036.es: Al parecer, venden objetos que demuestran que has estado en algún lugar, por si los amigos no te creen.
DATA_CMM_2036.ko: 여기에 방문한 기념품을 판매하는 듯하다. 먹으면 없어지는 물건이 기념이 되나~?
DATA_CMM_2036.zht: 販售著到此一遊的紀念品。吃掉就沒了的東西好像也能當成紀念。
DATA_CMM_2036.zhs: 贩售着到此一游的纪念品。吃掉就没了的东西好像也能当成纪念。

DATA_CMM_2037.ja: This vehicle connects cities together. It can only run on certain tracks, so you have to wait at special places to catch one. How annoying.
DATA_CMM_2037.en: This vehicle connects cities together. It can only run on certain tracks, so you have to wait at special places to catch one. How annoying.
DATA_CMM_2037.fr: Ce véhicule relie les hommes entre eux. Il est snob et ne roule que là où bon lui semble. Mauvais sujet.
DATA_CMM_2037.de: Dieses Fahrzeug verbindet Städte miteinander. Kann nur auf bestimmten Strecken fahren, also muss man an bestimmten Orten warten, um mitzufahren. Nervig.
DATA_CMM_2037.it: Un treno che percorre solo determinati percorsi per collegare diverse città.
DATA_CMM_2037.es: Tiene que ir por unos caminos especiales, por lo que debes montarte en estaciones especiales. Qué molesto.
DATA_CMM_2037.ko: 마을과 마을을 이어주는 탈것. 정해진 길로만 가기 때문에, 정해진 곳에서만 탈 수 있다는 것이 귀찮다.
DATA_CMM_2037.zht: 連接城鎮與城鎮的交通工具。只能走在規定的道路上，所以得在特定的地點等車，很麻煩。
DATA_CMM_2037.zhs: 连接城镇与城镇的交通工具。只能走在规定的道路上，所以得在特定的地点等车，很麻烦。

DATA_CMM_2038.ja: Look inside and faraway things become larger. Turn it around and they become smaller.
DATA_CMM_2038.en: Look inside and faraway things become larger. Turn it around and they become smaller.
DATA_CMM_2038.fr: Regardez dedans et les choses éloignées auront l'air proche. Si vous les retournez, vous aurez l'air bête.
DATA_CMM_2038.de: Schaut man hindurch, werden weit entfernte Dinge größer. Dreht man es um, werden sie kleiner.
DATA_CMM_2038.it: Usato in un verso avvicina gli oggetti e usato al contrario li allontana. Che oggetto miracoloso.
DATA_CMM_2038.es: Ideales para mirar cosas lejanas, pero aunque los pongas del revés no son prácticos como lupa.
DATA_CMM_2038.ko: 바라보면 먼 곳이 크게 보이는 도구. 거꾸로 보면 작게 보인다.
DATA_CMM_2038.zht: 一種道具，從中看出去就能放大遠方。倒過來的話，看起來會變小。
DATA_CMM_2038.zhs: 一种道具，从中看出去就能放大远方。倒过来的话，看起来会变小。

DATA_CMM_2039.ja: A seat for people who want to win big money and fabulous prizes. You may also need to wear a name tag.
DATA_CMM_2039.en: A seat for people who want to win big money and fabulous prizes. You may also need to wear a name tag.
DATA_CMM_2039.fr: Les gens s'assoient dedans pour gagner plein d'argent. Il faut souvent avoir une étiquette avec son nom sur sa veste.
DATA_CMM_2039.de: Ein Platz für Leute, die viel Geld und tolle Preise gewinnen wollen. Für den muss man wohl ein Namensschild tragen.
DATA_CMM_2039.it: Una sedia usata da chi vuole vincere grosse somme di denaro e premi. Vogliono tutti essere milionari.
DATA_CMM_2039.es: La gente viene a ganar premios y dinero, pero la mayoría se va sin nada más que el placer de participar.
DATA_CMM_2039.ko: 뉴욕에 가고 싶은 사람의 자리. 이상한 모자도 써야만 한다.
DATA_CMM_2039.zht: 想去紐約的人的座位。似乎得戴奇怪的帽子。
DATA_CMM_2039.zhs: 想去纽约的人的座位。似乎得戴奇怪的帽子。

DATA_CMM_2040.ja: A reckless mode of transportation that takes you up and drops you off all alone at the top of the mountain.
DATA_CMM_2040.en: A reckless mode of transportation that takes you up and drops you off all alone at the top of the mountain.
DATA_CMM_2040.fr: Nous Nous demandons ce que cela a de féerique d'être transporté sur un sommet désolé et glacial.
DATA_CMM_2040.de: Ein waghalsiges Transportmittel, das einen ganz nach oben auf den Berg bringt, einen dort absetzt und alleine lässt.
DATA_CMM_2040.it: Un sistema folle per trasportare la gente sulle cime.
DATA_CMM_2040.es: Este medio de transporte te lleva hasta lo alto y te abandona en completa soledad en una montaña.
DATA_CMM_2040.ko: 산 꼭대기에서만 내려주는 약간 난폭한 이동 수단.
DATA_CMM_2040.zht: 稍微有點粗魯的交通工具，會從山頂降下來。
DATA_CMM_2040.zhs: 稍微有点粗鲁的交通工具，会从山顶降下来。

DATA_CMM_2041.ja: A reckless, but thrilling ride that just hangs off a cable.
DATA_CMM_2041.en: A reckless, but thrilling ride that just hangs off a cable.
DATA_CMM_2041.fr: Avec lui, vous effectuez des voyages pendant lesquels votre vie ne tient qu'à un câble...
DATA_CMM_2041.de: Eine waghalsige, aber aufregende Fahrt, bei der man nur an einem Seil hängt.
DATA_CMM_2041.es: Es peligroso y a la vez emocionante viajar en una cabina suspendida de un cable. ¿O no?
DATA_CMM_2041.ko: 줄에 매달려 있는 것뿐인 스릴 넘치는 탈것.
DATA_CMM_2041.zht: 只靠繩索吊在半空中的刺激交通工具。
DATA_CMM_2041.zhs: 只靠绳索吊在半空中的刺激交通工具。

DATA_CMM_2042.ja: A fearsome pig whose breath sends mosquitoes packing.
DATA_CMM_2042.en: A fearsome pig whose breath sends mosquitoes packing.
DATA_CMM_2042.fr: Cochon terrifiant dont l'haleine sème l'effroi parmi les moustiques.
DATA_CMM_2042.de: Ein furchterregendes Schwein, dessen Atem Mücken vertreibt.
DATA_CMM_2042.it: Un maiale che respinge le zanzare con il pessimo fiato.
DATA_CMM_2042.es: Al parecer, este bicho tiene un aliento que acaba con los mosquitos.
DATA_CMM_2042.ko: 모기를 괴롭히는 무시무시한 연기를 내뿜는 돼지.
DATA_CMM_2042.zht: 厲害的豬，能呼出教訓蚊子的氣體。
DATA_CMM_2042.zhs: 厉害的猪，能呼出教训蚊子的气体。

DATA_CMM_2043.ja: A bag full of food shaped like little white grains. It's too tough and tasteless to eat like this.
DATA_CMM_2043.en: A bag full of food shaped like little white grains. It's too tough and tasteless to eat like this.
DATA_CMM_2043.fr: Sac plein de nourriture formée de petits grains. Elle n'est bonne que si on la fait cuire.
DATA_CMM_2043.de: Eine Tüte mit einem Lebensmittel, das aus kleinen weißen Körnern besteht. Es ist zu hart und geschmacklos, um es so zu essen.
DATA_CMM_2043.it: Una confezione piena di grani bianchi, va cotto però, non si può mangiarlo crudo.
DATA_CMM_2043.es: Estos granitos blancos no están nada buenos si te los comes crudos; palabra de Rey.
DATA_CMM_2043.ko: 알알이 하얀 식량이 들어있는 주머니. 이대로 먹으면 딱딱해서 맛이 없다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2043.zht: 滿滿一袋粒粒分明的白色糧食。直接食用似乎很硬又難吃。
DATA_CMM_2043.zhs: 满满一袋粒粒分明的白色粮食。直接食用似乎很硬又难吃。

DATA_CMM_2044.ja: Apparently, this is called the greatest invention of the century.
DATA_CMM_2044.en: Apparently, this is called the greatest invention of the century.
DATA_CMM_2044.de: Wird auch als die größte Erfindung des Jahrhunderts bezeichnet.
DATA_CMM_2044.it: Sono dei noodle istantanei, una grandissima invenzione.
DATA_CMM_2044.es: Algunos entusiastas afirman que este es el mejor invento del siglo.
DATA_CMM_2044.zht: 據說被稱為近年來最偉大的發明。
DATA_CMM_2044.zhs: 据说被称为近年来最伟大的发明。

DATA_CMM_2045.ja: A weapon that launches iron balls at high speeds. Sometimes these launch human beings instead.
DATA_CMM_2045.en: A weapon that launches iron balls at high speeds. Sometimes these launch human beings instead.
DATA_CMM_2045.fr: Arme qui envoie des balles de fer à des vitesses phénoménales. Lance parfois des hommes.
DATA_CMM_2045.de: Eine Waffe, die mit hoher Geschwindigkeit Eisenkugeln abschießt. Manchmal werden auch Menschen hineingesteckt.
DATA_CMM_2045.it: Un'arma che spara palle di ferro o uomini con dei buffi caschi.
DATA_CMM_2045.es: A veces dispara personas en lugar de bolas de hierro, pero eso suele ser en el circo.
DATA_CMM_2045.ko: 철로된 구슬을 힘차게 발사하는 무기. 가끔은 인간이 발사되는 경우도 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2045.zht: 能猛烈發射鐵球的武器。偶爾也會發射人類。
DATA_CMM_2045.zhs: 能猛烈发射铁球的武器。偶尔也会发射人类。

DATA_CMM_2046.ja: Shake the container, and a message falls out. Some messages make you happy, while others make you sad.
DATA_CMM_2046.en: Shake the container, and a message falls out. Some messages make you happy, while others make you sad.
DATA_CMM_2046.fr: Secouez le récipient et un message tombera. Certains vous font sourire, d'autres pleurer.
DATA_CMM_2046.de: Wenn man das Behältnis schüttelt, bekommt man eine Vorhersage. Manche Vorhersagen machen einen glücklich, andere eher traurig.
DATA_CMM_2046.it: Bisogna semplicemente scuotere il contenitore e prendere un messaggio. Alcuni sono buoni, altri meno.
DATA_CMM_2046.es: En esta cajita hay mensajes que predicen el futuro; sacúdela, saca uno y atente a las consecuencias.
DATA_CMM_2046.ko: 거꾸로 휘두르면 젓가락 같은 것이 튀어 나온다. 기분 좋은 젓가락과 나쁜 젓가락이 있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2046.zht: 倒過來搖晃就會掉出像筷子的東西。好像有分成開心的筷子跟不開心的筷子。
DATA_CMM_2046.zhs: 倒过来摇晃就会掉出像筷子的东西。好像有分成开心的筷子跟不开心的筷子。

DATA_CMM_2047.ja: There are lots of switches and things on this, but most of them are completely unrelated to studying.
DATA_CMM_2047.en: There are lots of switches and things on this, but most of them are completely unrelated to studying.
DATA_CMM_2047.fr: On y trouve toutes sortes d'élastiques ou d'autocollants qui n'ont rien à voir avec les études.
DATA_CMM_2047.de: Da sind viele Schalter und andere Sachen drauf, aber die meisten davon haben nichts mit Lernen zu tun.
DATA_CMM_2047.it: Un astuccio di moda tra i ragazzi.
DATA_CMM_2047.es: Está lleno de cosas, pero la mayoría no tienen nada que ver con actividades escolares.
DATA_CMM_2047.ko: 여러 가지 버튼이 달려 있으나, 공부에 도움이 되는 것은 거의 없다.
DATA_CMM_2047.zht: 附設各式各樣的機關，但好像幾乎都是些跟學習無關的東西。
DATA_CMM_2047.zhs: 附设各式各样的机关，但好像几乎都是些跟学习无关的东西。

DATA_CMM_2048.ja: If someone around you is gassy, it's safe to assume they ate one of these.
DATA_CMM_2048.en: If someone around you is gassy, it's safe to assume they ate one of these.
DATA_CMM_2048.fr: Fait moins mal qu'une patate dure lorsqu'on se la prend en pleine poire.
DATA_CMM_2048.de: Wenn jemand in der Umgebung Blähungen hat, kann man davon ausgehen, dass er eine davon gegessen hat.
DATA_CMM_2048.it: Se senti qualcuno vicino a te avere problemi d'aria, probabilmente ha mangiato una di queste.
DATA_CMM_2048.es: Si alguien a tu alrededor tiene gases, es seguro asumir que se comió uno de estos.
DATA_CMM_2048.ko: 방귀를 낀 사람이 있다면, 십중팔구 이것을 먹었을 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2048.zht: 要是有人放屁，說不定是剛才吃了地瓜。
DATA_CMM_2048.zhs: 要是有人放屁，说不定是刚才吃了地瓜。

DATA_CMM_2049.ja: Everyone sheds tears when they chop one of these up with a knife. If it's that depressing, why cut it at all?
DATA_CMM_2049.en: Everyone sheds tears when they chop one of these up with a knife. If it's that depressing, why cut it at all?
DATA_CMM_2049.fr: Tout le monde se met à pleurer lorsqu'on en coupe un. Pourquoi le couper si c'est si déprimant ?
DATA_CMM_2049.de: Jeder vergießt Tränen, wenn er so eine mit einem Messer schneidet. Wenn das so deprimierend ist, warum macht man es dann überhaupt?
DATA_CMM_2049.it: Se unita a speck e scamorza si viaggia indietro nel tempo.
DATA_CMM_2049.es: Si la gente se pone tan triste al cortarlas que llora, ¿por qué lo hacen?
DATA_CMM_2049.ko: 식칼로 자르면 모두 눈물을 흘린다. 그렇게 슬퍼할 바엔 자르지 않으면 될 것을……
DATA_CMM_2049.zht: 用菜刀切洋蔥的話大家都會流淚。既然那麼悲傷，不要切不就好了。
DATA_CMM_2049.zhs: 用菜刀切洋葱的话大家都会流泪。既然那么悲伤，不要切不就好了。

DATA_CMM_2050.ja: A gentle bird that doesn't struggle or resist when children straddle it.
DATA_CMM_2050.en: A gentle bird that doesn't struggle or resist when children straddle it.
DATA_CMM_2050.fr: Oiseau très patient qui ne résiste pas lorsque les enfants s'assoient dessus.
DATA_CMM_2050.de: Ein sanfter Vogel, der sich nicht wehrt, wenn sich Kinder auf ihn draufsetzen.
DATA_CMM_2050.it: Un uccellino gentile che non protesta mai, stranamente.
DATA_CMM_2050.es: Este pájaro es muy tranquilo; ni se mueve si los niños se sientan encima.
DATA_CMM_2050.ko: 아이들이 위에 올라타도 날뛰지 않는 착한 심성을 지닌 새.
DATA_CMM_2050.zht: 溫柔的鳥，被小孩跨坐也不會嘎嘎叫。
DATA_CMM_2050.zhs: 温柔的鸟，被小孩跨坐也不会嘎嘎叫。

DATA_CMM_2051.ja: This never falls down, but it never attacks, either. It probably won't last long in the boxing world.
DATA_CMM_2051.en: This never falls down, but it never attacks, either. It probably won't last long in the boxing world.
DATA_CMM_2051.fr: Il ne tombe jamais, mais il n'attaque jamais non plus. Pas très doué pour la boxe.
DATA_CMM_2051.de: Fällt nie um, aber greift auch nie an. Überlebt wahrscheinlich nicht sehr lange in der Boxwelt.
DATA_CMM_2051.it: Non cade mai ma non attacca nemmeno. In questo modo dimostra la sua superiorità.
DATA_CMM_2051.es: Nunca se cae, pero tampoco contraataca; no durará mucho en el boxeo.
DATA_CMM_2051.ko: 절대로 쓰러지지 않지만, 반격도 하지 않으므로 복서로서는 실격이다.
DATA_CMM_2051.zht: 絕對不會倒下，但也無法攻擊，因此並不適合當拳擊手。
DATA_CMM_2051.zhs: 绝对不会倒下，但也无法攻击，因此并不适合当拳击手。

DATA_CMM_2052.ja: If it's got its umbrella, walking stick, and canteen all ready, then why doesn't it set out already?
DATA_CMM_2052.en: If it's got its umbrella, walking stick, and canteen all ready, then why doesn't it set out already?
DATA_CMM_2052.fr: Il est prêt à partir, alors pourquoi ne s'en va-t-il pas ?
DATA_CMM_2052.de: Hat seinen Regenschirm, seinen Spazierstock und seine Feldflasche schon parat, aber warum macht er sich dann nicht auf den Weg?
DATA_CMM_2052.it: In Giappone è considerato un animale magico, per questo ha la borraccia e tutto il resto.
DATA_CMM_2052.es: Si ya tiene el paraguas, el bastón y la cantimplora, ¿cómo es que no acaba de irse?
DATA_CMM_2052.ko: 우산, 지팡이, 수통까지 매고 완벽히 여행 채비를 마친 주제에 아무리 기다려도 출발하지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_2052.zht: 手持雨傘、拐杖跟水壺準備要去旅行，但好像沒有要出發的樣子。
DATA_CMM_2052.zhs: 手持雨伞、拐杖跟水壶准备要去旅行，但好像没有要出发的样子。

DATA_CMM_2053.ja: A tiger made by gluing pieces of paper together. It nods and agrees to just about anything.
DATA_CMM_2053.en: A tiger made by gluing pieces of paper together. It nods and agrees to just about anything.
DATA_CMM_2053.fr: Tigre fait à partir de morceaux de papier collés. Ils acquiescent grosso modo à n'importe quoi.
DATA_CMM_2053.de: Ein Tiger, der aus zusammengeklebten Papierstücken besteht. Er nickt und ist eigentlich mit allem einverstanden.
DATA_CMM_2053.it: Una tigre creata incollando dei pezzi di carta, per questo non fa troppa paura.
DATA_CMM_2053.es: Se construye pegando piezas de papel. Dice que sí con la cabeza a todo.
DATA_CMM_2053.ko: 종이를 접어 만든 호랑이. 조그만 일에도 금방 고개를 끄덕거린다.
DATA_CMM_2053.zht: 紙糊成的老虎。雞毛蒜皮的小事也會立刻點頭同意。
DATA_CMM_2053.zhs: 纸糊成的老虎。鸡毛蒜皮的小事也会立刻点头同意。

DATA_CMM_2054.ja: These don't have much flavor by themselves. You'll need to put them in some brownish liquid, first.
DATA_CMM_2054.en: These don't have much flavor by themselves. You'll need to put them in some brownish liquid, first.
DATA_CMM_2054.fr: Elles n'ont pas vraiment de goût, seules. Il faut d'abord les plonger dans un liquide brun.
DATA_CMM_2054.de: Haben keinen großen Eigengeschmack. Man muss sie zuerst in eine bräunliche Flüssigkeit legen.
DATA_CMM_2054.it: Mangiati senza zuppa o salsa non sono molto saporiti.
DATA_CMM_2054.es: Solos resultan un tanto insípidos; mejor báñalos en alguna salsa.
DATA_CMM_2054.ko: 이것만 먹으면 아무 맛도 없으므로, 갈색 국물이 필요하다.

DATA_CMM_2054.zhs: 单吃竹笼荞麦面会没有味道，必须要加咖啡色的汤汁。

DATA_CMM_2055.en: Be careful when you're under one of these. You might have a load of snow dropped on you.

DATA_CMM_2055.zhs: 待在冬天针叶树下有时会被雪盖住，所以必须要小心。

DATA_CMM_2056.ja: We thought there was some kind of treasure in here. Boy, were We surprised.
DATA_CMM_2056.en: We thought there was some kind of treasure in here. Boy, were We surprised.
DATA_CMM_2056.fr: Nous pensions trouver un trésor à l'intérieur. Nom d'un Cosmos, quelle frayeur !
DATA_CMM_2056.de: Wir dachten, hier könnte sich ein Schatz drin befinden. Mann, waren wir überrascht.
DATA_CMM_2056.it: Pensavamo contenesse qualche tesoro, siamo rimasti decisamente sorpresi.
DATA_CMM_2056.es: Pensábamos que era un cofre del tesoro; menuda sorpresa nos llevamos.

DATA_CMM_2056.zhs: 才幻想着棺木里面会有哪些宝藏，结果打开一看吓得两脚瘫软。

DATA_CMM_2057.en: Apparently, We can get this souvenir that We aren't even allowed to open. To be honest, We really don't need this.

DATA_CMM_2057.ko: 절대 열어선 안된다는 상당히 민폐되는 선물을 주는 듯하다. 솔직히 그럴 거면 왜 주는데~?

DATA_CMM_2057.zhs: 似乎会送不能拆封的伴手礼，令人困扰。老实说真不想要那种东西。

DATA_CMM_2058.en: A dangerous vehicle with a large cannon attached to it. Driving this to the local supermarket is not recommended.

DATA_CMM_2058.zhs: 有大炮的危险车辆。不建议开出去兜风。

DATA_CMM_2059.ja: A toilet for boys. If there's a round thing on the bottom, that's your target.
DATA_CMM_2059.en: A toilet for boys. If there's a round thing on the bottom, that's your target.

DATA_CMM_2059.de: Eine Toilette für Jungs. Sieht man ein rundes Ding am Boden, ist das das Ziel.

DATA_CMM_2059.es: Chicos, apuntad siempre al agujerito que hay al fondo.
DATA_CMM_2059.ko: 남자 전용 화장실. 둥근 것이 들어있는데, 그것이 표적인 듯하다.

DATA_CMM_2059.zhs: 男生专用的马桶。如果里面放了个圆形，那似乎就是靶心。

DATA_CMM_2060.en: A tool for hooking fish. Get really good, and you can hook things like shoes and cans as well.

DATA_CMM_2060.de: Ein Werkzeug, um Fische an den Haken zu bekommen. Beherrscht man das richtig gut, kann man Sachen wie Schuhe und Dosen hochziehen.

DATA_CMM_2060.es: Si practicas lo suficiente, conseguirás pescar botas viejas y neumáticos.
DATA_CMM_2060.ko: 물고기를 낚는 도구. 숙달되면 장화라든지, 깡통 같은 것들도 낚아올릴 수 있게 된다고 한다.

DATA_CMM_2060.zhs: 钩鱼的道具。变熟练的话，连靴子跟罐头都能钩起来的样子。

DATA_CMM_2061.ja: This is always breathing in. We don't know when it's going to breathe out.
DATA_CMM_2061.en: This is always breathing in. We don't know when it's going to breathe out.

DATA_CMM_2061.zhs: 只顾着吸，不知道什么时候会吐出来。

DATA_CMM_2062.ja: A cute little glue stick. The lid often pops off by itself when you aren't paying attention.
DATA_CMM_2062.en: A cute little glue stick. The lid often pops off by itself when you aren't paying attention.

DATA_CMM_2062.zhs: 可爱的胶水，经常不知不觉间从盖子里漏出来。

DATA_CMM_2063.en: You put food and stuff on this dish. It's extremely handy, but too bulky to use much in the home.

DATA_CMM_2063.es: Aquí se pone comida y cosas para llevar de un lado a otro; cuidado si el pasillo es estrecho.

DATA_CMM_2064.en: Mainly used to pick up food. Otherwise, it's used to make clackity-clack sounds.

DATA_CMM_2065.en: This is a well-constructed boat, but upon closer inspection, it's too small to hold any people.

DATA_CMM_2066.en: You can use this to go forward, go backward, or even enjoy playing out your life.

DATA_CMM_2067.en: A box for teacups and dishes. The door is transparent, so it's easy to search for stuff, even if it's full.

DATA_CMM_2068.en: When this starts to flicker, it's telling you that it wants to be replaced.

DATA_CMM_2068.es: Cuando parpadea, te está diciendo en código que quiere que lo cambies.

DATA_CMM_2068.zhs: 日光灯开始闪烁，好像就是想更换的信号。

DATA_CMM_2071.en: A tool that remembers old TV pictures with its voluminous memory.

DATA_CMM_2071.es: Esta caja tiene tan buena memoria que se acuerda de películas de hace bastante tiempo.

DATA_CMM_2071.zhs: 有惊人记忆力的道具，能够记住电视播放过的图。

DATA_CMM_2072.ja: The leaves on this tree are like needles. Perhaps so it can skewer any snow that falls on it.
DATA_CMM_2072.en: The leaves on this tree are like needles. Perhaps so it can skewer any snow that falls on it.

DATA_CMM_2072.de: Die Blätter dieses Baumes sind wie Nadeln. Vielleicht spießt er so den ganzen Schnee auf, der auf ihn fällt.

DATA_CMM_2072.es: Sus hojas son como agujas; a lo mejor tejen trenzas de nieve.

DATA_CMM_2072.zhs: 说不定是为了戳穿雪，叶子才长得刺刺的。

DATA_CMM_2073.en: This stuff makes your hair all foamy, but most people rinse it out immediately. Such a waste.

DATA_CMM_2073.de: Dieses Zeug macht das Haar ganz schaumig, aber die meisten Leute spülen es sofort wieder raus. Was für eine Verschwendung.

DATA_CMM_2074.zhs: 好像有收藏家会四处收集旧书。

DATA_CMM_2075.en: This boat lets you run with the river current. It can be friends with even the most violent of rapids.

DATA_CMM_2097.zht: 覺得思考很麻煩的人們，似乎只會按照骰出的點數前進。
DATA_CMM_2097.zhs: 觉得思考很麻烦的人们，似乎只会按照骰出的点数前进。

DATA_CMM_2098.ja: Tie this to your head, and you can see the road ahead, even when it's dark. How convenient.
DATA_CMM_2098.en: Tie this to your head, and you can see the road ahead, even when it's dark. How convenient.
DATA_CMM_2098.fr: Attachez-la à votre tête et vous verrez la route, même s'il fait noir. Très pratique.
DATA_CMM_2098.de: Die bindet man sich um den Kopf, um auch im Dunkeln etwas auf der Straße zu erkennen. Echt praktisch.
DATA_CMM_2098.it: Per vedere cosa si nasconde là, avanti, sulla strada. Molto utile.
DATA_CMM_2098.es: Con esto puedes irte de excursión en plena noche y tener las manos libres para comer galletas. Qué adecuado.
DATA_CMM_2098.ko: 머리에 달면 어두워도 앞이 보이는 편리한 도구.
DATA_CMM_2098.zht: 方便的道具，戴在頭上就能看清黑暗中的道路。
DATA_CMM_2098.zhs: 方便的道具，戴在头上就能看清黑暗中的道路。

DATA_CMM_2099.ja: This tool brings you light at the flick of a switch. It's very helpful in a pinch.
DATA_CMM_2099.en: This tool brings you light at the flick of a switch. It's very helpful in a pinch.
DATA_CMM_2099.fr: Elle vous transforme en dieu de la lumière en un claquement d'interrupteur.
DATA_CMM_2099.de: Dieses Gerät erzeugt Licht auf Knopfdruck. Sehr hilfreich, wenn man in der Klemme steckt.
DATA_CMM_2099.it: Questo attrezzo porta la luce con un clic.
DATA_CMM_2099.es: Para iluminar lugares oscuros con solo hacer clic. Comprueba las pilas de vez en cuando.
DATA_CMM_2099.ko: 스위치 하나로 빛을 만드는 도구. 여차할 때 무지 편리하다.
DATA_CMM_2099.zht: 憑一個開關就能製造光亮的道具。有什麼萬一時非常方便。
DATA_CMM_2099.zhs: 凭一个开关就能制造光亮的道具。有什么万一时非常方便。

DATA_CMM_2100.ja: A drawing of the forest as seen from the sky. Even if you actually go up there, you won't see any lines or words, though.
DATA_CMM_2100.en: A drawing of the forest as seen from the sky. Even if you actually go up there, you won't see any lines or words, though.
DATA_CMM_2100.fr: Dessin de la forêt vue du ciel. Attention, la légende n'apparaît que sur la carte, pas ailleurs.
DATA_CMM_2100.de: Eine Zeichnung des Waldes aus Vogelperspektive. Wenn man wirklich hochfliegt, sieht man aber keine Linien oder Wörter.
DATA_CMM_2100.it: La mappa della foresta vista dall'alto. Anche se le scritte non ci sono davvero, sono indicazioni convenzionali.
DATA_CMM_2100.es: Parece una vista aérea, pero si vas en avión no verás los puntos ni las letras.
DATA_CMM_2100.ko: 하늘에서 바라본 숲속의 모습이 그려져 있다. 실제 그 장소에 가도 선이나 글자가 있는 것은 아니다.
DATA_CMM_2100.zht: 描繪著從空中眺望的森林。實際到該地點會發現既沒有畫線也沒有文字。
DATA_CMM_2100.zhs: 描绘着从空中眺望的森林。实际到该地点会发现既没有画线也没有文字。

DATA_CMM_2102.ja: A primitive staircase made out of tree trunks. Don't worry, it won't start rolling or anything.
DATA_CMM_2102.en: A primitive staircase made out of tree trunks. Don't worry, it won't start rolling or anything.
DATA_CMM_2102.fr: Escalier sommaire fait de rondins. Naturel et solide.
DATA_CMM_2102.de: Eine primitive Treppe aus Baumstämmen. Keine Sorge, sie fängt nicht an zu rollen oder so.
DATA_CMM_2102.it: Supporto primitivo composto da tre tronchi. Dovrebbe essere abbastanza sicuro.
DATA_CMM_2102.es: Esta escalera primitiva está hecha con troncos de árbol. No sufras, que no van a salir rodando.
DATA_CMM_2102.ko: 나무를 잘라 옆으로 놓아 만든 원시적인 계단. 넘어지지 않으므로 안심하고 오를 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_2102.zht: 原始的階梯，由樹木組裝而成。圓木不會滾走，看起來可以安心使用。
DATA_CMM_2102.zhs: 原始的阶梯，由树木组装而成。圆木不会滚走，看起来可以安心使用。

DATA_CMM_2103.ja: Apparently, the person who made this crane got very sore hands from folding such big paper.
DATA_CMM_2103.en: Apparently, the person who made this crane got very sore hands from folding such big paper.
DATA_CMM_2103.fr: La personne qui a créé cet origami a dû avoir des ampoules royales.
DATA_CMM_2103.de: Die Person, die diesen Kranich gebastelt hat, muss sich beim Falten des großen Papiers die Hände wundgescheuert haben.
DATA_CMM_2103.it: A quanto pare la persona che ha fatto questa gru origami ha delle mani estremamente sensibili e delicate.
DATA_CMM_2103.es: Suponemos que a quien la hizo le dolieron los brazos durante varios días.
DATA_CMM_2103.ko: 만들 적엔 마찰로 인해 손이 뜨거워질 정도로 문질렀다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2103.zht: 製作的時候會一直摩擦紙張，似乎會摩擦到指頭發燙的程度。
DATA_CMM_2103.zhs: 制作的时候会一直摩擦纸张，似乎会摩擦到指头发烫的程度。

DATA_CMM_2104.ja: Even after decades, this color scheme never changes.
DATA_CMM_2104.en: Even after decades, this color scheme never changes.
DATA_CMM_2104.fr: Ce motif semble indémodable. Pour les pique-niques, on ne goutte pas la nouveauté.
DATA_CMM_2104.de: Selbst nach Jahrzehnten sieht das Farbschema gleich aus.
DATA_CMM_2104.it: Passano gli anni ma questi colori vanno sempre di moda nei pic-nic.
DATA_CMM_2104.es: Este estampado no ha cambiado en los últimos 50 años.
DATA_CMM_2104.ko: 세월이 아무리 흘러도 이 색 배치만큼은 양보할 수 없다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2104.zht: 看來這種配色經過十幾年也不會退流行。
DATA_CMM_2104.zhs: 看来这种配色经过十几年也不会退流行。

DATA_CMM_2105.ja: The more expensive these are, the more susceptible they are to slippery hands or wayward balls. Be careful.
DATA_CMM_2105.en: The more expensive these are, the more susceptible they are to slippery hands or wayward balls. Be careful.
DATA_CMM_2105.fr: Plus ils sont chers, plus ils ont tendance à attirer les personnes maladroites. Méfiez-vous.
DATA_CMM_2105.de: Je teurer sie sind, desto empfänglicher werden sie für glitschige Hände oder verirrte Bälle. Vorsichtig behandeln.
DATA_CMM_2105.it: La terza legge di Sechi dice che la possibilità che un vaso venga lasciato cadere da mani goffe è direttamente proporzionale al valore del vaso stesso.
DATA_CMM_2105.es: Cuanto más caro es el jarrón, mayores probabilidades tiene de verse atacado por un balón perdido.
DATA_CMM_2105.ko: 굉장히 가치있는 물건일수록 손이 미끌어진다든지 공이 날라온다든지 하므로 주의가 필요하다.
DATA_CMM_2105.zht: 要小心，越貴的東西越容易不小心摔破或是被球砸到。
DATA_CMM_2105.zhs: 要小心，越贵的东西越容易不小心摔破或是被球砸到。

DATA_CMM_2106.ja: Believe it or not, this painful-looking creature is hiding some yummy stuff inside its body.
DATA_CMM_2106.en: Believe it or not, this painful-looking creature is hiding some yummy stuff inside its body.
DATA_CMM_2106.fr: Cette créature pleine de piquants cache une chair délicieuse.
DATA_CMM_2106.de: Ob man es glaubt oder nicht, diese schmerzhaft aussehende Kreatur verbirgt etwas Leckeres in ihrem Körper.
DATA_CMM_2106.it: Pieno di spine per difendere la carne deliziosa al proprio interno.
DATA_CMM_2106.es: Lo creas o no, dentro de ese peligroso exterior hay carne muy rica.
DATA_CMM_2106.ko: 보기만 해도 아픈 생물. 당연 그 속엔 맛있는 부분을 몰래 감추고 있다.
DATA_CMM_2106.zht: 乍看之下好像很刺人。不過凶險的外殼下果然藏著美味佳餚。
DATA_CMM_2106.zhs: 乍看之下好像很刺人。不过凶险的外壳下果然藏着美味佳肴。

DATA_CMM_2107.ja: Close your eyes and put this to your ear, and you're right by the ocean.
DATA_CMM_2107.en: Close your eyes and put this to your ear, and you're right by the ocean.
DATA_CMM_2107.fr: Fermez les yeux et ouvrez les oreilles, vous vous sentirez au bord de l'océan.
DATA_CMM_2107.de: Schließt man die Augen und hält sie sich ans Ohr, ist man direkt am Meer.
DATA_CMM_2107.it: Basta chiudere gli occhi e portarsi questa conchiglia all'orecchio per sentire il mare.
DATA_CMM_2107.es: Cierra los ojos, acércatela a la oreja y te creerás en medio del océano.
DATA_CMM_2107.ko: 귀에 대고 눈을 감으면 그곳은 이미 한여름의 바닷가.
DATA_CMM_2107.zht: 把海螺湊在耳邊閉眼傾聽，那裡就像是海灘。
DATA_CMM_2107.zhs: 把海螺凑在耳边闭眼倾听，那里就像是海滩。

DATA_CMM_2108.ja: We aren't exactly sure where this came from. Isn't it romantic?
DATA_CMM_2108.en: We aren't exactly sure where this came from. Isn't it romantic?
DATA_CMM_2108.fr: Nous ne savons pas vraiment d'où il vient. Que c'est romantique !
DATA_CMM_2108.de: Wir sind uns nicht ganz sicher, wo es herstammt. Ist das nicht romantisch?
DATA_CMM_2108.it: Se sei in montagna, in inverno e non ne possiedi... Auguri!
DATA_CMM_2108.es: No sabemos de dónde viene. ¿No es romántico?
DATA_CMM_2108.ko: 어디에서 왔는지 알 수 없는 로망이 넘치는 물건.
DATA_CMM_2108.zht: 不知道從哪來的漂流木，洋溢著浪漫風情。
DATA_CMM_2108.zhs: 不知道从哪来的漂流木，洋溢着浪漫风情。

DATA_CMM_2109.ja: An island floating in the water. If you try to get on, it might flip over.
DATA_CMM_2109.en: An island floating in the water. If you try to get on, it might flip over.
DATA_CMM_2109.fr: Celle-ci ne se mange pas. N'essayez pas de grimper dessus, vous pourriez tomber.
DATA_CMM_2109.de: Eine Insel, die im Wasser schwimmt. Wenn man sie betritt, könnte sie umkippen.
DATA_CMM_2109.it: Un'isola che galleggia nell'acqua. Le altre isole invece hanno delle fondamenta.
DATA_CMM_2109.es: Esta isla va flotando; es posible que se vuelque si intentas subirte. Ergo, no lo intentes.
DATA_CMM_2109.ko: 물에 떠있는 섬인 듯하다. 섬에 올라가면 깜짝 놀랄지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_2109.zht: 像是漂浮水上的島。登上島嶼也許會導致整座島翻倒過來。
DATA_CMM_2109.zhs: 像是漂浮水上的岛。登上岛屿也许会导致整座岛翻倒过来。

DATA_CMM_2110.fr: C'est le port d'attache de l'île flottante.
DATA_CMM_2110.it: Una roccia che supporta l'isola galleggiante.
DATA_CMM_2110.es: Para que la isla flotante no se hunda con el peso de las palmeras.

DATA_CMM_2111.ja: It's very flat, but that doesn't mean someone stepped on it or anything.
DATA_CMM_2111.en: It's very flat, but that doesn't mean someone stepped on it or anything.
DATA_CMM_2111.fr: Il n'aime pas beaucoup sa silhouette, mais il s'arrange.
DATA_CMM_2111.de: Sie ist sehr flach, aber das heißt nicht, dass da jemand draufgetreten ist oder so.
DATA_CMM_2111.es: Está muy plano, pero eso no es porque lo hayan pisado.
DATA_CMM_2111.ko: 굉장히 얇아져 있지만 누군가 일부러 망가뜨린 것은 아니라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2111.zht: 變得非常薄，但似乎不是被打扁的。
DATA_CMM_2111.zhs: 变得非常薄，但似乎不是被打扁的。

DATA_CMM_2112.ja: We thought fish took shelter from the rain under these, but apparently We were wrong.
DATA_CMM_2112.en: We thought fish took shelter from the rain under these, but apparently We were wrong.
DATA_CMM_2112.fr: Nous croyions que des poissons s'étaient réfugiés dessous pendant l'orage, mais Nous Nous trompâmes.
DATA_CMM_2112.de: Wir dachten, dass Fische darunter Schutz vorm Regen suchen, aber da haben wir uns wohl geirrt.
DATA_CMM_2112.it: Sembra fatto apposta perché i pesci si riparino dalla pioggia. Poi Ci ha colpito una rivelazione: perché i pesci dovrebbero ripararsi dall'acqua?
DATA_CMM_2112.es: Creíamos que los peces se protegían aquí de la lluvia, pero no.
DATA_CMM_2112.ko: 이 밑에서 물고기들이 비를 피하는 것이라고 생각했으나, 그런 것은 아니었나 보다.
DATA_CMM_2112.zht: 以為魚會在底下躲雨，但好像並非如此。
DATA_CMM_2112.zhs: 以为鱼会在底下躲雨，但好像并非如此。

DATA_CMM_2113.ja: This coral may be round, but it's too precious to roll around.
DATA_CMM_2113.en: This coral may be round, but it's too precious to roll around.
DATA_CMM_2113.fr: Ce corail a beau être rond, il est trop précieux pour rouler beaucoup.
DATA_CMM_2113.de: Diese Koralle mag rund sein, aber sie ist zu wertvoll, um herumzurollen.
DATA_CMM_2113.it: Rotondo e troppo prezioso per essere ignorato.
DATA_CMM_2113.es: Aunque sea redondo, está fijado al fondo y se niega a rodar.
DATA_CMM_2113.ko: 둥글지만 굴려서는 안 되는 귀중한 생물.
DATA_CMM_2113.zht: 珍貴的生物，雖然是圓形但不能滾動。
DATA_CMM_2113.zhs: 珍贵的生物，虽然是圆形但不能滚动。

DATA_CMM_2114.ja: This used to be all sharp and spiky, but it's rounded off recently.
DATA_CMM_2114.en: This used to be all sharp and spiky, but it's rounded off recently.
DATA_CMM_2114.fr: Autrefois, il se piquait d'être piquant, mais il s'est tourné vers un style plus rond.
DATA_CMM_2114.de: War früher total scharf und stachelig, ist in letzter Zeit aber abgerundet.
DATA_CMM_2114.it: Una volta era più spinoso, ma ora, con l'età e l'erosione, ha imparato a smussare i lati più duri del suo carattere e del suo corpo.
DATA_CMM_2114.es: Antes estaba lleno de cantos agudos, pero ha cogido algo de peso.
DATA_CMM_2114.ko: 예전엔 모가 났었지만 지금은 둥글게 변했다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2114.zht: 以前很尖銳，但是最近好像變圓滑了。
DATA_CMM_2114.zhs: 以前很尖锐，但是最近好像变圆滑了。

DATA_CMM_2115.ja: This is pretty as is, but a lot of polishing would make it sparkle even more beautifully.
DATA_CMM_2115.en: This is pretty as is, but a lot of polishing would make it sparkle even more beautifully.
DATA_CMM_2115.fr: Assez joli, mais s'il était plus poli, il brillerait encore plus.
DATA_CMM_2115.de: Sie ist schon hübsch, so wie sie ist, aber mit viel Politur würde sie noch mehr glänzen.
DATA_CMM_2115.it: Bello così com'è, anche se una bella pulita e levigatura lo renderebbe ancora più splendido.
DATA_CMM_2115.es: Muy bonito, pero si lo pulieran un poco estaría aún mejor.
DATA_CMM_2115.ko: 그대로도 아름답지만, 흔들어 놓으면 더욱 아름답게 빛을 내는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2115.zht: 原本就很漂亮了，但只要使勁擦拭好像就會散發非常漂亮的光芒。
DATA_CMM_2115.zhs: 原本就很漂亮了，但只要使劲擦拭好像就会散发非常漂亮的光芒。

DATA_CMM_2116.ja: An original decorative item made from a rice cake.
DATA_CMM_2116.en: An original decorative item made from a rice cake.
DATA_CMM_2116.fr: Objet décoratif original créé à partir d'un gâteau de riz.
DATA_CMM_2116.de: Ein origineller Dekorationsartikel, der aus einem Reiskuchen gemacht wurde.
DATA_CMM_2116.es: Original objeto decorativo fabricado con un pastelillo de arroz descomunal.
DATA_CMM_2116.ko: 먹는 떡을 손질해서 장식품으로 만든 아이디어 상품.
DATA_CMM_2116.zht: 創意商品，設法把食用麻糬做成擺飾。
DATA_CMM_2116.zhs: 创意商品，设法把食用麻糬做成摆饰。

DATA_CMM_2117.ja: We have to admit, eating all this would certainly make you large.
DATA_CMM_2117.en: We have to admit, eating all this would certainly make you large.
DATA_CMM_2117.fr: Il Nous faut admettre que celui qui le mangerait tout entier gonflerait, très certainement.
DATA_CMM_2117.de: Zugegeben, wenn man das alles verputzt, wird man ganz schön dick.
DATA_CMM_2117.it: Mangiare tutta questa carne farebbe di sicuro ingrassare.
DATA_CMM_2117.es: Comerse todo esto de una sentada no puede ser bueno para la salud.
DATA_CMM_2117.ko: 분명 다 먹으면 키가 클 것 같은 기분이 들기는 한다.
DATA_CMM_2117.zht: 好像全部吃光就能長得很大。
DATA_CMM_2117.zhs: 好像全部吃光就能长得很大。

DATA_CMM_2118.ja: You can find this little guy just about anytime except when you actually need one.
DATA_CMM_2118.en: You can find this little guy just about anytime except when you actually need one.
DATA_CMM_2118.fr: Vous le trouvez à peu près partout, sauf là où vous en avez vraiment besoin.
DATA_CMM_2118.de: Findet man ständig, außer wenn man mal einen braucht.
DATA_CMM_2118.it: Si trovano sempre, tranne quando servono.
DATA_CMM_2118.es: Se encuentran por todas partes, excepto cuando se necesita uno, claro está.
DATA_CMM_2118.ko: 아무데나 굴러다닐 듯한 돌맹이. 필요할 땐 꼭 안보이는 심술쟁이.
DATA_CMM_2118.zht: 平常隨處可見的小石子。需要它的時候反而找不到。
DATA_CMM_2118.zhs: 平常随处可见的小石子。需要它的时候反而找不到。

DATA_CMM_2119.ja: A flat shell that could probably also be used as a plate for food.
DATA_CMM_2119.en: A flat shell that could probably also be used as a plate for food.
DATA_CMM_2119.fr: Coquillage plat qui pourrait sans doute également être utilisé comme assiette.
DATA_CMM_2119.de: Eine flache Schale, die wahrscheinlich auch als Teller für Essen benutzt werden könnte.
DATA_CMM_2119.it: Una conchiglia piatta che può essere usata come posacenere.
DATA_CMM_2119.es: Hay quien las guarda como jabonera, o incluso para fabricar biquinis.
DATA_CMM_2119.zht: 扁平的貝殼。似乎更像是食物。
DATA_CMM_2119.zhs: 扁平的贝壳。似乎更像是食物。

DATA_CMM_2120.ja: A spiraling shell. Mistake it for soft serve ice cream and it'll hurt.
DATA_CMM_2120.en: A spiraling shell. Mistake it for soft serve ice cream and it'll hurt.
DATA_CMM_2120.fr: Il fait des vrilles infinies. Ce n'est pas un cornet à glace, attention !
DATA_CMM_2120.de: Eine spiralförmige Schale. Verwechselt man sie mit einem Softeis, tut’s bestimmt weh.
DATA_CMM_2120.it: Una conchiglia a spirale, sembra gelato ma in realtà ha una diversa consistenza.
DATA_CMM_2120.es: En una heladería en el fondo del mar podría pasar por un helado de máquina.
DATA_CMM_2120.ko: 빙글빙글 돌고 있는 조개 껍질. 소프트 아이스와 착각하면 낭패를 볼 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2120.zht: 層層盤繞的貝殼。要是跟霜淇淋搞錯會嘗到苦頭。
DATA_CMM_2120.zhs: 层层盘绕的贝壳。要是跟霜淇淋搞错会尝到苦头。

DATA_CMM_2121.ja: If We went inside this shell, Our body would get all twisted up and We'd look very uncool.
DATA_CMM_2121.en: If We went inside this shell, Our body would get all twisted up and We'd look very uncool.
DATA_CMM_2121.fr: Si Nous entrions dans ce coquillage, Nous serions bigrement écorné en en sortant.
DATA_CMM_2121.de: Wenn wir in diese Schale schlüpfen wollten, müssten wir unseren Körper wohl völlig verdrehen und dabei echt uncool aussehen.
DATA_CMM_2121.it: Se entrassimo in questa conchiglia il Nostro corpo sarebbe tutto arrotolato e perderemmo gran parte del Nostro fascino.
DATA_CMM_2121.es: Vivir aquí dentro debe de ser muy doloroso para un ser con huesos.
DATA_CMM_2121.ko: 나선형 집안에 들어가 있으면 몸도 꽈배기가 되어, 참 볼품없을 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2121.zht: 要進這種殼，身體必須捲來捲去，感覺不太好。
DATA_CMM_2121.zhs: 要进这种壳，身体必须卷来卷去，感觉不太好。

DATA_CMM_2122.ja: This is really huge. Practically family-sized.
DATA_CMM_2122.en: This is really huge. Practically family-sized.
DATA_CMM_2122.fr: Ne vous fiez pas à son nom, elle est énorme, donc très lourde.
DATA_CMM_2122.de: Die ist wirklich riesig. Im Prinzip in Familiengröße.
DATA_CMM_2122.es: Debe de ser el modelo familiar.
DATA_CMM_2122.ko: 굉장히 크다. 소위 이야기하는 패밀리 사이즈.
DATA_CMM_2122.zht: 非常巨大。這就是所謂的家庭號。
DATA_CMM_2122.zhs: 非常巨大。这就是所谓的家庭号。

DATA_CMM_2123.ja: This looks like it would hurt if it stabbed you, but it has no intention of doing that.
DATA_CMM_2123.en: This looks like it would hurt if it stabbed you, but it has no intention of doing that.
DATA_CMM_2123.fr: Il pourrait sans doute vous faire très mal s'il vous piquait, mais il est très pacifique.
DATA_CMM_2123.de: Sieht so aus, als würde es wehtun, wenn sie einen pikst, aber sie hat nicht die Absicht, einen zu piksen.
DATA_CMM_2123.es: Se puede usar como flecha en un juego de pistas o como galleta en la heladería del fondo del mar.
DATA_CMM_2123.ko: 찔리면 아플 것 같으나, 찌를 생각은 애초에 없는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2123.zht: 被刺到感覺會很痛，但三角貝殼似乎完全沒有打算要刺人。
DATA_CMM_2123.zhs: 被刺到感觉会很痛，但三角贝壳似乎完全没有打算要刺人。

DATA_CMM_2124.fr: Un livre rempli de contenu branché.
DATA_CMM_2124.it: Un libro con contenuti alla moda.
DATA_CMM_2124.ko: 패션에 정답은 없지만 방향성을 제시해 주는 책.
DATA_CMM_2124.zht: 裡面有很多關於流行時尚內容的書。
DATA_CMM_2124.zhs: 里面有很多关于流行时尚内容的书。

DATA_CMM_2125.ja: When playing hide-and-seek, you should tell everyone that you're here, lest you get locked inside.
DATA_CMM_2125.en: When playing hide-and-seek, you should tell everyone that you're here, lest you get locked inside.
DATA_CMM_2125.fr: Si vous jouez à cache-cache, évitez cette cachette cadenassée qui pourrait bien vous enfermer, petit cachottier !
DATA_CMM_2125.de: Beim Versteckspielen sollte man allen sagen, dass man sich hier versteckt, damit man nicht eingeschlossen wird.
DATA_CMM_2125.it: Ideale per giocare a nascondino in multiplayer ma è sempre meglio avvisare qualcuno delle proprie intenzioni prima di rimanervi chiuso a vita.
DATA_CMM_2125.es: No te metas ahí para jugar al escondite, que igual te encierran.
DATA_CMM_2125.ko: 숨바꼭질을 할 경우에는 문이 잠기지 않도록 안에 있다는 것을 확실히 어필해야 한다.
DATA_CMM_2125.zht: 必須要說清楚玩捉迷藏的時候不能鎖門吧？
DATA_CMM_2125.zhs: 必须要说清楚玩捉迷藏的时候不能锁门吧？

DATA_CMM_2126.ja: The teacher's desk. As you'd expect, there aren't any textbooks or notebooks inside.
DATA_CMM_2126.en: The teacher's desk. As you'd expect, there aren't any textbooks or notebooks inside.
DATA_CMM_2126.fr: Il y a peu de cahiers et de livres à l'intérieur. Il les emporte avec lui, car il ne peut pas s'en passer.
DATA_CMM_2126.de: Das Lehrerpult. Erwartungsgemäß befinden sich darin keine Lehrbücher oder Hefte.
DATA_CMM_2126.it: Pulpito per insegnanti, non nasconde né libri né quaderni.
DATA_CMM_2126.es: No, lamentablemente el profesor no se ha olvidado el examen de mañana en el cajón de la mesa...
DATA_CMM_2126.ko: 선생님 책상. 역시 교과서나 노트는 안 들어있는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2126.zht: 老師的桌子。裡面當然沒放課本或筆記本。
DATA_CMM_2126.zhs: 老师的桌子。里面当然没放课本或笔记本。

DATA_CMM_2127.ja: If you're enjoying class, you can always switch this off.
DATA_CMM_2127.en: If you're enjoying class, you can always switch this off.
DATA_CMM_2127.fr: Si vous aimez les cours, vous pouvez toujours l'éteindre.
DATA_CMM_2127.de: Wenn einem der Unterricht Spaß macht, kann man ihn jederzeit ausschalten.
DATA_CMM_2127.it: Utilissima per i concerti in piena notte con la complicità delle tenebre.
DATA_CMM_2127.es: Si lo pones a un volumen suficientemente alto, puedes hacer saltar los cristales, o eso dicen.
DATA_CMM_2127.ko: 수업이 재미있을 경우에는 이것의 스위치를 끊어놓자.
DATA_CMM_2127.zht: 如果覺得課堂有趣，可以把教室廣播的開關關掉。
DATA_CMM_2127.zhs: 如果觉得课堂有趣，可以把教室广播的开关关掉。

DATA_CMM_2128.ja: You'll get in trouble if you use it as a cape.
DATA_CMM_2128.en: You'll get in trouble if you use it as a cape.
DATA_CMM_2128.fr: Vous aurez des soucis si vous l'utilisez comme toge ou cape.
DATA_CMM_2128.de: Du bekommst Ärger, wenn du ihn als Umhang benutzt.
DATA_CMM_2128.it: Una tenda che può essere usata anche come toga.
DATA_CMM_2128.es: Buen escondite, pero que no te asomen los pies por debajo.
DATA_CMM_2128.zht: 把自己捲進窗簾裡玩，好像會被罵。
DATA_CMM_2128.zhs: 把自己卷进窗帘里玩，好像会被骂。

DATA_CMM_2129.ja: A bulb that lights up the classroom. When this burns out, the tallest guy in class suddenly becomes a hero.
DATA_CMM_2129.en: A bulb that lights up the classroom. When this burns out, the tallest guy in class suddenly becomes a hero.
DATA_CMM_2129.fr: Elle éclaire la classe. Lorsqu'elle grille, le garçon le plus grand se retrouve sous les feux de la rampe.
DATA_CMM_2129.de: Eine Glühbirne, die Klassenzimmer erhellt. Brennt sie durch, wird der Größte in der Klasse plötzlich zum Helden.
DATA_CMM_2129.it: Un neon usato per illuminare la classe. Quando si brucia, il più alto della classe diventa un eroe.
DATA_CMM_2129.es: Sería ideal para jugar a sables espaciales, si no fuera porque se apaga al sacarlo de sitio.
DATA_CMM_2129.ko: 교실을 밝게 비추는 전기. 이것이 꺼져 있을 때는 키가 큰 학생이 일약 영웅으로 부각된다.
DATA_CMM_2129.zht: 照亮教室的燈。教室日光燈熄滅的話，身材高大的學生會一躍成為英雄。
DATA_CMM_2129.zhs: 照亮教室的灯。教室日光灯熄灭的话，身材高大的学生会一跃成为英雄。

DATA_CMM_2130.ja: These mats are laid on the floors of Japanese homes. If you counted all the wrinkles in them, you'd likely get very sleepy.
DATA_CMM_2130.en: These mats are laid on the floors of Japanese homes. If you counted all the wrinkles in them, you'd likely get very sleepy.
DATA_CMM_2130.fr: Ces matelas sont posés sur le sol des maisons japonaises. Vous pouvez essayer de compter leurs rides pour vous endormir.
DATA_CMM_2130.de: Solche Matten findet man auf Böden japanischer Häuser. Wenn man alle Falten auf ihnen zählen würde, schliefe man wahrscheinlich ein.
DATA_CMM_2130.it: Questi tappeti costituiscono i pavimenti delle case giapponesi tradizionali.
DATA_CMM_2130.es: Estas esteras adornan todos los hogares japoneses. Ideales para la siesta del gato.
DATA_CMM_2130.ko: 일본 가정에 깔려있는 양탄자.잠이 안 올 때, 짚단 주름의 수를 세면 금세 잠들 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_2130.zht: 日本住宅鋪滿了榻榻米。若要數摺痕的數量大概會睡著。
DATA_CMM_2130.zhs: 日本住宅铺满了榻榻米。若要数折痕的数量大概会睡着。

DATA_CMM_2131.ja: These gym clothes have been neatly folded. The refreshing scent of sunshine is still on them.
DATA_CMM_2131.en: These gym clothes have been neatly folded. The refreshing scent of sunshine is still on them.
DATA_CMM_2131.fr: Ils sont pliés avec art. La bonne odeur de la lessive a remplacé celle de la sueur...
DATA_CMM_2131.de: Diese Turnsachen sind anständig zusammengelegt. Der erfrischende Duft der Sonne liegt noch in der Luft.
DATA_CMM_2131.it: Usata per fare ginnastica, per fortuna è pulita e profuma di fresco.
DATA_CMM_2131.es: Huele tan a fresco que parece un anuncio de detergente.
DATA_CMM_2131.ko: 예쁘게 개어진 체조복. 햇살의 향취가 풍겨나와 매우 상쾌하다.
DATA_CMM_2131.zht: 疊整齊的體育服。聞起來有太陽的味道，非常清爽。
DATA_CMM_2131.zhs: 迭整齐的体育服。闻起来有太阳的味道，非常清爽。

DATA_CMM_2132.ja: Show this to your parents, and you'll get to eat something good. Too bad these are so hard to get.
DATA_CMM_2132.en: Show this to your parents, and you'll get to eat something good. Too bad these are so hard to get.
DATA_CMM_2132.fr: Montrez ça à vos parents et vous aurez une petite récompense. Dommage que ce soit si difficile à obtenir.
DATA_CMM_2132.de: Zeigt man die seinen Eltern, bekommt man was Tolles zu essen. Schade, dass sie so schwer zu erreichen sind.
DATA_CMM_2132.it: Un'ottima valutazione, da mostrare ad amici e genitori con orgoglio.
DATA_CMM_2132.es: Si se las enseñas a tus padres, puede haber premio. Lo malo es que son difíciles de conseguir.
DATA_CMM_2132.ko: 이것을 부모님께 보여주면 맛있는 음식이 나온다. 그러나 얻기가 매우 어렵다.
DATA_CMM_2132.zht: 對父母展示的話就能拿到好吃的東西。但是得到100分很困難。
DATA_CMM_2132.zhs: 对父母展示的话就能拿到好吃的东西。但是得到100分很困难。

DATA_CMM_2133.ja: This is very embarrassing to show to your parents, but as far as comedy material goes, this is a perfect 100.
DATA_CMM_2133.en: This is very embarrassing to show to your parents, but as far as comedy material goes, this is a perfect 100.
DATA_CMM_2133.fr: Toujours très embêtant à montrer à ses parents, mais en contrepartie, vous apprenez la négociation.
DATA_CMM_2133.de: Echt peinlich, die seinen Eltern zu zeigen, aber für die großen Augen gibt es die Note 1.
DATA_CMM_2133.it: Una pessima valutazione da mostrare ai tuoi genitori, ma è ottima come materiale comico.
DATA_CMM_2133.es: Por más vueltas que le des se acabarán enterando de que lo tienes, así que mejor confiésalo.
DATA_CMM_2133.ko: 부끄러워서 부모님께 보여줄 수 없으나, 임팩트는 100점 짜리다.
DATA_CMM_2133.zht: 0分太丟臉不能給父母看，但作為笑話哽是100分。
DATA_CMM_2133.zhs: 0分太丢脸不能给父母看，但作为笑话哽是100分。

DATA_CMM_2134.ja: We aren't sure if this is a flute or a piano, but either way, it's fun. Press the button and liquid comes out.
DATA_CMM_2134.en: We aren't sure if this is a flute or a piano, but either way, it's fun. Press the button and liquid comes out.
DATA_CMM_2134.fr: Croisement entre la flûte et le piano, très original. Appuyez sur le bouton pour que du liquide en sorte.
DATA_CMM_2134.de: Wir sind uns nicht sicher, ob das eine Flöte oder ein Klavier ist, aber witzig ist es dennoch. Drückt man den Knopf, kommt Flüssigkeit heraus.
DATA_CMM_2134.it: Sembra uno strumento nato da un piano e un flauto.
DATA_CMM_2134.es: No sabemos si es una flauta o un piano, así que, además de instrumento musical, es un enigma.
DATA_CMM_2134.ko: 피리인지 피아노인지 헛갈리지만 어쨌든 즐거운 악기. 버튼을 누르면 액체가 빠져 나온다.
DATA_CMM_2134.zht: 不確定口風琴算鋼琴還是笛子，總之很有意思。壓下按鈕會流出液體。
DATA_CMM_2134.zhs: 不确定口风琴算钢琴还是笛子，总之很有意思。压下按钮会流出液体。

DATA_CMM_2135.ja: You receive this when you do something cool. If the deed was really awesome, it comes in a special case.
DATA_CMM_2135.en: You receive this when you do something cool. If the deed was really awesome, it comes in a special case.
DATA_CMM_2135.fr: Vous le recevez pour vous rappeler toute votre vie ce que vous avez réussi.
DATA_CMM_2135.de: Erhält man, wenn man etwas Cooles geschafft hat. Wenn es eine wirklich tolle Tat war, bekommt man zusätzlich noch ein besonderes Etui.
DATA_CMM_2135.it: Lo si riceve dopo anni di sofferenze, per dimostrare di avere una certa resistenza al dolore.
DATA_CMM_2135.es: La gente que tiene muchos de estos colgados en la pared suele impresionar bastante.
DATA_CMM_2135.ko: 뭔가 대단한 일을 해냈을 때 받는 것. 더욱 대단한 경우에는 특제 케이스에 넣어 준다.
DATA_CMM_2135.zht: 做出了不起的事情時可以拿到獎狀，特別厲害的話還會裝進特製的盒子裡。
DATA_CMM_2135.zhs: 做出了不起的事情时可以拿到奖状，特别厉害的话还会装进特制的盒子里。

DATA_CMM_2136.ja: This is a little too heavy to drink from.
DATA_CMM_2136.en: This is a little too heavy to drink from.
DATA_CMM_2136.fr: Un peu trop lourd pour servir de coupe...
DATA_CMM_2136.de: Ist so schwer, dass sich daraus nur schwer trinken lässt.
DATA_CMM_2136.it: Una coppa che non viene usata per bere.
DATA_CMM_2136.es: Por desgracia, es demasiado pesada para beber en ella.
DATA_CMM_2136.zht: 拿來喝飲料會有點太重。
DATA_CMM_2136.zhs: 拿来喝饮料会有点太重。

DATA_CMM_2137.ja: This bag is huge, yet there's nothing but black paint inside.
DATA_CMM_2137.en: This bag is huge, yet there's nothing but black paint inside.
DATA_CMM_2137.fr: Ce sac est énorme, mais il ne contient rien d'autre que de la peinture noire.
DATA_CMM_2137.de: Diese Tasche ist riesig, aber da ist nur schwarze Farbe drin.
DATA_CMM_2137.it: Il fato vuole che una cartuccia di inchiostro si sia rotta al suo interno.
DATA_CMM_2137.es: Es enorme, pero dentro solo tiene un líquido negro.
DATA_CMM_2137.ko: 이렇게 큰 가방인데도 검은 물감밖에 안 들어있다.
DATA_CMM_2137.zht: 容量這麼大卻只放了黑色顏料。
DATA_CMM_2137.zhs: 容量这么大却只放了黑色颜料。

DATA_CMM_2138.ja: The bag may be red, but you can still only draw black characters.
DATA_CMM_2138.en: The bag may be red, but you can still only draw black characters.
DATA_CMM_2138.fr: Il est peut-être rouge, mais vous ne pourrez dessiner que des caractères noirs.
DATA_CMM_2138.de: Auch wenn die Tasche rot ist, kann man trotzdem nur schwarze Zeichen zeichnen.
DATA_CMM_2138.it: La borsa è apparentemente rossa, ma in realtà l'inchiostro contenuto è nero.
DATA_CMM_2138.es: Aunque el estuche sea rojo, solo puedes dibujar caracteres en negro.
DATA_CMM_2138.ko: 가방은 빨갛지만 역시 검은 글자밖에 쓰지 못하는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2138.zht: 即便袋子變成紅色，好像還是只能寫出黑色的字。
DATA_CMM_2138.zhs: 即便袋子变成红色，好像还是只能写出黑色的字。

DATA_CMM_2139.ja: You can get answers by clacking the beads with your fingers. Some experts can even work these in their minds.
DATA_CMM_2139.en: You can get answers by clacking the beads with your fingers. Some experts can even work these in their minds.
DATA_CMM_2139.fr: En faisant glisser ses perles avec les doigts, vous répondez à vos questions. Pourquoi utiliser des ordinateurs ?
DATA_CMM_2139.de: Man erhält Antworten, indem man Perlen mit den Fingern zum Klappern bringt. Es gibt Experten, die können das sogar im Kopf.
DATA_CMM_2139.it: Serve per contare oltre al dieci.
DATA_CMM_2139.es: Las respuestas a tus preguntas en unas bolas que hacen ruido. Ya solo lo manejan unos pocos nostálgicos.
DATA_CMM_2139.ko: 손가락으로 짤각짤각 거리면 답이 나온다. 짤각거리지 않고 답을 내는 달인도 있는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2139.zht: 用手指啪嚓啪嚓打算盤，答案就呼之欲出。似乎也有用不著打算盤也能得出答案的高手。
DATA_CMM_2139.zhs: 用手指啪嚓啪嚓打算盘，答案就呼之欲出。似乎也有用不着打算盘也能得出答案的高手。

DATA_CMM_2140.ja: People occasionally draw works of art on the back of these.
DATA_CMM_2140.en: People occasionally draw works of art on the back of these.
DATA_CMM_2140.fr: Les gens dessinent parfois des œuvres d'art au dos de ceux-ci.
DATA_CMM_2140.de: Gelegentlich zeichnen Menschen Kunstwerke auf die Rückseite solcher Papiere.
DATA_CMM_2140.es: En el reverso suelen encontrarse obras de arte del dibujo improvisado.
DATA_CMM_2140.ko: 뒷편에 예술 작품이 그려져 있는 경우도 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2140.zht: 有時背面會畫著藝術大作。
DATA_CMM_2140.zhs: 有时背面会画着艺术大作。

DATA_CMM_2141.ja: The teacher probably wouldn't remember anybody's names unless he looked at this in the morning.
DATA_CMM_2141.en: The teacher probably wouldn't remember anybody's names unless he looked at this in the morning.
DATA_CMM_2141.fr: L'aide-mémoire du professeur pour les noms des élèves.
DATA_CMM_2141.de: Lehrer würden sich wahrscheinlich an keinen Schülernamen erinnern, wenn sie nicht morgens hier reinsehen würden.
DATA_CMM_2141.it: Perché gli studenti devono sapere date e dati a memoria mentre gli insegnanti hanno bisogno del registro per ricordarsi i nomi degli alunni?
DATA_CMM_2141.es: Hay profesores que se pasan un año leyendo los nombres y aun así no se los aprenden.
DATA_CMM_2141.ko: 선생님은 아침에 이걸 보지 않으면, 이름을 기억하지 못하는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2141.zht: 老師早上不看點名簿似乎就會想不起名字。
DATA_CMM_2141.zhs: 老师早上不看点名簿似乎就会想不起名字。

DATA_CMM_2142.ja: No matter which file you open, you won't find any secret letters.
DATA_CMM_2142.en: No matter which file you open, you won't find any secret letters.
DATA_CMM_2142.fr: Ouvrez le dossier que vous voulez, vous ne serez jamais pris de court.
DATA_CMM_2142.de: Egal welche Akte man auch öffnet, man findet keine geheimen Briefe.
DATA_CMM_2142.es: Da igual dónde mires, aquí no vas a encontrar secretos dignos de espionaje.
DATA_CMM_2142.ko: 아무리 뒤져봐도 비밀 편지는 안 들어있는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2142.zht: 好像不管開哪個抽屜，都不會有秘密信件。
DATA_CMM_2142.zhs: 好像不管开哪个抽屉，都不会有秘密信件。

DATA_CMM_2143.ja: A chair used while working. This can tire your body out, so you don't want to sit on it for too long.
DATA_CMM_2143.en: A chair used while working. This can tire your body out, so you don't want to sit on it for too long.
DATA_CMM_2143.fr: Pratique pour travailler. Curieusement, votre corps n'aime pas s'asseoir trop longtemps, alors attention.
DATA_CMM_2143.de: Ein Stuhl für die Arbeit. Ermüdet den Körper, deshalb sollte man nicht zu lange darauf sitzen.
DATA_CMM_2143.it: Una sedia usata quando si lavora, probabilmente studiata per migliorare le abilità lavorative delle persone.
DATA_CMM_2143.es: Su efecto secundario es provocar gran cansancio, así que procura no sentarte mucho en ella.
DATA_CMM_2143.ko: 일을 할 때 사용하는 의자. 꽤나 피곤하므로 장시간 앉아있고 싶은 생각은 없다.
DATA_CMM_2143.zht: 工作用的椅子。好像因為心力交瘁而不想久坐。
DATA_CMM_2143.zhs: 工作用的椅子。好像因为心力交瘁而不想久坐。

DATA_CMM_2144.ja: Students look forward to getting these every day. You can't leave any food behind, even if you don't like it.
DATA_CMM_2144.en: Students look forward to getting these every day. You can't leave any food behind, even if you don't like it.
DATA_CMM_2144.fr: Les élèves attendent son arrivée avec impatience chaque jour. C'est pour cela qu'ils n'ont pas le droit d'y laisser de la nourriture.
DATA_CMM_2144.de: Schüler freuen sich jeden Tag darauf. Man darf kein Essen darauf zurücklassen, auch wenn man es nicht mag.
DATA_CMM_2144.it: Gli studenti lo usano moltissimo, forse perché mangiare è necessario.
DATA_CMM_2144.es: Soporte del alimento para los cerebros estudiantes; aunque no te guste, nunca te dejas nada.
DATA_CMM_2144.ko: 하루 중, 학생들이 가장 고대하는 것. 싫어하는 음식이라도 남겨서는 안된다.
DATA_CMM_2144.zht: 學生每天的期待。就算是討厭的食物也不能吃剩。
DATA_CMM_2144.zhs: 学生每天的期待。就算是讨厌的食物也不能吃剩。

DATA_CMM_2145.ja: These panels separate the toilets. Without these, the doors wouldn't have much meaning.
DATA_CMM_2145.en: These panels separate the toilets. Without these, the doors wouldn't have much meaning.
DATA_CMM_2145.fr: Ces panneaux séparent les toilettes. Sans eux, les portes seraient en porte-à-faux.
DATA_CMM_2145.de: Diese Wände trennen Toiletten voneinander. Ohne die hätten die Türen keinen großen Sinn.
DATA_CMM_2145.it: Questi pannelli separano i vari bagni, sia lodato chi li ha inventati!
DATA_CMM_2145.es: Sirve para sujetar las puertas que, de lo contrario, tendrían que flotar.
DATA_CMM_2145.ko: 화장실과 화장실을 나누는 판. 이게 없으면 문이 있어봐야 아무 소용없다.
DATA_CMM_2145.zht: 隔出一間間廁所的板子。有門但沒有廁所隔板的話也沒有意義。
DATA_CMM_2145.zhs: 隔出一间间厕所的板子。有门但没有厕所隔板的话也没有意义。

DATA_CMM_2146.ja: The door to the toilet. Broken doors that open while you're inside tend to cause panic.
DATA_CMM_2146.en: The door to the toilet. Broken doors that open while you're inside tend to cause panic.
DATA_CMM_2146.fr: Porte de toilettes. Celles qui sont cassées et qui s'ouvrent n'importe quand provoquent la panique.
DATA_CMM_2146.de: Eine Tür zur Toilette. Kaputte Türen, die sich öffnen, während man drinnen ist, lösen oft Panik aus.
DATA_CMM_2146.it: La porta dei bagni, sempre meglio sceglierne una la cui serratura funzioni.
DATA_CMM_2146.es: Las puertas sin cerrojo que se abren mientras estás dentro suelen causar pánico.
DATA_CMM_2146.ko: 화장실 문. 한 번도 열린 적이 없는 문이 세계 어딘가에 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2146.zht: 廁所的門。某處似乎有打不開的廁所門。
DATA_CMM_2146.zhs: 厕所的门。某处似乎有打不开的厕所门。

DATA_CMM_2147.ja: Apparently, everyone is trying their best to reach these goals. We think they can do it if they work together.
DATA_CMM_2147.en: Apparently, everyone is trying their best to reach these goals. We think they can do it if they work together.
DATA_CMM_2147.fr: Chacun fait de son mieux pour atteindre ces objectifs. Nous pensons qu'ils peuvent y arriver en coopérant.
DATA_CMM_2147.de: Offensichtlich gibt hier jeder sein Bestes, um seine Ziele zu erreichen. Wir glauben, dass es alle schaffen können, wenn sie zusammenarbeiten.
DATA_CMM_2147.it: Ognuno in classe sta cercando di fare il proprio meglio per raggiungere questi obiettivi.
DATA_CMM_2147.es: Aquí aparecen las metas a alcanzar. Seguro que lo conseguirán si trabajan unidos.
DATA_CMM_2147.ko: 모두 힘을 합쳐 이것을 목표로 노력하고 있는 것 같다. 열심히 하면 반드시 가능할 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2147.zht: 大家好像都會把標語當成努力目標。只要一起努力，一定能成功。
DATA_CMM_2147.zhs: 大家好像都会把标语当成努力目标。只要一起努力，一定能成功。

DATA_CMM_2148.ja: Apparently, simply finding a goal can be a goal in itself.
DATA_CMM_2148.en: Apparently, simply finding a goal can be a goal in itself.
DATA_CMM_2148.fr: Le fait de trouver un objectif peut parfois être un objectif en soi.
DATA_CMM_2148.de: Anscheinend ist die Suche nach einem Ziel schon ein Ziel an sich.
DATA_CMM_2148.it: C'è chi crede che trovare un obiettivo sia un obiettivo in sé.
DATA_CMM_2148.es: Al parecer, el hecho de encontrar un objetivo ya es un objetivo en sí mismo.
DATA_CMM_2148.ko: 목표를 발견하는 것을 목표로 삼는 경우도 있는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2148.zht: 好像有時候的目標會是找到一個目標。
DATA_CMM_2148.zhs: 好像有时候的目标会是找到一个目标。

DATA_CMM_2149.ja: A book full of Japanese kanji. How anyone can remember and read them all is a mystery.
DATA_CMM_2149.en: A book full of Japanese kanji. How anyone can remember and read them all is a mystery.
DATA_CMM_2149.fr: Livre plein de kanjis. Comment font-ils tous pour se souvenir d'autant de mots ?
DATA_CMM_2149.de: Ein Buch voll mit japanischen Kanji. Wie man sich die alle merken und lesen kann, bleibt rätselhaft.
DATA_CMM_2149.it: Un libro che insegna i kanji giapponesi.
DATA_CMM_2149.es: Está lleno de kanji. No comprendemos cómo puede haber gente que los recuerde todos.
DATA_CMM_2149.ko: 여러 이야기의 다이제스트 판이 실려있는 매우 경제적인 제품.
DATA_CMM_2149.zht: 划算的商品，刊載著各式各樣故事的摘錄。
DATA_CMM_2149.zhs: 划算的商品，刊载着各式各样故事的摘录。

DATA_CMM_2150.ja: Most people look at these and wonder why they had such poor fashion sense "back then."
DATA_CMM_2150.en: Most people look at these and wonder why they had such poor fashion sense "back then."
DATA_CMM_2150.fr: En les regardant, la plupart des gens sont perplexes devant leur manque de sens esthétique, "à l'époque".
DATA_CMM_2150.de: Die meisten Menschen schauen da rein und fragen sich, warum sie „damals" so einen schlechten Kleidungsgeschmack hatten.
DATA_CMM_2150.it: Un libro che acquista valore affettivo con il tempo.
DATA_CMM_2150.es: La mayor parte de la gente se avergüenza de su peinado de la época cuando mira estos libros.
DATA_CMM_2150.ko: 과자 부스러기가 들어있으면 당첨~인 것은 아니다. 물론…
DATA_CMM_2150.zht: 如果班級圖書裡面有餅乾屑，好像也不代表中獎。
DATA_CMM_2150.zhs: 如果班级图书里面有饼干屑，好像也不代表中奖。

DATA_CMM_2151.ja: This is another of the languages that exists on Earth. It seems to be fairly popular.
DATA_CMM_2151.en: This is another of the languages that exists on Earth. It seems to be fairly popular.
DATA_CMM_2151.fr: L'une des langues qui se parlent sur Terre. Elle a l'air très populaire.
DATA_CMM_2151.de: Eine weitere Sprache, die auf der Erde gesprochen wird. Scheint ziemlich beliebt zu sein.
DATA_CMM_2151.it: Un libro di testo per apprendere la lingua inglese.
DATA_CMM_2151.es: ¿A que sería fantástico tener una fórmula mágica que hiciera pasar su saber a la cabeza sin esfuerzo?
DATA_CMM_2151.ko: 지구에서 쓰이는 언어 중의 하나. 제대로 쓰기만 하면 친구가 많아진다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2151.zht: 地球上的語言之一。聽說只要學會英文，就能交到很多朋友。
DATA_CMM_2151.zhs: 地球上的语言之一。听说只要学会英文，就能交到很多朋友。

DATA_CMM_2152.ja: A writing tool. You can only write really thick characters with this, so it's a bit inconvenient.
DATA_CMM_2152.en: A writing tool. You can only write really thick characters with this, so it's a bit inconvenient.
DATA_CMM_2152.fr: Outil d'écriture peu pratique. On ne peut qu'écrire des caractères très épais avec.
DATA_CMM_2152.de: Ein Schreibwerkzeug. Man kann damit nur richtig dicke Buchstaben schreiben, ist also etwas umständlich.
DATA_CMM_2152.it: Uno strumento per scrivere ideogrammi nel modo tradizionale.
DATA_CMM_2152.es: Su uso requiere paciencia; no es adecuado para tomar apuntes en clase.
DATA_CMM_2152.ko: 글자를 쓰는 도구. 상당히 두꺼운 글자밖에 못 쓰므로 꽤 불편하다.
DATA_CMM_2152.zht: 寫字的道具。只能寫出相當粗的字體，有點不方便。
DATA_CMM_2152.zhs: 写字的道具。只能写出相当粗的字体，有点不方便。

DATA_CMM_2153.ja: Children hit each other with this ball during recess. It's soft and squishy so that people don't fight.
DATA_CMM_2153.en: Children hit each other with this ball during recess. It's soft and squishy so that people don't fight.
DATA_CMM_2153.fr: Les enfants se tapent avec pendant la récréation. Il est doux pour qu'ils ne se battent pas.
DATA_CMM_2153.de: Mit diesem Ball schießen sich Kinder in Pausen gegenseitig ab. Er ist weich, damit sich keiner wehtut.
DATA_CMM_2153.it: Un pallone usato soprattutto per giocare a palla avvelenata.
DATA_CMM_2153.es: Es blandita, por lo que no hace daño y evita peleas.
DATA_CMM_2153.ko: 아이들이 쉬는 시간에 상대방에게 던지는 공. 싸우지 않도록 약간 말랑말랑하게 만들었다.
DATA_CMM_2153.zht: 孩子們在休息時間會拿躲避球砸朋友。為了避免吵架，球稍微有點彈性。
DATA_CMM_2153.zhs: 孩子们在休息时间会拿躲避球砸朋友。为了避免吵架，球稍微有点弹性。

DATA_CMM_2154.ja: Throw your garbage into this box, but separate your recyclables first.
DATA_CMM_2154.en: Throw your garbage into this box, but separate your recyclables first.
DATA_CMM_2154.fr: Donnez-lui à manger vos ordures, mais n'oubliez pas de trier ce qui est recyclable, elle a la digestion fragile.
DATA_CMM_2154.de: Man wirft seinen Abfall in diesen Eimer, aber davor muss man ihn trennen.
DATA_CMM_2154.it: Un cestino per l'immondizia, prima però, ricicla il riciclabile!
DATA_CMM_2154.es: Antes de tirar la basura, asegúrate de haber separado las cosas que se reciclan.
DATA_CMM_2154.ko: 쓰레기를 버리는 상자. 안 타는 물건은 집어 넣어선 안된다.
DATA_CMM_2154.zht: 丟垃圾的箱子。不能丟禁止燃燒的物品。
DATA_CMM_2154.zhs: 丢垃圾的箱子。不能丢禁止燃烧的物品。

DATA_CMM_2155.ja: If you hide in here, be careful not to mess up your timing and come out after class has started.
DATA_CMM_2155.en: If you hide in here, be careful not to mess up your timing and come out after class has started.
DATA_CMM_2155.fr: Si vous vous y cachez, faites attention de ne pas en sortir après le début de la classe.
DATA_CMM_2155.de: Wenn man sich darin versteckt, sollte man erst wieder rauskommen, wenn die Unterrichtsstunde vorbei ist.
DATA_CMM_2155.it: Se lo usi come nascondiglio, ricordati di uscire in tempo per le lezioni.
DATA_CMM_2155.es: Está bien esconderse aquí si buscas soledad, pero ¿no es un poco estrecha?
DATA_CMM_2155.ko: 여기에 숨으면 수업이 시작된다든지 해서 나갈 타이밍을 잡기가 어렵다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2155.zht: 聽說要是躲在這裡面，一旦開始上課就很難找到時機出來了。
DATA_CMM_2155.zhs: 听说要是躲在这里面，一旦开始上课就很难找到时机出来了。

DATA_CMM_2156.ja: A notebook for studying. The information on the outside cover is very helpful.
DATA_CMM_2156.en: A notebook for studying. The information on the outside cover is very helpful.
DATA_CMM_2156.de: Ein Notizheft zum Lernen. Die Informationen auf dem Umschlag sind sehr hilfreich.
DATA_CMM_2156.it: Un quaderno con appunti per studiare a casa, sul tram o al cinema.
DATA_CMM_2156.es: Se suele comprar para anotar cosas útiles y después se pierde justo cuando la necesitas.
DATA_CMM_2156.ko: 공부하기 위한 노트. 표지 뒷편에 쓰인 상식이 나름대로 유용하다.
DATA_CMM_2156.zht: 學習的筆記本。封面內側的小知識令人有點開心。
DATA_CMM_2156.zhs: 学习的笔记本。封面内侧的小知识令人有点开心。

DATA_CMM_2157.ja: A bundle of papers not meant for any particular purpose.
DATA_CMM_2157.en: A bundle of papers not meant for any particular purpose.
DATA_CMM_2157.fr: Tas de papiers qui n'a pas d'utilisation très précise.
DATA_CMM_2157.de: Ein Bündel von Papieren, die keinen bestimmten Zweck haben.
DATA_CMM_2157.it: Un blocco di fogli che possono essere usati un po' per tutto.
DATA_CMM_2157.es: Si tu afición no es el dibujo no le encontrarás demasiada utilidad.
DATA_CMM_2157.ko: 특별한 용도가 없는 종이 묶음이라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2157.zht: 好像是沒有特定用途的一疊紙。
DATA_CMM_2157.zhs: 好像是没有特定用途的一迭纸。

DATA_CMM_2160.ja: A red and white reversible hat. This is great for making teams, but things get tougher when there are three teams.
DATA_CMM_2160.en: A red and white reversible hat. This is great for making teams, but things get tougher when there are three teams.
DATA_CMM_2160.fr: Couvre-chef rouge et blanc réversible. Très utile pour former deux équipes, mais pas trois.
DATA_CMM_2160.de: Eine rot-weiße Wendemütze. Gut geeignet, um Teams zu bilden, aber bei drei Teams wird's haarig.
DATA_CMM_2160.it: Un cappello rosso. Ottimo per non passare inosservato.
DATA_CMM_2160.es: Para poder pasar de un equipo a otro sin tener que cambiar de camiseta.
DATA_CMM_2160.ko: 빨간색의 멋진 모자. 팀을 구분하는데 편리하지만, 3개 팀일 경우에는 매우 곤란해진다.
DATA_CMM_2160.zht: 紅白兩色的雙面帽子。分隊會很方便，但要分成三隊就會有點麻煩。
DATA_CMM_2160.zhs: 红白两色的双面帽子。分队会很方便，但要分成三队就会有点麻烦。

DATA_CMM_2161.ja: You can be a hero for three minutes with this hat. When one person wears this, everyone else does too, and the neighborhood gets chock-full of heroes.
DATA_CMM_2161.en: You can be a hero for three minutes with this hat. When one person wears this, everyone else does too, and the neighborhood gets chock-full of heroes.
DATA_CMM_2161.fr: Devenez un héros pendant trois minutes avec cette casquette. Quand quelqu'un la met, tout le monde s'y met, et les héros envahissent la rue.
DATA_CMM_2161.de: Mit dieser Kappe wird man für drei Minuten zum Helden. Wenn sie einer trägt, machen es bald alle und die Helden sprießen nur so aus dem Boden.
DATA_CMM_2161.it: Un cappello che rende degli eroi per circa tre minuti.
DATA_CMM_2161.es: Te sentirías muy especial con ella, si no fuera porque también la llevan otras 3.485 personas.
DATA_CMM_2161.ko: 이것을 쓰면 3분간 히어로가 될 수 있다. 누군가 시작하면 모두 따라하기 때문에 순식간에 적백 물결.
DATA_CMM_2161.zht: 戴上它就能變成英雄三分鐘。一有人先起頭，其他人也會跟著做，最後到處都是英雄。
DATA_CMM_2161.zhs: 戴上它就能变成英雄三分钟。一有人先起头，其他人也会跟着做，最后到处都是英雄。

DATA_CMM_2162.ja: A very daintily-built bed. People not feeling well use it.
DATA_CMM_2162.en: A very daintily-built bed. People not feeling well use it.
DATA_CMM_2162.fr: Lit conçu avec beaucoup de soin. Il n'y a sûrement pas meilleur endroit pour dormir.
DATA_CMM_2162.de: Ein sehr zierlich gebautes Bett. Menschen, die sich krank fühlen, benutzen es.
DATA_CMM_2162.it: Un letto finemente costruito. Per i malati.
DATA_CMM_2162.es: Una cama delicada para enfermos delicados.
DATA_CMM_2162.ko: 굉장히 약해 보이는 침대. 씨름선수는 사용 금지.
DATA_CMM_2162.zht: 結構脆弱的床。給不舒服的人使用。
DATA_CMM_2162.zhs: 结构脆弱的床。给不舒服的人使用。

DATA_CMM_2163.ja: Simply carrying this mature item around will make you feel more serious.
DATA_CMM_2163.en: Simply carrying this mature item around will make you feel more serious.
DATA_CMM_2163.fr: Le simple fait d'en porter un rend les élèves sérieux.
DATA_CMM_2163.de: Wenn man diesen erwachsenen Gegenstand trägt, fühlt man sich gleich viel ernster.
DATA_CMM_2163.it: Con questa borsa gli studenti si sentono più studiosi.
DATA_CMM_2163.es: Solo por llevarla ya te sientes mayor. ¡Horror!
DATA_CMM_2163.ko: 왠지 지니고 있는 것만으로도 성실해지는 듯한 느낌이 드는 물건.
DATA_CMM_2163.zht: 樸素的學生書包，總覺得光是擁有就會變得認真。
DATA_CMM_2163.zhs: 朴素的学生书包，总觉得光是拥有就会变得认真。

DATA_CMM_2164.ja: This is carried by students who suddenly realize they don't want to be just like everyone else.
DATA_CMM_2164.en: This is carried by students who suddenly realize they don't want to be just like everyone else.
DATA_CMM_2164.fr: Il est apprécié des élèves qui s'aperçoivent soudain qu'ils ne veulent pas être comme tout le monde.
DATA_CMM_2164.de: Wird von Schülern getragen, die plötzlich merken, dass sie nicht so sein wollen wie alle anderen.
DATA_CMM_2164.it: Una borsa per chi ama distinguersi.
DATA_CMM_2164.es: En principio era para llevar al gimnasio, pero ahora se usan incluso para la compra.
DATA_CMM_2164.ko: 슬슬 다른 학생과 같은 건 싫다고 느낄 때쯤에 등장하는 아이템인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2164.zht: 似乎是學生擁有的運動包，差不多是時候開始討厭跟大家一模一樣了。
DATA_CMM_2164.zhs: 似乎是学生拥有的运动包，差不多是时候开始讨厌跟大家一模一样了。

DATA_CMM_2165.ja: A very flat tiger. We don't know if it lost a bet or something, but it sure isn't doing that for fun.
DATA_CMM_2165.en: A very flat tiger. We don't know if it lost a bet or something, but it sure isn't doing that for fun.
DATA_CMM_2165.fr: Tigre qui tient beaucoup de la sole. Nous ne savons pas s'il fait ça parcequ'il a perdu un pari, mais il ne le fait pas par plaisir, c'est sûr.
DATA_CMM_2165.de: Ein sehr flacher Tiger. Wir wissen nicht, ob er eine Wette verloren hat oder so, aber er macht das sicher nicht zum Spaß.
DATA_CMM_2165.it: Una tigre molto piatta e che ama stare ferma nei salotti della gente.
DATA_CMM_2165.es: No sabemos qué le habrá pasado a este felino para estar tan aplatanado.
DATA_CMM_2165.ko: 납짝쿵이 된 호랑이. 어떤 벌칙 게임인지는 모르겠으나, 자진해서 하고 있는 건 아닌 듯…
DATA_CMM_2165.zht: 壓扁的老虎。不知道是什麼懲罰遊戲．但看起來不是自己喜歡才玩的。
DATA_CMM_2165.zhs: 压扁的老虎。不知道是什么惩罚游戏．但看起来不是自己喜欢才玩的。

DATA_CMM_2166.ja: Apparently drawing doodles on the photographs for comedic effect is very popular these days.
DATA_CMM_2166.en: Apparently drawing doodles on the photographs for comedic effect is very popular these days.
DATA_CMM_2166.fr: La mode des gribouillis comiques sur les photos d'hommes célèbres bat son plein parmi les élèves.
DATA_CMM_2166.de: Anscheinend ist es heutzutage sehr beliebt, Fotos mit Kritzeleien zu versehen, um witzig zu wirken.
DATA_CMM_2166.it: Un libro di storia sulle foto del quale gli studenti hanno disegnato baffi e scarabocchi.
DATA_CMM_2166.es: Los personajes que aparecen en las ilustraciones ya tienen bigote y barba, no se pueden pintarrajear.
DATA_CMM_2166.ko: 실려있는 사진에 낙서를 해서 예술로 승화시키는 작업이 유행하는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2166.zht: 大家好像很喜歡在照片上塗鴉，讓照片變有趣。
DATA_CMM_2166.zhs: 大家好像很喜欢在照片上涂鸦，让照片变有趣。

DATA_CMM_2167.ja: This menu is written on a blackboard. It won't show up on the test, so don't worry.
DATA_CMM_2167.en: This menu is written on a blackboard. It won't show up on the test, so don't worry.
DATA_CMM_2167.fr: Ce menu est écrit sur un tableau, mais il ne fera pas l'objet d'un test, pas de panique.
DATA_CMM_2167.de: Dieses Menü ist auf eine Tafel geschrieben. Wird in Klassenarbeiten nicht abgefragt, also keine Sorge.
DATA_CMM_2167.it: Nessun insegnante ha mai fatto interrogazioni sul menù anche se è scritto su di una lavagna.
DATA_CMM_2167.es: Aunque te guste mucho borrar pizarras, si quitas el menú los demás no sabrán qué hay para comer.
DATA_CMM_2167.ko: 칠판에 적혀있지만 시험에 나오지는 않으므로 안심하도록.
DATA_CMM_2167.zht: 午餐菜單會寫在黑板上，但考試並不會考，所以可以儘管放心。
DATA_CMM_2167.zhs: 午餐菜单会写在黑板上，但考试并不会考，所以可以尽管放心。

DATA_CMM_2168.ja: Everyone rubs their dirty hands all over this, so We bet it must be filthy by now.
DATA_CMM_2168.en: Everyone rubs their dirty hands all over this, so We bet it must be filthy by now.
DATA_CMM_2168.fr: Tout le monde y frotte ses mains sales. Il doit être vraiment dégoûtant, maintenant.
DATA_CMM_2168.de: Jeder reibt sich damit seine schmutzigen Hände, also muss sie mittlerweile ganz schön verdreckt sein.
DATA_CMM_2168.it: Ognuno ci si strofina le mani sporche, deve essere lurido.
DATA_CMM_2168.es: Todo el mundo se lava las sucias manos en él. ¿Hará falta jabón para lavar el jabón?
DATA_CMM_2168.ko: 모두가 더러운 손으로 만져대므로 이것 자체가 더럽게 느껴지기도 한다.
DATA_CMM_2168.zht: 感覺很髒，大家都會用髒手摸它。
DATA_CMM_2168.zhs: 感觉很脏，大家都会用脏手摸它。

DATA_CMM_2169.ja: You pump this up and down in the toilet to clean out the plumbing. It's not exactly pretty.
DATA_CMM_2169.en: You pump this up and down in the toilet to clean out the plumbing. It's not exactly pretty.
DATA_CMM_2169.fr: Elle est utilisée pour toiletter la tuyauterie des toilettes. Quel travail ingrat !
DATA_CMM_2169.de: Wird in Toilettenabflüsse gesetzt und niedergedrückt, um Rohre freizulegen. Nicht sehr appetitlich.
DATA_CMM_2169.it: Usato per sgorgare i gabinetti, non è un bello spettacolo.
DATA_CMM_2169.es: Por mucha curiosidad que tengas, utilizarlo no tiene ningún encanto.
DATA_CMM_2169.ko: 밀거나 당기거나 해서 파이프 안의 이물질을 끌어내는 듯하다. 절대 깨끗하다곤 말할 수 없다.
DATA_CMM_2169.zht: 馬桶吸盤稱不上是乾淨。似乎是藉由吸附再放開，拉出堵塞管線的垃圾。
DATA_CMM_2169.zhs: 马桶吸盘称不上是干净。似乎是藉由吸附再放开，拉出堵塞管线的垃圾。

DATA_CMM_2170.ja: Water comes out when you twist it. Pinching it has no effect.
DATA_CMM_2170.en: Water comes out when you twist it. Pinching it has no effect.
DATA_CMM_2170.fr: De l'eau en sort quand vous le tournez. Pas la peine de le pincer.
DATA_CMM_2170.de: Es fließt Wasser, wenn man daran dreht. Ihn zu drücken bewirkt nichts.
DATA_CMM_2170.es: La mera persuasión no surte efecto; hay que retorcerlo para que suelte agua.
DATA_CMM_2170.ko: 비틀면 물이 나온다. 꼬집을 경우엔 안 나온다.
DATA_CMM_2170.zht: 一擰就會流出水。掐水龍頭，水也不會出來。
DATA_CMM_2170.zhs: 一拧就会流出水。掐水龙头，水也不会出来。

DATA_CMM_2171.ja: The roof's steep to keep the snow off, not so you can have fun sliding around up there.
DATA_CMM_2171.en: The roof's steep to keep the snow off, not so you can have fun sliding around up there.
DATA_CMM_2171.fr: Le toit est pentu pour en faire tomber la neige, pas pour s'amuser à glisser dessus.
DATA_CMM_2171.de: Das Dach ist steil, um Schnee fernzuhalten, und nicht, damit man von oben zum Spaß herunterrutscht.
DATA_CMM_2171.it: Il tetto è ripido per evitare che la neve vi si accumuli, non per usarlo come trampolino da bob.
DATA_CMM_2171.es: El tejado sirve para que no entre nieve en la casa, no para que esquíes en él.
DATA_CMM_2171.ko: 지붕이 급격한 경사로 되어있는 것은 눈을 잘 떨어뜨리기 위한 것이지 미끄럼타라고 그런 건 아닌 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2171.zht: 屋頂陡峭是為了防止積雪，不是滑好玩的。
DATA_CMM_2171.zhs: 屋顶陡峭是为了防止积雪，不是滑好玩的。

DATA_CMM_2172.ja: A block made of snow. It's fairly sturdy, but it's still fundamentally snow, so it will melt.
DATA_CMM_2172.en: A block made of snow. It's fairly sturdy, but it's still fundamentally snow, so it will melt.
DATA_CMM_2172.fr: Il a beau avoir l'air très solide et vous regarder d'un air glacial, vos relations se réchaufferont.
DATA_CMM_2172.de: Ein Block aus Schnee. Ist ziemlich stabil, aber im Grunde besteht er trotzdem aus Schnee, also schmilzt er irgendwann.
DATA_CMM_2172.it: Un blocco di neve, piuttosto massiccio. Si tratta comunque di neve.
DATA_CMM_2172.es: Ahora es muy sólido, pero sabemos que no durará.
DATA_CMM_2172.ko: 눈으로 만든 블록. 나름대로 단단하지만 근본적으로 눈이기에 결국 녹는다.
DATA_CMM_2172.zht: 用雪製成的方塊。相當的堅固，但終究是雪，還是會融化。
DATA_CMM_2172.zhs: 用雪制成的方块。相当的坚固，但终究是雪，还是会融化。

DATA_CMM_2173.ja: A looong piece of paper rolled up into a cylinder. It's easy to use, but We bet it's tough to make.
DATA_CMM_2173.en: A looong piece of paper rolled up into a cylinder. It's easy to use, but We bet it's tough to make.
DATA_CMM_2173.fr: Long morceau de papier roulé en cylindre. Facile à utiliser, mais difficile à fabriquer.
DATA_CMM_2173.de: Ein langes Stück Papier, das zylindrisch aufgerollt ist. Einfach zu benutzen, aber bestimmt schwer zu fertigen.
DATA_CMM_2173.it: Un lungo pezzo di carta arrotolato intorno a un cilindro. Chissà come fanno a farla.
DATA_CMM_2173.es: Debe de ser terrible trabajar en la fábrica enrollándolo alrededor del tubo de cartón.
DATA_CMM_2173.ko: 긴 종이가 둘둘 말려있다. 쓰기는 쉬워도, 만드는 건 대단히 어렵다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2173.zht: 把一張很長很長的紙捲成圓筒。用起來很方便，但製作的時候應該很麻煩。
DATA_CMM_2173.zhs: 把一张很长很长的纸卷成圆筒。用起来很方便，但制作的时候应该很麻烦。

DATA_CMM_2174.ja: This makes a loud whining noise that makes everyone run away.
DATA_CMM_2174.en: This makes a loud whining noise that makes everyone run away.
DATA_CMM_2174.fr: Elle émet des hurlements stridents qui font fuir les gens, bien différents du chant des sirènes.
DATA_CMM_2174.de: Lässt ein lautes, heulendes Geräusch von sich, das alle in die Flucht schlägt.
DATA_CMM_2174.it: Questa cosa produce un suono lacerante e intenso che fa scappare tutti.
DATA_CMM_2174.es: Hace un ruido tremendo que sirve más para irritar a los vecinos que para avisar a las autoridades.
DATA_CMM_2174.ko: 굉장히 시끄러운 소리로 울기 때문에 모두 물러나는가 보다.
DATA_CMM_2174.zht: 會以相當大的音量鈴鈴作響，所以大家都會逃跑的樣子。
DATA_CMM_2174.zhs: 会以相当大的音量铃铃作响，所以大家都会逃跑的样子。

DATA_CMM_2175.ja: If you had one of these, you could hold a class anywhere, anytime.
DATA_CMM_2175.en: If you had one of these, you could hold a class anywhere, anytime.
DATA_CMM_2175.fr: Si Nous en avions un, Nous pourrions faire la classe n'importe où.
DATA_CMM_2175.de: Mit so einer kann man überall und jederzeit Unterricht abhalten.
DATA_CMM_2175.it: Una lavagna per fare lezione ovunque e a qualsiasi ora.
DATA_CMM_2175.es: Para impartir una clase donde sea y cuando sea.
DATA_CMM_2175.ko: 이것만 있으면 언제 어디서든 수업을 진행할 수 있을지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_2175.zht: 說不定有了移動式黑板就能四處上課了。
DATA_CMM_2175.zhs: 说不定有了移动式黑板就能四处上课了。

DATA_CMM_2176.ja: A collection of books and papers. This appears to be well-organized, but the contents are all mixed up.
DATA_CMM_2176.en: A collection of books and papers. This appears to be well-organized, but the contents are all mixed up.
DATA_CMM_2176.fr: Assemblage de livres et de papiers. Il a l'air bien organisé, mais c'est un vrai désordre à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_2176.de: Ein Bündel von Büchern und Papieren. Scheint gut geordnet zu sein, aber der Inhalt ist ganz durcheinander.
DATA_CMM_2176.it: Un archivio di libri e documenti, sembra che sia ben organizzato ma non bisogna farsi ingannare dalle apparenze.
DATA_CMM_2176.es: Parecen estar muy bien organizados, pero si miras de cerca verás que el caos acecha.
DATA_CMM_2176.ko: 책이나 서류 다발. 겉에서 보면 정리된 듯 보이나, 내용은 엉망진창.
DATA_CMM_2176.zht: 整疊的書跟文件。乍看之下整理好了，但裡面還亂糟糟的樣子。
DATA_CMM_2176.zhs: 整迭的书跟文件。乍看之下整理好了，但里面还乱糟糟的样子。

DATA_CMM_2177.ja: This tape could bind some pretty big things together.
DATA_CMM_2177.en: This tape could bind some pretty big things together.
DATA_CMM_2177.fr: Ce ruban pourrait embobiner plus d'un naïf papier.
DATA_CMM_2177.de: Dieses Band verbindet einige echt große Sachen miteinander.
DATA_CMM_2177.it: Un nastro per unire oggetti. Il nastro dell'amicizia.
DATA_CMM_2177.es: En las películas sirve para atar a los malhechores, pero dudamos que funcione en realidad.
DATA_CMM_2177.ko: 더덕더덕 붙이면 찢어진 종이는 원래대로 되지만 상처받은 마음은 좀처럼 회복되지 않는다.
DATA_CMM_2177.zht: 破掉的紙貼一貼就能恢復原狀，但好像拿破碎的心沒轍。
DATA_CMM_2177.zhs: 破掉的纸贴一贴就能恢复原状，但好像拿破碎的心没辙。

DATA_CMM_2178.ja: A long wall near the ceiling. Changing what's posted up here is a pain, so you see the same notices all semester.
DATA_CMM_2178.en: A long wall near the ceiling. Changing what's posted up here is a pain, so you see the same notices all semester.
DATA_CMM_2178.fr: Long mur près du plafond. Comme ce qu'on y accroche est difficilement accessible, on lit les mêmes affiches tout un semestre.
DATA_CMM_2178.de: Eine lange Wand nahe der Decke. Es ist mühsam, die Aushänge hier zu ändern, daher sieht man das ganze Schuljahr über die gleichen.
DATA_CMM_2178.es: Cambiar los carteles de tan arriba es complicado, así que dejan los mismos durante todo el curso.
DATA_CMM_2178.ko: 천정 부근의 긴 벽. 여기에 걸려있는 것은 바꿔끼는 것이 귀찮아서 1학기간 유지된다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2178.zht: 天花板附近的長形牆壁。更換貼在這裡的東西很麻煩，所以好像會置之不理整個學期。
DATA_CMM_2178.zhs: 天花板附近的长形墙壁。更换贴在这里的东西很麻烦，所以好像会置之不理整个学期。

DATA_CMM_2179.ja: Apparently you're not allowed to draw on these.
DATA_CMM_2179.en: Apparently you're not allowed to draw on these.
DATA_CMM_2179.fr: Il paraît que vous n'avez pas le droit de dessiner dessus.
DATA_CMM_2179.de: Anscheinend darf man nicht darauf zeichnen.
DATA_CMM_2179.it: A quanto pare non è permesso disegnarci sopra.
DATA_CMM_2179.es: Aparentemente no está permitido dibujar en esto.

DATA_CMM_2180.ja: Apparently, this class is in the running for the Sports Championship.
DATA_CMM_2180.en: Apparently, this class is in the running for the Sports Championship.
DATA_CMM_2180.fr: Cette classe serait dans la course pour le championnat sportif.
DATA_CMM_2180.de: Anscheinend ist diese Klasse im Rennen um die Sportmeisterschaft.
DATA_CMM_2180.it: Una classe in cui tutti sono bravissimi negli sport.
DATA_CMM_2180.es: Según dicen, esta clase es la mejor de todo el cole. Pelotas.

DATA_CMM_2181.ja: The teacher's room. When this sign is up, you have to knock and be polite and follow a lot of other annoying rules.
DATA_CMM_2181.en: The teacher's room. When this sign is up, you have to knock and be polite and follow a lot of other annoying rules.
DATA_CMM_2181.fr: Si vous voyez ce signe sur une porte, vous devez frapper avant d'entrer, être poli et suivre bien d'autres règles compliquées.
DATA_CMM_2181.de: Das Lehrerzimmer. Wenn dieses Schild hängt, muss man anklopfen, höflich sein und eine Menge anderer lästiger Regeln befolgen.
DATA_CMM_2181.it: L'ufficio degli insegnanti, bisogna sempre bussare ed essere gentili quando si entra qui.
DATA_CMM_2181.es: En la mayoría de colegios se conoce también como "la guarida del dragón" y otras lindezas.
DATA_CMM_2181.ko: 선생님의 방. 이게 걸려있는 곳에선 노크, 인사 등 여러 가지 빡빡한 룰이 적용되는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2181.zht: 教職員辦公室有很多辛苦的規則，要敲門還要打招呼等等。
DATA_CMM_2181.zhs: 教职员办公室有很多辛苦的规则，要敲门还要打招呼等等。

DATA_CMM_2182.ja: A chair for when the principal is talking with a visitor. In other words, it's not used too often.
DATA_CMM_2182.en: A chair for when the principal is talking with a visitor. In other words, it's not used too often.
