DATA_CMM_2182.fr: Destiné à accueillir le principal et ses visiteurs. Autant dire qu'il chôme souvent.
DATA_CMM_2182.de: Ein Sofa für Besucher des Schulrektors. Wird also nicht allzu oft benutzt.
DATA_CMM_2182.it: Un divano per gli ospiti, quindi non viene usato spesso.
DATA_CMM_2182.es: Este asiento se reserva a las visitas importantes de verdad. Tanto, que aún está por estrenar.
DATA_CMM_2182.ko: 교장 선생님이 손님과 이야기할 때 사용하는 의자. 즉 그다지 사용될 일이 없는 물건.
DATA_CMM_2182.zht: 高級沙發是校長跟貴賓說話時的椅子。換而言之，很少派上用場。
DATA_CMM_2182.zhs: 高级沙发是校长跟贵宾说话时的椅子。换而言之，很少派上用场。

DATA_CMM_2183.ja: A very high-class table used for extremely normal things.
DATA_CMM_2183.en: A very high-class table used for extremely normal things.
DATA_CMM_2183.fr: Très haute table utilisée pour des choses tout à fait banales.
DATA_CMM_2183.de: Ein sehr hochwertiger Tisch, auf den ganz normale Dinge gestellt werden.
DATA_CMM_2183.it: Un tavolo sofisticato usato per compiti banali.
DATA_CMM_2183.es: Esta mesa es de muy buena calidad, pero se usa para cosas muy normales.
DATA_CMM_2183.ko: 상당히 고급스러운 테이블. 사용처는 그저 평범하기 짝이 없다.
DATA_CMM_2183.zht: 洋溢著高級質感的桌子，使用方式卻極其普通。
DATA_CMM_2183.zhs: 洋溢着高级质感的桌子，使用方式却极其普通。

DATA_CMM_2184.ja: Even if something delicious was on this dish, you wouldn't want to eat it.
DATA_CMM_2184.en: Even if something delicious was on this dish, you wouldn't want to eat it.
DATA_CMM_2184.fr: Même si un mets délicieux y était posé, il serait judicieux de ne pas y goûter.
DATA_CMM_2184.de: Selbst wenn etwas Leckeres drin wäre, würde man es nicht essen wollen.
DATA_CMM_2184.it: Destinato a essere vittima di molestie da parte delle sigarette.
DATA_CMM_2184.es: Por muy rico que estuviera lo que pusiesen en este platillo, no nos lo comeríamos. ¡Puaj!
DATA_CMM_2184.ko: 설령 맛난 음식이 놓여있다고 하더라도 식욕이 떨어져버리는 접시.
DATA_CMM_2184.zht: 就算裝了美食，也會讓人喪失食慾的盤子。
DATA_CMM_2184.zhs: 就算装了美食，也会让人丧失食欲的盘子。

DATA_CMM_2185.ja: A picture of an old principal. He isn't the ancestor of the current one or anything.
DATA_CMM_2185.en: A picture of an old principal. He isn't the ancestor of the current one or anything.
DATA_CMM_2185.fr: Photo d'un ancien directeur. Ce n'est pas l'ancêtre du principal actuel.
DATA_CMM_2185.de: Ein Bild eines alten Rektors. Ist nicht der Vorfahre des aktuellen oder so.
DATA_CMM_2185.it: La foto di un vecchio preside, non è un antenato del preside attuale.
DATA_CMM_2185.es: Es el retrato de otro director que hubo en el cole, pero no es el abuelo del actual ni nada parecido.
DATA_CMM_2185.ko: 옛날 교장 선생님의 사진. 조상님은 아닌 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2185.zht: 這是以前的校長照片，不是自己的祖先。
DATA_CMM_2185.zhs: 这是以前的校长照片，不是自己的祖先。

DATA_CMM_2186.ja: A picture of a principal from several generations ago. Apparently he liked to keep his conversations relatively short.
DATA_CMM_2186.en: A picture of a principal from several generations ago. Apparently he liked to keep his conversations relatively short.
DATA_CMM_2186.fr: Photo d'un directeur qui dirigea l'école il y a longtemps. Il détestait les conversations longues.
DATA_CMM_2186.de: Ein Bild eines Rektors, der vor vielen Generation im Amt war. Anscheinend hielt er seine Gespräche immer eher kurz.
DATA_CMM_2186.it: Una foto di un preside di qualche tempo fa, molto apprezzato perché parlava molto poco.
DATA_CMM_2186.es: Este fue director del cole en época más reciente. Al parecer, se retiró a un monasterio.
DATA_CMM_2186.ko: 몇 대 전의 교장 선생님 사진. 비교적 훈사가 짧은 사람이었다고 전해진다.
DATA_CMM_2186.zht: 好幾任以前的校長照片。相較之下好像話比較少。
DATA_CMM_2186.zhs: 好几任以前的校长照片。相较之下好象话比较少。

DATA_CMM_2187.ja: A safe filled with the school's most valuable items. The secrets of the ancients are probably stored inside.
DATA_CMM_2187.en: A safe filled with the school's most valuable items. The secrets of the ancients are probably stored inside.
DATA_CMM_2187.fr: Coffre-fort rempli des objets les plus précieux de l'école. Des secrets immémoriaux y sont sans doute entreposés.
DATA_CMM_2187.de: Ein Tresor, voll mit den wertvollsten Schulsachen. Wahrscheinlich beherbergt er auch die Geheimnisse unserer Vorfahren.
DATA_CMM_2187.it: Una cassaforte che custodisce i segreti più preziosi della scuola.
DATA_CMM_2187.es: Aquí se guardan los objetos valiosos del colegio; suponemos que se refieren al saber de siglos.
DATA_CMM_2187.ko: 학교의 소중한 것이 보관된 금고. 아마도 7대 불가사의를 푸는 열쇠가 들어있을 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2187.zht: 保管學校貴重物品的金庫。裡面應該會有解開學校七大不可思議之謎的提示。
DATA_CMM_2187.zhs: 保管学校贵重物品的金库。里面应该会有解开学校七大不可思议之谜的提示。

DATA_CMM_2188.ja: When the teacher violently throws this open, that's the sign you're about to be yelled at.
DATA_CMM_2188.en: When the teacher violently throws this open, that's the sign you're about to be yelled at.
DATA_CMM_2188.fr: Lorsque le professeur l'ouvre violemment, c'est le signe qu'il y a de l'orage dans l'air...
DATA_CMM_2188.de: Wenn der Lehrer diese Tür gewaltsam öffnet, ist das ein Zeichen dafür, dass man wohl gleich angeschrien wird.
DATA_CMM_2188.it: Da come un insegnante apre la porta si capisce quanto brutta sarà la giornata a scuola.
DATA_CMM_2188.es: Si el profesor la abre con violencia, ten por seguro que te va a caer un castigo.
DATA_CMM_2188.ko: 선생님이 터프하게 열고 들어오면 설교가 시작된다는 신호다.
DATA_CMM_2188.zht: 當老師粗魯推門進教室時，就是準備教訓人的警訊。
DATA_CMM_2188.zhs: 当老师粗鲁推门进教室时，就是准备教训人的警讯。

DATA_CMM_2189.ja: This window separates the classroom from the hallway. The classrooms have little privacy.
DATA_CMM_2189.en: This window separates the classroom from the hallway. The classrooms have little privacy.
DATA_CMM_2189.fr: Cette fenêtre sépare la classe et le couloir. Difficile d'aller discrètement aux toilettes dans ces conditions...
DATA_CMM_2189.de: Dieses Fenster trennt das Klassenzimmer vom Flur. Die Klassenzimmer haben echt wenig Privatsphäre.
DATA_CMM_2189.it: Una finestra interna per permettere di controllare i corridoi.
DATA_CMM_2189.es: Sirve para que se pueda ver el aula desde el pasillo; no hay respeto a la intimidad.
DATA_CMM_2189.ko: 복도와 교실의 세계를 절단하고 있다. 그래도 창문이 있어서 비교적 개방적이다.
DATA_CMM_2189.zht: 室內窗隔開了教室與走廊。話雖如此，因為能看到對面，所以算是開放式空間。
DATA_CMM_2189.zhs: 室内窗隔开了教室与走廊。话虽如此，因为能看到对面，所以算是开放式空间。

DATA_CMM_2190.ja: A window too inconveniently placed to open and close much.
DATA_CMM_2190.en: A window too inconveniently placed to open and close much.
DATA_CMM_2190.fr: Du fait de sa situation, elle est condamnée à ne s'ouvrir qu'un peu.
DATA_CMM_2190.de: Ein Fenster, das so ungünstig platziert ist, dass man es weder öffnen noch schließen kann.
DATA_CMM_2190.es: Siempre están en un lugar en el que es difícil abrirlas y cerrarlas.
DATA_CMM_2190.ko: 열기도 닫기도 힘든 높은 곳에 있는 창.
DATA_CMM_2190.zht: 氣窗位於高處，不論要開或是要關都很不方便。
DATA_CMM_2190.zhs: 气窗位于高处，不论要开或是要关都很不方便。

DATA_CMM_2191.ja: A wall with all sorts of things stuck on it. Big news often shows up here, so keep an eye on it.
DATA_CMM_2191.en: A wall with all sorts of things stuck on it. Big news often shows up here, so keep an eye on it.
DATA_CMM_2191.fr: Mur sur lequel on colle les choses les plus diverses. Des annonces importantes y fleurissent, alors admirez-le tous les matins.
DATA_CMM_2191.de: Eine Wand, an der alles Mögliche haftet. Hier tauchen oft große Neuigkeiten auf, also sollte man sie im Auge behalten.
DATA_CMM_2191.it: Un corridoio con un sacco di avvisi appesi. A volte ci sono cose interessanti.
DATA_CMM_2191.es: Tendría alguna utilidad si no fuera por los graciosos que arrancan y pintarrajean los anuncios.
DATA_CMM_2191.ko: 여러 가지 정보가 걸려있는 벽. 빅 뉴스도 걸리곤 하므로 종종 체크하자.
DATA_CMM_2191.zht: 會張貼各式各樣東西的牆壁。好像也會冒出大新聞，需要時時確認。
DATA_CMM_2191.zhs: 会张贴各式各样东西的墙壁。好像也会冒出大新闻，需要时时确认。

DATA_CMM_2192.ja: People don't put anything funny up here too often.
DATA_CMM_2192.en: People don't put anything funny up here too often.
DATA_CMM_2192.fr: On y lit rarement des choses marrantes.
DATA_CMM_2192.de: Es kommt nicht oft vor, dass hier jemand etwas Lustiges anschreibt.
DATA_CMM_2192.es: Deberían dedicar uno a anunciar cosas divertidas, como fiestas y comilonas.
DATA_CMM_2192.ko: 그다지 재미있는 건수가 걸리는 일은 없다.
DATA_CMM_2192.zht: 佈告欄不會貼笑得出來的東西。
DATA_CMM_2192.zhs: 布告栏不会贴笑得出来的东西。

DATA_CMM_2194.ja: The classroom TV sits on this shelf. This tends to be overlooked during cleaning.
DATA_CMM_2194.en: The classroom TV sits on this shelf. This tends to be overlooked during cleaning.
DATA_CMM_2194.fr: La télé de la classe trône sur cette étagère, mais on l'oublie souvent lors des nettoyages.
DATA_CMM_2194.de: Auf diesem Regal steht der Klassenzimmerfernseher. Wird beim Staubwischen oft übersehen.
DATA_CMM_2194.it: Una mensola dove viene posta la TV della classe. Non la puliscono spesso.
DATA_CMM_2194.es: Como está tan arriba, suelen olvidarse de quitarle el polvo y parece nevado.
DATA_CMM_2194.ko: 교실에서 텔레비전을 올려놓은 선반. 청소할 때는 언제나 잊혀진다.
DATA_CMM_2194.zht: 掛著教室電視的架子。常常被忘記清潔。
DATA_CMM_2194.zhs: 挂着教室电视的架子。常常被忘记清洁。

DATA_CMM_2195.ja: You put assorted decorations on this tree at Christmas.
DATA_CMM_2195.en: You put assorted decorations on this tree at Christmas.
DATA_CMM_2195.fr: On décore ce sapin chaque Noël, mais on ne s'en lasse pas.
DATA_CMM_2195.de: An diesen Baum hängt man zu Weihnachten verschiedenste Dekorationen.
DATA_CMM_2195.it: A Natale questo tipo di albero viene addobbato e decorato.
DATA_CMM_2195.es: Parece que nadie aprecia su belleza natural y se empeña en colgarle adornos de colores.
DATA_CMM_2195.ko: 크리스마스에는 여러 가지로 장식이 되는 나무.
DATA_CMM_2195.zht: 聖誕節時，上面會裝飾很多東西。
DATA_CMM_2195.zhs: 圣诞节时，上面会装饰很多东西。

DATA_CMM_2196.ja: A vehicle that glides on top of the snow. This can't run once the snow melts.
DATA_CMM_2196.en: A vehicle that glides on top of the snow. This can't run once the snow melts.
DATA_CMM_2196.fr: Véhicule qui glisse gracieusement sur la neige en hiver et qui déprime dans son garage le reste de l'année.
DATA_CMM_2196.de: Ein Fahrzeug, das über die Schneedecke gleitet. Kann nicht mehr fahren, wenn der Schnee schmilzt.
DATA_CMM_2196.it: Un veicolo che scivola sulla neve, abbastanza inutile d'estate.
DATA_CMM_2196.es: Para deslizarse sobre la nieve; resulta poco práctico si vives en zonas tropicales.
DATA_CMM_2196.ko: 눈 위를 슥슥 달리는 탈것. 눈이 녹아버리면 달리지 못하는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2196.zht: 會在雪地上咻咻奔馳的交通工具。雪融化之後好像就不能跑了。
DATA_CMM_2196.zhs: 会在雪地上咻咻奔驰的交通工具。雪融化之后好像就不能跑了。

DATA_CMM_2197.ja: A vehicle pulled by a pack of dogs. Useful when taking your dog for a walk.
DATA_CMM_2197.en: A vehicle pulled by a pack of dogs. Useful when taking your dog for a walk.
DATA_CMM_2197.fr: Il aime se faire traîner par une meute de chiens. Très pratique pour promener Médor.
DATA_CMM_2197.de: Ein Gefährt, das von einem Hunderudel gezogen wird. Nützlich, wenn man mit dem Hund Gassi geht.
DATA_CMM_2197.it: Una slitta trainata da un gruppo di cani. Utile per farsi portare durante la passeggiata.
DATA_CMM_2197.es: Estupendo para sacar a pasear al perro sin cansarte para nada.
DATA_CMM_2197.ko: 개가 끌어주는 탈것. 산책할 때 이용하면 편리할 듯싶다.
DATA_CMM_2197.zht: 由狗拉行的交通工具。散步時用雪橇應該會很方便吧？
DATA_CMM_2197.zhs: 由狗拉行的交通工具。散步时用雪橇应该会很方便吧？

DATA_CMM_2198.ja: A house made of ice. You'd think it's cold inside, but oddly enough, it's warmer than it is outside.
DATA_CMM_2198.en: A house made of ice. You'd think it's cold inside, but oddly enough, it's warmer than it is outside.
DATA_CMM_2198.fr: Maison de glace. On penserait qu'il fait froid à l'intérieur, mais c'est tout de même plus chaud qu'à l'extérieur.
DATA_CMM_2198.de: Ein Haus aus Eis. Man könnte meinen, dass es da drinnen kalt ist, aber komischerweise ist es wärmer als draußen.
DATA_CMM_2198.it: Una casa fatta di ghiaccio. Stranamente dentro c'è un bel tepore.
DATA_CMM_2198.es: Lo que no llegamos a entender es que se pueda encender una hoguera dentro y no se funda.
DATA_CMM_2198.ko: 눈으로 만들어진 집. 안은 추울 거라고 생각했는데 밖보다 따뜻한 것이 신기할 따름이다.
DATA_CMM_2198.zht: 用雪蓋成的屋子。原本以為裡面會很冷，事實上比外頭溫暖，真是不可思議。
DATA_CMM_2198.zhs: 用雪盖成的屋子。原本以为里面会很冷，事实上比外头温暖，真是不可思议。

DATA_CMM_2199.ja: People with beards so shaggy that you can't tell where the mouth is often come out of here.
DATA_CMM_2199.en: People with beards so shaggy that you can't tell where the mouth is often come out of here.
DATA_CMM_2199.fr: Des gens aux barbes de père Noël s'y reposent souvent entre deux sommets.
DATA_CMM_2199.de: Hierher kommen oft Leute mit Bärten, die so struppig sind, dass man den Mund nicht mehr sieht.
DATA_CMM_2199.it: Gli abitanti hanno una barba così folta che non si vede la bocca.
DATA_CMM_2199.es: Aquí suele vivir gente con barbas tan pobladas que no se les ve la boca.
DATA_CMM_2199.ko: 어디가 입인지 구분이 안 가는 털복숭이 남자가 나와 맞이하는 경우가 많다.
DATA_CMM_2199.zht: 現身山小屋的人，經常有著毛絨大臉，難以區分嘴巴在哪邊。
DATA_CMM_2199.zhs: 现身山小屋的人，经常有着毛绒大脸，难以区分嘴巴在哪边。

DATA_CMM_2200.ja: A place that rents out skis. They must really love skiing if they have enough to lend to people.
DATA_CMM_2200.en: A place that rents out skis. They must really love skiing if they have enough to lend to people.
DATA_CMM_2200.fr: On y loue beaucoup de skis. On s'y perd dans toutes ces paires.
DATA_CMM_2200.de: Ein Ort, wo man Skier ausleiht. Die Inhaber müssen Skifahren wirklich lieben, wenn sie genug davon haben, um sie zu verleihen.
DATA_CMM_2200.it: Un posto dove si noleggiano gli sci, probabilmente ne hanno comprati un po' troppi e ora li devono prestare.
DATA_CMM_2200.es: Debe de gustarles mucho esquiar si tienen tantos pares que se los prestan a la gente.
DATA_CMM_2200.ko: 스키를 빌려주는 곳. 빌려줄 수 있을 만큼 가지고 있다니, 정말 스키를 좋아하나 보다.
DATA_CMM_2200.zht: 出租滑雪道具的地方。滑雪用品多到可以借人，可見真的很喜歡滑很滑的雪。
DATA_CMM_2200.zhs: 出租滑雪道具的地方。滑雪用品多到可以借人，可见真的很喜欢滑很滑的雪。

DATA_CMM_2201.ja: Ride in this, and reaching the mountain top is a breeze. Mountain climbers should use it too.
DATA_CMM_2201.en: Ride in this, and reaching the mountain top is a breeze. Mountain climbers should use it too.
DATA_CMM_2201.fr: Montez dedans et vous arriverez au sommet frais comme un cabri. Les alpinistes devraient l'utiliser !
DATA_CMM_2201.de: Wenn man damit fährt, erreicht man den Gipfel im Nu. Auch Bergsteiger sollten ihn benutzen.
DATA_CMM_2201.it: Un mezzo di locomozione comodo e rischioso allo stesso tempo.
DATA_CMM_2201.es: Sube en esto para llegar a la cima sin cansarte. No entendemos por qué no las usan los montañeros.
DATA_CMM_2201.ko: 여기에 타면 정상까지 편히 갈 수 있다. 등산에서도 이걸 사용하면 편리할 텐데…
DATA_CMM_2201.zht: 搭乘登山吊椅就能舒適愉快抵達山頂。爬山的時候也搭乘就輕鬆多了。
DATA_CMM_2201.zhs: 搭乘登山吊椅就能舒适愉快抵达山顶。爬山的时候也搭乘就轻松多了。

DATA_CMM_2202.ja: A house that's only in its element when the snowy season comes.
DATA_CMM_2202.en: A house that's only in its element when the snowy season comes.
DATA_CMM_2202.fr: Elle ne reprend vie que lorsque la neige revient.
DATA_CMM_2202.de: Ein Haus, das nur dann in seinem Element ist, wenn Schnee fällt.
DATA_CMM_2202.it: Una casa che trova la sua ragion d'essere nelle stagioni nevose.
DATA_CMM_2202.es: Está bien visitarla como curiosidad, pero se nos enfriarían los reales pies.
DATA_CMM_2202.ko: 눈이 내리는 계절에 실력을 발휘하는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2202.zht: 雪國住宅似乎到下雪季節就會發揮本領。
DATA_CMM_2202.zhs: 雪国住宅似乎到下雪季节就会发挥本领。

DATA_CMM_2203.ja: This melts away over time, which doesn't make for a very good pet.
DATA_CMM_2203.en: This melts away over time, which doesn't make for a very good pet.
DATA_CMM_2203.fr: Il fond quand revient la chaleur. Ce n'est pas un ami très fidèle...
DATA_CMM_2203.de: Schmilzt mit der Zeit weg und gibt so kein besonders gutes Haustier ab.
DATA_CMM_2203.it: Un animale gelido e silenzioso che ci abbandona sul far dell'estate.
DATA_CMM_2203.es: Mejor no le cojas cariño, porque en primavera se irá a un lugar mejor.
DATA_CMM_2203.ko: 시간이 지나면 녹아버리므로 애완용으로는 적합하지 않은 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2203.zht: 雪兔會隨時間經過融化，所以不能當寵物的樣子。
DATA_CMM_2203.zhs: 雪兔会随时间经过融化，所以不能当宠物的样子。

DATA_CMM_2204.ja: You'll be embarrassed without these, but too many will make you feel uneasy.
DATA_CMM_2204.en: You'll be embarrassed without these, but too many will make you feel uneasy.
DATA_CMM_2204.fr: Difficile à utiliser : on en a toujours trop ou pas assez.
DATA_CMM_2204.de: Ohne die wird's peinlich, aber zu viele fühlen sich auch nicht gut an.
DATA_CMM_2204.it: Senza ti sentiresti in imbarazzo, ma troppe mettono a disagio.
DATA_CMM_2204.es: Si se ponen demasiadas, la cosa acaba pareciendo un laberinto.
DATA_CMM_2204.ko: 이것이 없으면 창피하지만 이것만 잔뜩 있으면 왠지 불안해진다.
DATA_CMM_2204.zht: 沒有會很尷尬。但全都是窄廁所隔板的話，也總覺得靠不住。
DATA_CMM_2204.zhs: 没有会很尴尬。但全都是窄厕所隔板的话，也总觉得靠不住。

DATA_CMM_2205.ja: Apparently these help people calm down.
DATA_CMM_2205.en: Apparently these help people calm down.
DATA_CMM_2205.fr: Elles auraient un effet apaisant sur ceux qui les tapent avec le crâne.
DATA_CMM_2205.de: Helfen Leuten anscheinend dabei, sich zu entspannen.
DATA_CMM_2205.es: Hay que tener cuidado y espaciarlas bien o provocan claustrofobia.
DATA_CMM_2205.ko: 이것 덕분에 마음이 진정되는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2205.zht: 多虧有它，才能安心上廁所。
DATA_CMM_2205.zhs: 多亏有它，才能安心上厕所。

DATA_CMM_2206.ja: Considering how narrow it is, this does a great deal of work.
DATA_CMM_2206.en: Considering how narrow it is, this does a great deal of work.
DATA_CMM_2206.fr: Elle a l'air frêle, mais elle travaille beaucoup.
DATA_CMM_2206.de: Wenn man bedenkt, wie schmal er ist, leistet er richtig gute Arbeit.
DATA_CMM_2206.it: Nonostante sia magra fa un ottimo lavoro.
DATA_CMM_2206.es: Para lo delgadita que está, tiene bastante fuerza.
DATA_CMM_2206.ko: 가는 주제에 꽤 멋지게 임무를 수행하는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2206.zht: 橫梁以消瘦身材的方式工作付出，似乎表現得相當好。
DATA_CMM_2206.zhs: 横梁以消瘦身材的方式工作付出，似乎表现得相当好。

DATA_CMM_2207.ja: Even if you hear laughter come from inside, that doesn't mean they're eating their house.
DATA_CMM_2207.en: Even if you hear laughter come from inside, that doesn't mean they're eating their house.
DATA_CMM_2207.fr: Vous entendrez peut-être des rires à l'intérieur, aux heures des repas.
DATA_CMM_2207.de: Auch wenn man Lachen aus dem Haus hört, heißt das nicht, dass da jemand sein Haus isst.
DATA_CMM_2207.it: Anche se si sentono delle risate all'interno, non significa che stia mangiando la casa.
DATA_CMM_2207.es: Para gente diminuta que ama el contacto más directo con la naturaleza.
DATA_CMM_2207.ko: 이 안에서 웃음소리가 들려온다 해도, 집을 뜯어먹어서 그런 것은 아닌 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2207.zht: 就算能聽到蘑菇屋裡傳出笑聲，好像也不代表會把房子吃掉。
DATA_CMM_2207.zhs: 就算能听到蘑菇屋里传出笑声，好像也不代表会把房子吃掉。

DATA_CMM_2208.ja: If you really want to show off, you could plant red flowers where the eyes would be.
DATA_CMM_2208.en: If you really want to show off, you could plant red flowers where the eyes would be.
DATA_CMM_2208.fr: Pour frimer, vous pourriez peut-être planter des géraniums pour faire les yeux.
DATA_CMM_2208.de: Wenn man wirklich auffallen will, kann man an der Stelle, wo sich die Augen befinden würden, rote Blumen einpflanzen.
DATA_CMM_2208.it: Se proprio si vuole dare un tocco di classe, si possono piantare fiori rossi al posto degli occhi.
DATA_CMM_2208.es: Si quieres aumentar el impacto, pon flores rojas donde deberían estar los ojos.
DATA_CMM_2208.ko: 눈 주변에 빨간 꽃이 핀다든지 하는 시스템이 장비되어 있을지도…
DATA_CMM_2208.zht: 說不定會有一些別緻的巧思，像是眼睛的部位會綻放紅色花朵之類的。
DATA_CMM_2208.zhs: 说不定会有一些别致的巧思，像是眼睛的部位会绽放红色花朵之类的。

DATA_CMM_2209.ja: This may be made of branches and leaves, but those antlers still look painful. We would be careful.
DATA_CMM_2209.en: This may be made of branches and leaves, but those antlers still look painful. We would be careful.
DATA_CMM_2209.fr: C'est un animal végétant, mais ses bois ont quand même l'air redoutables. Méfions-Nous.
DATA_CMM_2209.de: Mag aus Zweigen und Blättern bestehen, aber das Geweih sieht trotzdem so aus, als würde es wehtun. Wir wären vorsichtig.
DATA_CMM_2209.it: Sembra vero, meglio stargli alla larga per precauzione.
DATA_CMM_2209.es: Será de ramas y hojas, pero la cornamenta parece contundente; precaución.
DATA_CMM_2209.ko: 이파리로 되어 있다고는 하지만, 뿔에 찔리면 아플지도 모르므로 주의하자.
DATA_CMM_2209.zht: 就算只是灌木叢，被鹿角戳到好像還是會痛，小心一點比較好。
DATA_CMM_2209.zhs: 就算只是灌木丛，被鹿角戳到好像还是会痛，小心一点比较好。

DATA_CMM_2210.ja: If you hear this quacking, that's probably just the insects inside buzzing.
DATA_CMM_2210.en: If you hear this quacking, that's probably just the insects inside buzzing.
DATA_CMM_2210.fr: Il n'a rien à voir avec le canard laqué. S'il cancane, ce sont probablement les oiseaux à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_2210.de: Wenn man es quaken hört, ist das wahrscheinlich nur auf das Summen der Insekten im Inneren zurückzuführen.
DATA_CMM_2210.it: Crediamo di averlo visto muoversi... Ma non ne siamo sicuri.
DATA_CMM_2210.es: Si ves que se agita, no te asustes: serán los bichitos que viven dentro.
DATA_CMM_2210.ko: 꽥꽥 우는 소리가 들린다면, 그건 아마 안의 벌레가 우는 소리일 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2210.zht: 葉子鴨嗄嗄叫的話，只是因為裡頭有蟲吧？
DATA_CMM_2210.zhs: 叶子鸭嗄嗄叫的话，只是因为里头有虫吧？

DATA_CMM_2211.ja: Someday, this bush wants to stick its head and legs into its shell like a real turtle.
DATA_CMM_2211.en: Someday, this bush wants to stick its head and legs into its shell like a real turtle.
DATA_CMM_2211.fr: Cette tortue a un rêve : pouvoir, un jour, rentrer sa tête et ses pattes dans sa coquille, comme toute tortue qui se respecte.
DATA_CMM_2211.de: Eines Tages möchte sich dieser Busch mit seinem Kopf und seinen Beinen in seinem Panzer verkriechen, so wie eine echte Schildkröte.
DATA_CMM_2211.it: A volte la testa e le zampe vorrebbero sparire nel guscio.
DATA_CMM_2211.es: Que no, ¿cómo va a ser una tortuga de verdad que ha echado raíces por ser tan lenta?
DATA_CMM_2211.ko: 언젠간 진짜 거북이 되어서 목이나 팔, 다리를 집어넣겠다는 야망을 지녔다.
DATA_CMM_2211.zht: 葉子龜看起來很渴望有一天能變成真正的烏龜，把頭跟四肢縮回龜殼。
DATA_CMM_2211.zhs: 叶子龟看起来很渴望有一天能变成真正的乌龟，把头跟四肢缩回龟壳。

DATA_CMM_2212.ja: It may have grown old, but it's still beautiful.
DATA_CMM_2212.en: It may have grown old, but it's still beautiful.
DATA_CMM_2212.fr: Elle est sans doute vieille, mais elle a gardé toute sa beauté.
DATA_CMM_2212.de: Ist zwar recht alt, aber immer noch schön.
DATA_CMM_2212.it: Non è appena sbocciata ma è bellissima.
DATA_CMM_2212.es: Sigue siendo hermosa pese a las canas.
DATA_CMM_2212.zht: 白玫瑰即便上了年紀，看起來還是很漂亮。
DATA_CMM_2212.zhs: 白玫瑰即便上了年纪，看起来还是很漂亮。

DATA_CMM_2213.ja: It may be yellow, but it still has thorns.
DATA_CMM_2213.en: It may be yellow, but it still has thorns.
DATA_CMM_2213.fr: Ce n'est pas parce qu'elle est jaune qu'elle n'a pas d'épines.
DATA_CMM_2213.de: Mag zwar gelb sein, hat aber trotzdem Dornen.
DATA_CMM_2213.it: Anche se è gialla ha le spine.
DATA_CMM_2213.es: La ciudad sería más hermosa si los semáforos se hicieran con flores.
DATA_CMM_2213.ko: 노란 색이라도 가시가 나 있는 건 마찬가지.
DATA_CMM_2213.zht: 黃玫瑰就算長成黃色，也依然有刺。
DATA_CMM_2213.zhs: 黄玫瑰就算长成黄色，也依然有刺。

DATA_CMM_2214.ja: If We're getting all touchy-feely, We suppose We can touch this, too.
DATA_CMM_2214.en: If We're getting all touchy-feely, We suppose We can touch this, too.
DATA_CMM_2214.fr: Si Nous devenions soudain touche-à-tout, Nous pourrions sans doute le toucher Nous aussi.
DATA_CMM_2214.de: Wenn wir schon rührselig werden, können wir das hier auch anfassen.
DATA_CMM_2214.it: Se Ci sentiamo toccati nel profondo, supponiamo di poterlo toccare.
DATA_CMM_2214.es: Para recordar a gentes que vivieron en otro tiempo. Ya podrían haber dejado una herencia.
DATA_CMM_2214.zht: 既然是心心相印，摸一下應該也沒關係。
DATA_CMM_2214.zhs: 既然是心心相印，摸一下应该也没关系。

DATA_CMM_2215.ja: This looks like a horse, but it doesn't seem quite as noble. People are split on its lovability.
DATA_CMM_2215.en: This looks like a horse, but it doesn't seem quite as noble. People are split on its lovability.
DATA_CMM_2215.fr: On dirait un cheval, mais il n'est pas aussi noble. Les opinions sont partagées à son sujet.
DATA_CMM_2215.de: Sieht aus wie ein Pferd, wirkt aber nicht ganz so anmutig. Was die Liebenswürdigkeit angeht, sind die Leute geteilter Meinung.
DATA_CMM_2215.it: Sembra un cavallo ma è un poco meno nobile.
DATA_CMM_2215.es: Hay quien dice que es más entrañable que la clásica estatua ecuestre, pero las opiniones están divididas.
DATA_CMM_2215.ko: 말인 듯하지만 말처럼 고급스런 느낌은 없는 동물. 애교면에서는 동점.
DATA_CMM_2215.zht: 驢子長得像馬，卻沒有馬一般的高貴感。討喜程度倒是平分秋色。
DATA_CMM_2215.zhs: 驴子长得像马，却没有马一般的高贵感。讨喜程度倒是平分秋色。

DATA_CMM_2216.ja: This dog waited so long for its master to come home that it turned into a statue. It's a very sad story.
DATA_CMM_2216.en: This dog waited so long for its master to come home that it turned into a statue. It's a very sad story.
DATA_CMM_2216.fr: Il a attendu pendant si longtemps que son maître rentre chez lui qu'il s'est changé en statue. Triste histoire.
DATA_CMM_2216.de: Dieser Hund wartete so lange darauf, dass sein Herrchen nach Hause kommt, dass er sich in eine Statue verwandelt hat. Eine sehr traurige Geschichte.
DATA_CMM_2216.it: Questo cane ha atteso così tanto il suo padrone che si è tramutato in una statua.
DATA_CMM_2216.es: Lleva tanto tiempo esperando al amo que ha acabado así. Qué triste.
DATA_CMM_2216.ko: 주인을 기다리다 끝내 동상이 되어버린 개와는 무관하다.
DATA_CMM_2216.zht: 和那隻癡癡等主人回家，等到變銅像的狗沒有任何關係。
DATA_CMM_2216.zhs: 和那只痴痴等主人回家，等到变铜像的狗没有任何关系。

DATA_CMM_2217.ja: A super hard cat. Maybe it saw something really scary.
DATA_CMM_2217.en: A super hard cat. Maybe it saw something really scary.
DATA_CMM_2217.fr: Ce chat de pierre est sans doute immobile parce qu'il a vu quelque chose d'effrayant.
DATA_CMM_2217.de: Eine superharte Katze. Vielleicht wurde sie von etwas sehr Unheimlichem erschreckt.
DATA_CMM_2217.it: Un gatto durissimo, sembra fatto di metallo.
DATA_CMM_2217.es: A lo mejor se ha quedado así porque vio algo que le dio mucho miedo.
DATA_CMM_2217.ko: 굉장히 딱딱해진 고양이. 뭔가 무서운 거라도 본 것인가…
DATA_CMM_2217.zht: 一隻很僵硬的貓。說不定是因為看到恐怖的東西。
DATA_CMM_2217.zhs: 一只很僵硬的猫。说不定是因为看到恐怖的东西。

DATA_CMM_2218.ja: A very hard rooster. It's much sturdier than the one spinning around on the roof.
DATA_CMM_2218.en: A very hard rooster. It's much sturdier than the one spinning around on the roof.
DATA_CMM_2218.fr: Coq de roc. Il est beaucoup plus solide que ceux qui tournent sur les toits.
DATA_CMM_2218.de: Ein sehr harter Hahn. Wesentlich stabiler als der, der sich auf dem Dach dreht.
DATA_CMM_2218.it: Un gallo più massiccio di quello che segna il vento sul tetto.
DATA_CMM_2218.es: Por más horas que lo dejes estofar, no va a ponerse tierno; mejor haz una ensalada.
DATA_CMM_2218.ko: 굉장히 단단한 닭. 지붕 위에서 빙글빙글 도는 녀석보다도 더 단단하다.
DATA_CMM_2218.zht: 非常結實的雞。比在屋頂打轉的那隻還強壯。
DATA_CMM_2218.zhs: 非常结实的鸡。比在屋顶打转的那只还强壮。

DATA_CMM_2219.ja: The largest flower in the world. It's hard to imagine giving something this big as a present.
DATA_CMM_2219.en: The largest flower in the world. It's hard to imagine giving something this big as a present.
DATA_CMM_2219.fr: La plus grande fleur du monde. Elle fleurit rarement, alors il est très dur de l'offrir.
DATA_CMM_2219.de: Die größte Blume der Welt. Es ist schwer vorstellbar, etwas so Großes zu verschenken.
DATA_CMM_2219.it: Il fiore più grande del mondo. Speriamo non lo vendano mai a mazzi.
DATA_CMM_2219.es: Es la flor más grande del mundo; no es la más práctica para un ramo, pues.
DATA_CMM_2219.ko: 세계에서 가장 큰 꽃. 아무리 그래도 이 정도로 크면 선물로는 적합하지 않은 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2219.zht: 世界上最大的花。這麼巨大的花，應該沒辦法當禮物了。
DATA_CMM_2219.zhs: 世界上最大的花。这么巨大的花，应该没办法当礼物了。

DATA_CMM_2220.ja: A shiny gold axe. Not very practical for chopping wood.
DATA_CMM_2220.en: A shiny gold axe. Not very practical for chopping wood.
DATA_CMM_2220.fr: Hache d'or brillante. Elle n'est pas très pratique pour couper du bois.
DATA_CMM_2220.de: Eine glänzende Axt aus Gold. Zum Holzhacken eher unpraktisch.
DATA_CMM_2220.it: Un'ascia fatta d'oro. Era legata ad una leggenda...
DATA_CMM_2220.es: No sirve para cortar madera, pero queda estupenda encima de la chimenea.
DATA_CMM_2220.ko: 번쩍번쩍한 도끼. 내심 이것을 노리고 있다고 해도 처음엔 무조건 거절하도록.
DATA_CMM_2220.zht: 金光閃閃的斧頭。就算真的想要金斧頭，一開始也必須拒絕。
DATA_CMM_2220.zhs: 金光闪闪的斧头。就算真的想要金斧头，一开始也必须拒绝。

DATA_CMM_2221.ja: A dazzling silver axe. We would sell it and buy a chainsaw.
DATA_CMM_2221.en: A dazzling silver axe. We would sell it and buy a chainsaw.
DATA_CMM_2221.fr: Hache d'argent éclatante. Nous préférons utiliser les tronçonneuses.
DATA_CMM_2221.de: Eine strahlende Axt aus Silber. Wir würden sie verkaufen und lieber eine Kettensäge davon kaufen.
DATA_CMM_2221.it: Un'ascia d'argento. Certo che se ne avessimo una la venderemmo in cambio di una motosega.
DATA_CMM_2221.es: Lo más inteligente sería venderla y comprar una motosierra.
DATA_CMM_2221.ko: 번쩍번쩍한 도끼. 이것 역시 거절해야 한다. 어차피 나중에 모두 받을 테니 조금만 더 참아라.
DATA_CMM_2221.zht: 也必須拒絕閃閃發亮的銀斧頭。要先忍耐，之後應該可以拿到手。
DATA_CMM_2221.zhs: 也必须拒绝闪闪发亮的银斧头。要先忍耐，之后应该可以拿到手。

DATA_CMM_2222.ja: This signals that the race has started. You don't have to worry about this during the race itself.
DATA_CMM_2222.en: This signals that the race has started. You don't have to worry about this during the race itself.
DATA_CMM_2222.fr: Indique que la course a commencé, puis il sombre dans l'oubli.
DATA_CMM_2222.de: Signalisiert, dass ein Rennen beginnt. Während des Rennens selbst muss man nicht darauf achten.
DATA_CMM_2222.it: Questo dà il segnale che la corsa è iniziata.
DATA_CMM_2222.es: Para que sepas que la carrera ha empezado, aunque no participes.
DATA_CMM_2222.ko: 레이스의 시작을 알리는 신호. 레이스 중에는 신경쓰지 말고 무조건 달리면 된다.
DATA_CMM_2222.zht: 會通知開始比賽的訊號。比賽中不必太介意賽車信號燈，盡情奔馳就行了。
DATA_CMM_2222.zhs: 会通知开始比赛的讯号。比赛中不必太介意赛车信号灯，尽情奔驰就行了。

DATA_CMM_2223.ja: Crash into this barrier, and you'll end up okay. The barrier itself may be annoyed though.
DATA_CMM_2223.en: Crash into this barrier, and you'll end up okay. The barrier itself may be annoyed though.
DATA_CMM_2223.fr: Ecrasez votre voiture contre cette barrière et vous n'aurez pas une égratignure. Mais la barrière sera un peu froissée...
DATA_CMM_2223.de: Wenn man gegen diese Barriere fährt, passiert nichts. Vielleicht stört es aber die Barriere selbst.
DATA_CMM_2223.it: Chiunque si schianti su questa barriera non si fa del male. La barriera invece sì.
DATA_CMM_2223.es: Si chocas, a ti no te pasará nada, pero la barrera puede tomárselo como un atropello.
DATA_CMM_2223.ko: 부딪혀도 괜찮도록 만든 구조물. 정작 본인은 굉장히 민폐일 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2223.zht: 撞上去也不要緊。不過對紅輪胎護欄來說相當困擾吧？
DATA_CMM_2223.zhs: 撞上去也不要紧。不过对红轮胎护栏来说相当困扰吧？

DATA_CMM_2228.ja: The race drivers are too busy concentrating on the race to notice this. We don't expect it's very effective.
DATA_CMM_2228.en: The race drivers are too busy concentrating on the race to notice this. We don't expect it's very effective.
DATA_CMM_2228.fr: Les pilotes sont trop concentrés sur la course pour la remarquer. Elle doit s'ennuyer.
DATA_CMM_2228.de: Rennfahrer sind zu sehr damit beschäftigt, sich auf ihr Rennen zu konzentrieren, um auf ihn zu achten. Wir glauben nicht, dass er große Wirkung erzielt.
DATA_CMM_2228.it: Probabilmente i piloti sono troppo concentrati sulla gara per notare queste pubblicità, non saranno molto efficaci.
DATA_CMM_2228.es: Los pilotos están tan concentrados que ni lo ven; dudamos de su efectividad publicitaria.
DATA_CMM_2228.ko: 레이스 중인 레이서는 필사적이기 때문에 그다지 광고 효과는 없을 것 같은데…
DATA_CMM_2228.zht: 選手都很拼命比賽，所以不太能期待贊助商拱門的成效。
DATA_CMM_2228.zhs: 选手都很拼命比赛，所以不太能期待赞助商拱门的成效。

DATA_CMM_2229.ja: An ad for a store that sells a lot more than departments nowadays. They really ought to update the name.
DATA_CMM_2229.en: An ad for a store that sells a lot more than departments nowadays. They really ought to update the name.
DATA_CMM_2229.fr: Pub pour un magasin qui vend ce que proposent plusieurs petits magasins. C'est peut-être pour cela qu'il est grand.
DATA_CMM_2229.de: Eine Anzeige für ein Haus, in dem man aber keine Häuser kauft. Man sollte sich wirklich einen neuen Namen überlegen.
DATA_CMM_2229.it: La pubblicità di un centro commerciale.
DATA_CMM_2229.es: En el anuncio ya dicen que la tienda es grande para que vayas con tiempo.
DATA_CMM_2229.ko: 틀림없이 100종류 이상의 상품을 팔고 있는 가게의 간판. 이름을 바꾸는 편이 나을 듯싶다.
DATA_CMM_2229.zht: 商店的招牌，確實販賣著百種以上的商品。換個名字可能比較好吧？
DATA_CMM_2229.zhs: 商店的招牌，确实贩卖着百种以上的商品。换个名字可能比较好吧？

DATA_CMM_2230.ja: Apparently, it's best not to drink too much of this. Then again, it's best not to drink too much of anything.
DATA_CMM_2230.en: Apparently, it's best not to drink too much of this. Then again, it's best not to drink too much of anything.
DATA_CMM_2230.fr: On recommande de ne pas abuser de ce liquide. En fait, il est mieux de ne rien boire en excès.
DATA_CMM_2230.de: Anscheinend ist es ratsam, nicht zu viel davon zu trinken. Aber eigentlich ist es auch ratsam, von nichts zu viel zu trinken.
DATA_CMM_2230.it: Berlo fa molto bene, a quanto pare, a meno che non si sia allergici.
DATA_CMM_2230.es: Dicen que no es bueno beber leche en exceso, pero en realidad no es bueno beber nada en exceso.
DATA_CMM_2230.ko: 과음해선 안 된다면 다른 음료와 뭐가 다른 거지?
DATA_CMM_2230.zht: 跟其他飲料一樣，要小心不要飲用過量。
DATA_CMM_2230.zhs: 跟其他饮料一样，要小心不要饮用过量。

DATA_CMM_2231.ja: A very pop-art style plant, but the more pop-art it is, the more likely it's poisonous.
DATA_CMM_2231.en: A very pop-art style plant, but the more pop-art it is, the more likely it's poisonous.
DATA_CMM_2231.fr: Plante qui a adopté un style très pop art. En général, plus elle a ce style-là, plus elle est vénéneuse.
DATA_CMM_2231.de: Eine Pflanze im Pop-Art-Stil, aber je pop-art-iger sie ist, desto wahrscheinlicher ist sie giftig.
DATA_CMM_2231.it: Forma di vita molto pop art.
DATA_CMM_2231.es: Cuanto más colorida y llamativa sea, más probable es que sea venenosa.
DATA_CMM_2231.ko: 어딘가 경쾌한 느낌을 주는 식물. 그러나 경쾌한 느낌을 주는 것들은 대부분 독버섯.
DATA_CMM_2231.zht: 總覺得蘑菇有種流行的氣質。不過越是流行的東西通常越毒。
DATA_CMM_2231.zhs: 总觉得蘑菇有种流行的气质。不过越是流行的东西通常越毒。

DATA_CMM_2232.ja: That color is charming, but the taste leaves much to be desired.
DATA_CMM_2232.en: That color is charming, but the taste leaves much to be desired.
DATA_CMM_2232.fr: Il est d'une couleur charmante mais son goût laisse à désirer.
DATA_CMM_2232.de: Seine Farbe ist reizvoll, aber sein Geschmack lässt zu wünschen übrig.
DATA_CMM_2232.it: I colori sono bellissimi, il sapore è pessimo.
DATA_CMM_2232.es: El color es precioso, pero el sabor deja mucho que desear.
DATA_CMM_2232.ko: 매력적인 색을 띠고 있지만 맛은 그다지 매력적이지 않은 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2232.zht: 顏色很有吸引力，但味道又是另一回事了。
DATA_CMM_2232.zhs: 颜色很有吸引力，但味道又是另一回事了。

DATA_CMM_2233.ja: A place where they watch over the race and keep it safe.
DATA_CMM_2233.en: A place where they watch over the race and keep it safe.
DATA_CMM_2233.fr: Endroit d'où l'on observe la course pour qu'elle reste sûre.
DATA_CMM_2233.de: Ein Ort, an dem man über ein Rennen wacht und für seine Sicherheit sorgt.
DATA_CMM_2233.it: Una postazione per osservare che tutto vada liscio nella gara.
DATA_CMM_2233.es: Desde aquí vigilan la carrera para asegurarse de que no se hace daño.

DATA_CMM_2234.ja: A vehicle that uses a propeller to fly. Sometimes it just sits on the ground and spins, too.
DATA_CMM_2234.en: A vehicle that uses a propeller to fly. Sometimes it just sits on the ground and spins, too.
DATA_CMM_2234.fr: Véhicule qui utilise une hélice pour voler. Parfois, elle tourne alors qu'il ne bouge pas.
DATA_CMM_2234.de: Ein Transportmittel, das zum Fliegen einen Propeller benutzt. Manchmal sitzt es auch einfach auf dem Boden, obwohl sich der Propeller dreht.
DATA_CMM_2234.it: Un veicolo che usa delle eliche per volare. Non capiamo esattamente come faccia.
DATA_CMM_2234.es: No sabemos por qué, pero siempre nos hacen pensar en libélulas.
DATA_CMM_2234.ko: 프로펠러로 하늘을 나는 탈것. 빙글빙글 돌기도 한다.
DATA_CMM_2234.zht: 靠螺旋槳飛上天的交通工具。也會在原地轉來轉去。
DATA_CMM_2234.zhs: 靠螺旋桨飞上天的交通工具。也会在原地转来转去。

DATA_CMM_2235.ja: A cloud shaped like a heart. It must have feelings for another cloud.
DATA_CMM_2235.en: A cloud shaped like a heart. It must have feelings for another cloud.
DATA_CMM_2235.fr: Il est au cœur des nuages. Sa forme semble indiquer qu'il en pince pour un autre nuage.
DATA_CMM_2235.de: Eine Wolke in der Form eines Herzens. Sie hat bestimmt Gefühle für eine andere Wolke.
DATA_CMM_2235.it: Una nuvola a forma di cuore. Probabilmente si è innamorata di un'altra nuvola.
DATA_CMM_2235.es: Esta nube debe de estar enamorada de algún cumulonimbo.
DATA_CMM_2235.ko: 비둘기 모양을 한 구름. 아마도 마음을 주고 있는 구름이 있는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2235.zht: 愛心形狀的雲。看來有雲懷著思慕之情。
DATA_CMM_2235.zhs: 爱心形状的云。看来有云怀着思慕之情。

DATA_CMM_2236.ja: A cloud that looks like ice cream. Don't worry, it won't ever melt.
DATA_CMM_2236.en: A cloud that looks like ice cream. Don't worry, it won't ever melt.
DATA_CMM_2236.fr: Nuage ressemblant à une glace. Il doit être très froid.
DATA_CMM_2236.de: Eine Wolke, die wie ein Eis aussieht. Keine Sorge, sie schmilzt nie.
DATA_CMM_2236.it: Una nuvola a forma di gelato. Un gelato che non si squaglia.
DATA_CMM_2236.es: Lo bueno de esta nube es que no se funde. Lo malo, que no se puede comer.
DATA_CMM_2236.ko: 소프트 아이스처럼 생긴 구름. 시간이 지나도 녹지 않아 안심이다.
DATA_CMM_2236.zht: 像霜淇淋的雲。放著不管也不會融化，很令人放心。
DATA_CMM_2236.zhs: 像霜淇淋的云。放着不管也不会融化，很令人放心。

DATA_CMM_2237.ja: A cloud shaped like an adorable kitten. It may also look like other things, depending on how you look at it.
DATA_CMM_2237.en: A cloud shaped like an adorable kitten. It may also look like other things, depending on how you look at it.
DATA_CMM_2237.fr: Il fait penser à un agréable chaton. Mais attention, quand il ronronne, c'est qu'il y a de l'orage dans l'air.
DATA_CMM_2237.de: Eine Wolke mit der Form eines niedlichen Kätzchens. Vielleicht sieht sie auch nach etwas anderem aus, je nachdem, wie man sie betrachtet.
DATA_CMM_2237.it: Una nuvola a forma di gattino. In realtà potrebbe sembrare anche altre cose.
DATA_CMM_2237.es: Qué mona esta nube con forma de gatito. O de otras cosas, según cómo la mires.
DATA_CMM_2237.ko: 귀여운 고양이 모습을 한 구름. 보는 사람에 따라서는 전혀 다른 것으로 보이기도 한다.
DATA_CMM_2237.zht: 可愛貓咪形狀的雲。不同的人可能會把雲看成不同的東西。
DATA_CMM_2237.zhs: 可爱猫咪形状的云。不同的人可能会把云看成不同的东西。

DATA_CMM_2238.ja: A melon-shaped cloud. If you broke it open, there would probably be a very sticky rainstorm.
DATA_CMM_2238.en: A melon-shaped cloud. If you broke it open, there would probably be a very sticky rainstorm.
DATA_CMM_2238.fr: Espérons que sa pluie n'est pas du jus de melon.
DATA_CMM_2238.de: Eine melonenförmige Wolke. Würde man sie aufbrechen, bekäme man wahrscheinlich sehr klebrigen Regen.
DATA_CMM_2238.it: Una nuvola a forma di melone. Speriamo non si apra.
DATA_CMM_2238.es: Y si pudiéramos abrirla, ¿caería una lluvia dulce de pepitas y almíbar?
DATA_CMM_2238.ko: 멜론 모양의 구름. 아마 속을 가르면 끈적끈적한 비가 내릴 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2238.zht: 宛如哈密瓜的雲。切開的話大概會下黏答答的雨吧？
DATA_CMM_2238.zhs: 宛如哈密瓜的云。切开的话大概会下粘答答的雨吧？

DATA_CMM_2239.ja: A cloud shaped like a strawberry shortcake. There's more than enough to go around, so don't worry.
DATA_CMM_2239.en: A cloud shaped like a strawberry shortcake. There's more than enough to go around, so don't worry.
DATA_CMM_2239.fr: Nuage à l'air de gâteau à la fraise. Il y en aura pour tout le monde, ne vous pressez pas.
DATA_CMM_2239.de: Eine Wolke mit der Form eines Erdbeerkuchens. Es ist mehr als genug für alle da, also keine Sorge.
DATA_CMM_2239.it: Una nuvola a forma di tortina, ci si mangerebbe in tanti.
DATA_CMM_2239.es: Las personas glotonas siempre acaban viendo nubes como esta cuando miran al cielo.
DATA_CMM_2239.ko: 딸기 케이크 모양을 한 구름. 서로 먹으려 다투지 않아도 될 만큼 크므로 안심이다.
DATA_CMM_2239.zht: 草莓奶油蛋糕形狀的雲。儘管放心，蛋糕大到不會產生爭執。
DATA_CMM_2239.zhs: 草莓奶油蛋糕形状的云。尽管放心，蛋糕大到不会产生争执。

DATA_CMM_2240.ja: A cylindrical candy with a face on it. Slice it all you want, and the same face will always pop up.
DATA_CMM_2240.en: A cylindrical candy with a face on it. Slice it all you want, and the same face will always pop up.
DATA_CMM_2240.fr: Friandise cylindrique sur laquelle est dessiné un visage. Découpez-la autant que vous voulez, le visage ne disparaîtra pas.
DATA_CMM_2240.de: Ein zylindrisches Bonbon mit Gesicht darauf. Man kann es in Scheiben schneiden, so oft man will, und man wird immer dasselbe Gesicht sehen.
DATA_CMM_2240.it: Un dolce cilindrico con una faccia stampata. Puoi associare ad essa il tuo peggior nemico.
DATA_CMM_2240.es: Estos caramelos llevan una cara; quizá sea la del campeón de comer caramelos.
DATA_CMM_2240.ko: 어디를 잘라도 긴타로 얼굴이 나오는 사탕. 비스듬하게 자르면 엄청난 사람이 등장한다.
DATA_CMM_2240.zht: 不管怎麼切都會冒出金太郎的糖果。斜斜切下去的話會出現很厲害的人物。
DATA_CMM_2240.zhs: 不管怎么切都会冒出金太郎的糖果。斜斜切下去的话会出现很厉害的人物。

DATA_CMM_2241.ja: A tool used to hold cloth in place while sewing.
DATA_CMM_2241.en: A tool used to hold cloth in place while sewing.
DATA_CMM_2241.fr: Elle permet de tenir le tissu pendant qu'on coud.
DATA_CMM_2241.de: Ein Werkzeug, das dazu dient, beim Nähen den Stoff zu fixieren.
DATA_CMM_2241.it: Uno strumento usato per tener fermi i vestiti mentre si cuce.
DATA_CMM_2241.es: Sirve para sujetar la ropa al coser, pero alguna gente los clava en muñecos.
DATA_CMM_2241.ko: 바느질을 할 때 천을 고정시키는 도구.
DATA_CMM_2241.zht: 縫紉的時候預留布的道具。
DATA_CMM_2241.zhs: 缝纫的时候预留布的道具。

DATA_CMM_2242.ja: Red and blue in a single pencil! It's not purple in the middle or anything.
DATA_CMM_2242.en: Red and blue in a single pencil! It's not purple in the middle or anything.
DATA_CMM_2242.fr: Du rouge et du bleu dans un seul crayon ! Ils ne se mélangent pas, cependant.
DATA_CMM_2242.de: Rot und Blau in einem einzigen Stift! Ist in der Mitte nicht lila oder so.
DATA_CMM_2242.it: Una matita a doppia funzione, amata da un certo tipo di insegnanti. Da quel certo tipo.
DATA_CMM_2242.es: Lo malo es que si lo pierdes, te quedas sin los dos colores.
DATA_CMM_2242.ko: 파랑과 빨강이 하나가 되었다. 가운데로 쓴다고 보라색이 되거나 하진 않는다.
DATA_CMM_2242.zht: 一隻有藍色也有紅色的彩色鉛筆。但交接處的顏色不會變紫色。
DATA_CMM_2242.zhs: 一只有蓝色也有红色的彩色铅笔。但交接处的颜色不会变紫色。

DATA_CMM_2243.ja: A tool used to clip together two pieces of paper.
DATA_CMM_2243.en: A tool used to clip together two pieces of paper.
DATA_CMM_2243.fr: Outil permettant d'attacher deux morceaux de papier.
DATA_CMM_2243.de: Ein Werkzeug zum Zusammenheften von zwei Papierstücken.
DATA_CMM_2243.it: Usata per tenere assieme due pezzi di carta.
DATA_CMM_2243.es: Como las hojas de papel no tienen manitas de las que cogerse, se sujetan con esto.
DATA_CMM_2243.zht: 把紙跟紙併在一起的道具。
DATA_CMM_2243.zhs: 把纸跟纸并在一起的道具。

DATA_CMM_2244.ja: A tin filled with cookies. Sometimes when you open it, all that's left are the paper dividers.
DATA_CMM_2244.en: A tin filled with cookies. Sometimes when you open it, all that's left are the paper dividers.
DATA_CMM_2244.fr: Boîte pleine de biscuits. Parfois désespérément vide car tous ses habitants sont partis pour un long voyage...
DATA_CMM_2244.de: Eine Dose gefüllt mit Keksen. Manchmal öffnet man sie und findet nur noch Butterbrotpapier darin vor.
DATA_CMM_2244.it: Una latta piena di biscotti. Anche se aprirla può riservare amare sorprese.
DATA_CMM_2244.es: Si tienes un mal día, seguro que al abrirla solo quedan las migas.
DATA_CMM_2244.ko: 쿠키가 들어있는 캔. 어쩌면 빈 곽만 있지 않을까 하는 불길한 느낌이 든다…
DATA_CMM_2244.zht: 塞滿餅乾的盒子。說不定打開後只剩塑膠隔層。
DATA_CMM_2244.zhs: 塞满饼干的盒子。说不定打开后只剩塑胶隔层。

DATA_CMM_2245.ja: Medicine you put directly into your eyes. When you apply it, you make a face that looks like you want some in your mouth, too.
DATA_CMM_2245.en: Medicine you put directly into your eyes. When you apply it, you make a face that looks like you want some in your mouth, too.
DATA_CMM_2245.fr: Médicaments que vous mettez directement dans les yeux. Au moment où vous les appliquez, vous n'y voyez goutte.
DATA_CMM_2245.de: Medizin, die man direkt in die Augen gibt. Wenn man sie benutzt, verzieht man sein Gesicht so, als würde man auch etwas in den Mund tropfen.
DATA_CMM_2245.it: Una medicina in gocce da mettere direttamente negli occhi. La gente fa delle facce stranissime quando la mette.
DATA_CMM_2245.es: Aunque no duele ni pica ni nada, hay gente a la que hay que atar para ponérselas.
DATA_CMM_2245.ko: 눈에 직접 넣는 약. 집어넣을 때는 입에도 넣어달라는 듯한 표정이 된다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2245.zht: 直接點進眼睛裡的藥。點藥水時嘴巴張開開的，好像也想把藥點進去。
DATA_CMM_2245.zhs: 直接点进眼睛里的药。点药水时嘴巴张开开的，好像也想把药点进去。

DATA_CMM_2246.ja: A piece of paper you stick on letters in place of cash when you send them. You can't use it as cash in stores, though.
DATA_CMM_2246.en: A piece of paper you stick on letters in place of cash when you send them. You can't use it as cash in stores, though.
DATA_CMM_2246.fr: Morceau de papier que l'on colle sur les lettres pour les faire voyager. Ce n'est pas un billet de banque.
DATA_CMM_2246.de: Ein Stück Papier, das man anstelle von Bargeld auf Briefe klebt, um sie zu verschicken. In Geschäften wird sie als Bargeld aber nicht akzeptiert.
DATA_CMM_2246.it: Un pezzo di carta da incollare sulle lettere per spedirle. Prima bisogna leccarlo, il che è un po' disgustoso.
DATA_CMM_2246.es: Los hacen con un sabor repugnante para asegurarse de que no los pegas a lo tonto por ahí.
DATA_CMM_2246.ko: 편지를 보낼 때, 돈 대신 붙이는 종이. 가게에서 돈 대신 사용할 수는 없다.
DATA_CMM_2246.zht: 代替郵資的紙片，會貼在要寄的信上面。
DATA_CMM_2246.zhs: 代替邮资的纸片，会贴在要寄的信上面。

DATA_CMM_2247.ja: A table whose legs can be folded up. Don't forget to take the legs out again when you use it.
DATA_CMM_2247.en: A table whose legs can be folded up. Don't forget to take the legs out again when you use it.
DATA_CMM_2247.fr: Table dont les pieds peuvent être repliés. N'oubliez pas de les déplier avant de l'utiliser à nouveau.
DATA_CMM_2247.de: Ein Tisch, dessen Beine hochgeklappt werden können. Aber nicht vergessen, die Beine wieder auszuklappen, bevor man ihn benutzt.
DATA_CMM_2247.it: Un tavolo le cui gambe possono essere richiuse. Meglio riaprirle per usarlo di nuovo.
DATA_CMM_2247.es: Claro que parece muy baja, ¡te has olvidado de ponerle las patas!
DATA_CMM_2247.ko: 다리를 접을 수 있는 타입의 테이블. 사용할 때 다리를 펴는 것을 잊어서는 안된다.
DATA_CMM_2247.zht: 腳可以疊起來的桌子。別忘了使用的時候要把腳伸出來。
DATA_CMM_2247.zhs: 脚可以迭起来的桌子。别忘了使用的时候要把脚伸出来。

DATA_CMM_2248.ja: An even more effective trap than a banana peel.
DATA_CMM_2248.en: An even more effective trap than a banana peel.
DATA_CMM_2248.fr: Piège encore plus efficace qu'une peau de banane.
DATA_CMM_2248.de: Eine noch effektivere Falle als Bananenschalen.
DATA_CMM_2248.it: Più insidioso di una buccia di banana.
DATA_CMM_2248.es: Uno solo garantiza más caídas que las pieles de mil plátanos.
DATA_CMM_2248.ko: 바나나 껍질보다 멋진 함정이 될 듯싶다.
DATA_CMM_2248.zht: 感覺比香蕉皮更適合當陷阱。
DATA_CMM_2248.zhs: 感觉比香蕉皮更适合当陷阱。

DATA_CMM_2249.ja: A tool used to keep laundry from flying off the line.
DATA_CMM_2249.en: A tool used to keep laundry from flying off the line.
DATA_CMM_2249.fr: Outil utilisé pour empêcher le linge de se faire la malle. Sorte de berger du tissu.
DATA_CMM_2249.de: Ein Werkzeug, das verhindert, dass Wäsche von der Leine fliegt.
DATA_CMM_2249.it: Un attrezzo usato per evitare che i vestiti se ne volino via.
DATA_CMM_2249.es: Sirve para que la ropa tendida no pueda aprovechar el viento para evadirse.
DATA_CMM_2249.ko: 세탁물이 바람에 날리지 않도록 집어놓는 도구.
DATA_CMM_2249.zht: 用來夾住洗好的衣服，防止被風吹走。
DATA_CMM_2249.zhs: 用来夹住洗好的衣服，防止被风吹走。

DATA_CMM_2250.ja: Eggs in-between two pieces of bread, just like the name.
DATA_CMM_2250.en: Eggs in-between two pieces of bread, just like the name.
DATA_CMM_2250.fr: Œufs pris en sandwich au milieu de tranches de pain, comme le nom l'indique.
DATA_CMM_2250.de: Eier zwischen zwei Brotscheiben, wie der Name schon sagt.
DATA_CMM_2250.es: Nos sigue gustando más el tradicional huevo frito con su yemita, mmm.
DATA_CMM_2250.ko: 내용물이 계란이어서 이런 이름이 붙은 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2250.zht: 似乎因為夾著蛋才叫雞蛋三明治。
DATA_CMM_2250.zhs: 似乎因为夹着蛋才叫鸡蛋三明治。

DATA_CMM_2251.ja: A sugary cookie. Eat too many before dinner and your mom will yell at you.
DATA_CMM_2251.en: A sugary cookie. Eat too many before dinner and your mom will yell at you.
DATA_CMM_2251.fr: Biscuit sucré. Si vous en mangez trop avant le repas, votre maman ne se montrera pas tout miel.
DATA_CMM_2251.de: Ein Keks aus Zucker. Wenn man vor dem Abendessen zu viele davon isst, bekommt man Ärger mit seiner Mutter.
DATA_CMM_2251.it: Un biscotto molto dolce, mai mangiarne troppi prima di cena.
DATA_CMM_2251.es: Irresistible; no comas demasiadas antes de la cena o tu madre acabará escondiéndolas.
DATA_CMM_2251.ko: 달콤한 쿠키. 저녁 식사 전에 너무 많이 먹으면 엄마한테 혼난다.
DATA_CMM_2251.zht: 香甜的餅乾。晚餐前吃太多會被媽媽罵。
DATA_CMM_2251.zhs: 香甜的饼干。晚餐前吃太多会被妈妈骂。

DATA_CMM_2252.ja: Apparently these have dried fruit in them. We wish there were something juicier inside.
DATA_CMM_2252.en: Apparently these have dried fruit in them. We wish there were something juicier inside.
DATA_CMM_2252.fr: Celui-ci contiendrait des fruits secs. Nous trouvons cela plutôt étrange.
DATA_CMM_2252.de: Anscheinend ist er mit Trockenfrüchten gefüllt. Wir wünschten, da wäre etwas Saftigeres drin.
DATA_CMM_2252.it: Con frutta secca all'interno. Chissà che sapore ha.
DATA_CMM_2252.es: Este bizcocho va relleno de fruta desecada; está bueno, pero le falta un algo...
DATA_CMM_2252.ko: 말린 과일이 들어있는 듯하다. 물기 있는 과일도 먹고 싶은데…
DATA_CMM_2252.zht: 據說裡面會加水果乾。真希望是放新鮮多汁的水果。
DATA_CMM_2252.zhs: 据说里面会加水果干。真希望是放新鲜多汁的水果。

DATA_CMM_2253.ja: Those colors may be flashy, but it tastes just like any other candy.
DATA_CMM_2253.en: Those colors may be flashy, but it tastes just like any other candy.
DATA_CMM_2253.fr: Il a peut être des couleurs vives, mais son goût n'est pas très différent de celui des autres bonbons.
DATA_CMM_2253.de: Trotz der schrillen Farben schmeckt sie wie jede andere Süßigkeit.
DATA_CMM_2253.it: Ha dei colori brillanti ma il sapore è piuttosto banale.
DATA_CMM_2253.es: Los colores llaman mucho la atención, pero sabe igual que cualquier otro caramelo.
DATA_CMM_2253.zht: 顏色很鮮豔，吃起來就只是糖果。
DATA_CMM_2253.zhs: 颜色很鲜艳，吃起来就只是糖果。

DATA_CMM_2254.ja: If you get greedy and stuff a lot of these in your mouth, you won't be able to breathe. So be careful.
DATA_CMM_2254.en: If you get greedy and stuff a lot of these in your mouth, you won't be able to breathe. So be careful.
DATA_CMM_2254.fr: Si vous êtes gourmand, attention ! Ne vous étouffez pas en mangeant trop vite.
DATA_CMM_2254.de: Wenn man gierig wird und sich zu viel davon in den Mund steckt, bekommt man keine Luft mehr. Also Vorsicht.
DATA_CMM_2254.es: Si te llenas demasiado la boca, no podrás respirar. Que lo sepas.
DATA_CMM_2254.ko: 욕심 부려서 잔뜩 입에 넣으면 숨을 못 쉬니 주의할 것.
DATA_CMM_2254.zht: 如果太貪心一口塞進嘴巴裡，可能會哽到無法呼吸，要小心。
DATA_CMM_2254.zhs: 如果太贪心一口塞进嘴巴里，可能会哽到无法呼吸，要小心。

DATA_CMM_2255.ja: A super sweet candy that's a major pain if it gets stuck behind your teeth.
DATA_CMM_2255.en: A super sweet candy that's a major pain if it gets stuck behind your teeth.
DATA_CMM_2255.fr: Merveilleuse friandise qui devient un cauchemar lorsqu'elle se coince entre deux dents.
DATA_CMM_2255.de: Ein supersüße Süßigkeit, die echt nervig sein kann, wenn sie zwischen den Zähnen klebt.
DATA_CMM_2255.it: Un dolce super zuccherato che si attacca ai denti come null'altro al mondo.
DATA_CMM_2255.es: Una vez se nos quedó pegado a una muela y nos la arrancamos al intentar despegarlo. Palabra de soberano.
DATA_CMM_2255.ko: 앞니 앞에 붙으면 꽤나 고생하는 달콤한 과자.
DATA_CMM_2255.zht: 黏在門牙內側會很難纏的甜食。
DATA_CMM_2255.zhs: 粘在门牙内侧会很难缠的甜食。

DATA_CMM_2256.ja: A somewhat darker-colored caramel. There's apparently coffee inside, but it tastes as sweet as ever.
DATA_CMM_2256.en: A somewhat darker-colored caramel. There's apparently coffee inside, but it tastes as sweet as ever.
DATA_CMM_2256.fr: Caramel plus noir que les autres. Il y aurait du café à l'intérieur, mais il n'est pas amer pour deux sous.
DATA_CMM_2256.de: Ein etwas dunkler gefärbtes Karamell. Anscheinend ist da Kaffee drin, schmeckt aber so süß wie eh und je.
DATA_CMM_2256.it: Un dolce al caramello più scuro, forse ha un po' di caffè tra gli ingredienti.
DATA_CMM_2256.es: Aunque se supone que lleva café, no tiene nada de amargo.
DATA_CMM_2256.ko: 약간 색깔이 진한 캐러멜. 커피가 들어간 듯하지만 달콤한 것은 변함이 없다.
DATA_CMM_2256.zht: 顏色有點深的焦糖。好像會加進咖啡裡，但焦糖仍然很甜。
DATA_CMM_2256.zhs: 颜色有点深的焦糖。好像会加进咖啡里，但焦糖仍然很甜。

DATA_CMM_2257.ja: A crispy, light snack. Can be used as a toothbrush if you put some chocolate on it.
DATA_CMM_2257.en: A crispy, light snack. Can be used as a toothbrush if you put some chocolate on it.
DATA_CMM_2257.fr: Petit biscuit croquant. Les motifs à la surface en font une brosse à dents sucrée.
DATA_CMM_2257.de: Ein knuspriger und einfacher Snack. Kann auch als Zahnbürste für Schokolade benutzt werden.
DATA_CMM_2257.it: Un dolce leggero insaporito dalla vaniglia.
DATA_CMM_2257.es: Estas galletas son golosas y estupendas con helado.
DATA_CMM_2257.ko: 바삭바삭 가벼운 느낌의 과자. 초콜릿을 치약삼아 양치질하는 칫솔도 된다.
DATA_CMM_2257.zht: 吃起來又酥又脆的點心。有些還會做成巧克力牙刷的形狀。
DATA_CMM_2257.zhs: 吃起来又酥又脆的点心。有些还会做成巧克力牙刷的形状。

DATA_CMM_2258.ja: A cookie stuck into some cream. It tastes better if you let the cream work its way inside a bit.
DATA_CMM_2258.en: A cookie stuck into some cream. It tastes better if you let the cream work its way inside a bit.
DATA_CMM_2258.fr: Un biscuit avec de la crème. Encore meilleur si on le laisse s'en imbiber.
DATA_CMM_2258.de: Ein Keks, der in etwas Sahne steckt. Er schmeckt noch besser, wenn er ein bisschen von dem Eis aufgesogen hat.
DATA_CMM_2258.it: Un wafer infilato nel morbido gelato. C'è a chi piace e a chi no.
DATA_CMM_2258.es: Nata con una galleta. Está más rica si dejas que se ablande un poco con la nata.
DATA_CMM_2258.ko: 아이스크림에 꽂혀있는 과자. 약간 눅눅한 편이 더 맛있는 경우도 있다.
DATA_CMM_2258.zht: 插在冰淇淋上的點心。有時候稍微軟掉才好吃。
DATA_CMM_2258.zhs: 插在冰淇淋上的点心。有时候稍微软掉才好吃。

DATA_CMM_2259.ja: This certainly stands out, but it has surprisingly few fans.
DATA_CMM_2259.en: This certainly stands out, but it has surprisingly few fans.
DATA_CMM_2259.fr: Elle a beau se parer de belles couleurs, elle n'est pas de taille à lutter contre les gaufrettes.
DATA_CMM_2259.de: Sicherlich etwas Besonderes, ist aber überraschenderweise nicht sehr beliebt.
DATA_CMM_2259.it: Una ciliegina, o la si ama o la si odia.
DATA_CMM_2259.es: Destaca mucho, pero la verdad es que tiene pocos adeptos.
DATA_CMM_2259.ko: 눈에 잘 띄긴 하지만 팬은 그다지 많지 않다.
DATA_CMM_2259.zht: 雖然引人注目，但是它的粉絲很少。
DATA_CMM_2259.zhs: 虽然引人注目，但是它的粉丝很少。

DATA_CMM_2260.ja: They probably picked this cherry too early.
DATA_CMM_2260.en: They probably picked this cherry too early.
DATA_CMM_2260.fr: Celle-ci est sans doute en colère d'avoir été cueillie trop tôt.
DATA_CMM_2260.de: Wahrscheinlich wurde diese Kirsche zu früh gepflückt.
DATA_CMM_2260.es: Parece que la recogieron demasiado pronto.
DATA_CMM_2260.ko: 아마도 수확하기엔 너무 이르지 않았나 싶다.
DATA_CMM_2260.zht: 綠色可能是太早採收了。
DATA_CMM_2260.zhs: 绿色可能是太早采收了。

DATA_CMM_2261.ja: A spiraling candy that's a lot harder to eat than you'd think.
DATA_CMM_2261.en: A spiraling candy that's a lot harder to eat than you'd think.
DATA_CMM_2261.fr: Bonbon en spirale beaucoup plus dur à manger qu'il n'en a l'air.
DATA_CMM_2261.de: Eine spiralförmige Süßigkeit, die viel schwieriger zu essen ist, als man denkt.
DATA_CMM_2261.it: Un dolce a spirale che è più difficile da mangiare di quanto non sembri.
DATA_CMM_2261.es: Que sepamos, nadie ha intentado hipnotizar a nadie con estas espirales tan dulces.
DATA_CMM_2261.ko: 뱅글뱅글 돌린 사탕. 의외로 먹는데 고생한다.
DATA_CMM_2261.zht: 一圈圈捲起來的糖果。要吃光比想像中辛苦。
DATA_CMM_2261.zhs: 一圈圈卷起来的糖果。要吃光比想象中辛苦。

DATA_CMM_2262.ja: Stars like these are extremely uncommon.
DATA_CMM_2262.en: Stars like these are extremely uncommon.
DATA_CMM_2262.fr: Ce genre d'étoile est très rare.
DATA_CMM_2262.es: Si una de estas va a caer en tu cocina, no la dejes escapar: están buenísimas.
DATA_CMM_2262.zht: 很少見到這種形狀的星星。
DATA_CMM_2262.zhs: 很少见到这种形状的星星。

DATA_CMM_2263.ja: Apparently you don't have to cut this into nice little pieces before eating it.
DATA_CMM_2263.en: Apparently you don't have to cut this into nice little pieces before eating it.
DATA_CMM_2263.fr: Il n'est pas nécessaire de le couper en petits morceaux avant de le déguster.
DATA_CMM_2263.de: Anscheinend muss man ihn vor dem Verzehr nicht in schöne, kleine Stücke schneiden.
DATA_CMM_2263.it: Lo si può mangiare in un boccone.
DATA_CMM_2263.es: Una comida muy práctica para la que no hacen falta cubiertos.
DATA_CMM_2263.ko: 색대로 등분해서 먹으라는 소리는 아닌 듯싶다.
DATA_CMM_2263.zht: 不需要工整地掰開，想怎麼吃就怎麼吃。
DATA_CMM_2263.zhs: 不需要工整地掰开，想怎么吃就怎么吃。

DATA_CMM_2264.ja: If you eat this right after exercising, your mouth will get all mumbly.
DATA_CMM_2264.en: If you eat this right after exercising, your mouth will get all mumbly.
DATA_CMM_2264.fr: Si vous la mangez juste après avoir fait du sport, vous aurez l'impression d'étouffer.
DATA_CMM_2264.de: Wenn man das direkt nach dem Sport isst, nuschelt man nur noch.
DATA_CMM_2264.es: El mejor premio a una dura sesión de gimnasio. O de estudios. O de lo que sea.
DATA_CMM_2264.ko: 운동 직후에 먹으면 목이 막혀서 꽤나 고생한다.
DATA_CMM_2264.zht: 運動後馬上吃會咀嚼得很辛苦。
DATA_CMM_2264.zhs: 运动后马上吃会咀嚼得很辛苦。

DATA_CMM_2265.ja: This has a very haughty-sounding name, but it's actually a mass-market food.
DATA_CMM_2265.en: This has a very haughty-sounding name, but it's actually a mass-market food.
DATA_CMM_2265.fr: Elle rappelait beaucoup de souvenirs à Marcel, mais aujourd'hui, on se souvient surtout qu'elle est délicieuse.
DATA_CMM_2265.de: Klingt sehr hochtrabend, ist aber eigentlich eine Süßigkeit für den Massenmarkt.
DATA_CMM_2265.it: Dal nome sembra qualcosa di esotico, di raro, ma in realtà è un dolcetto alquanto comune.
DATA_CMM_2265.es: Las hay rellenas de chocolate, de avellana y también de magdalena.
DATA_CMM_2265.zht: 名字聽起來很高級，其實是平民點心。
DATA_CMM_2265.zhs: 名字听起来很高级，其实是平民点心。

DATA_CMM_2266.ja: An environmentally-friendly candy. You can even eat the part you hold.
DATA_CMM_2266.en: An environmentally-friendly candy. You can even eat the part you hold.
DATA_CMM_2266.fr: Friandise écologique. Vous pouvez même manger sa poignée.
DATA_CMM_2266.de: Eine umweltfreundliche Süßigkeit. Man kann sogar den Teil essen, den man in der Hand hält.
DATA_CMM_2266.it: Un dolce utilizzabile per ardimentose sfide a shangai.
DATA_CMM_2266.es: Es respetuoso con el medio ambiente y no genera residuos: también te comes el palito.
DATA_CMM_2266.ko: 손잡이까지 먹을 수 있는 환경친화적 과자.
DATA_CMM_2266.zht: 手拿的部分也能吃，很環保的點心。
DATA_CMM_2266.zhs: 手拿的部分也能吃，很环保的点心。

DATA_CMM_2267.ja: Even though it's bitter, that doesn't mean it's defective.
DATA_CMM_2267.en: Even though it's bitter, that doesn't mean it's defective.
DATA_CMM_2267.fr: Il est très amer, mais c'est normal, il n'est pas périmé.
DATA_CMM_2267.de: Obwohl sie bitter ist, erzielt sie dennoch ihre Wirkung.
DATA_CMM_2267.it: Il fatto che sia fondente non sottintende che si stia sciogliendo.
DATA_CMM_2267.es: Aunque se llame amargo, es la amargura más irresistible que hemos probado en todo el Cosmos.
DATA_CMM_2267.ko: 가끔 쓴 맛이 나는 것도 있다고 하는데, 실패작인 것은 아니다.
DATA_CMM_2267.zht: 偶爾也會有比較苦的種類，苦甜巧克力似乎並不算是失敗品。
DATA_CMM_2267.zhs: 偶尔也会有比较苦的种类，苦甜巧克力似乎并不算是失败品。

DATA_CMM_2268.ja: A rubbery food that's hard to describe. Merely touching it makes you a little happier.
DATA_CMM_2268.en: A rubbery food that's hard to describe. Merely touching it makes you a little happier.
DATA_CMM_2268.fr: Bonbon caoutchouteux difficile à décrire. Le simple fait de le voir est euphorisant.
DATA_CMM_2268.de: Essen aus Gummi, das schwer zu beschreiben ist. Es einfach schon zu berühren, macht einen ein bisschen glücklicher.
DATA_CMM_2268.it: Un dolce che piace soprattutto ai bambini viziati.
DATA_CMM_2268.es: Es difícil describir esta comida, pero tiene el poder de poner a todo el mundo de buen humor.
DATA_CMM_2268.ko: 쫄깃쫄깃한 신기한 과자. 주무르기만 하고 있어도 약간 행복해지는 느낌.
DATA_CMM_2268.zht: Q彈Q彈的難以形容。只要觸摸軟糖就能感受到些許幸福。
DATA_CMM_2268.zhs: Q弹Q弹的难以形容。只要触摸软糖就能感受到些许幸福。

DATA_CMM_2269.ja: They must be trying to lure people in with the sweetness and the hypnotic spiral.
DATA_CMM_2269.en: They must be trying to lure people in with the sweetness and the hypnotic spiral.
DATA_CMM_2269.fr: Les marchands de bonbons tentent sûrement d'hypnotiser les enfants avec cette spirale interminable.
DATA_CMM_2269.de: Wahrscheinlich versucht hier jemand, die Leute mit der Süße und der hypnotischen Spirale zu ködern.
DATA_CMM_2269.it: La spirale serve per ipnotizzare i clienti.
DATA_CMM_2269.es: Con estos azules tan profundos, resulta hipnótica de verdad.
DATA_CMM_2269.ko: 달콤함과 빙글빙글 도는 모양으로 누군가를 유혹하려 한 거겠지.
DATA_CMM_2269.zht: 甜蜜的滋味加上令人眼花的漩渦，是想誘惑誰呢？
DATA_CMM_2269.zhs: 甜蜜的滋味加上令人眼花的漩涡，是想诱惑谁呢？

DATA_CMM_2270.ja: We thought this was just for decoration, but We were astonished by its sweet, creamy taste.
DATA_CMM_2270.en: We thought this was just for decoration, but We were astonished by its sweet, creamy taste.
DATA_CMM_2270.fr: Nous pensions que ce n'était qu'une décoration, mais son goût sucré et crémeux Nous a convaincu.
DATA_CMM_2270.de: Wir dachten, sie sei nur zur Dekoration, aber wir waren überrascht, wie süß und cremig sie schmeckt.
DATA_CMM_2270.it: La prima volta pensavamo si trattasse di qualcosa di ornamentale, ma dopo averla provata...
DATA_CMM_2270.es: Antes creíamos que solo era para decorar, pero hemos descubierto que tiene un sabor muy atrayente.
DATA_CMM_2270.ko: 단순한 장식인가 했더니 의외로 달콤하고 부드러워 놀랐다.
DATA_CMM_2270.zht: 原以為只是裝飾，沒想到吃起來香甜綿密，真令人吃驚。
DATA_CMM_2270.zhs: 原以为只是装饰，没想到吃起来香甜绵密，真令人吃惊。

DATA_CMM_2271.ja: A triangular cookie with cream on top. It's crispy and easy to eat.
DATA_CMM_2271.en: A triangular cookie with cream on top. It's crispy and easy to eat.
DATA_CMM_2271.fr: Biscuit triangulaire avec de la crème. Il est croustillant et délicieux.
DATA_CMM_2271.de: Ein dreieckiger Keks mit Sahne oben drauf. Ziemlich knusprig und leicht zu essen.
DATA_CMM_2271.it: Un biscotto triangolare con della crema.
DATA_CMM_2271.es: Advertencia: no se ha utilizado ningún árbol en la fabricación de estas galletitas.
DATA_CMM_2271.ko: 크림이 올라가 있는 삼각형 쿠키. 바삭바삭하니 먹기 편한 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2271.zht: 上面放了奶油的三角形餅乾。酥酥脆脆，感覺很順口。
DATA_CMM_2271.zhs: 上面放了奶油的三角形饼干。酥酥脆脆，感觉很顺口。

DATA_CMM_2272.ja: This one's medium-sized. It has a medium amount of calories, too.
DATA_CMM_2272.en: This one's medium-sized. It has a medium amount of calories, too.
DATA_CMM_2272.fr: Il est de taille moyenne, tout comme son nombre de calories.
DATA_CMM_2272.de: Der hier ist mittelgroß und hat somit auch mittelviele Kalorien.
DATA_CMM_2272.it: Si narra che sia il dolce favorito dagli antichi faraoni egizi, per Noi sono quisquilie.
DATA_CMM_2272.es: Que las galletas no te impidan ver el postre. ¿O no era así?

DATA_CMM_2273.ja: If you eat a lot of this, you may not need to eat any other sweets for a while.
DATA_CMM_2273.en: If you eat a lot of this, you may not need to eat any other sweets for a while.
DATA_CMM_2273.fr: Si vous en mangez beaucoup, vos besoins en friandises seront couverts pendant un certain temps.
DATA_CMM_2273.de: Wenn man genug davon isst, wird man eine Zeit lang wohl keine anderen Süßigkeiten mehr essen wollen.
DATA_CMM_2273.it: Ce n'è abbastanza per due indigestioni.
DATA_CMM_2273.es: Si te das un atracón, es probable que no quieras volver a ver dulces en una temporada.
DATA_CMM_2273.ko: 잔뜩 먹으면 당분간은 단 것은 보기도 싫어질지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_2273.zht: 要是吃太多，說不定會膩到暫時不想吃甜點。
DATA_CMM_2273.zhs: 要是吃太多，说不定会腻到暂时不想吃甜点。

DATA_CMM_2274.ja: You can guess a tree's age by counting the rings, but apparently that's not how it works here.
DATA_CMM_2274.en: You can guess a tree's age by counting the rings, but apparently that's not how it works here.
DATA_CMM_2274.fr: On peut déterminer l'âge d'un arbre grâce au nombre de cercles de son tronc, mais cela ne marche pas pour ce gâteau.
DATA_CMM_2274.de: Man kann das Alter eines Baumes bestimmen, indem man seine Ringe zählt, aber anscheinend funktioniert das bei dem hier nicht.
DATA_CMM_2274.it: Non puoi contare la sua età dal tronco. Non è un vero albero.
DATA_CMM_2274.es: Se puede calcular la edad de los árboles contando sus anillos, pero en este caso no es así.
DATA_CMM_2274.ko: 나이테 같은 것이 많으면 많을수록 오래된 것은 아닌 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2274.zht: 長得很像年輪，但不代表越多圈放得越久。
DATA_CMM_2274.zhs: 长得很像年轮，但不代表越多圈放得越久。

DATA_CMM_2275.ja: A strawberry-flavored flower. The bees must love how sweet this is.
DATA_CMM_2275.en: A strawberry-flavored flower. The bees must love how sweet this is.
DATA_CMM_2275.fr: Fleur parfumée à la fraise. Les abeilles doivent adorer son goût sucré.
DATA_CMM_2275.de: Eine Blume mit Erdbeergeschmack. Bienen müssen sie lieben, weil sie so süß ist.
DATA_CMM_2275.it: Un fiore al sapore di fragola. La natura è meravigliosa.
DATA_CMM_2275.es: Las abejas deben de pelearse por esta flor tan primorosa.
DATA_CMM_2275.ko: 딸기 맛의 꽃. 이 정도로 달콤하면 벌들도 기뻐할 테지.
DATA_CMM_2275.zht: 草莓口味的花。這麼甜的話蜜蜂應該也會開心。
DATA_CMM_2275.zhs: 草莓口味的花。这么甜的话蜜蜂应该也会开心。

DATA_CMM_2276.ja: Cutting the bottom part of the tree makes for a great table.
DATA_CMM_2276.en: Cutting the bottom part of the tree makes for a great table.
DATA_CMM_2276.fr: En coupant la base d'un arbre, on obtient une superbe table.
DATA_CMM_2276.de: Aus dem unteren Teil eines Baumes kann man diesen tollen Tisch fertigen.
DATA_CMM_2276.it: Se si taglia un albero si ricava un ottimo tavolo con la sua base. Per favore non fatelo spesso.
DATA_CMM_2276.es: El tocón que queda al cortar un árbol grande queda perfecto como mesa rústica.
DATA_CMM_2276.ko: 나무 밑을 자르니 딱 쓰기 좋은 테이블이 완성된 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2276.zht: 橫切樹的下半部似乎剛好能當成桌子。
DATA_CMM_2276.zhs: 横切树的下半部似乎刚好能当成桌子。

DATA_CMM_2277.ja: A cookie shaped like a chicken. It doesn't appear to lay eggs.
DATA_CMM_2277.en: A cookie shaped like a chicken. It doesn't appear to lay eggs.
DATA_CMM_2277.fr: Biscuit qui ressemble à une poule. Il ne semble pas pondre d'œuf.
DATA_CMM_2277.de: Ein Keks mit der Form eines Huhns. Scheint keine Eier zu legen.
DATA_CMM_2277.it: Un biscotto a forma di pollo, deve averlo partorito una mente instabile.
DATA_CMM_2277.es: Nos preguntamos si también habrá galletas con forma de muslo, pechuga o alitas.
DATA_CMM_2277.ko: 닭 모양을 한 비스킷. 역시 달걀을 낳지는 않는다.
DATA_CMM_2277.zht: 雞造型的餅乾。看來不會生蛋。
DATA_CMM_2277.zhs: 鸡造型的饼干。看来不会生蛋。

DATA_CMM_2278.ja: A cookie shaped like a pig. It looks plump and delicious.
DATA_CMM_2278.en: A cookie shaped like a pig. It looks plump and delicious.
DATA_CMM_2278.fr: Ce biscuit-là ressemble à un cochon. Il a l'air gras et délicieux.
DATA_CMM_2278.de: Ein Keks mit der Form eines Schweins. Sieht prall und lecker aus.
DATA_CMM_2278.it: Un biscotto a forma di maialino. Che carino.
DATA_CMM_2278.es: Incluso en forma de galleta se nos hace la boca agua al verlo.
DATA_CMM_2278.ko: 돼지 모양을 한 비스킷. 포동포동한 것이 먹음직스러워 보인다.
DATA_CMM_2278.zht: 豬造型的餅乾。圓滾滾肥滋滋，感覺很可口。
DATA_CMM_2278.zhs: 猪造型的饼干。圆滚滚肥滋滋，感觉很可口。

DATA_CMM_2279.ja: A cookie shaped like a donkey. It's got longer ears than a horse, making it better value.
DATA_CMM_2279.en: A cookie shaped like a donkey. It's got longer ears than a horse, making it better value.
DATA_CMM_2279.fr: Il est mieux qu'un biscuit cheval, car ses oreilles sont plus longues.
DATA_CMM_2279.de: Ein Keks mit der Form eines Esels. Hat längere Ohren als Pferde und macht deswegen noch satter.
DATA_CMM_2279.it: Un biscotto a forma di ciuchino. Le orecchie sono grandi per sentirci meglio.
DATA_CMM_2279.es: Cuéntale tus secretos; con esas orejas tan largas, seguro que sabe escuchar.
DATA_CMM_2279.ko: 당나귀 모양을 한 비스킷. 말보다 귀가 긴 만큼 이득이다.
DATA_CMM_2279.zht: 驢子造型的餅乾。耳朵比馬長的部分算是吃到賺到。
DATA_CMM_2279.zhs: 驴子造型的饼干。耳朵比马长的部分算是吃到赚到。

DATA_CMM_2280.ja: A cookie shaped like a sheep. It's hard to tell for sure, though, since there's no wool or anything.
DATA_CMM_2280.en: A cookie shaped like a sheep. It's hard to tell for sure, though, since there's no wool or anything.
DATA_CMM_2280.fr: Il veut ressembler à un mouton. Comme il n'a pas de laine, il bêle à fendre l'âme.
DATA_CMM_2280.de: Ein Keks mit der Form eines Schafs. Erkennt man aber nicht so leicht, weil da keine Wolle oder so dran ist.
DATA_CMM_2280.it: Un biscotto a forma di pecora. Almeno così crediamo.
DATA_CMM_2280.es: No vemos la lana por ninguna parte. Quizá se la quitó porque tenía calor en el horno.
DATA_CMM_2280.ko: 양 모양을 한 비스킷. 털이 없으면 무슨 생물인지 구분이 안 간다.
DATA_CMM_2280.zht: 綿羊造型的餅乾。要是沒有羊毛就完全搞不清楚是什麼了。
DATA_CMM_2280.zhs: 绵羊造型的饼干。要是没有羊毛就完全搞不清楚是什么了。

DATA_CMM_2281.ja: Well, for accuracy's sake, We think this should be called "Pie with Chocolate Inside."
DATA_CMM_2281.en: Well, for accuracy's sake, We think this should be called "Pie with Chocolate Inside."
DATA_CMM_2281.fr: Pour être vraiment précis, il aurait fallu la baptiser "tourte avec du chocolat à l'intérieur".
DATA_CMM_2281.de: Der Genauigkeit halber sollte man ihn „Kuchen mit Schokolade drin" nennen.
DATA_CMM_2281.it: Una torta con il ripieno di cioccolato.
DATA_CMM_2281.es: Una tarta de bizcocho de chocolate, rellena de chocolate y con cobertura de chocolate. Solo para muy apasionados.
DATA_CMM_2281.zht: 正確來說是裡面放了巧克力的派。
DATA_CMM_2281.zhs: 正确来说是里面放了巧克力的派。

DATA_CMM_2282.ja: We think it's more fun to just keep on sucking this, resisting the urge to bite down.
DATA_CMM_2282.en: We think it's more fun to just keep on sucking this, resisting the urge to bite down.
DATA_CMM_2282.fr: Nous pensons qu'il est plus sage de le sucer ; vous risquez de regretter d'avoir mordu dedans.
DATA_CMM_2282.de: Wir glauben, es macht mehr Spaß, immer weiter daran zu lutschen und dem Drang zu widerstehen, reinzubeißen.
DATA_CMM_2282.it: Meglio lasciare che si sciolga in bocca che masticarlo.
DATA_CMM_2282.es: Es difícil resistir la tentación de morderlo, pero por propia experiencia sabemos que es muy mala idea.
DATA_CMM_2282.ko: 씹고 싶은 욕망을 억누르면서 빨아먹는 것도 이 과자를 즐기는 방법 중 하나라 생각한다.
DATA_CMM_2282.zht: 克制想咬下去的衝動，持續舔食也是吃焦糖的樂趣。
DATA_CMM_2282.zhs: 克制想咬下去的冲动，持续舔食也是吃焦糖的乐趣。

DATA_CMM_2283.ja: Grown-ups say they're sick of being asked why there's a hole in the middle.
DATA_CMM_2283.en: Grown-ups say they're sick of being asked why there's a hole in the middle.
DATA_CMM_2283.fr: Les adultes disent en avoir marre qu'on leur demande pourquoi certains beignets ont un trou au milieu.
DATA_CMM_2283.de: Erwachsene sagen, dass sie es leid sind, gefragt zu werden, warum da in der Mitte ein Loch ist.
DATA_CMM_2283.it: Ma perché c'è un buco nel mezzo?

DATA_CMM_2309.ja: Apparently, the older brother is about to return from overseas.
DATA_CMM_2309.en: Apparently, the older brother is about to return from overseas.
DATA_CMM_2309.fr: Le grand frère doit revenir de l'étranger très bientôt.
DATA_CMM_2309.de: Anscheinend kehrt der ältere Bruder bald aus Übersee zurück.
DATA_CMM_2309.it: Il fratello maggiore, a quanto pare, sta tornando dall'estero e la famiglia è in fermento.
DATA_CMM_2309.es: Dicen que el hijo mayor vuelve pronto de su viaje de vuelta al mundo.
DATA_CMM_2309.ko: 외국에 나가있는 장남이 이번에 귀국하는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2309.zht: 木藤家在國外旅行的長男似乎最近要回國。
DATA_CMM_2309.zhs: 木藤家在国外旅行的长男似乎最近要回国。

DATA_CMM_2310.ja: This place deliberately points their kitchen exhaust toward the street in order to attract customers. That's good business!
DATA_CMM_2310.en: This place deliberately points their kitchen exhaust toward the street in order to attract customers. That's good business!
DATA_CMM_2310.fr: La hotte de sa cuisine rejette ses effluves dans la rue pour attirer les clients. Ils ont eu le nez creux !
DATA_CMM_2310.de: Hier richtet man seinen Küchenabzug absichtlich auf die Straße, um Gäste anzulocken. Keine dumme Idee!
DATA_CMM_2310.it: Usano il buon odore che produce il loro cibo per attirare i clienti.
DATA_CMM_2310.es: Han orientado los extractores de la cocina a la calle para que el olor atraiga clientes. ¡Qué olfato comercial!
DATA_CMM_2310.ko: 일부러 도로 변으로 냄새를 흘려서 손님을 끌어모으는 배테랑 사장님.
DATA_CMM_2310.zht: 烤雞肉串店很擅長做生意，會故意朝大街上搧煙，藉此吸引大家。
DATA_CMM_2310.zhs: 烤鸡肉串店很擅长做生意，会故意朝大街上搧烟，藉此吸引大家。

DATA_CMM_2311.ja: If this lamp is around, chances are there's a yakitori restaurant nearby.
DATA_CMM_2311.en: If this lamp is around, chances are there's a yakitori restaurant nearby.
DATA_CMM_2311.fr: Si vous voyez cette lampe, un restaurant yakitori habite sans doute dans les parages.
DATA_CMM_2311.de: Wenn man diese Lampe sieht, ist wahrscheinlich ein Yakitori-Restaurant in der Nähe.
DATA_CMM_2311.it: Una lampada che indica che un ristorante yakitori è nei paraggi.
DATA_CMM_2311.es: Si ves uno de estos, es probable que haya un restaurante de yakitori cerca.
DATA_CMM_2311.ko: 빨간색 이것이 걸려 있으면 그곳은 십중팔구 꼬치구이 집이다.
DATA_CMM_2311.zht: 掛著紅色燈籠的地方，高機率會是烤雞肉串店。
DATA_CMM_2311.zhs: 挂着红色灯笼的地方，高机率会是烤鸡肉串店。

DATA_CMM_2312.ja: If you get lost or lose something, the person inside here will help you.
DATA_CMM_2312.en: If you get lost or lose something, the person inside here will help you.
DATA_CMM_2312.fr: Si vous vous perdez près d'elle, le monsieur à l'intérieur pourra sans doute vous aider.
DATA_CMM_2312.de: Wenn man sich verirrt oder etwas verliert, wird einem hier geholfen.
DATA_CMM_2312.it: Le persone che vivono in questa baracca fanno di tutto per aiutare il prossimo.
DATA_CMM_2312.es: Si te pierdes tú o pierdes algo, aquí te ayudarán a encontrarte.
DATA_CMM_2312.ko: 길을 잃거나 돈을 떨어뜨렸을 경우, 안에 있는 사람이 도와주는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2312.zht: 聽說迷路或掉東西，裡面的人會幫忙。
DATA_CMM_2312.zhs: 听说迷路或掉东西，里面的人会帮忙。

DATA_CMM_2313.ja: This is just an ordinary coffee shop, but older men apparently have trouble entering this place.
DATA_CMM_2313.en: This is just an ordinary coffee shop, but older men apparently have trouble entering this place.
DATA_CMM_2313.fr: C'est un simple café, mais les vieux messieurs semblent avoir du mal à y entrer.
DATA_CMM_2313.de: Eigentlich ein ganz normales Café, aber ältere Männer haben offenbar Schwierigkeiten, es zu betreten.
DATA_CMM_2313.it: Si tratta di un normalissimo bar frequentato soprattutto da gente giovane.
DATA_CMM_2313.es: Un apacible lugar para tomarse un café y sucumbir a la tentación de los pasteles.
DATA_CMM_2313.ko: 평범한 커피 전문점인데도, 아저씨들은 들어가기 힘들다.
DATA_CMM_2313.zht: 明明只是尋常的咖啡廳，大叔要踏進門卻好像有障礙。
DATA_CMM_2313.zhs: 明明只是寻常的咖啡厅，大叔要踏进门却好像有障碍。

DATA_CMM_2314.ja: A cozy place full of TVs and refrigerators. It seems like a great place to live, but you'd get kicked out if you tried it.
DATA_CMM_2314.en: A cozy place full of TVs and refrigerators. It seems like a great place to live, but you'd get kicked out if you tried it.
DATA_CMM_2314.fr: Il est plein de télés et de réfrigérateurs. Très tentant d'y boire des bières devant la télé, mais pas la peine d'essayer...
DATA_CMM_2314.de: Ein gemütlicher Ort mit Fernsehern und Kühlschränken. Scheint ein guter Ort zum Wohnen zu sein, aber probiert man es, fliegt man vermutlich raus.
DATA_CMM_2314.it: Un posto accogliente, pieno di TV e frigoriferi. Sembrerebbe un ottimo luogo in cui vivere, ma chi ci ha provato è stato cacciato in malo modo.
DATA_CMM_2314.es: Está llena de teles y neveras. Te encantaría quedarte a vivir aquí, pero te echan cada vez que lo intentas.
DATA_CMM_2314.ko: TV나 냉장고가 잔뜩 있어서 매우 쾌적하다. 살기 편할 것 같은데 진짜 살려고 하면 내쫒는다.
DATA_CMM_2314.zht: 家電行裡有很多電視跟冰箱，十分宜人。感覺住起來會很舒適，但真的住下來的話會被趕出去。
DATA_CMM_2314.zhs: 家电行里有很多电视跟冰箱，十分宜人。感觉住起来会很舒适，但真的住下来的话会被赶出去。

DATA_CMM_2315.ja: Apparently, they sell various machines in this place.
DATA_CMM_2315.en: Apparently, they sell various machines in this place.
DATA_CMM_2315.fr: On semble vendre des machines très diverses à l'intérieur.
DATA_CMM_2315.de: Anscheinend werden hier verschiedene Geräte verkauft.
DATA_CMM_2315.it: A quanto pare vendono molte cose interessanti qui.
DATA_CMM_2315.es: Para que sepas que aquí se venden aparatos de muchos tipos.
DATA_CMM_2315.ko: 여러 가지 기계를 파는 곳이라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2315.zht: 好像是會販賣五花八門機器的地方。
DATA_CMM_2315.zhs: 好像是会贩卖五花八门机器的地方。

DATA_CMM_2316.ja: The purple part tastes like grapes. This is actually pretty good.
DATA_CMM_2316.en: The purple part tastes like grapes. This is actually pretty good.
DATA_CMM_2316.fr: Le morceau violet a un goût de raisin. Plutôt délicieux...
DATA_CMM_2316.de: Der lila Teil schmeckt nach Weintrauben. Wirklich nicht übel.
DATA_CMM_2316.it: La parte viola è al sapore di uva.
DATA_CMM_2316.es: La parte oscura sabe a uvas. La verdad es que está muy buena.
DATA_CMM_2316.ko: 보라색은 고구마 맛이라고 한다. 의외로 맛있다.
DATA_CMM_2316.zht: 紫色的地方有地瓜味。跌破眼鏡地好吃。
DATA_CMM_2316.zhs: 紫色的地方有地瓜味。跌破眼镜地好吃。

DATA_CMM_2318.ja: They don't seem to sell plain old ice here.
DATA_CMM_2318.en: They don't seem to sell plain old ice here.
DATA_CMM_2318.fr: Pourquoi ne vendent-ils pas de la glace nature ?
DATA_CMM_2318.de: Normales Eis scheint es hier nicht zu geben.
DATA_CMM_2318.es: Tienen sorbetes de todos los sabores, pero no sirven hielo normal de agua.
DATA_CMM_2318.ko: 얼음을 그대로 파는 것은 아니라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2318.zht: 這裡好像沒有直接賣冰塊。
DATA_CMM_2318.zhs: 这里好像没有直接卖冰块。

DATA_CMM_2319.ja: This store is full of fish. Cats stare at it from their nearby hiding place, waiting for their chance.
DATA_CMM_2319.en: This store is full of fish. Cats stare at it from their nearby hiding place, waiting for their chance.
DATA_CMM_2319.fr: Magasin plein de poissons. Les chats adorent y faire du lèche-vitrines.
DATA_CMM_2319.de: In diesem Geschäft sind überall Fische. Katzen starren es aus ihren Verstecken an und warten auf ihre Chance.
DATA_CMM_2319.it: Un negozio pieno di pesci. I gatti ne sono entusiasti.
DATA_CMM_2319.es: Curiosamente, siempre hay gran cantidad de gatos acechando en el vecindario.
DATA_CMM_2319.ko: 생선을 잔뜩 팔고 있기 때문에 항상 고양이가 찬스를 노리고 있는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2319.zht: 水產店放了很多魚，因此好像有貓在陰影中緊盯不放，伺機而動。
DATA_CMM_2319.zhs: 水产店放了很多鱼，因此好像有猫在阴影中紧盯不放，伺机而动。

DATA_CMM_2320.ja: The sign advertises the store's freshly-caught and delicious merchandise.
DATA_CMM_2320.en: The sign advertises the store's freshly-caught and delicious merchandise.
DATA_CMM_2320.fr: Cette enseigne indique le paradis des poissons et de la mer.
DATA_CMM_2320.de: Das Schild wirbt für die frisch gefangenen und köstlichen Waren im Geschäft.
DATA_CMM_2320.it: Se vuoi del pesce è qui che devi venire.
DATA_CMM_2320.es: Por si a algún gato despistado le falla la nariz.
DATA_CMM_2320.ko: 얼마나 신선한지를 어필하고 있는 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2320.zht: 水產旗子似乎標榜著活蹦亂跳現撈水產。
DATA_CMM_2320.zhs: 水产旗子似乎标榜着活蹦乱跳现捞水产。

DATA_CMM_2321.ja: This is the only place you're allowed to get on and off trains.
DATA_CMM_2321.en: This is the only place you're allowed to get on and off trains.
DATA_CMM_2321.fr: C'est le seul endroit où vous avez le droit de monter et de descendre des trains.
DATA_CMM_2321.de: Der einzige Ort, an dem man in Züge ein- und aussteigen darf.
DATA_CMM_2321.it: Le stazioni sono gli unici posti dove è permesso salire e scendere dalle vetture.
DATA_CMM_2321.es: Solo puedes subir o bajar del tren en este lugar.
DATA_CMM_2321.ko: 여기를 거치지 않고서는 열차를 타거나 내리거나 할 수 없다.
DATA_CMM_2321.zht: 好像只能從棕耳鵯車站上下電車。
DATA_CMM_2321.zhs: 好像只能从棕耳鹎车站上下电车。

DATA_CMM_2322.ja: We think this is the name of the person that lives here. It must be a pain not having anywhere to put your letters.
DATA_CMM_2322.en: We think this is the name of the person that lives here. It must be a pain not having anywhere to put your letters.
DATA_CMM_2322.fr: Nous pensons qu'il porte le nom de la personne qui habite ici. Pas de risque que ses lettres s'égarent.
DATA_CMM_2322.de: Wir glauben, dass so der Mensch heißt, der hier wohnt. Es muss schlimm sein, wenn man seine Briefe nirgends einwerfen kann.
DATA_CMM_2322.es: Debe de ser el nombre de la persona que vive aquí. Sería más fácil instalar un buzón.
DATA_CMM_2322.ko: 여기 사는 사람의 이름인 것 같다. 편지를 넣는 통이 없어서 약간 불편하다.
DATA_CMM_2322.zht: 應該是住這裡的人的名字。沒有收信的地方有點不方便。
DATA_CMM_2322.zhs: 应该是住这里的人的名字。没有收信的地方有点不方便。

DATA_CMM_2323.ja: You can't get near the train without passing through here.
DATA_CMM_2323.en: You can't get near the train without passing through here.
DATA_CMM_2323.fr: Impossible de s'approcher du train sans faire tourner cette roue.
DATA_CMM_2323.de: Man kann sich keinem Zug nähern, ohne an so einem vorbeizugehen.
DATA_CMM_2323.it: Per avvicinarsi al treno bisogna superare questa difficilissima prova. Il cancello si aprirà solo alle persone dal cuore puro o a quelle che hanno comprato il biglietto.
DATA_CMM_2323.es: Hay gente que se lo salta, pero eso no está bien.
DATA_CMM_2323.ko: 여기를 통과해야 열차로 갈 수 있다.
DATA_CMM_2323.zht: 不經過剪票口就無法靠近電車。
DATA_CMM_2323.zhs: 不经过剪票口就无法靠近电车。

DATA_CMM_2324.ja: The principal's morning announcement the other day set a new length record.
DATA_CMM_2324.en: The principal's morning announcement the other day set a new length record.
DATA_CMM_2324.fr: Dans son dernier discours, le principal a battu son propre record de longueur.
DATA_CMM_2324.de: Mit der Länge der morgendlichen Durchsage hat der Schulrektor vor Kurzem einen neuen Rekord aufgestellt.
DATA_CMM_2324.it: L'altro giorno il preside ha fatto un discorso di due ore che ha annoiato un po' tutti.
DATA_CMM_2324.es: Para que los niños vayan haciéndose a la idea de lo que es ir a trabajar cada mañana.
DATA_CMM_2324.ko: 최근 들어 조회 때 교장 선생님 훈사가 최단기록을 경신한 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2324.zht: 好像在最近的朝會刷新了最長演講紀錄。
DATA_CMM_2324.zhs: 好像在最近的朝会刷新了最长演讲纪录。

DATA_CMM_2325.ja: The frogs who live in here like it well enough.
DATA_CMM_2325.en: The frogs who live in here like it well enough.
DATA_CMM_2325.fr: Les grenouilles qui l'habitent regardent le ciel toute la journée.
DATA_CMM_2325.de: Den Fröschen, die in ihm leben, gefällt es dort ganz gut.
DATA_CMM_2325.it: Le rane che ci vivono sono pazze di questo pozzo.
DATA_CMM_2325.es: Las ranas que viven aquí parecen muy contentas con el barrio.
DATA_CMM_2325.ko: 이 안에 있는 개구리는 바깥세상을 모르는 미숙한 녀석인 듯하다. 나올 수 없으니 어쩔 수 없지 않나.
DATA_CMM_2325.zht: 在水井裡的青蛙似乎不懂人情世故，是個不成熟的傢伙。但是因為出不了水井，所以這也無可奈何。
DATA_CMM_2325.zhs: 在水井里的青蛙似乎不懂人情世故，是个不成熟的家伙。但是因为出不了水井，所以这也无可奈何。

DATA_CMM_2326.ja: This is the home of someone who can make your dreams come true. He's never at home, though, and he doesn't come out even if you ring the bell.
