DATA_CMM_2664.de: Um sich vor Raubtieren zu schützen, nahm er in seiner Entwicklung die gleiche Farbe wie Schnee an.
DATA_CMM_2664.it: Per proteggere la propria privacy è diventato dello stesso colore della neve.
DATA_CMM_2664.es: Era negro, pero se volvió blanco como la nieve: otro triunfo de las leyes de la evolución.
DATA_CMM_2664.ko: 적으로부터 몸을 지키기 위해 눈과 같은 색으로 진화한 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2664.zht: 聽說是為了自我保護，所以才進化成跟雪一樣的顏色。
DATA_CMM_2664.zhs: 听说是为了自我保护，所以才进化成跟雪一样的颜色。

DATA_CMM_2665.ja: An energetic child who can't wait to go out when it snows. Apparently she has never caught a cold.
DATA_CMM_2665.en: An energetic child who can't wait to go out when it snows. Apparently she has never caught a cold.
DATA_CMM_2665.fr: Rejeton énergique qui ne tient plus en place dès que la neige tombe. Elle n'a encore jamais attrapé de rhume.
DATA_CMM_2665.de: Ein energiegeladenes Kind, das es kaum erwarten kann, raus in den Schnee zu gehen. Hat sich wohl noch nie erkältet.
DATA_CMM_2665.it: Una bimba piena di vita che non vede l'ora di giocare nella neve. Non ha mai preso un raffreddore.
DATA_CMM_2665.es: Esta niña no para ni un minuto en casa mientras quede un centímetro de nieve. Y nunca se resfría.
DATA_CMM_2665.ko: 눈이 오면 안절부절 못하는 활발한 아이. 감기에 걸린 적은 없다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2665.zht: 一下雪就坐不住，充滿活力的孩子。據說沒有感冒過。
DATA_CMM_2665.zhs: 一下雪就坐不住，充满活力的孩子。据说没有感冒过。

DATA_CMM_2666.ja: He's currently regretting his attempt at physical humor.
DATA_CMM_2666.en: He's currently regretting his attempt at physical humor.
DATA_CMM_2666.fr: Il est en train de regretter sa tentative d'humour à skis.
DATA_CMM_2666.de: Bereut mittlerweile seinen Versuch, seinen Körper humoristisch einzusetzen.
DATA_CMM_2666.it: Si sta pentendo di aver fatto il pagliaccio.
DATA_CMM_2666.es: Acaba de descubrir que cuando vas sobre esquís no es buena idea hacer el payaso.
DATA_CMM_2666.ko: 몸까지 던진 혼신의 개그를 선보인 것을 죽도록 후회하고 있는 듯…
DATA_CMM_2666.zht: 聽說他很後悔自己曾經使出渾身解數搞笑。
DATA_CMM_2666.zhs: 听说他很后悔自己曾经使出浑身解数搞笑。

DATA_CMM_2667.ja: His next goal is to fix his fear of heights.
DATA_CMM_2667.en: His next goal is to fix his fear of heights.
DATA_CMM_2667.fr: Son prochain objectif : se libérer du vertige.
DATA_CMM_2667.de: Hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, seine Höhenangst zu überwinden.
DATA_CMM_2667.it: Vuole superare la sua paura delle altezze.
DATA_CMM_2667.es: Su próximo reto es enfrentarse a su miedo a las alturas.
DATA_CMM_2667.ko: 고소공포증을 극복하는 것이 앞으로의 과제인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2667.zht: 接下來的難題似乎是克服懼高症。
DATA_CMM_2667.zhs: 接下来的难题似乎是克服惧高症。

DATA_CMM_2668.ja: He seems to have found a way to always stop when he wants to.
DATA_CMM_2668.en: He seems to have found a way to always stop when he wants to.
DATA_CMM_2668.fr: Il semble avoir trouvé un moyen de s'arrêter quand il veut.
DATA_CMM_2668.de: Scheint einen Weg gefunden zu haben, immer dann anzuhalten, wenn er es will.
DATA_CMM_2668.it: A quanto pare ha imparato a frenare quando vuole fermarsi.
DATA_CMM_2668.es: Lo que nunca hemos comprendido es cómo detenernos llevando esos aparatos en los pies.
DATA_CMM_2668.ko: 확실히 멈출 수 있는 스타일을 발견한 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2668.zht: 他好像找到絕對能停下來的姿勢了。
DATA_CMM_2668.zhs: 他好像找到绝对能停下来的姿势了。

DATA_CMM_2669.ja: Ever since she saw a prince on a white horse, she's been practicing pretending to sleep every day.
DATA_CMM_2669.en: Ever since she saw a prince on a white horse, she's been practicing pretending to sleep every day.
DATA_CMM_2669.fr: Depuis qu'elle a vu un prince sur un cheval blanc, elle s'est mise à utiliser le rouet de sa marâtre.
DATA_CMM_2669.de: Seit sie einen Prinzen auf einem weißen Pferd gesehen hat, übt sie jeden Tag, so zu tun, als würde sie schlafen.
DATA_CMM_2669.it: Da quando ha visto dei film si allena per far finta di dormire ogni giorno.
DATA_CMM_2669.es: Ahora mismo va a despertar al príncipe azul para que limpie los destrozos de la fiesta con sus amigotes.
DATA_CMM_2669.ko: 백마 탄 왕자님을 본 이후부터 대본대로 맹연습을 반복하고 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2669.zht: 自從看到白馬王子後，每天都在練習裝睡。
DATA_CMM_2669.zhs: 自从看到白马王子后，每天都在练习装睡。

DATA_CMM_2670.ja: Don't worry, he can get out by himself.
DATA_CMM_2670.en: Don't worry, he can get out by himself.
DATA_CMM_2670.fr: Ne vous inquiétez pas, il mue dès le réveil.
DATA_CMM_2670.de: Keine Sorge, er schafft es da alleine raus.
DATA_CMM_2670.it: Nessuna paura, è in grado di uscirne da solo.
DATA_CMM_2670.es: No te preocupes, que conseguirá salir del saco él solito.
DATA_CMM_2670.ko: 혼자서 나올 수 있기 때문에 걱정 안해도 될 듯싶다.
DATA_CMM_2670.zht: 好像不必替他擔心能不能自己出來。
DATA_CMM_2670.zhs: 好像不必替他担心能不能自己出来。

DATA_CMM_2671.ja: A great man who's built his body and spirit by punching and being punched by others. The belt around his waist is proof of his victory.
DATA_CMM_2671.en: A great man who's built his body and spirit by punching and being punched by others. The belt around his waist is proof of his victory.
DATA_CMM_2671.fr: Un homme tout en muscles, qui s'est forgé un corps et un esprit de fer en donnant et en recevant des coups.
DATA_CMM_2671.de: Ein großer Mann, dessen Körper und Geist darauf eingestellt sind, andere zu schlagen und geschlagen zu werden. Sein Gürtel steht für seinen Sieg.
DATA_CMM_2671.it: Un uomo fantastico che ha forgiato il proprio corpo e il proprio spirito a suon di cazzotti. La sua cintura è il segno della vittoria.
DATA_CMM_2671.es: Un hombre que se dedica a dar y recibir. Al menos es justo.
DATA_CMM_2671.ko: 치거나 맞거나 하면서 몸과 마음을 단련시키는 대단한 사람. 허리의 벨트는 승리의 증표다.
DATA_CMM_2671.zht: 靠著揍人與被揍鍛鍊身心到極致的強勁人類。腰帶是勝利的證據。
DATA_CMM_2671.zhs: 靠着揍人与被揍锻炼身心到极致的强劲人类。腰带是胜利的证据。

DATA_CMM_2672.ja: He's been troubled that no matter how many times he tells people his carpet isn't for sale, nobody listens.
DATA_CMM_2672.en: He's been troubled that no matter how many times he tells people his carpet isn't for sale, nobody listens.
DATA_CMM_2672.fr: Il en a plus qu'assez qu'on lui demande toujours et encore si son tapis est à vendre. Personne ne l'écoute.
DATA_CMM_2672.de: Es nervt ihn, dass ihm niemand zuhört, wenn er sagt, dass sein Teppich nicht zum Verkauf steht.
DATA_CMM_2672.it: Si è stufato di spiegare alla gente che il suo tappeto non è in vendita.
DATA_CMM_2672.es: La única desventaja es que no se puede esconder la suciedad debajo de esa alfombra.
DATA_CMM_2672.ko: 이 양탄자는 파는 것이 아니라고 몇 번을 말해도 못 알아듣는 통에 고민스럽다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2672.zht: 「這條地毯是非賣品」他最近很煩惱都說破嘴了，還是有人不聽。
DATA_CMM_2672.zhs: 「这条地毯是非卖品」他最近很烦恼都说破嘴了，还是有人不听。

DATA_CMM_2673.ja: Apparently her hobby is scaring people. Earlier, she had a bad experience getting chased around by a dog.
DATA_CMM_2673.en: Apparently her hobby is scaring people. Earlier, she had a bad experience getting chased around by a dog.
DATA_CMM_2673.fr: Elle s'amuse en effrayant les gens. Dans sa vie terrestre, elle avait été traumatisée par un chien la poursuivant.
DATA_CMM_2673.de: Offenbar ist es ihr Hobby, Menschen zu erschrecken. Früher hatte sie ein schlimmes Erlebnis, als sie von einem Hund gejagt wurde.
DATA_CMM_2673.it: Il suo hobby è andare in giro a spaventare la gente.
DATA_CMM_2673.es: Parece que se dedica a perseguir a la gente, pero en realidad es que busca compañía.
DATA_CMM_2673.ko: 사람을 놀라게 하는 것이 취미란다. 일전엔 개에게 쫓겨다니며 고생했던 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2673.zht: 興趣是嚇人。聽說前陣子被狗追得很慘的樣子。
DATA_CMM_2673.zhs: 兴趣是吓人。听说前阵子被狗追得很惨的样子。

DATA_CMM_2674.ja: Apparently, he isn't practicing poking people with his ducktail.
DATA_CMM_2674.en: Apparently, he isn't practicing poking people with his ducktail.
DATA_CMM_2674.fr: Sa super coiffure n'aurait rien d'exceptionnel.
DATA_CMM_2674.de: Anscheinend übt er gar nicht, bei Leuten mit seinem Entenschwanz-Haarschnitt anzuecken.
DATA_CMM_2674.it: Autentica testimonianza di quanto sia importante la tonificazione dell'addome.
DATA_CMM_2674.es: Pasarán meses antes de que dejen de llamarle "Eh, tú" y aprendan su nombre.
DATA_CMM_2674.ko: 자랑거리인 리전트 헤어로 사람을 찌르는 연습을 하고 있는 것은 아닌 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2674.zht: 並不是在練習用他自豪的飛機頭戳人。
DATA_CMM_2674.zhs: 并不是在练习用他自豪的飞机头戳人。

DATA_CMM_2675.ja: He's building up his legs and hips with so-called bunny hops. His sandals are made out of aluminum.
DATA_CMM_2675.en: He's building up his legs and hips with so-called bunny hops. His sandals are made out of aluminum.
DATA_CMM_2675.fr: Il se muscle les jambes et les hanches en faisant de petits sauts. Ses sandales sont faites en aluminium.
DATA_CMM_2675.de: Er trainiert seine Beine und Hüften mit so genannten Häschensprüngen. Seine Sandalen bestehen als Aluminium.
DATA_CMM_2675.it: Il passo della quaglia sta svelando a questo ragazzo nuove forme di dolore.
DATA_CMM_2675.es: Aprovecha los ratos libres para entrenarse; su sueño es correr la maratón y luego retirarse.
DATA_CMM_2675.ko: 토끼뜀으로 다리와 허리를 강화하고 있는 듯. 신고 있는 나막신은 알루미늄 제품이라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2675.zht: 在做所謂的兔子跳鍛鍊下盤。據說他穿的木屐是鋁做的。
DATA_CMM_2675.zhs: 在做所谓的兔子跳锻炼下盘。据说他穿的木屐是铝做的。

DATA_CMM_2676.ja: A strong man who builds buildings. There's a house in the mountains he built by himself.
DATA_CMM_2676.en: A strong man who builds buildings. There's a house in the mountains he built by himself.
DATA_CMM_2676.fr: Homme fort qui construit des bâtiments. Il possède un chalet en montagne, qu'il a lui-même construit.
DATA_CMM_2676.de: Ein kräftiger Mann, der Gebäude baut. In den Bergen steht ein Haus, das er selbst gebaut hat.
DATA_CMM_2676.it: Un uomo forte e deciso che costruisce cose. Ha costruito da solo una casa in montagna.
DATA_CMM_2676.es: No sabemos si se dedican a esto porque son fuertes, o se vuelven fuertes a base de trabajar en esto.
DATA_CMM_2676.ko: 건물을 세워주는 힘이 장사인 사람이다. 뒷산에 혼자서 세운 집을 가지고 있다고…
DATA_CMM_2676.zht: 幫人建造房屋的大力士。後山好像有他自己獨立建造的房子。
DATA_CMM_2676.zhs: 帮人建造房屋的大力士。后山好像有他自己独立建造的房子。

DATA_CMM_2677.ja: He hasn't quite gotten the hang of focusing yet.
DATA_CMM_2677.en: He hasn't quite gotten the hang of focusing yet.
DATA_CMM_2677.fr: Il n'a pas encore complètement trouvé le truc pour zoomer.
DATA_CMM_2677.de: Er hat es noch nicht ganz geschafft, den Fokus zu finden.
DATA_CMM_2677.it: Non ha ancora compreso il concetto di "mettere a fuoco".
DATA_CMM_2677.es: Todavía no le ha cogido el truco a lo de enfocar. Todo llegará...

DATA_CMM_2678.ja: They must be arguing right now.
DATA_CMM_2678.en: They must be arguing right now.
DATA_CMM_2678.fr: Ils doivent être en train de se disputer.
DATA_CMM_2678.es: Seguro que ahora mismo están discutiendo.

DATA_CMM_2679.ja: His glasses are about to fly off.
DATA_CMM_2679.en: His glasses are about to fly off.
DATA_CMM_2679.fr: Ses lunettes sont à deux doigts de s'envoler.
DATA_CMM_2679.es: Que se le caen las gafas.
DATA_CMM_2679.zht: 在這之後眼鏡飛出去了。
DATA_CMM_2679.zhs: 在这之后眼镜飞出去了。

DATA_CMM_2680.ja: Apparently, acting like this is something that transcends borders. Their minds are in slow motion now.
DATA_CMM_2680.en: Apparently, acting like this is something that transcends borders. Their minds are in slow motion now.
DATA_CMM_2680.fr: Ce type de comportement traverse les frontières. Leurs esprits sont en hibernation.
DATA_CMM_2680.de: Anscheinend überschreitet solches Verhalten Grenzen. Ihre Gedanken bewegen sich gerade in Zeitlupe.
DATA_CMM_2680.it: A quanto pare stanno vivendo questo momento al rallentatore.
DATA_CMM_2680.es: Según nos han dicho, se les reconocería en cualquier lugar del mundo.
DATA_CMM_2680.ko: 설레는 이 마음은 만국 공통인 듯싶다. 두 사람 사이에는 이미 슬로우 모션이 적용 중.
DATA_CMM_2680.zht: 這個行動好像是世界通用的。現在這兩個人的世界是慢動作。
DATA_CMM_2680.zhs: 这个行动好像是世界通用的。现在这两个人的世界是慢动作。

DATA_CMM_2681.ja: Right now, his main concern is that people not pull his nose.
DATA_CMM_2681.en: Right now, his main concern is that people not pull his nose.
DATA_CMM_2681.fr: Pour le moment, sa principale préoccupation est d'éviter que des gens ne lui tirent le nez.
DATA_CMM_2681.de: Im Moment ist es seine größte Sorge, sich nicht an der Nase herumführen zu lassen.
DATA_CMM_2681.it: Si preoccupa molto che la gente lo prenda per il naso.
DATA_CMM_2681.es: Su mayor preocupación es que no le tiren de la trompa.
DATA_CMM_2681.ko: 제발 코를 잡아 당기지 말았으면 하는 것이 지금 가장 큰 소원이다.
DATA_CMM_2681.zht: 現在最大的心願就是希望別人不要拉他的鼻子。
DATA_CMM_2681.zhs: 现在最大的心愿就是希望别人不要拉他的鼻子。

DATA_CMM_2682.ja: He looks like he could really use some water right about now.
DATA_CMM_2682.en: He looks like he could really use some water right about now.
DATA_CMM_2682.fr: Il semble mourir d'envie de plonger dans une piscine, immédiatement.
DATA_CMM_2682.de: Sieht aus, als könnte er gerade wirklich etwas Wasser gebrauchen.
DATA_CMM_2682.it: Ha probabilmente bisogno di un po' d'acqua.
DATA_CMM_2682.es: Ahora mismo pone cara de necesitar varios cubos de agua.

DATA_CMM_2683.ja: Apparently he's started to get concerned by his clothing size.
DATA_CMM_2683.en: Apparently he's started to get concerned by his clothing size.
DATA_CMM_2683.fr: Il commence à s'inquiéter de la taille de ses vêtements.
DATA_CMM_2683.de: Offenbar macht er sich mittlerweile Gedanken über seine Kleidergröße.
DATA_CMM_2683.it: Si preoccupa un po' della sua taglia.
DATA_CMM_2683.es: Parece que ha empezado a preocuparse por su talla de pantalón.
DATA_CMM_2683.ko: 최근에 옷 사이즈가 신경쓰이기 시작했다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2683.zht: 最近好像開始在意衣服的尺寸了。
DATA_CMM_2683.zhs: 最近好像开始在意衣服的尺寸了。

DATA_CMM_2684.ja: He's a cumulonimbus cloud, but he'd prefer to be called a nimbostratus.
DATA_CMM_2684.en: He's a cumulonimbus cloud, but he'd prefer to be called a nimbostratus.
DATA_CMM_2684.fr: C'est un cumulonimbus, mais il préfère qu'on l'appelle nimbostratus.
DATA_CMM_2684.de: Er ist eine Cumulonimbuswolke, aber würde es vorziehen, als Nimbostratus bezeichnet zu werden.
DATA_CMM_2684.it: Si tratta di un cumulonembo ma vorrebbe essere chiamato nembostrato.
DATA_CMM_2684.es: Es un cumulonimbo, pero le gustaría llegar a ser un nimboestrato.
DATA_CMM_2684.ko: 원래는 구름 소나기였는데, 글로벌시대에 맞추어 외국식으로 소나기 구름이라고 불리게 됐다고…

DATA_CMM_2685.ja: He's left the front lines and is enjoying his retirement.
DATA_CMM_2685.en: He's left the front lines and is enjoying his retirement.
DATA_CMM_2685.fr: Pour l'heure, il profite de sa retraite.
DATA_CMM_2685.de: Er ist nicht mehr an der Front und genießt seinen Ruhestand.
DATA_CMM_2685.it: Ha abbandonato la scena e si sta godendo la pensione.
DATA_CMM_2685.es: Ha decidido que la vida son 2 días y se lo está pasando como un enano. A la vejez...
DATA_CMM_2685.zht: 還在前線就退休了。現在隱居中。
DATA_CMM_2685.zhs: 还在前线就退休了。现在隐居中。

DATA_CMM_2686.ja: Apparently she's pretty good at the yo-yo.
DATA_CMM_2686.en: Apparently she's pretty good at the yo-yo.
DATA_CMM_2686.fr: Elle maîtrise à la perfection le balancement du yo-yo.
DATA_CMM_2686.de: Anscheinend ist sie echt gut im Jo-Jo-Spielen.
DATA_CMM_2686.it: A quanto pare è bravissima con lo yo yo.
DATA_CMM_2686.es: Dicen que es una fiera con el yoyó.
DATA_CMM_2686.zht: 聽說連溜溜球的本事都是一絕。
DATA_CMM_2686.zhs: 听说连溜溜球的本事都是一绝。

DATA_CMM_2687.ja: She was born in an area famous for its hot springs, so her skin must be naturally smooth and soft.
DATA_CMM_2687.en: She was born in an area famous for its hot springs, so her skin must be naturally smooth and soft.
DATA_CMM_2687.fr: Elle est née dans une région de geysers, alors sa peau doit être naturellement douce et régulière.
DATA_CMM_2687.de: Sie wurde in einer Gegend geboren, die für ihre heißen Quellen berühmt ist, deswegen muss ihre Haut von Natur aus glatt und weich sein.
DATA_CMM_2687.it: Viene da una regione famosa per le sorgenti termali, la sua pelle deve essere morbida e liscia per natura.
DATA_CMM_2687.es: Nació en una zona famosa por sus manantiales, lo que explica la tersura de su cutis.
DATA_CMM_2687.ko: 온천이 유명한 곳 출신이다. 분명 아기 피부일 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2687.zht: 出身溫泉勝地，他的肌膚一定像蛋殼般細緻無暇吧。
DATA_CMM_2687.zhs: 出身温泉胜地，他的肌肤一定像蛋壳般细致无暇吧。

DATA_CMM_2688.ja: His captivating high-pitched voice echoes across the city.
DATA_CMM_2688.en: His captivating high-pitched voice echoes across the city.
DATA_CMM_2688.fr: Sa voix criarde résonne partout dans la ville.
DATA_CMM_2688.de: Seine fesselnde, hohe Stimme hallt durch die Stadt.
DATA_CMM_2688.it: Ha una voce stridula ma ammaliante.
DATA_CMM_2688.es: Su cautivadora voz chillona resuena por toda la oficina cada vez que habla.
DATA_CMM_2688.ko: 매력적인 하이 톤 보이스로 온 도시를 흥분시키고 있다.
DATA_CMM_2688.zht: 聽說他醉人的高音會響徹大都市。
DATA_CMM_2688.zhs: 听说他醉人的高音会响彻大都市。

DATA_CMM_2689.ja: A dandy whose sunglasses go great with his look.
DATA_CMM_2689.en: A dandy whose sunglasses go great with his look.
DATA_CMM_2689.fr: C'est un dandy qui sait porter des lunettes de soleil comme personne.
DATA_CMM_2689.de: Ein Dandy, dessen Sonnenbrille hervorragend zu seinem Look passt.
DATA_CMM_2689.es: Esto sí que es un dandi; las gafas le dan el toque perfecto.
DATA_CMM_2689.zht: 非常適合戴墨鏡的型男。
DATA_CMM_2689.zhs: 非常适合戴墨镜的型男。

DATA_CMM_2690.ja: He's such a big shot that he has pigeons run his errands.
DATA_CMM_2690.en: He's such a big shot that he has pigeons run his errands.
DATA_CMM_2690.fr: Il est tellement haut placé qu'il entretient un pigeonnier pour transmettre ses messages.
DATA_CMM_2690.de: Er ist solch eine große Nummer, dass er seine Besorgungen von Tauben erledigen lässt.
DATA_CMM_2690.it: Un vero boss del quartiere, comanda per strada.
DATA_CMM_2690.es: Ha llegado a ese grado de importancia en el que tiene gente para hacerle los recados.
DATA_CMM_2690.zht: 能夠使喚鴿子跑腿的大牌人物。
DATA_CMM_2690.zhs: 能够使唤鸽子跑腿的大牌人物。

DATA_CMM_2691.ja: A big-name singer whose emotional voice makes you think he stayed out too late last night.
DATA_CMM_2691.en: A big-name singer whose emotional voice makes you think he stayed out too late last night.
DATA_CMM_2691.fr: Un crooner hors pair. Les accents rauques de sa voix donnent l'impression qu'il est toujours enrhumé.
DATA_CMM_2691.de: Ein bekannter Sänger, dessen gefühlvolle Stimme den Eindruck erweckt, dass er gestern Nacht zu lange unterwegs war.
DATA_CMM_2691.it: Un cantante famoso la cui voce molto profonda induce a pensare che abbia passato la notte a gozzovigliare.
DATA_CMM_2691.es: Dicen que tiene una voz profunda y desgarrada, pero suena como si estuviera en una caverna.
DATA_CMM_2691.ko: 왕년에 꽤나 놀았다고 여겨지는 이모셔널 보이즈를 소유한 거물급 가수.
DATA_CMM_2691.zht: 聲音動人，會被以為是在外頭玩過火的大牌歌手。
DATA_CMM_2691.zhs: 声音动人，会被以为是在外头玩过火的大牌歌手。

DATA_CMM_2692.ja: A woman with soul who always picks red over white when she has the choice.
DATA_CMM_2692.en: A woman with soul who always picks red over white when she has the choice.
DATA_CMM_2692.fr: Inconsciemment, elle a une petite préférence colorée pour le rouge plutôt que le blanc.
DATA_CMM_2692.de: Eine Frau mit Seele, die sich immer für Rot und gegen Weiß entscheidet, wenn sie die Wahl hat.
DATA_CMM_2692.it: Una donna passionale, che sceglie sempre vestiti rossi, se ne ha la possibilità.
DATA_CMM_2692.es: Esta mujer adora el color rojo y detesta el blanco. Nunca sabremos por qué.
DATA_CMM_2692.ko: 언제나 붉은 주먹으로 거리를 휩쓰는 여성.
DATA_CMM_2692.zht: 要說到是紅是白的話，她的紅色拳頭總是很強勁。
DATA_CMM_2692.zhs: 要说到是红是白的话，她的红色拳头总是很强劲。

DATA_CMM_2693.ja: We'd usually leave off the Mr., but since We're younger than him, We thought We'd try addressing him properly.
DATA_CMM_2693.en: We'd usually leave off the Mr., but since We're younger than him, We thought We'd try addressing him properly.
DATA_CMM_2693.fr: En temps normal, Nous ne lui donnerions pas du "Monsieur", mais comme Nous sommes plus jeune, essayons d'être poli !
DATA_CMM_2693.de: Normalerweise lassen wir das „Herr" weg, aber da wir jünger sind als er, wollten wir ihn richtig ansprechen.
DATA_CMM_2693.it: Meglio rivolgersi a lui con la giusta deferenza.
DATA_CMM_2693.es: No le gusta que le llamen "señor" por aquello de que hace mayor. Pero es que lo es.
DATA_CMM_2693.ko: 뭔래는 존칭을 쓰지 않지만, 일단 연상이므로 소개란에서 만큼은 존칭을 붙여 보았습니다. 네.
DATA_CMM_2693.zht: 雖然藝名叫做「小坂本」，但他年紀比較大，所以還是叫他「坂本先生」。
DATA_CMM_2693.zhs: 虽然艺名叫做「小坂本」，但他年纪比较大，所以还是叫他「坂本先生」。

DATA_CMM_2694.ja: She's so talented at drawing that she could write graffiti on a clean wall and no one would get angry.
DATA_CMM_2694.en: She's so talented at drawing that she could write graffiti on a clean wall and no one would get angry.
DATA_CMM_2694.fr: Elle est tellement douée que même si elle faisait un immonde graffiti sur un mur immaculé, nul ne lui en voudrait.
DATA_CMM_2694.de: Eine so begabte Malerin, dass sie Graffiti auf eine leere Wand bringen könnte, ohne dass sich jemand darüber aufregen würde.
DATA_CMM_2694.it: Così brava a disegnare che quando scarabocchia i muri la gente è contenta.
DATA_CMM_2694.es: Dibuja tan bien que si hiciera pintadas en los muros de la ciudad nadie protestaría.
DATA_CMM_2694.ko: 투명한 판에다 낙서를 해도 혼나지 않을 정도로 그림을 잘그리는 여성.
DATA_CMM_2694.zht: 很擅長畫圖的女生，厲害到就算在透明板上塗鴉也不會被罵。
DATA_CMM_2694.zhs: 很擅长画图的女生，厉害到就算在透明板上涂鸦也不会被骂。

DATA_CMM_2695.ja: Apparently his dream is to become one with the river current.
DATA_CMM_2695.en: Apparently his dream is to become one with the river current.
DATA_CMM_2695.fr: Il voudrait devenir aussi agile que l'écume des torrents qu'il descend.
DATA_CMM_2695.de: Anscheinend träumt er davon, eins mit der Strömung des Flusses zu werden.
DATA_CMM_2695.it: A quanto pare il suo sogno è di fondersi con la corrente del fiume.
DATA_CMM_2695.es: Su mayor deseo es ser uno con la corriente.
DATA_CMM_2695.ko: 강물의 흐름과 일체가 되는 것이 꿈인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2695.zht: 聽說他的夢想是跟河川流動融為一體。
DATA_CMM_2695.zhs: 听说他的梦想是跟河川流动融为一体。

DATA_CMM_2696.ja: He always has a spare pair of underpants in his backpack, just in case he goes up on the winner's podium.
DATA_CMM_2696.en: He always has a spare pair of underpants in his backpack, just in case he goes up on the winner's podium.
DATA_CMM_2696.fr: Il a toujours une paire de sous-vêtements de rechange, au cas où il monterait sur le podium.
DATA_CMM_2696.de: Hat immer eine Ersatzunterhose im Gepäck, nur für den Fall, dass er mal aufs Siegertreppchen kommt.
DATA_CMM_2696.it: Porta sempre con sé un ricambio, per ogni evenienza.
DATA_CMM_2696.es: Siempre lleva una camiseta limpia para no subir al podio empapado en sudor. Qué considerado.
DATA_CMM_2696.ko: 시상대에 오를 때를 대비하여 갈아입을 바지를 항상 휴대하고 다닌다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2696.zht: 聽說他的包包裡總是帶著上領獎台的時候能換穿的內褲。
DATA_CMM_2696.zhs: 听说他的包包里总是带着上领奖台的时候能换穿的内裤。

DATA_CMM_2697.ja: Don't tell anyone, but once he was late because he got lost.
DATA_CMM_2697.en: Don't tell anyone, but once he was late because he got lost.
DATA_CMM_2697.fr: Ne le dites à personne, mais il lui est arrivé d'arriver en retard après s'être perdu.
DATA_CMM_2697.de: Nicht weitersagen, aber einmal kam er zu spät, weil er sich verlaufen hatte.
DATA_CMM_2697.it: Ogni tanto si perde, ma dissimula.
DATA_CMM_2697.es: No se lo digas a nadie, pero una vez llegó tarde porque se perdió.
DATA_CMM_2697.ko: 한 번 길을 잃어 버려서 늦어진 사실은 여기서만의 비밀이다.
DATA_CMM_2697.zht: 這個祕密只告訴你，他曾經迷路遲到。
DATA_CMM_2697.zhs: 这个秘密只告诉你，他曾经迷路迟到。

DATA_CMM_2698.ja: He once got in an argument with his boss because he wanted to ride a train.
DATA_CMM_2698.en: He once got in an argument with his boss because he wanted to ride a train.
DATA_CMM_2698.fr: Une fois, il s'est disputé avec son supérieur parce qu'il voulait conduire un train.
DATA_CMM_2698.de: Geriet mal in einen Streit mit seinem Chef, weil er mit dem Zug fahren wollte.
DATA_CMM_2698.it: Una volta ha litigato con il suo capo perché voleva guidare un treno.
DATA_CMM_2698.es: Se peleó con su jefe porque no le dejaba conducir el tren. Sabia decisión, declaramos.
DATA_CMM_2698.ko: 옛날에 열차에 타고 싶어서 상사와 크게 싸운 적이 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2698.zht: 據說他以前非常想搭電車，因此跟上司吵架。
DATA_CMM_2698.zhs: 据说他以前非常想搭电车，因此跟上司吵架。

DATA_CMM_2699.ja: The way he wiggles his butt is several dozen times cuter than the way his parents do.
DATA_CMM_2699.en: The way he wiggles his butt is several dozen times cuter than the way his parents do.
DATA_CMM_2699.fr: Quand il marche sur ses petites pattes, il fait fondre le cœur de toutes les vieilles dames alentour.
DATA_CMM_2699.de: Die Art und Weise, wie es mit seinem Hintern wackelt, ist wesentlich niedlicher, als wenn es seine Eltern tun.
DATA_CMM_2699.it: Come sculetta bene! È troppo carino!
DATA_CMM_2699.es: Son monísimos así pequeñitos, antes de desarrollar el mismo mal genio que sus padres.
DATA_CMM_2699.ko: 토실토실한 엉덩이가 엄마보다 몇 배는 더 귀엽다.
DATA_CMM_2699.zht: 牠緩緩搖曳的屁股比雙親的可愛好幾十倍。
DATA_CMM_2699.zhs: 它缓缓摇曳的屁股比双亲的可爱好几十倍。

DATA_CMM_2700.ja: A beautiful and popular fish. A lot of people seem to become relaxed just by looking at one.
DATA_CMM_2700.en: A beautiful and popular fish. A lot of people seem to become relaxed just by looking at one.
DATA_CMM_2700.fr: Beau poisson très populaire. Beaucoup de gens se sentent relaxés simplement en le regardant.
DATA_CMM_2700.de: Ein hübscher und beliebter Fisch. Viele Leute scheint es zu entspannen, wenn sie ihn nur ansehen.
DATA_CMM_2700.it: Un pesce bello e popolare. Un sacco di persone si rilassano solo a guardarlo.
DATA_CMM_2700.es: En realidad, es erróneo e injusto esperar que esté contando chistes toda la velada.
DATA_CMM_2700.ko: 매우 인기있는 예쁜 물고기. 보기만 해도 편안해지는 사람들도 많다.
DATA_CMM_2700.zht: 非常受歡迎的漂亮魚類。聽說有很多人看著牠就能紓壓。
DATA_CMM_2700.zhs: 非常受欢迎的漂亮鱼类。听说有很多人看着它就能纾压。

DATA_CMM_2701.ja: This guy's good at swimming. He doesn't even need to come up for air.
DATA_CMM_2701.en: This guy's good at swimming. He doesn't even need to come up for air.
DATA_CMM_2701.fr: Il est imbattable en natation. Il n'a même pas besoin de respirer.
DATA_CMM_2701.de: Dieses Kerlchen kann gut schwimmen. Er braucht dafür nicht mal nach Luft zu schnappen.
DATA_CMM_2701.it: Bravissimo a nuotare, non ha nemmeno bisogno di sollevare la testa per respirare.
DATA_CMM_2701.es: Es muy buen nadador; ni siquiera necesita salir a respirar.
DATA_CMM_2701.ko: 수영을 매우 잘한다. 숨은 안 쉬어도 되나 보다.
DATA_CMM_2701.zht: 游泳好手，好像不用換氣。
DATA_CMM_2701.zhs: 游泳好手，好像不用换气。

DATA_CMM_2702.es: Este color resulta de lo más peculiar.

DATA_CMM_2703.ja: He's doing a bit more than borrowing the shell on his back. He's taken it for his own, really.
DATA_CMM_2703.en: He's doing a bit more than borrowing the shell on his back. He's taken it for his own, really.
DATA_CMM_2703.fr: Il est impropre de dire qu'il a emprunté le coquillage qu'il a sur le dos. En fait, il se l'est approprié.
DATA_CMM_2703.de: Er leiht sich die Schale auf seinem Rücken nicht nur aus, sondern macht sie sich wirklich zu eigen.
DATA_CMM_2703.it: Non ha preso la conchiglia in prestito, l'ha proprio rubata.
DATA_CMM_2703.es: Este animalito confirma que en el reino animal también hay okupas.
DATA_CMM_2703.ko: 등에 진 조개껍데기는 빌린 게 아니라 이미 자기 것인 양 행세한다.
DATA_CMM_2703.zht: 背上的貝殼根本不是寄居，而是完全占為己有了。
DATA_CMM_2703.zhs: 背上的贝壳根本不是寄居，而是完全占为己有了。

DATA_CMM_2704.ja: A really big elephant that lived long ago. When people catch it, they eat the meat right off the bone.
DATA_CMM_2704.en: A really big elephant that lived long ago. When people catch it, they eat the meat right off the bone.
DATA_CMM_2704.fr: Très grand éléphant qui vivait il y a fort longtemps. Nos ancêtres les hommes préhistoriques étaient friands de sa viande.
DATA_CMM_2704.de: Ein wirklich großer Elefant, der vor langer Zeit gelebt hat. Wenn die Menschen es fingen, aßen sie sein Fleisch direkt von den Knochen.
DATA_CMM_2704.it: Un elefante enorme vissuto secoli fa. Chissà che bistecche!
DATA_CMM_2704.es: Al parecer, cuando lo cazaban se comían la carne directamente, sin sacar filetes ni nada.
DATA_CMM_2704.ko: 아주 먼 옛날에 살았던 매우 큰 코끼리. 잡히면 그 유명한 만화 고기로 만들어진다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2704.zht: 生活在遠古的巨大象類。被人類抓到就會被做成漫畫中巨大的帶骨肉。
DATA_CMM_2704.zhs: 生活在远古的巨大象类。被人类抓到就会被做成漫画中巨大的带骨肉。

DATA_CMM_2705.ja: When it comes to pulling sleds, no dog is better. You could say he's a genuine snow dog.
DATA_CMM_2705.en: When it comes to pulling sleds, no dog is better. You could say he's a genuine snow dog.
DATA_CMM_2705.fr: Il ne se fait jamais tirer la patte pour tirer des traîneaux.
DATA_CMM_2705.de: Wenn es ums Schlittenziehen geht, gibt es keinen besseren Hund. Man könnte sagen, er ist ein echter Schneehund.
DATA_CMM_2705.it: Il miglior cane per trainare delle slitte. Ha degli occhi blu magnetici.
DATA_CMM_2705.es: No hay mejor perro para tirar del trineo; se diría que es su gran vocación.
DATA_CMM_2705.ko: 썰매만 매면 당할 개가 없다. 누가 눈나라 출신 아니랄까 봐.
DATA_CMM_2705.zht: 沒有其他犬類比牠更會拉雪橇。貨真價實的雪國出身。
DATA_CMM_2705.zhs: 没有其他犬类比它更会拉雪橇。货真价实的雪国出身。

DATA_CMM_2706.ja: A strong-looking dog whose black hair shines in the light. His owner is either a police officer or a very rich man.
DATA_CMM_2706.en: A strong-looking dog whose black hair shines in the light. His owner is either a police officer or a very rich man.
DATA_CMM_2706.fr: C'est un chien très fort dont le poil noir luit dans la nuit. Son maître est souvent un policier ou un homme riche.
DATA_CMM_2706.de: Ein kräftiger Hund, dessen schwarzes Fell im Licht glänzt. Sein Besitzer ist entweder Polizist oder ein sehr reicher Mann.
DATA_CMM_2706.it: Un cane dall'aspetto pericoloso e autoritario. Ottimo compagno di un poliziotto o di un lord inglese.
DATA_CMM_2706.es: Aunque tienen aspecto fiero, dicen que son muy amistosos. Nos gusta el brillo de su pelaje negro.
DATA_CMM_2706.ko: 강해 보이는 검은 개. 경찰이나 부자들이 주로 기르고 있다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2706.zht: 烏黑亮麗，看起來就很強勁的犬類。養這種狗的不是警察就是有錢人。
DATA_CMM_2706.zhs: 乌黑亮丽，看起来就很强劲的犬类。养这种狗的不是警察就是有钱人。

DATA_CMM_2707.ja: He must have filled his daily quota.
DATA_CMM_2707.en: He must have filled his daily quota.
DATA_CMM_2707.fr: Il doit avoir terminé de travailler pour cette année.
DATA_CMM_2707.de: Der muss bestimmt seine tägliche Quote erfüllt haben.
DATA_CMM_2707.it: Probabilmente ha già fatto tutto quello che doveva fare oggi.
DATA_CMM_2707.es: Ya debe de haber fabricado los juguetes para hoy.
DATA_CMM_2707.zht: 今天有達到生產定額嗎？
DATA_CMM_2707.zhs: 今天有达到生产定额吗？

DATA_CMM_2708.ja: A clumsy old woman who performs mischief in an attempt to get noticed.
DATA_CMM_2708.en: A clumsy old woman who performs mischief in an attempt to get noticed.
DATA_CMM_2708.fr: Vieille femme maladroite qui cuisine des choses dégoûtantes dans une marmite pour se faire remarquer.
DATA_CMM_2708.de: Eine ungeschickte alte Frau, die Unheil anrichtet, um aufzufallen.
DATA_CMM_2708.it: Una vecchia donna che cerca di venir notata facendo cattiverie.
DATA_CMM_2708.es: En realidad, solo hace las cosas que hace para llamar la atención.
DATA_CMM_2708.ko: 누군가가 토닥거려 주길 원하면서도 심술을 부리고 마는 감정 표현이 서툰 할머니.
DATA_CMM_2708.zht: 其實只是想有人關注她，卻總是不小心使壞，是個彆扭的婆婆。
DATA_CMM_2708.zhs: 其实只是想有人关注她，却总是不小心使坏，是个别扭的婆婆。

DATA_CMM_2709.ja: He once gave a speech in place of the principal. Apparently, people liked it a lot.
DATA_CMM_2709.en: He once gave a speech in place of the principal. Apparently, people liked it a lot.
DATA_CMM_2709.fr: Une fois, il a fait un discours à la place du principal. On en parle encore.
DATA_CMM_2709.de: Er hielt einmal eine Rede für den Schulleiter. Offenbar hat sie den Leuten sehr gefallen.
DATA_CMM_2709.it: C'è chi lo apprezza più del preside.
DATA_CMM_2709.es: Una vez dio un discurso en lugar del Director y a la gente le gustó mucho.
DATA_CMM_2709.ko: 교장 선생님 대신 훈시를 했더니 꽤나 반응이 좋았다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2709.zht: 代替校長演說，結果評價不錯的樣子。
DATA_CMM_2709.zhs: 代替校长演说，结果评价不错的样子。

DATA_CMM_2710.ja: Everyone crouches like this behind the school building, so his legs probably don't hurt.
DATA_CMM_2710.en: Everyone crouches like this behind the school building, so his legs probably don't hurt.
DATA_CMM_2710.fr: Tout le monde s'accroupit comme ça derrière l'école, alors il est entraîné.
DATA_CMM_2710.de: Alle hocken so hinter dem Schulgebäude, also tun ihm wahrscheinlich nicht die Beine weh.
DATA_CMM_2710.it: Accucciandosi in questo modo pare che le gambe non facciano male.
DATA_CMM_2710.es: Parece bastante cómodo en la postura; seguro que lleva años practicando.
DATA_CMM_2710.ko: 교정 뒷편에서 항상 이 자세로 앉아있지만 특별히 다리가 불편해서 그런 것은 아니라고.
DATA_CMM_2710.zht: 聽說他在校舍後面總是這種坐姿，所以並不覺得腳痠。
DATA_CMM_2710.zhs: 听说他在校舍后面总是这种坐姿，所以并不觉得脚酸。

DATA_CMM_2711.ja: The father of the Hoshino family, he takes his time off seriously. He also still gets sick in space.
DATA_CMM_2711.en: The father of the Hoshino family, he takes his time off seriously. He also still gets sick in space.
DATA_CMM_2711.fr: Le père de la famille Hoshino. Il est sérieux, même en vacances : il est toujours dans la Lune.
DATA_CMM_2711.de: Der Vater der Familie Hoshino nimmt seine Auszeit sehr ernst. Außerdem wird ihm in Weltraum immer noch übel.
DATA_CMM_2711.it: Il padre della famiglia Hoshino. Una persona seria. Soffre ancora il mal di spazio.
DATA_CMM_2711.es: Este padre de familia se toma su tiempo libre muy seriamente. Tan seriamente que ni lo disfruta.
DATA_CMM_2711.ko: 휴일을 만끽하고 있는 호시노 일가의 아빠. 실은 아직 우주 멀미 중.
DATA_CMM_2711.zht: 假日過得很充實的星野家老爸。其實在宇宙還是會暈。
DATA_CMM_2711.zhs: 假日过得很充实的星野家老爸。其实在宇宙还是会晕。

DATA_CMM_2712.ja: A soft, quivery, bouncy treat. Everyone loves it.
DATA_CMM_2712.en: A soft, quivery, bouncy treat. Everyone loves it.
DATA_CMM_2712.fr: Dessert doux, tremblant et absorbant les chocs. Tout le monde l'aime.
DATA_CMM_2712.de: Ein weicher, zitternder und wackliger Genuss. Wird von allen geliebt.
DATA_CMM_2712.it: Morbido, tremolante, delizioso. Tutti lo adorano.
DATA_CMM_2712.es: Una capa de azúcar crujiente y después esa textura cremosa... Indescriptible.
DATA_CMM_2712.zht: 滑溜溜，彈嫩嫩的高人氣食物。
DATA_CMM_2712.zhs: 滑溜溜，弹嫩嫩的高人气食物。

DATA_CMM_2713.ja: He may be vicious, but the mark on his chest and the way he's susceptible to cold make him sort of cute.
DATA_CMM_2713.en: He may be vicious, but the mark on his chest and the way he's susceptible to cold make him sort of cute.
DATA_CMM_2713.fr: Il est peut-être féroce, mais il a l'air tellement mignon...
DATA_CMM_2713.de: Er mag zwar wild sein, aber sein Brustfell und seine Anfälligkeit für Kälte lassen ihn irgendwie niedlich wirken.
DATA_CMM_2713.it: Un animale feroce che, non si sa perché, risulta essere anche così carino.
DATA_CMM_2713.es: Tiene un mal genio terrible pero cuando está tranquilo es como un peluche grandote.
DATA_CMM_2713.ko: 흉포하지만, 가슴에 트레이드 마크가 달려있다든지, 추위를 탄다든지 하는 귀여운 일면도 있다.
DATA_CMM_2713.zht: 雖然兇猛，但有些可愛的部分，例如胸口上有著商標，還怕冷。
DATA_CMM_2713.zhs: 虽然凶猛，但有些可爱的部分，例如胸口上有着商标，还怕冷。

DATA_CMM_2714.ja: The black stripes won't fall off if you scare him.
DATA_CMM_2714.en: The black stripes won't fall off if you scare him.
DATA_CMM_2714.fr: Il ne quitte jamais son pyjama.
DATA_CMM_2714.de: Die schwarzen Streifen fallen nicht ab, wenn man es erschreckt.
DATA_CMM_2714.it: Le strisce nere non sono verniciate.
DATA_CMM_2714.es: Lo curioso es que las rayas no se vuelven blancas a medida que envejece.
DATA_CMM_2714.ko: 아무리 놀라도 검은 얼룩이 빠지는 일은 없다.
DATA_CMM_2714.zht: 就算嚇到發白，黑色的條紋也不會消失。
DATA_CMM_2714.zhs: 就算吓到发白，黑色的条纹也不会消失。

DATA_CMM_2715.ja: He may be king, but he doesn't work very hard. We wish he would learn a thing or two from his wife.
DATA_CMM_2715.en: He may be king, but he doesn't work very hard. We wish he would learn a thing or two from his wife.
DATA_CMM_2715.fr: C'est peut-être un roi, mais un roi fainéant. Nous aimerions que sa femme soit moins patiente.
DATA_CMM_2715.de: Er mag zwar König sein, aber viel macht er dafür nicht. Wir wünschen uns, er würde noch was von seiner Frau dazulernen.
DATA_CMM_2715.it: Re degli animali, ma non lavora molto. Forse dovrebbe imparare un paio di cose da sua moglie.
DATA_CMM_2715.es: Será el rey de la selva, pero es un gandul de cuidado. Su señora leona debería darle un toque.
DATA_CMM_2715.ko: 임금님인 주제에 일을 안 한다. 왕비님을 좀 본받으라지.
DATA_CMM_2715.zht: 雖然是王卻不太勤勞的樣子。真希望牠向太太學習一下。
DATA_CMM_2715.zhs: 虽然是王却不太勤劳的样子。真希望它向太太学习一下。

DATA_CMM_2716.ja: His clothes are fancy, so he must be a big star in the animal kingdom.
DATA_CMM_2716.en: His clothes are fancy, so he must be a big star in the animal kingdom.
DATA_CMM_2716.fr: Il s'habille avec beaucoup de goût, alors il doit faire des jaloux.
DATA_CMM_2716.de: Seine Kleidung ist schick, was ihn im Tierreich bestimmt zu einem großen Star macht.
DATA_CMM_2716.it: Si veste decisamente bene, deve essere una specie di star nel mondo degli animali.
DATA_CMM_2716.es: Con esa ropa de colores llamativos parece un cantante de ópera o un adivino.
DATA_CMM_2716.ko: 의상이 화려한 것을 봐선 분명 동물계의 대 스타일 것이다.
DATA_CMM_2716.zht: 服裝華美，所以應該是動物界的大明星吧。
DATA_CMM_2716.zhs: 服装华美，所以应该是动物界的大明星吧。

DATA_CMM_2717.ja: He was promised a kiss from his girlfriend if he can learn how to turn without falling over.
DATA_CMM_2717.en: He was promised a kiss from his girlfriend if he can learn how to turn without falling over.
DATA_CMM_2717.fr: Sa petite amie lui a promis de l'embrasser s'il apprenait à tourner sans tomber.
DATA_CMM_2717.de: Seine Freundin hat ihm einen Kuss versprochen, wenn er lernt zu wenden, ohne umzufallen.
DATA_CMM_2717.it: La sua ragazza ha promesso di baciarlo se imparerà a non cadere.
DATA_CMM_2717.es: Su novia le ha prometido un beso si consigue engancharse al telearrastre sin caerse.
DATA_CMM_2717.ko: 스핀을 걸고 라면 내기를 한 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2717.zht: 聽說他有承諾如果會轉彎就請吃拉麵。
DATA_CMM_2717.zhs: 听说他有承诺如果会转弯就请吃拉面。

DATA_CMM_2718.ja: They call him the Red Comet. He zooms down the slopes ten times faster than other people.
DATA_CMM_2718.en: They call him the Red Comet. He zooms down the slopes ten times faster than other people.
DATA_CMM_2718.fr: On l'appelle la flèche rouge. Il descend les pistes plus vite qu'un courant d'air.
DATA_CMM_2718.de: Man nennt ihn den Roten Kometen. Er saust zehnmal schneller die Pisten runter als andere Menschen.
DATA_CMM_2718.it: Lo chiamano la cometa rossa, è dieci volte più veloce di chiunque altro.
DATA_CMM_2718.es: Se le conoce como Cometa Roja por su velocidad incomparable en el descenso.
DATA_CMM_2718.ko: 붉은 혜성이라 불리고 있는 듯하다. 다른 사람보다 10배는 빨리 타고 내려온다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2718.zht: 人稱紅色流星，聽說滑斜坡的速度是其他人的10倍。
DATA_CMM_2718.zhs: 人称红色流星，听说滑斜坡的速度是其他人的10倍。

DATA_CMM_2719.ja: He's the best at kicking up lots of snow when he stops.
DATA_CMM_2719.en: He's the best at kicking up lots of snow when he stops.
DATA_CMM_2719.fr: C'est lui le meilleur pour faire jaillir la neige lorsqu'il s'arrête.
DATA_CMM_2719.de: Er ist der Beste darin, beim Anhalten viel Schnee aufzuwirbeln.
DATA_CMM_2719.it: Non c'è nessuno bravo come lui a fare alzare la neve con una sterzata.
DATA_CMM_2719.es: Cada vez que frena provoca una avalancha en miniatura.
DATA_CMM_2719.ko: 멈출 때 스핀으로 눈발을 날리는 것이 특기인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2719.zht: 最擅長的好像是停下時濺起大量的雪。
DATA_CMM_2719.zhs: 最擅长的好像是停下时溅起大量的雪。

DATA_CMM_2720.ja: A creature you rarely see with your own eyes. He's created all sorts of legends in all sorts of places.
DATA_CMM_2720.en: A creature you rarely see with your own eyes. He's created all sorts of legends in all sorts of places.
DATA_CMM_2720.fr: On le voit rarement, mais il fait beaucoup parler de lui. C'est le héros de nombreuses légendes.
DATA_CMM_2720.de: Ein Geschöpf, das man selten mit eigenen Augen sieht. Er ist Stoff aller möglichen Legenden an allen möglichen Orten.
DATA_CMM_2720.it: Una creatura molto rara che si vede di rado. Ha fatto nascere moltissime leggende un po' in tutto il mondo.
DATA_CMM_2720.es: Pese a todas las historias que se cuentan, no tenemos ningún testimonio fiable de que hayan sido vistos.
DATA_CMM_2720.ko: 자주 볼 수 없는 생물. 여러 장소에서 여러 전설을 탄생시킨 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2720.zht: 不太有機會看到的生物。好像在各地創造了各種傳說。
DATA_CMM_2720.zhs: 不太有机会看到的生物。好像在各地创造了各种传说。

DATA_CMM_2721.ja: This bird is resurrected whenever it dies. Their numbers must do nothing but increase.
DATA_CMM_2721.en: This bird is resurrected whenever it dies. Their numbers must do nothing but increase.
DATA_CMM_2721.fr: Cet oiseau ressuscite dès qu'il meurt. Impossible de contrôler sa population.
DATA_CMM_2721.de: Dieser Vogel wird jedes Mal wiedergeboren, wenn er stirbt. Müssen mit der Zeit wohl echt viele werden.
DATA_CMM_2721.it: Questo uccello depone un uovo, poi muore, ed infine rinasce da quell'uovo. Non riusciamo a capire se sia comodo o gran seccatura.
DATA_CMM_2721.es: Si resucita cada vez que se muere, ¿cómo es que hay tan pocos? ¿No se casan?
DATA_CMM_2721.ko: 죽어도 부활하므로 개체 수가 계속 늘어난다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2721.zht: 就算死了也會復活，所以數量有增無減。
DATA_CMM_2721.zhs: 就算死了也会复活，所以数量有增无减。

DATA_CMM_2722.ja: Nobody seems to have told them that their feet are showing.
DATA_CMM_2722.en: Nobody seems to have told them that their feet are showing.
DATA_CMM_2722.fr: Personne n'a dit à ses occupants que leurs pieds dépassaient...
DATA_CMM_2722.de: Niemand scheint ihnen gesagt zu haben, dass ihre Füße zu sehen sind.
DATA_CMM_2722.it: Nessuno gli ha detto che gli si vedono i piedi.
DATA_CMM_2722.es: Nadie se ha molestado en avisarles de que se les ven los pies.
DATA_CMM_2722.zht: 好像沒有人願意告訴他腳露餡了。
DATA_CMM_2722.zhs: 好像没有人愿意告诉他脚露馅了。

DATA_CMM_2723.ja: He's a really fast runner, and hates it when people ride him.
DATA_CMM_2723.en: He's a really fast runner, and hates it when people ride him.
DATA_CMM_2723.fr: Il court très vite et déteste être pris pour une monture.
DATA_CMM_2723.de: Ein wirklich schneller Läufer, der es hasst, wenn man auf ihm reitet.
DATA_CMM_2723.it: Corre molto veloce e odia essere cavalcato.
DATA_CMM_2723.es: Podría correr mucho más rápido si la gente no se empeñara en montarse a lomos.
DATA_CMM_2723.ko: 달리기가 빠르다고 한다. 사람이 등에 타는 걸 매우 싫어한다.
DATA_CMM_2723.zht: 一言以蔽之就是跑得很快。非常討厭載人。
DATA_CMM_2723.zhs: 一言以蔽之就是跑得很快。非常讨厌载人。

DATA_CMM_2724.ja: This is training for the heart. They're learning to think about each other's feelings so that they feel more comfortable.
DATA_CMM_2724.en: This is training for the heart. They're learning to think about each other's feelings so that they feel more comfortable.
DATA_CMM_2724.fr: Ils font un peu d'exercice. C'est bon pour le cœur. Nous Nous demandons lequel s'amuse le plus.
DATA_CMM_2724.de: Übung für das Herz. Sie lernen, an die Gefühle des anderen zu denken, um sich wohler fühlen.
DATA_CMM_2724.it: In questo modo si allena il cuore. Stanno imparando a riflettere sui reciproci sentimenti.
DATA_CMM_2724.es: Es un buen método para aprender a colaborar.
DATA_CMM_2724.ko: 서로가 서로를 생각해주면 굉장히 편해지는, 마음을 나누는 트레이닝 방법.
DATA_CMM_2724.zht: 為彼此著想就會非常輕鬆，算是一種心靈鍛鍊。
DATA_CMM_2724.zhs: 为彼此着想就会非常轻松，算是一种心灵锻炼。

DATA_CMM_2725.ja: She'll put a flower necklace around your neck and give you a kiss on the cheek. An idol to fathers everywhere.
DATA_CMM_2725.en: She'll put a flower necklace around your neck and give you a kiss on the cheek. An idol to fathers everywhere.
DATA_CMM_2725.fr: Elle vous met un collier de fleurs autour du cou et vous embrasse sur la joue. Une légende parmi la gent masculine.
DATA_CMM_2725.de: Sie legt einem eine Blumenkette um den Hals und gibt einem einen Kuss auf die Wange. Ein Idol aller Väter.
DATA_CMM_2725.it: Mette corone di fiori ed elargisce baci ai turisti. Che animo gentile.
DATA_CMM_2725.es: Te pondrá un collar de flores y te dará un besito, pero para eso tienes que ir a Hawai.
DATA_CMM_2725.ko: 꽃다발을 목에 걸고, 게다가 볼에 쪽~까지 해주는 아빠들의 영원한 아이돌.
DATA_CMM_2725.zht: 脖子上帶著花圈，還會親吻人臉頰，是爸爸們的偶像。
DATA_CMM_2725.zhs: 脖子上带着花圈，还会亲吻人脸颊，是爸爸们的偶像。

DATA_CMM_2726.ja: A faithful dog-like creature who's been waiting for its master to return for ages.
DATA_CMM_2726.en: A faithful dog-like creature who's been waiting for its master to return for ages.
DATA_CMM_2726.fr: Animal aussi fidèle qu'un chien, qui attend son maître depuis des siècles.
DATA_CMM_2726.de: Ein treues, hundeähnliches Geschöpf, das schon seit Ewigkeiten auf die Rückkehr seines Herrchens wartet.
DATA_CMM_2726.it: Una creatura fedele che aspetta il ritorno del proprio padrone da secoli.
DATA_CMM_2726.es: A primera vista, parece un perro fiel que espera al amo, pero es mucho más que eso.
DATA_CMM_2726.ko: 언제까지나 주인의 귀환을 기다리는 충실한 개 비슷한 생물.
DATA_CMM_2726.zht: 永遠等待主人回來，像忠犬般的生物。
DATA_CMM_2726.zhs: 永远等待主人回来，像忠犬般的生物。

DATA_CMM_2727.ja: A man who's good at cooking. His head isn't actually that long.
DATA_CMM_2727.en: A man who's good at cooking. His head isn't actually that long.
DATA_CMM_2727.fr: Il est très doué pour la cuisine. Il porte un chapeau long pour faire parler les bavards. Et toc !
DATA_CMM_2727.de: Ein Mann, der gut kochen kann. Sein Kopf ist eigentlich nicht so lang.
DATA_CMM_2727.it: Un uomo bravo a cucinare. La sua testa non è lunghissima nonostante il cappello.
DATA_CMM_2727.es: No es que tenga la cabeza alargada, es que los sombreros de chef son así de verdad.
DATA_CMM_2727.ko: 요리 실력이 뛰어난 아저씨. 실제 머리는 그렇게 길지 않다.
DATA_CMM_2727.zht: 很會煮菜的叔叔。頭沒有看起來那麼長。
DATA_CMM_2727.zhs: 很会煮菜的叔叔。头没有看起来那么长。

DATA_CMM_2728.ja: His parents wanted a strong, sturdy son, even if he was a little naughty. They got their wish.
DATA_CMM_2728.en: His parents wanted a strong, sturdy son, even if he was a little naughty. They got their wish.
DATA_CMM_2728.fr: Ses parents voulaient un fils fort et solide, même s'il était un peu agité. Ils ont été entendus !
DATA_CMM_2728.de: Seine Eltern wünschten sich einen kräftigen, stämmigen Sohn, auch wenn er ein bisschen frech sein würde. Ihr Wunsch wurde ihnen erfüllt.
DATA_CMM_2728.it: I suoi genitori avevano desiderato un figlio forte e sano anche se un po' bricconcello. Sono stati accontentati.
DATA_CMM_2728.es: Sus padres querían un niño vivaracho aunque fuera un poco travieso. Deseo concedido.
DATA_CMM_2728.ko: 무식해도 좋다 튼튼히만 자라다오, 라는 부모의 소원대로 되었다.
DATA_CMM_2728.zht: 父母希望他堅強地成長茁壯，頑皮點也無所謂。他也如父母所願地這樣長大了。
DATA_CMM_2728.zhs: 父母希望他坚强地成长茁壮，顽皮点也无所谓。他也如父母所愿地这样长大了。

DATA_CMM_2729.ja: People say he's a different person whenever he's holding a racket. He never notices himself.
DATA_CMM_2729.en: People say he's a different person whenever he's holding a racket. He never notices himself.
DATA_CMM_2729.fr: Il paraît qu'il se transforme avec une raquette dans la main. Il ne s'en rend même pas compte.
DATA_CMM_2729.de: Die Leute sagen, er sei ein anderer Mensch, wenn er einen Schläger in der Hand hält. Ihm wird das nie bewusst.
DATA_CMM_2729.it: Tutti gli dicono che appena impugna una racchetta cambia completamente personalità, ma lui non ci crede.
DATA_CMM_2729.es: Dicen que cambia completamente cuando coge la raqueta, pero no vemos ninguna diferencia.
DATA_CMM_2729.ko: 라켓을 쥐면 사람이 변한다는 말을 자주 듣는다. 자각은 못하는 듯.
DATA_CMM_2729.zht: 常有人說他一握上球拍整個人都變了，不過本人沒有自覺。
DATA_CMM_2729.zhs: 常有人说他一握上球拍整个人都变了，不过本人没有自觉。

DATA_CMM_2730.ja: An energetic 16-year-old. He recently got his driver's license.
DATA_CMM_2730.en: An energetic 16-year-old. He recently got his driver's license.
DATA_CMM_2730.fr: Un adolescent qui a fait le plein d'énergie. Il vient d'avoir son permis.
DATA_CMM_2730.de: Ein energiegeladener 16-Jähriger. Er hat vor Kurzem seinen Führerschein gemacht.
DATA_CMM_2730.it: Un ragazzo di sedici anni pieno di energie. Ha appena preso la patente A1.
DATA_CMM_2730.es: Está ahorrando para poder comprarse una moto y ponerle gasolina aquí.
DATA_CMM_2730.ko: 활발함이 장기인 18세. 최근엔 자동차 면허를 땄다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2730.zht: 18歲，活力就是最大優點。聽說最近考到了駕照。
DATA_CMM_2730.zhs: 18岁，活力就是最大优点。听说最近考到了驾照。

DATA_CMM_2731.ja: Her hobby is going to rock concerts.
DATA_CMM_2731.en: Her hobby is going to rock concerts.
DATA_CMM_2731.fr: Son passe-temps favori : les concerts de rock.
DATA_CMM_2731.de: Es ist ihr Hobby, Rockkonzerte zu besuchen.
DATA_CMM_2731.it: Il suo hobby è andare ai concerti rock.
DATA_CMM_2731.es: Cuando tiene tiempo libre va a conciertos de rock duro.
DATA_CMM_2731.zht: 聽說興趣是聽搖滾樂的演唱會。
DATA_CMM_2731.zhs: 听说兴趣是听摇滚乐的演唱会。

DATA_CMM_2732.ja: He's actually sucking his gut in right now.
DATA_CMM_2732.en: He's actually sucking his gut in right now.
DATA_CMM_2732.fr: Là, il est en train de rentrer le ventre.
DATA_CMM_2732.de: Er zieht gerade seinen Bauch ein.
DATA_CMM_2732.it: Sta tenendo in dentro la pancia.
DATA_CMM_2732.es: Si sigue metiendo barriga así, acabará poniéndose azul.
DATA_CMM_2732.ko: 실은 배에 잔뜩 힘을 주고 있는 듯하다.

DATA_CMM_2733.ja: She took out her contacts, so she can't see a thing right now. Her butterfly stroke is absolutely beautiful.
DATA_CMM_2733.en: She took out her contacts, so she can't see a thing right now. Her butterfly stroke is absolutely beautiful.
DATA_CMM_2733.fr: Elle a enlevé ses lentilles, alors elle n'y voit plus rien. Elle nage merveilleusement bien le papillon.
DATA_CMM_2733.de: Sie hat ihre Kontaktlinsen rausgenommen, deshalb sieht sie momentan nichts. Ihr Schmetterlingsstil ist wunderschön.
DATA_CMM_2733.it: Si è tolta le lenti quindi sta nuotando alla cieca.
DATA_CMM_2733.es: Se ha quitado las lentillas, así que hay que decirle dónde está la piscina.
DATA_CMM_2733.ko: 콘택트 렌즈를 벗었기 때문에 아무것도 안 보이는 것 같다. 접영 폼이 매우 멋지다.
DATA_CMM_2733.zht: 因為拿掉隱形眼鏡了，所以什麼都看不到。蝶式的姿勢非常標準。
DATA_CMM_2733.zhs: 因为拿掉隐形眼镜了，所以什么都看不到。蝶式的姿势非常标准。

DATA_CMM_2734.ja: He hates washing his eyes after leaving the pool, so he's decided to keep on swimming forever.
DATA_CMM_2734.en: He hates washing his eyes after leaving the pool, so he's decided to keep on swimming forever.
DATA_CMM_2734.fr: Il déteste se laver les yeux en sortant de l'eau, alors il ne s'arrête jamais.
DATA_CMM_2734.de: Er hasst es, sich nach dem Schwimmen die Augen auszuwaschen, also schwimmt er einfach immer weiter.
DATA_CMM_2734.it: Odia farsi la doccia dopo aver lasciato la piscina quindi ha deciso di continuare a nuotare per sempre.
DATA_CMM_2734.es: Disfruta tanto en la piscina que ha decidido quedarse a vivir. Los dueños del gimnasio no están de acuerdo.
DATA_CMM_2734.ko: 풀장 이용 후에 눈을 씻는 것을 싫어하기 때문에, 이대로 그냥 수영하기로 결심한 듯.
DATA_CMM_2734.zht: 因為不喜歡游泳後洗眼睛，所以就這樣一直游下去。
DATA_CMM_2734.zhs: 因为不喜欢游泳后洗眼睛，所以就这样一直游下去。

DATA_CMM_2735.ja: She managed to swim to the neighboring island recently. Next, she intends to try it without coming up for air.
DATA_CMM_2735.en: She managed to swim to the neighboring island recently. Next, she intends to try it without coming up for air.
DATA_CMM_2735.fr: Elle a réussi à nager jusqu'à l'île voisine, récemment. Elle a décidé de le refaire, en apnée.
DATA_CMM_2735.de: Hat es neulich geschafft, bis zur Nachbarinsel zu schwimmen. Als Nächstes will sie es versuchen, ohne aufzutauchen und Luft zu holen.
DATA_CMM_2735.it: Recentemente ha nuotato fino ad un'isola vicina. Ora sta cercando nuovi record da battere.
DATA_CMM_2735.es: Consiguió nadar hasta la isla de al lado. Lo que hacen algunos por no pagar billete.
DATA_CMM_2735.ko: 얼마 전 옆의 섬까지 수영으로 도착했다고 한다. 다음엔 왕복에 도전한다고…
DATA_CMM_2735.zht: 不久前成功游到附近的島嶼了。下次想不換氣游過去。
DATA_CMM_2735.zhs: 不久前成功游到附近的岛屿了。下次想不换气游过去。

DATA_CMM_2736.ja: A god whose main assignment is the rain. He's not the type to go to new places.
DATA_CMM_2736.en: A god whose main assignment is the rain. He's not the type to go to new places.
DATA_CMM_2736.fr: Un dieu dont le travail consiste à faire pleuvoir. Il est très casanier.
DATA_CMM_2736.de: Ein Gott, dessen Hauptaufgabe es ist, es regnen zu lassen. Besucht nicht gerne neue Orte.
DATA_CMM_2736.it: Un dio il cui compito principale è la pioggia, amato dai contadini e odiato dai bambini.
DATA_CMM_2736.es: Se ocupa de que llueva cuando quieres ir a la playa y haga sol en época de exámenes. Así son los dioses.
DATA_CMM_2736.ko: 주로 비를 관장하고 있는 신이다. 새로운 곳으로는 그다지 외출하지 않는 타입.
DATA_CMM_2736.zht: 主要負責降雨業務的神明。是不喜歡探索新地區的類型。
DATA_CMM_2736.zhs: 主要负责降雨业务的神明。是不喜欢探索新地区的类型。

DATA_CMM_2737.ja: The chief of the Wind Blowing Section, Wind Office, Weather Department. He has a tendency to sometimes overdo it.
DATA_CMM_2737.en: The chief of the Wind Blowing Section, Wind Office, Weather Department. He has a tendency to sometimes overdo it.
DATA_CMM_2737.fr: C'est le chef des vents, du bureau des alizés et de l'office des girouettes. Il ne sent pas sa force, parfois.
DATA_CMM_2737.de: Der Leiter der Abteilung Windwehen, Windbüro und Wetteramt. Hat die Tendenz, es manchmal zu übertreiben.
DATA_CMM_2737.it: Il capo del reparto Venti e Sbuffi dell'ufficio Meteo. Ha la tendenza ad esagerare un po'.
DATA_CMM_2737.es: Cuando se enfada provoca huracanes tremendos, pero tremendos.
DATA_CMM_2737.ko: 바람을 관리하는 과장님. 너무 열심히 일하는 것이 옥의 티다.
DATA_CMM_2737.zht: 天氣部門颳風課的課長。小小的缺點是偶爾會賣力過頭。
DATA_CMM_2737.zhs: 天气部门刮风课的课长。小小的缺点是偶尔会卖力过头。

DATA_CMM_2738.ja: You need these to fly through the skies freely and without sadness.
DATA_CMM_2738.en: You need these to fly through the skies freely and without sadness.
DATA_CMM_2738.fr: Elles sont indispensables pour planer librement dans les airs, au-dessus de la mêlée.
DATA_CMM_2738.de: Die braucht man, um frei und ohne Tristesse durch die Lüfte zu fliegen.
DATA_CMM_2738.es: El mejor complemento para volar por los aires, pero los humanos no las llevan de serie.
DATA_CMM_2738.ko: 슬픔이 없는 자유의 하늘로 날아가기 위해선 이게 필요하다.
DATA_CMM_2738.zht: 想飛上沒有哀傷的自由高空的話就需要這個。
DATA_CMM_2738.zhs: 想飞上没有哀伤的自由高空的话就需要这个。

DATA_CMM_2739.ja: He tells himself that a bird that can't fly isn't a bird, so maybe he isn't a bird himself.
DATA_CMM_2739.en: He tells himself that a bird that can't fly isn't a bird, so maybe he isn't a bird himself.
DATA_CMM_2739.fr: Il se dit qu'un oiseau qui ne peut pas voler n'est pas vraiment un oiseau, et qu'il a peut-être volé son identité.
DATA_CMM_2739.de: Er redet sich ein, dass ein Vogel, der nicht fliegen kann, kein Vogel ist, also ist er selbst wahrscheinlich kein Vogel.
DATA_CMM_2739.it: Si ripete di continuo che un uccello che non vola non è un uccello e quindi, forse, non è un uccello neppure lui.
DATA_CMM_2739.es: Se dice que los pájaros pueden volar; él no puede volar, ergo, no es un pájaro.
DATA_CMM_2739.ko: 날 수 없는 새는 새가 아니다라고 말하는 걸 봐선, 진짜 새는 아닐 지도 모른다.
DATA_CMM_2739.zht: 因為他自己說了「不會飛的鳥不算鳥」，所以也許真的不是鳥。
DATA_CMM_2739.zhs: 因为他自己说了「不会飞的鸟不算鸟」，所以也许真的不是鸟。

DATA_CMM_2740.ja: He wishes he could turn into a star this way.
DATA_CMM_2740.en: He wishes he could turn into a star this way.
DATA_CMM_2740.fr: Ils aimeraient se transformer en étoile.
DATA_CMM_2740.de: Er wünschte, er könnte so zu einem Planeten werden.
DATA_CMM_2740.it: Spera di diventare una stella un giorno.
DATA_CMM_2740.es: Su mayor ilusión sería poder rodar así por el universo.
DATA_CMM_2740.zht: 他好像想就這樣變成星星。
DATA_CMM_2740.zhs: 他好像想就这样变成星星。

DATA_CMM_2741.ja: His hobby is tackling snow-covered mountain paths.
DATA_CMM_2741.en: His hobby is tackling snow-covered mountain paths.
DATA_CMM_2741.fr: Il n'est jamais aussi heureux que lorsqu'il glisse sur des chemins enneigés.
DATA_CMM_2741.de: Es ist sein Hobby, schneebedeckte Bergpfade zu erobern.
DATA_CMM_2741.it: Il suo hobby è travolgere le montagnette di neve.
DATA_CMM_2741.es: Le encanta trazar diseños con su vehículo en la nieve fresca. Es bastante artístico.
DATA_CMM_2741.ko: 눈이 쌓인 고개를 정복하는 것이 취미인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2741.zht: 興趣是攻略積雪的山道。
DATA_CMM_2741.zhs: 兴趣是攻略积雪的山道。

DATA_CMM_2742.ja: The Hoshino's cat. He got a cramp in his leg the other day trying to lick the back of his thigh.
DATA_CMM_2742.en: The Hoshino's cat. He got a cramp in his leg the other day trying to lick the back of his thigh.
DATA_CMM_2742.fr: Le chat de la famille Hoshino. Il a attrapé une crampe en essayant de se lécher l'arrière de la patte.
DATA_CMM_2742.de: Der Kater der Familie Hoshino. Neulich hat er einen Krampf im Bein bekommen, als er versuchte, die Rückseite seines Oberschenkels zu lecken.
DATA_CMM_2742.it: Il gatto della famiglia Hoshino. L'altro giorno gli è venuto un crampo mentre cercava di leccarsi la coscia destra.
DATA_CMM_2742.es: Es el gato de la familia; en vez de ir a cazar ratones, se queda con la boca abierta esperando que entren solos.
DATA_CMM_2742.ko: 호시노 일가의 고양이. 일전에 허벅지를 핥으려다가 그만 다리에 쥐가 났었다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2742.zht: 星野家養的貓。之前想舔大腿內側卻抽筋了。
DATA_CMM_2742.zhs: 星野家养的猫。之前想舔大腿内侧却抽筋了。

DATA_CMM_2743.ja: He can fly faster than the wind, but that's dangerous when someone's riding him, so he holds back.
DATA_CMM_2743.en: He can fly faster than the wind, but that's dangerous when someone's riding him, so he holds back.
DATA_CMM_2743.fr: Il peut voler plus vite que le vent, mais comme il a peur pour ses passagers, il se déplace au trot.
DATA_CMM_2743.de: Er kann schneller fliegen als der Wind, aber das ist gefährlich, wenn jemand auf ihm reitet, also hält er sich zurück.
DATA_CMM_2743.it: Può volare più veloce del vento ma è pericoloso se qualcuno lo sta cavalcando per cui, di solito, si limita.
DATA_CMM_2743.es: Puede volar tan rápido como el viento, pero si lleva jinete debe contenerse un poco.
DATA_CMM_2743.ko: 바람보다 빨리 날 수 있지만, 사람을 태우고 있을 때는 위험하므로 자제하는 모양이다.
DATA_CMM_2743.zht: 能夠飛得比風快，但是載人的時候會降速忍耐，避免危險。
DATA_CMM_2743.zhs: 能够飞得比风快，但是载人的时候会降速忍耐，避免危险。

DATA_CMM_2744.ja: His walking route is always the same. So is the time he leaves and gets back.
DATA_CMM_2744.en: His walking route is always the same. So is the time he leaves and gets back.
DATA_CMM_2744.fr: Son itinéraire et les horaires de ses promenades ne varient jamais.
DATA_CMM_2744.de: Seine Laufstrecke ist immer gleich. Genauso wie die Zeit, zu der er losläuft und zurückkommt.
DATA_CMM_2744.it: Fa sempre la stessa passeggiata e ci mette sempre lo stesso tempo.
DATA_CMM_2744.es: Siempre sale de casa a la misma hora y sigue el mismo recorrido. Creemos que a su vida le falta emoción.
DATA_CMM_2744.ko: 산책할 때는 항상 함께 하는 모양이다. 외출과 귀가 시간도 항상 동일하다.
DATA_CMM_2744.zht: 散步的路線和出門、回家的時間一直都是固定的。
DATA_CMM_2744.zhs: 散步的路线和出门、回家的时间一直都是固定的。

DATA_CMM_2745.ja: This hasn't been used too much lately, except for dusting.
DATA_CMM_2745.en: This hasn't been used too much lately, except for dusting.
DATA_CMM_2745.fr: On l'a assez peu utilisé récemment, sauf pour épousseter.
DATA_CMM_2745.de: Wurde in letzter Zeit nicht allzu oft benutzt, außer zum Abstauben.
DATA_CMM_2745.it: Pianta che cresce vicino agli acquitrini.
DATA_CMM_2745.es: No se ha usado mucho últimamente, salvo para quitar el polvo.
DATA_CMM_2745.ko: 최근엔 먼지를 터는 것 외엔 의외로 사용하지 않는 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2745.zht: 最近除了撢灰塵以外好像不太常用。
DATA_CMM_2745.zhs: 最近除了撢灰尘以外好像不太常用。

DATA_CMM_2747.ja: A young boy with a big appetite who only wants some ice cream. This is his second time skating.
DATA_CMM_2747.en: A young boy with a big appetite who only wants some ice cream. This is his second time skating.
DATA_CMM_2747.fr: Jeune garçon à l'appétit redoutable, qui ne mange que de la glace. C'est la deuxième fois qu'il patine.
DATA_CMM_2747.de: Ein kleiner Junge mit großem Appetit, der nur ein Eis möchte. Er läuft zum zweiten Mal Schlittschuh.
DATA_CMM_2747.it: Un ragazzo giovane dal poderoso appetito ma che mangia quasi solo gelati. È la seconda volta che pattina in vita sua.
DATA_CMM_2747.es: Este chico no quiere comer otra cosa que helados; no sabemos cómo hace en invierno.
DATA_CMM_2747.ko: 갑자기 팥빙수가 먹고 싶어진 식욕왕성한 소년. 스케이트는 2번째.
DATA_CMM_2747.zht: 開始瘋狂想吃刨冰的食慾旺盛少年。第二次滑冰。
DATA_CMM_2747.zhs: 开始疯狂想吃刨冰的食欲旺盛少年。第二次滑冰。

DATA_CMM_2748.ja: A bright-eyed old man who loves passing younger people. He's proud of his healthy teeth.
DATA_CMM_2748.en: A bright-eyed old man who loves passing younger people. He's proud of his healthy teeth.
DATA_CMM_2748.fr: Vieil homme aux yeux brillants qui jubile lorsqu'il dépasse de plus jeunes patineurs. Il est fier de ses belles dents.
DATA_CMM_2748.de: Ein aufgeweckter alter Mann, der gerne an jüngeren Menschen vorbeigeht. Er ist stolz auf seine gesunden Zähne.
DATA_CMM_2748.it: Un nonnino sveglio che ama sorpassare i più giovani. Orgoglioso dei suoi denti in perfetta salute.
DATA_CMM_2748.es: Le encanta adelantar a los jovenzuelos y hacer más acrobacias que ellos.
DATA_CMM_2748.ko: 젊은 사람들을 추월하는 데에 쾌감을 느끼는 할아버지. 튼튼한 이빨이 자랑인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2748.zht: 最喜歡超車年輕人，朝氣蓬勃的老爺爺。最得意自己牙齒堅固。
DATA_CMM_2748.zhs: 最喜欢超车年轻人，朝气蓬勃的老爷爷。最得意自己牙齿坚固。

DATA_CMM_2749.ja: After everyone near her goes away, she's thinking about trying a triple loop.
DATA_CMM_2749.en: After everyone near her goes away, she's thinking about trying a triple loop.
DATA_CMM_2749.fr: Elle est en train de se dire qu'elle devrait essayer un triple axel quand tout le monde sera parti.
DATA_CMM_2749.de: Nachdem alle in ihrer Nähe verschwunden sind, überlegt sie, eine Dreifachschleife anzugehen.
DATA_CMM_2749.it: Appena se ne vanno tutti proverà un triplo salto mortale.
DATA_CMM_2749.es: Está cogiendo impulso para un triple axel; aparten a las criaturas.
DATA_CMM_2749.ko: 주위 사람들이 가고 나면 3회전 점프에 도전할 생각이다.
DATA_CMM_2749.zht: 他好像打算沒有人的話就挑戰三周跳。
DATA_CMM_2749.zhs: 他好像打算没有人的话就挑战三周跳。

DATA_CMM_2750.ja: The distant ancestor of Earthlings. His favorite food was mammoth, but only because pizza hadn't been invented yet.
DATA_CMM_2750.en: The distant ancestor of Earthlings. His favorite food was mammoth, but only because pizza hadn't been invented yet.
DATA_CMM_2750.fr: Lointain ancêtre des Terriens. Son plat préféré était le mammouth cru, mais seulement parce que la pizza n'existait pas.
DATA_CMM_2750.de: Der entfernte Vorfahr der Erdlinge. Sein Lieblingsessen war Mammut, aber nur, weil die Pizza noch nicht erfunden war.
DATA_CMM_2750.it: Un antenato dei terrestri. Il suo cibo preferito erano i mammut, ma solo perché la pizza non era ancora stata inventata.
DATA_CMM_2750.es: Su comida favorita era el mamut, pero eso es porque aún no se había inventado la pizza.
DATA_CMM_2750.ko: 아주 먼 옛날 살았다던 지구인의 선조. 매머드 고기를 먹어본 귀중한 존재.
DATA_CMM_2750.zht: 生活在遠古時代的地球人祖先。吃過長毛象，非常稀奇。
DATA_CMM_2750.zhs: 生活在远古时代的地球人祖先。吃过长毛象，非常稀奇。

DATA_CMM_2751.ja: A boy dissatisfied with grown-up rules. His dream is to become a politician.
DATA_CMM_2751.en: A boy dissatisfied with grown-up rules. His dream is to become a politician.
DATA_CMM_2751.fr: Il en a assez de toutes ces règles inventées par les adultes. Il veut changer le monde.
DATA_CMM_2751.de: Ein Junge, der unzufrieden mit den Regeln der Erwachsenen ist. Es ist sein Traum, Politiker zu werden.
DATA_CMM_2751.it: Un ragazzo deluso dalle regole del mondo degli adulti. Il suo sogno è di diventare un famoso politico.
DATA_CMM_2751.es: No le gusta cumplir las normas; de mayor, quiere ser político.
DATA_CMM_2751.ko: 어른들의 룰이 매우 불만스러운 소년. 장래 희망은 정치가라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2751.zht: 對大人的規定非常不滿的少年。將來的夢想是當政治家。
DATA_CMM_2751.zhs: 对大人的规定非常不满的少年。将来的梦想是当政治家。

DATA_CMM_2752.ja: Recently, this pair finally started breathing in unison.
DATA_CMM_2752.en: Recently, this pair finally started breathing in unison.
DATA_CMM_2752.fr: Ses deux têtes ont récemment commencé à respirer à l'unisson.
DATA_CMM_2752.de: Vor Kurzem hat das Paar endlich angefangen, im Gleichtakt zu atmen.
DATA_CMM_2752.it: Questa coppia di teste, di recente, ha cominciato a respirare all'unisono.
DATA_CMM_2752.es: Después de años de esfuerzo, ambas cabezas han conseguido por fin armonizar su respiración.
DATA_CMM_2752.ko: 최근 들어서야 겨우 호흡이 맞기 시작한 두 녀석.
DATA_CMM_2752.zht: 最近兩個終於開始有默契。
DATA_CMM_2752.zhs: 最近两个终于开始有默契。

DATA_CMM_2753.ja: This is the most comfortable way for him to sit.
DATA_CMM_2753.en: This is the most comfortable way for him to sit.
DATA_CMM_2753.fr: C'est la manière la plus confortable pour lui de s'asseoir.
DATA_CMM_2753.de: So kann er am bequemsten sitzen.
DATA_CMM_2753.es: Dice que está cómodo sentado así.
DATA_CMM_2753.ko: 어쩐지 이렇게 앉아야만 가장 마음이 안정된다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2753.zht: 不知道為什麼就是這個坐姿最舒服。
DATA_CMM_2753.zhs: 不知道为什么就是这个坐姿最舒服。

DATA_CMM_2754.ja: This guy is really good at not getting hit in dodgeball.
DATA_CMM_2754.en: This guy is really good at not getting hit in dodgeball.
DATA_CMM_2754.fr: Il est vraiment très fort pour éviter de se faire toucher au ballon prisonnier.
DATA_CMM_2754.de: Dieser Typ ist wirklich gut darin, beim Völkerball nicht getroffen zu werden.
DATA_CMM_2754.it: Bravissimo a schivare i colpi a palla avvelenata.
DATA_CMM_2754.es: Es muy bueno esquivando las pelotas, pero no sabemos si puede atraparlas.
DATA_CMM_2754.ko: 피구에서 굉장히 잘 피하는 것이 자랑인 듯.

DATA_CMM_2755.ja: She got in an argument with her brother over whether it's called "hugging your knees" or sitting "fetal position."
DATA_CMM_2755.en: She got in an argument with her brother over whether it's called "hugging your knees" or sitting "fetal position."
DATA_CMM_2755.fr: Elle s'est disputée avec son frère pour savoir si cette position s'appelait "s'accroupir" ou "être en position fœtale".
DATA_CMM_2755.de: Sie hat sich mit ihrem Bruder darüber gestritten, ob es „Knieumarmung" oder „Embryohaltung" heißt.
DATA_CMM_2755.it: Ha iniziato un litigio con suo fratello sulla questione: "Si dice sedersi rannicchiati o in posizione fetale?".
DATA_CMM_2755.es: Las horas en el gimnasio le están viniendo muy bien para defenderse de sus abusones hermanos.
DATA_CMM_2755.ko: 앉는 방법을 두고 오빠랑 크게 다투었다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2755.zht: 為了該抱膝坐還是盤腿坐跟哥哥吵架了。
DATA_CMM_2755.zhs: 为了该抱膝坐还是盘腿坐跟哥哥吵架了。

DATA_CMM_2756.ja: People are a little scared of her because her expression changes completely whenever she's "it" during tag.
DATA_CMM_2756.en: People are a little scared of her because her expression changes completely whenever she's "it" during tag.
DATA_CMM_2756.fr: Elle fait un peu peur aux gens parce qu'elle fait très bien le loup.
DATA_CMM_2756.de: Die anderen Kinder haben ein wenig Angst vor ihrem Gesichtsausdruck, wenn sie beim Fangenspielen „dran" ist.
DATA_CMM_2756.it: La gente è abbastanza spaventata da lei perché la sua faccia si tramuta in una maschera di rabbia agonistica quando gioca a qualcosa.
DATA_CMM_2756.es: La gente le tiene miedo por la cara que se le pone cuando le toca pillar.
DATA_CMM_2756.ko: 술래잡기에서 술래를 시키면 표정이 변하기 때문에, 다소 두려움의 대상이 된 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2756.zht: 玩鬼抓人當鬼，性情就會大變，所以其他人有點怕她。
DATA_CMM_2756.zhs: 玩鬼抓人当鬼，性情就会大变，所以其他人有点怕她。

DATA_CMM_2757.ja: A large elephant born in India. He wishes he had bigger ears, like his African cousins.
DATA_CMM_2757.en: A large elephant born in India. He wishes he had bigger ears, like his African cousins.
DATA_CMM_2757.fr: Un grand éléphant né en Inde. Il aimerait avoir de plus grandes oreilles, comme ses cousins africains.
DATA_CMM_2757.de: Ein großer, in Indien geborener Elefant. Er wünschte, er hätte so große Ohren wie seine afrikanischen Verwandten.
DATA_CMM_2757.it: Un elefante nato in India che invidia le orecchie enormi dei suoi cugini africani.
DATA_CMM_2757.es: Le gustaría tener las orejas grandes como su primo africano. Qué se le va a hacer...
DATA_CMM_2757.ko: 얼마 전까지는 아프리카 코끼리라 불리던 남아프리카 출신의 코끼리.
DATA_CMM_2757.zht: 不久之前都還被當成非洲象，卻是源於南美的大型象類。
DATA_CMM_2757.zhs: 不久之前都还被当成非洲象，却是源于南美的大型象类。

DATA_CMM_2758.ja: Whether changing light bulbs or wiping high windows, he's always getting ordered about.
DATA_CMM_2758.en: Whether changing light bulbs or wiping high windows, he's always getting ordered about.
DATA_CMM_2758.fr: Dès qu'il s'agit de changer des ampoules ou d'essuyer de hautes fenêtres, tout le monde s'intéresse à lui.
DATA_CMM_2758.de: Ob Wechseln von Glühbirnen oder Saubermachen hoher Fenster, ständig wird er herumkommandiert.
DATA_CMM_2758.it: Gli chiedono sempre di cambiare lampadine e prendere oggetti posti in alto.
DATA_CMM_2758.es: Ya sea para cambiar bombillas o bajar cajas, siempre le están pidiendo favores.
DATA_CMM_2758.ko: 형광등 교환이나, 윗 창문 환기 등, 나름대로 혹사당하는 친구이다.
DATA_CMM_2758.zht: 常被叫去換燈泡或擦上層的窗戶。
DATA_CMM_2758.zhs: 常被叫去换灯泡或擦上层的窗户。

DATA_CMM_2759.ja: He feels like he could see so much better when he put on the glasses.
DATA_CMM_2759.en: He feels like he could see so much better when he put on the glasses.
DATA_CMM_2759.fr: Il a l'impression de voir bien mieux avec ses lunettes sur le nez.
DATA_CMM_2759.de: Er fühlt sich, als könnte er besser sehen, wenn er die Brille trägt.
DATA_CMM_2759.it: Si sente come se fosse in grado di vedere molto meglio indossando degli occhiali.
DATA_CMM_2759.es: Siente que puede ver mucho mejor cuando se pone las gafas.
DATA_CMM_2759.ko: 안경을 쓴 그날부터 급격히 머리가 좋아진 것 같다.
DATA_CMM_2759.zht: 自從戴上眼鏡後，感覺腦袋好像也變好了。
DATA_CMM_2759.zhs: 自从戴上眼镜后，感觉脑袋好像也变好了。

DATA_CMM_2760.ja: The boss of the school. He loves playing soccer, and he's a great singer, too.
DATA_CMM_2760.en: The boss of the school. He loves playing soccer, and he's a great singer, too.
DATA_CMM_2760.fr: Le caïd de l'école. Il adore jouer au football, et il chante avec une belle voix.
DATA_CMM_2760.de: Der Boss der Schule. Er liebt es, Fußball zu spielen, und ist auch ein großartiger Sänger.
DATA_CMM_2760.it: Il capo della scuola, ama giocare a calcio ed è un grande cantante.
DATA_CMM_2760.es: El jefe de todo el colegio. Le gusta jugar al fútbol y cantar.
DATA_CMM_2760.ko: 야끼소바 빵을 매우 좋아하는 학교 짱. 노래도 잘 한다.
DATA_CMM_2760.zht: 最愛炒麵麵包的校園老大。他還很會唱歌。
DATA_CMM_2760.zhs: 最爱炒面面包的校园老大。他还很会唱歌。

DATA_CMM_2761.ja: An odd person who takes delicate care of his pinky nails and right nostril hairs.
DATA_CMM_2761.en: An odd person who takes delicate care of his pinky nails and right nostril hairs.
DATA_CMM_2761.fr: Drôle d'élève qui prend grand soin de ses ongles roses et des poils de sa narine droite.
DATA_CMM_2761.de: Ein schräger Bursche, der seine Fingernägel und die Haare im rechten Nasenloch sorgfältig kürzt.
DATA_CMM_2761.it: Un personaggio bizzarro che si prende estrema cura delle unghie dei suoi mignoli e dei peli della sua narice destra.
DATA_CMM_2761.es: Sabe que debería salir más, pero cuando lo invitan a una fiesta siempre dice que ya tiene otros planes.
DATA_CMM_2761.ko: 새끼 손가락 손톱과 우측 콧털을 매우 소중히 여기는 괴짜.
DATA_CMM_2761.zht: 非常寶貝小指指甲和右側鼻毛的怪人。
DATA_CMM_2761.zhs: 非常宝贝小指指甲和右侧鼻毛的怪人。

DATA_CMM_2762.ja: His mother put away all the winter clothes, so he had to wear short sleeves today.
DATA_CMM_2762.en: His mother put away all the winter clothes, so he had to wear short sleeves today.
DATA_CMM_2762.fr: Sa mère a rangé tous ses vêtements d'hiver, alors il a dû mettre un haut à manches courtes aujourd'hui.
DATA_CMM_2762.de: Seine Mutter hat alle seine Wintersachen verstaut, deswegen muss er heute etwas Kurzärmliges tragen.
DATA_CMM_2762.it: Sua madre ha messo via i vestiti invernali quindi ha solo maniche corte.
DATA_CMM_2762.es: Su madre ya ha guardado la ropa de invierno, así que tiene que ir en camiseta.
DATA_CMM_2762.ko: 엄마가 겨울 옷을 모두 정리해버린 탓에 어쩔 수 없이 반팔로 왔다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2762.zht: 媽媽不小心把冬衣都收起來了，不得不穿短袖。
DATA_CMM_2762.zhs: 妈妈不小心把冬衣都收起来了，不得不穿短袖。

DATA_CMM_2763.ja: A popular girl who's good at piano and ballet. The smell of her hair is the best smell in school, apparently.
DATA_CMM_2763.en: A popular girl who's good at piano and ballet. The smell of her hair is the best smell in school, apparently.
DATA_CMM_2763.fr: Elle doit sa popularité au fait qu'elle joue du piano et fait du ballet. La délicieuse odeur de ses cheveux parfume toute l'école.
DATA_CMM_2763.de: Ein beliebtes Mädchen, das gut Klavier spielt und Ballett tanzt. Offenbar duftet nichts in der Schule so gut wie ihre Haare.
DATA_CMM_2763.it: Una ragazza molto ammirata, bravissima con il piano e a ballare. Si dice che i suoi capelli profumino di rosa.
DATA_CMM_2763.es: Toca el piano y su cabello huele a jazmines. Es el sueño de cualquier romántico.
DATA_CMM_2763.ko: 피아노와 발레가 특기인 인기 만점의 소녀. 머리카락에서 나는 향이 학교 제일이라고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2763.zht: 擅長鋼琴與芭蕾舞的高人氣少女。聽說她的頭髮全校第一香。
DATA_CMM_2763.zhs: 擅长钢琴与芭蕾舞的高人气少女。听说她的头发全校第一香。

DATA_CMM_2764.ja: He's already prepared for today, so he's considering taking a nap.
DATA_CMM_2764.en: He's already prepared for today, so he's considering taking a nap.
DATA_CMM_2764.fr: Il est prêt pour aujourd'hui, alors il se demande s'il ne ferait pas une petite sieste.
DATA_CMM_2764.de: Er hat sich bereits auf den heutigen Tag vorbereitet und überlegt, ein Nickerchen zu halten.
DATA_CMM_2764.it: Ha già studiato tutto, quindi sta pensando di dormire un po'.
DATA_CMM_2764.es: Opina que ya ha hecho suficiente por hoy y que ya es hora de echarse una siesta.
DATA_CMM_2764.ko: 오늘은 예습을 미리 했기 때문에 잠이라도 자볼까 생각 중이다.
DATA_CMM_2764.zht: 因為有先預習過，所以正在考慮今天要不要打瞌睡。
DATA_CMM_2764.zhs: 因为有先预习过，所以正在考虑今天要不要打瞌睡。

DATA_CMM_2765.ja: She doesn't take any notes. She only ever writes letters.
DATA_CMM_2765.en: She doesn't take any notes. She only ever writes letters.
DATA_CMM_2765.fr: Elle ne prend pas de notes. Par contre, elle écrit énormément de lettres.
DATA_CMM_2765.de: Sie macht sich keine Notizen. Sie schreibt immer nur Briefe.
DATA_CMM_2765.it: Non scrive mai appunti, però scrive lettere splendide.
DATA_CMM_2765.es: Parece que toma apuntes, pero en realidad está escribiendo cartas a su amiga por correspondencia.
DATA_CMM_2765.ko: 필기도 안하고 편지만 잔뜩 쓰고 있다.
DATA_CMM_2765.zht: 完全不寫筆記只顧著寫信。
DATA_CMM_2765.zhs: 完全不写笔记只顾着写信。

DATA_CMM_2766.ja: He just remembered how he blew milk out his nose the other day. He's trying not to laugh now.
DATA_CMM_2766.en: He just remembered how he blew milk out his nose the other day. He's trying not to laugh now.
DATA_CMM_2766.fr: Il vient de se rappeler comment il a éternué du lait l'autre jour et il essaie de ne pas rire.
DATA_CMM_2766.de: Er hat sich gerade daran erinnert, wie ihm neulich die Milch aus der Nase spritzte. Jetzt versucht er, nicht zu lachen.
DATA_CMM_2766.it: Ride ricordandosi una barzelletta che ha sentito ieri ma che ha capito solo oggi.
DATA_CMM_2766.es: Está intentando no reírse por un chiste que le han contado antes. Es que no lo pillaba.
DATA_CMM_2766.ko: 일전에 우유를 뿜어댄 사건을 떠올리고는 웃음을 참고 있다.
DATA_CMM_2766.zht: 想起之前的噴牛奶事件，想笑卻強忍著不笑。
DATA_CMM_2766.zhs: 想起之前的喷牛奶事件，想笑却强忍着不笑。

DATA_CMM_2767.ja: He's considering complaining at morning assembly about how the guy in front of him has been nervously tapping his foot lately.
DATA_CMM_2767.en: He's considering complaining at morning assembly about how the guy in front of him has been nervously tapping his foot lately.
DATA_CMM_2767.fr: Il se demande s'il ne va pas dénoncer à la réunion quotidienne l'élève de devant qui tape nerveusement avec son pied.
DATA_CMM_2767.de: Sie überlegt, ob sie sich bei der Morgenversammlung darüber beschweren soll, dass der Typ vor ihr in letzter Zeit ständig nervös mit dem Fuß wippt.
DATA_CMM_2767.it: Sta pensando di lamentarsi all'assemblea scolastica perché il tizio seduto davanti continua a tamburellare con le dita.
DATA_CMM_2767.es: Quiere cambiarse de sitio porque el de atrás le da patadas constantemente.
DATA_CMM_2767.ko: 앞좌석 남학생의 다리 떨기가 심해진 것을 조회 시간에 어필할까말까 고민 중인 듯하다.
DATA_CMM_2767.zht: 前面的男同學抖腳越來越嚴重，正在考慮要不要在朝會時告狀。
DATA_CMM_2767.zhs: 前面的男同学抖脚越来越严重，正在考虑要不要在朝会时告状。

DATA_CMM_2768.ja: She's loved animals for a long time and seems to enjoy her work. She looks after the poisonous frogs.
DATA_CMM_2768.en: She's loved animals for a long time and seems to enjoy her work. She looks after the poisonous frogs.
DATA_CMM_2768.fr: Elle adore les animaux depuis longtemps et elle semble aimer son travail. Elle s'occupe des grenouilles venimeuses.
DATA_CMM_2768.de: Sie liebt schon immer Tiere und scheint ihre Arbeit zu genießen. Sie kümmert sich um die Giftfrösche.
DATA_CMM_2768.it: Ha sempre amato gli animali e ne ha fatto un lavoro. Si occupa delle rane velenose.
DATA_CMM_2768.es: Es buena en su trabajo porque le encantan los animales, incluso las ranas venenosas.
DATA_CMM_2768.ko: 예전부터 동물을 좋아했기 때문에 일이 재미있는 듯하다. 담당은 독개구리.
DATA_CMM_2768.zht: 因為他以前就很喜歡動物，所以工作做得快樂。負責餵食毒蛙。
DATA_CMM_2768.zhs: 因为他以前就很喜欢动物，所以工作做得快乐。负责喂食毒蛙。

DATA_CMM_2769.ja: He's resting because he stayed up too late last night playing videogames.
DATA_CMM_2769.en: He's resting because he stayed up too late last night playing videogames.
DATA_CMM_2769.fr: Il se repose parce qu'il a joué aux jeux vidéo tard, la nuit dernière.
DATA_CMM_2769.de: Er macht eine Pause, weil er gestern Nacht zu lange aufgeblieben ist und Videospiele gezockt hat.
DATA_CMM_2769.it: Riposa perché ieri ha fatto le ore piccole giocando ai videogiochi.
DATA_CMM_2769.es: Está cansado porque se quedó levantado hasta tarde jugando a videojuegos.
DATA_CMM_2769.ko: 어젯 밤 늦게까지 게임을 해서 부족해진 잠을 보충하고 있다.
DATA_CMM_2769.zht: 昨晚電動打太晚睡眠不足，正在休息。
DATA_CMM_2769.zhs: 昨晚电动打太晚睡眠不足，正在休息。

DATA_CMM_2770.ja: A somewhat palish prince. This must be the ancestor everyone's talking about. He's dead, but he's still flying merrily about.
DATA_CMM_2770.en: A somewhat palish prince. This must be the ancestor everyone's talking about. He's dead, but he's still flying merrily about.
DATA_CMM_2770.fr: Un Prince un peu pâlichon. Ce doit être lui, l'ancêtre dont tout le monde parle. Il est mort, mais il volette toujours joyeusement.
DATA_CMM_2770.de: Ein etwas blass aussehender Prinz. Das muss der Vorfahr sein, von dem alle reden. Er ist tot, fliegt aber immer noch fröhlich herum.
DATA_CMM_2770.it: Assomiglia al Principe, forse è un antenato, quello di cui tutti parlano. È trapassato ma svolazza ancora allegramente.
DATA_CMM_2770.es: Es como un príncipe, pero más pálido y con menos sentido práctico. En realidad, no tiene sentido práctico.
DATA_CMM_2770.ko: 왠지 하얗게 된 왕자. 이것이 소문으로만 듣던 조상님이다. 이미 죽었는데도 활발하게 날아다닌다.
DATA_CMM_2770.zht: 很像白色的王子。這就是傳說中的祖先。雖然已經過世了，卻很有活力地到處飛舞。
DATA_CMM_2770.zhs: 很像白色的王子。这就是传说中的祖先。虽然已经过世了，却很有活力地到处飞舞。

DATA_CMM_2771.ja: A king who flies via a secret technique that no one can imitate. He'd go faster if he used his feet.
DATA_CMM_2771.en: A king who flies via a secret technique that no one can imitate. He'd go faster if he used his feet.
DATA_CMM_2771.fr: Un Roi qui vole en utilisant une technique secrète que nul ne peut imiter. Il irait plus vite en marchant.
DATA_CMM_2771.de: Ein König, der dank einer Geheimtechnik, die niemand nachahmen kann, fliegen kann. Er würde schneller fliegen, wenn er dafür seine Füße benutzen würde.
DATA_CMM_2771.it: Un re che vola grazie a una tecnica segreta che nessuno può imitare. Andrebbe più veloce se usasse anche i piedi.
DATA_CMM_2771.es: Vuela gracias a una técnica secreta jamás revelada, pero nuestros pies son más veloces.
DATA_CMM_2771.ko: 누구도 흉내내지 못한 포즈로 나는 아바마마. 다리를 사용하면 더 빨라진다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2771.zht: 飛行方式無人能效仿的大王。聽說用上腳的話可以飛得更快。
DATA_CMM_2771.zhs: 飞行方式无人能效仿的大王。听说用上脚的话可以飞得更快。

DATA_CMM_2772.ja: Bathe yourself in this wonderful beam of light and you'll feel happy. It's dangerous to spend too long in it, though.
DATA_CMM_2772.en: Bathe yourself in this wonderful beam of light and you'll feel happy. It's dangerous to spend too long in it, though.
DATA_CMM_2772.fr: Baignez-vous dans cet incroyable rayon de lumière et vous serez heureux. C'est dangereux d'y rester trop longtemps.
DATA_CMM_2772.de: Taucht man in diesen wunderbaren Lichtstrahl ein, fühlt man sich glücklich. Es ist allerdings gefährlich, sich zu lange darin aufzuhalten.
DATA_CMM_2772.it: Basta immergersi in questo raggio di luce per sentirsi felici. Non bisogna abusarne però.
DATA_CMM_2772.es: Báñate en su luz y sentirás felicidad. Pero recuerda que antes o después tienes que salir.
DATA_CMM_2772.ko: 쬐면 행복한 기분으로 변하는 광선. 너무 많이 쬐면 의외로 위험하다고 한다.
DATA_CMM_2772.zht: 照到這種美妙的光線就會感到幸福。不過照太多好像很危險。
DATA_CMM_2772.zhs: 照到这种美妙的光线就会感到幸福。不过照太多好像很危险。

DATA_CMM_2773.ja: This timid fish is shocked by the smallest thing. It's probably best not to show him a mirror.
DATA_CMM_2773.en: This timid fish is shocked by the smallest thing. It's probably best not to show him a mirror.
DATA_CMM_2773.fr: Ce poisson timide est dérangé par les choses les plus insignifiantes. Mieux vaut le tenir éloigné des miroirs.
DATA_CMM_2773.de: Dieser ängstliche Fisch erschreckt sich schon bei der kleinsten Sache. Wahrscheinlich ist es in seinem Interesse, ihm keinen Spiegel zu zeigen.
DATA_CMM_2773.it: Questo pesce timido si spaventa con poco, sarebbe dunque meglio non presentargli mai lo specchio.
DATA_CMM_2773.es: Se asusta con cualquier cosa; será mejor que no le enseñes un espejo.
DATA_CMM_2773.ko: 별 것 아닌 것에도 쇼크를 받는 소심한 물고기. 어쨌든 거울은 절대 보여주지 말자.
DATA_CMM_2773.zht: 據說一點小事也會非常震驚的膽小魚類。總之還是別讓牠照到鏡子好。
DATA_CMM_2773.zhs: 据说一点小事也会非常震惊的胆小鱼类。总之还是别让它照到镜子好。

DATA_CMM_2774.ja: He looks like he's having fun, so you probably shouldn't point out the hole in the basket.
DATA_CMM_2774.en: He looks like he's having fun, so you probably shouldn't point out the hole in the basket.
DATA_CMM_2774.fr: Si vous ne voulez pas gâcher son plaisir, ne lui dites pas qu'il y a un trou dans le panier.
DATA_CMM_2774.de: Er sieht aus, als hätte er Spaß, also sollte man ihn besser nicht auf das Loch im Korb hinweisen.
DATA_CMM_2774.it: Sembra che si stia divertendo... In realtà è una gioia effimera: la palla è bucata.
DATA_CMM_2774.es: Parece que se divierte jugando aunque el cesto tenga el fondo roto.
DATA_CMM_2774.ko: 재밌어 보이니 바구니에 구멍이 나있는 건 일단 비밀로 해두자.
DATA_CMM_2774.zht: 因為他好像很樂在其中，所以還是別告訴他籃子破了吧。
DATA_CMM_2774.zhs: 因为他好像很乐在其中，所以还是别告诉他篮子破了吧。

DATA_CMM_2775.ja: When this man disappears, Jumboman always shows up. He says it's just a coincidence.
DATA_CMM_2775.en: When this man disappears, Jumboman always shows up. He says it's just a coincidence.
DATA_CMM_2775.fr: Quand il disparaît, Jumboman arrive. Il dit que c'est une simple coïncidence.
DATA_CMM_2775.de: Wenn dieser Mann verschwindet, taucht immer Jumboman auf. Er sagt, das sei reiner Zufall.
DATA_CMM_2775.it: Quando appare Jumboman questa persona sparisce sempre... dice che si tratta di una coincidenza.
DATA_CMM_2775.es: Cuando este se va, llega Jumbomán, aunque insiste en que es casualidad.
DATA_CMM_2775.ko: 이 사람이 사라지면 반드시 점보맨이 나타난다. 본인은 관계를 부정하고 있다.
DATA_CMM_2775.zht: 只要這個人消失，Jumbo man就一定會出現。不過本人否定兩者間的關聯。
DATA_CMM_2775.zhs: 只要这个人消失，Jumbo man就一定会出现。不过本人否定两者间的关联。

DATA_CMM_2776.ja: A woman who loves her grandkids, but not enough to eat them up. No one can beat her speedy sewing technique.
DATA_CMM_2776.en: A woman who loves her grandkids, but not enough to eat them up. No one can beat her speedy sewing technique.
